attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, building, or unit number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the location is situated.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the location is situated (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee paid to the location owner or manager for the right to film at this location. Excludes additional costs such as permits, insurance, or restoration.

attributes.name: fee_currency

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location owner requires specific production insurance coverage or certificates of insurance before filming can commence.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the location in decimal degrees format, used for mapping, navigation, and sunrise/sunset calculations.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the location used in production schedules and call sheets. Typically assigned by the location manager or production coordinator.

attributes.name: location_name

attributes.name: owner_contact_email

attributes.name: owner_contact_phone

attributes.name: parking_capacity
attributes.description: Number of vehicle parking spaces available at or near the location for crew, cast, and equipment trucks.

attributes.name: permit_authority

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was last modified in the system.

products.name: broadcast
products.description: This association product represents the broadcast event linking a production episode to a specific schedule slot. It captures the operational details of each individual airing of an episode, including transmission version, territory, platform, repeat sequencing, and rights window. Each record represents one broadcast occurrence of one episode in one slot, enabling multi-territory, multi-platform scheduling with version control and repeat tracking.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, a single production episode is broadcast multiple times across different schedule slots (primetime, repeat slots, different channels, international feeds, streaming platforms). Conversely, each schedule slot contains exactly one episode at a time, but the same slot position (e.g., Monday 8pm) will host different episodes over time. The business actively manages broadcast events as operational records, tracking which version of which episode airs in which slot, for which territory, on which platform, with specific rights windows and repeat sequencing.

attributes.name: production_episode_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the schedule slot in which this episode is broadcast

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this specific broadcast of the episode occurred or is scheduled to occur. Enables tracking of original vs repeat airings over time.

attributes.name: broadcast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this specific broadcast event. Tracks whether the scheduled broadcast occurred as planned or was preempted/cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this broadcast assignment was created in the scheduling system. Audit trail for scheduling operations.

attributes.name: edit_type
attributes.description: Classification of editorial modifications applied for this specific broadcast (content edits for standards, time compression, localization). Varies by territory and daypart.

attributes.name: platform_type
attributes.description: Distribution platform on which this broadcast occurs. Same episode may be scheduled across linear TV, streaming simulcast, and VOD platforms with different rights and versions.

attributes.name: repeat_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of how many times this episode has been broadcast on this channel/platform. 0 = original airing, 1+ = repeat. Critical for rights management and audience measurement.

products.name: episode_sponsorship
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between production_episode and sponsorship. It captures the specific placement, fulfillment, and integration details for each sponsorship deal applied to each episode. Each record links one production_episode to one sponsorship with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, including placement timecodes, fulfillment tracking, and integration scene references.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, a single episode can have multiple sponsorship deals (e.g., Brand A sponsors the opening billboard, Brand B sponsors the closing billboard, Brand C has product integration in scenes 5-7), and a single sponsorship deal (especially for series or season-level sponsorships) applies to multiple episodes across the season or series run. The business actively manages each episode-sponsorship placement as a distinct fulfillment obligation with specific timecodes, placement types, verification status, and impression tracking.

products.name: project_sponsorship
products.description: This association product represents the commercial partnership between a content production project and an advertising client who provides funding or co-production support. It captures the financial terms, partnership structure, and deliverable obligations that exist only in the context of this specific project-advertiser relationship. Each record links one production project to one advertiser with attributes governing the sponsorship arrangement.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting, content production projects frequently secure funding from multiple advertising partners simultaneously (e.g., a documentary series with automotive, tech, and beverage sponsors), and advertisers invest in multiple production projects across their portfolio. The business actively manages these sponsorship partnerships as distinct operational entities with specific financial terms, deliverable obligations, approval rights, and partnership statuses that belong to neither the project nor the advertiser alone.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Channels are profit centers for revenue and cost tracking. Executive dashboards, board reporting, segment EBITDA, and management accounting all depend on channel-to-profit-center mapping. Core financi

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: Channels transmitted via specific equipment - critical for signal path management, maintenance coordination, outage root cause analysis, and equipment performance tracking. Supports NOC operations and

attributes.name: ad_break_duration_sec
attributes.description: Default duration in seconds of a standard ad pod (ad break) for this channel. Used by Wide Orbit traffic system for ad scheduling, inventory management, and avail calculation. Typical values are 120 (2 minutes) or 180 (3 minutes).
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; IAB Ad Pod Standards; Internal Ad Operations Policy

attributes.name: affiliate_network_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the parent broadcast network or affiliate group this channel belongs to (e.g., NBC, CBS, ABC, FOX). Used for network affiliation reporting, retransmission consent negotiations, and carriage fee calculations.
attributes.references: FCC Network Affiliation Rules; Retransmission Consent Agreements; Salesforce Media Cloud Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: blackout_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast blackout restrictions are applicable to this channel. When true, blackout rules must be enforced during playout and OTT delivery to restrict content in specific geographic markets per rights agreements.
attributes.references: FCC Sports Blackout Rules (47 CFR 76.111); Rightsline Rights and Availabilities; Internal Rights Management Policy

attributes.name: broadcast_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the channel's primary broadcast timezone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Governs daypart definitions, schedule generation, and EPG time display for the channel's primary market.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ATSC A/65 PSIP; Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Configuration

attributes.name: call_sign
attributes.description: Officially assigned broadcast call sign (e.g., WABC, KNBC) that uniquely identifies the station with the regulatory authority. Serves as the primary external business identifier for the channel as registered with the FCC or Ofcom.
attributes.references: Federal Communications Commission (FCC) Call Sign Registry; Ofcom Broadcasting Licence

attributes.name: carriage_fee_usd
attributes.description: The per-subscriber monthly carriage fee in US dollars charged to MVPDs and vMVPDs for distributing this channel. Commercially sensitive financial data used in revenue assurance, financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Internal Revenue Assurance Policy; SOX Financial Reporting Compliance

attributes.name: cdn_origin_url
attributes.description: The origin ingest URL configured in Akamai CDN for this channel's live stream delivery. Used for OTT/streaming distribution, ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming) packaging, and CDN cache configuration.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN Configuration; HLS RFC 8216; ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH

attributes.name: channel_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the channel. Drives playout automation eligibility, EPG publication, and scheduling availability in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Channel Management; Internal Broadcast Operations Standard

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the channel by its distribution and scheduling model. Linear indicates traditional scheduled broadcast; simulcast indicates simultaneous multi-platform broadcast; pop-up indicates temporary event channel; FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) indicates ad-supported streaming linear channel; VOD indicates on-demand programming window channel.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Glossary; ATSC Standards; Internal Channel Classification Policy

attributes.name: content_rating_system
attributes.description: Default content advisory rating applied to the channel's programming under the applicable rating system (e.g., US TV Parental Guidelines). Drives V-chip compliance, parental control enforcement, and COPPA-regulated children's content restrictions.
attributes.references: FCC V-Chip / TV Parental Guidelines; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); Motion Picture Association (MPA) Rating System

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where the channel is licensed and originates its broadcast signal (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, rights windowing, and blackout rule enforcement.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FCC Broadcast Licensing; Ofcom Broadcasting Licence; European Audiovisual Observatory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel record was first created in the system of record. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: dai_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) is active for this channel, enabling server-side ad replacement for OTT/streaming delivery. Drives ad operations workflow in Wide Orbit and integration with DAI platforms.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35; Wide Orbit DAI Integration

attributes.name: dalet_channel_code
attributes.description: The channel identifier as configured in Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system. Used to link this channel to content ingest workflows, metadata management, archive operations, and rundown generation in Dalet.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM System; Internal Digital Asset Management Policy

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this channel was or is scheduled to be permanently decommissioned and removed from broadcast. Nullable for active channels. Used for lifecycle management, licence surrender, and EPG removal planning.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licence Surrender; Ofcom Licence Revocation; Internal Channel Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: drm_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Digital Rights Management (DRM) encryption is applied to this channel's content stream for OTT/streaming delivery. Drives content protection configuration in Akamai CDN and subscriber entitlement enforcement in Zuora.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Protection Standards; Akamai DRM Integration; ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH

attributes.name: epg_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is published to the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) for audience-facing schedule display. Channels under testing or decommissioned may be excluded from EPG publication.
attributes.references: DVB SI/EPG Standard EN 300 468; ATSC A/65 PSIP; Internal EPG Publication Policy

attributes.name: genre
attributes.description: Primary programming genre classification of the channel (e.g., News, Sports, Entertainment, Children, Documentary, Music). Used for EPG categorization, audience segmentation, advertising sales targeting, and Nielsen ratings demographic alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: News|Sports|Entertainment|Children|Documentary|Music|General|Movies|Lifestyle|Education — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DVB Content Descriptor; ATSC A/65 Content Advisory; Nielsen Media Research Genre Classification

attributes.name: hls_stream_url
attributes.description: The HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) manifest URL for this channel's live stream, used for Apple device and browser-based OTT delivery via Akamai CDN. Supports ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming) for adaptive quality delivery.
attributes.references: HLS RFC 8216; Akamai CDN Streaming; ATSC 3.0 IP Delivery

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date on which this channel first went live and began broadcasting. Used for channel lifecycle tracking, anniversary reporting, regulatory licence history, and audience growth analytics.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licence; Ofcom Broadcasting Licence; Internal Channel Master Record

attributes.name: logical_channel_number
attributes.description: The numeric channel position assigned to this channel in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and set-top box channel lineup. Used by MVPDs and vMVPDs for channel navigation and must-carry compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DVB Project Logical Channel Descriptor; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard; MVPD Carriage Agreement

attributes.name: max_ad_load_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of total broadcast hour that may be allocated to advertising on this channel. Governs inventory capacity planning, FCC commercial limits compliance (children's programming), and upfront/scatter market sales commitments.
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act (47 CFR 73.670); IAB Ad Load Guidelines; Wide Orbit Inventory Management

attributes.name: mediafirst_channel_code
attributes.description: The channel identifier as configured in the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system. Used to link this master channel record to the playout engine for schedule execution, automation triggers, graphics insertion, and failover configuration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Channel Management API; Internal Playout Operations Standard

attributes.name: mpeg_dash_stream_url
attributes.description: The MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) manifest URL for this channel's live stream, used for Android, Smart TV, and cross-platform OTT delivery via Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH; Akamai CDN Streaming; DVB-DASH

attributes.name: must_carry_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is subject to must-carry obligations requiring MVPDs to include it in their channel lineup. Drives compliance reporting and carriage fee negotiations.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Cable Television Consumer Protection and Competition Act 1992

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the broadcast network or channel brand (e.g., CNN, BBC One, ESPN). Used as the primary identity label for display in EPG, scheduling tools, and audience-facing interfaces.
attributes.references: Internal Channel Master; Ericsson MediaFirst Channel Configuration

attributes.name: nielsen_station_code
attributes.description: The unique station identifier assigned by Nielsen Media Research for audience measurement, ratings reporting, and GRP/TRP calculations. Links this channel to Nielsen ratings data for advertising sales and audience analytics.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Station Index; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: playout_automation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel is configured for automated playout via Ericsson MediaFirst. When true, schedule execution, ad insertion cues, and failover are handled automatically. When false, manual playout operation is required.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Automation Configuration; Internal Broadcast Operations SLA

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the primary audio language of the channel's programming (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'fra' for French). Used for EPG metadata, accessibility compliance, and audience targeting.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 639-2 Language Codes; FCC Accessibility Requirements

attributes.name: resolution_profile
attributes.description: Video resolution classification of the channel output. SD (Standard Definition), HD (High Definition 1080i/720p), UHD (Ultra High Definition 4K/8K). Determines encoding profiles, CDN delivery tiers, and subscriber package eligibility.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Part 4; DVB-T2 EN 302 755; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4 AVC/HEVC

attributes.name: retransmission_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel requires retransmission consent from MVPDs before rebroadcasting. Drives carriage fee negotiations and compliance with FCC retransmission consent rules.
attributes.references: FCC Retransmission Consent Rules (47 CFR 76.64); Cable Television Consumer Protection and Competition Act 1992

attributes.name: scte35_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers are active on this channel for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI). SCTE-35 signals define ad pod boundaries and splice points used by Wide Orbit traffic system and DAI platforms.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; IAB DAI Guidelines; Wide Orbit Traffic System Integration

attributes.name: transmission_standard
attributes.description: Technical broadcast transmission standard used to deliver the channel signal. ATSC and ATSC 3.0 apply to North American over-the-air broadcast; DVB-T/T2 and DVB-S/S2 apply to European terrestrial and satellite; QAM applies to cable distribution; IP applies to OTT/streaming delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ATSC|ATSC3|DVB-T|DVB-T2|DVB-S|DVB-S2|QAM|IP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATSC Standards A/53, A/322; DVB Project DVB-T2 EN 302 755; SCTE Standards; ISO/IEC 13818

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: wide_orbit_station_code
attributes.description: The station code as configured in the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system. Used to link this channel master record to ad scheduling, sales orders, affidavit generation, and invoicing workflows in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Internal Ad Operations Integration Standard

products.name: daypart
products.description: Reference definition of named broadcast time segments (e.g., Early Morning, Morning Drive, Daytime, Prime Time, Late Fringe, Overnight) used to govern ad pricing, content scheduling, and audience targeting. Captures daypart code, start/end time boundaries, day-of-week applicability, audience demographic profile, and rate multiplier. Aligns with Nielsen daypart taxonomy and Wide Orbit traffic system.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Primary key for daypart

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Business justification: Daypart-specific DAI rules enforce regulatory and business constraints (COPPA restrictions in children's dayparts, primetime ad load caps, scatter vs upfront eligibility). Technical operations configu

attributes.name: ad_pod_max_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ad Pod Maximum Count Per Hour
attributes.description: The maximum number of ad pods (commercial breaks) permitted per hour within this daypart. Used by Wide Orbit for ad scheduling capacity planning and by Ericsson MediaFirst for playout rundown validation. Supports FCC commercial time compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 73 (Commercial Limits); Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: ad_pod_max_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The maximum allowable total duration in seconds for an ad pod (group of ads in a break) within this daypart. Governs commercial break length limits enforced by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation and Wide Orbit ad scheduling. Aligns with FCC commercial time limits for children's programming dayparts.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 73 (Commercial Limits); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: applicable_days
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of days of the week on which this daypart definition applies, using three-letter abbreviations (e.g., MON|TUE|WED|THU|FRI for weekday dayparts, SAT|SUN for weekend). Governs schedule generation in Ericsson MediaFirst and ad inventory availability in Wide Orbit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MON|TUE|WED|THU|FRI|SAT|SUN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: avg_audience_000
attributes.description: The average audience size in thousands of viewers (000s) expected during this daypart, based on Nielsen Media Research Platform historical ratings data. Used as the principal quantitative measurement of daypart audience value for ad sales, GRP calculations, and content scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: base_cpm_usd
attributes.description: The baseline CPM (Cost Per Mille) rate in US dollars for advertising inventory sold within this daypart, before application of the rate_multiplier or audience demographic adjustments. Represents the floor pricing reference used in Salesforce Media Cloud upfront and scatter market proposals.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: blackout_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast blackout restrictions can be applied to content scheduled within this daypart. When True, blackout rules (e.g., sports rights geographic exclusivity) may be enforced by the distribution platform. Aligns with must-carry and retransmission consent obligations.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 76 (Blackout Rules); Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: content_rating_restriction
attributes.description: The maximum permissible TV content rating (per MPA/TV Parental Guidelines) for programming scheduled within this daypart. Enforces content appropriateness standards — e.g., Prime Time may allow up to TV-14, while Children's dayparts are restricted to TV-Y or TV-Y7. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst for schedule validation.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines; FCC 47 CFR Part 73; Ofcom Broadcasting Code

attributes.name: coppa_restricted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this daypart is subject to COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) restrictions due to programming directed at children under 13. When True, audience data collection, behavioral targeting, and ad pod duration limits are governed by COPPA compliance rules and FCC children's television regulations.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); FCC Children's Television Act; FCC 47 CFR Part 73

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this daypart record was first created in the scheduling domain data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and Silver layer ingestion reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this daypart is eligible for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) on OTT and streaming platforms. When True, ad pods within this daypart can be dynamically replaced with targeted ads during streaming delivery through Akamai CDN, enabling addressable advertising revenue.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; SCTE-35; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: day_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the day-of-week applicability for the daypart. 'weekday' covers Monday–Friday, 'weekend' covers Saturday–Sunday, 'all_week' applies every day, and 'holiday' applies on designated public holidays. Used for rate card segmentation and audience demographic profiling.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: daypart_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric business identifier for the daypart, used as the externally-known reference key across Wide Orbit traffic system, Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation, and Salesforce Media Cloud ad sales. Examples: PRIME, EARLY_AM, DAYTIME, LATE_FRINGE, OVERNIGHT. Aligns with Nielsen daypart taxonomy codes.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: daypart_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the daypart, including its programming characteristics, audience profile, and scheduling context. Used for internal documentation, Salesforce Media Cloud proposal narratives, and EPG metadata. Example: 'Prime Time (8PM-11PM) — highest-rated evening programming block targeting Adults 18-49.'

attributes.name: daypart_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the daypart segment as displayed in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG), ad sales proposals, and scheduling interfaces. Examples: Early Morning, Morning Drive, Daytime, Prime Time, Late Fringe, Overnight.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: daypart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the daypart definition. 'active' indicates the daypart is in operational use for scheduling and ad sales. 'inactive' means temporarily suspended. 'draft' means under review before activation. 'deprecated' means retired from use but retained for historical reference.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: daypart_type
attributes.description: Classifies the daypart by broadcast delivery mode. 'linear' applies to traditional scheduled broadcast, 'non_linear' to on-demand programming windows, 'simulcast' to simultaneous multi-platform broadcast segments, and 'vod_window' to VOD availability windows governed by this daypart definition.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB-SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the daypart window expressed in minutes. Derived from start_time and end_time boundaries but stored explicitly for scheduling calculations, ad inventory capacity planning, and rate card generation in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this daypart definition becomes effective for scheduling and ad sales operations. Supports versioned daypart definitions where boundaries or rates change seasonally or following regulatory updates. Used in Wide Orbit and Ericsson MediaFirst schedule generation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this daypart definition expires and is no longer applicable for scheduling and ad sales. Null indicates an open-ended definition with no planned expiry. Supports seasonal daypart adjustments (e.g., summer schedule changes) and regulatory compliance updates.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: The clock time (HH:mm:ss, 24-hour or extended broadcast-day format) at which the daypart ends. Supports broadcast day overflow notation (e.g., 25:59:59 for content airing past midnight within the same broadcast day). Paired with start_time to define the daypart boundary.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65; Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: epg_display_order
attributes.description: The sequential display order of this daypart within the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) channel grid, used by Ericsson MediaFirst for schedule presentation and by digital EPG distribution systems. Lower values appear earlier in the broadcast day display.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB-SI EN 300 468; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: grp_index
attributes.description: The GRP (Gross Rating Point) index value representing the expected audience delivery weight for this daypart relative to the total broadcast day. Used in media planning, upfront negotiations, and scatter market pricing. Sourced from Nielsen Media Research Platform ratings data.

attributes.name: hut_level
attributes.description: The HUT (Homes Using Television) percentage representing the proportion of TV households actively viewing during this daypart. A key audience measurement metric sourced from Nielsen Media Research Platform, used to benchmark daypart audience potential and inform ad pricing.

attributes.name: makegood_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether compensatory ad spots (makegoods) can be scheduled within this daypart to fulfill underdelivered audience guarantees from other dayparts. Governs Wide Orbit makegood scheduling logic and Salesforce Media Cloud campaign reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: nielsen_daypart_code
attributes.description: The standardized daypart code as defined by Nielsen Media Research taxonomy (e.g., PRIME, EARLY_NEWS, LATE_NEWS, DAYTIME, EARLY_FRINGE, LATE_FRINGE, OVERNIGHT). Used to align internal scheduling definitions with Nielsen audience measurement reports and ratings data ingested from the Nielsen Media Research Platform.

attributes.name: rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Pricing multiplier applied to the base CPM (Cost Per Mille) rate card for ad inventory sold within this daypart. A value of 1.0000 represents the base rate; Prime Time typically carries a multiplier greater than 1.0 (e.g., 2.5000), while Overnight may be below 1.0 (e.g., 0.3000). Used in Salesforce Media Cloud proposal generation and Wide Orbit billing.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: scatter_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether unsold ad inventory within this daypart is available for scatter market (last-minute) sales. Governs Wide Orbit inventory availability rules for short-notice ad placement and makegood scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: scte35_cue_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers are enabled for ad break signaling within this daypart. When True, Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation inserts SCTE-35 splice_insert commands at ad pod boundaries, enabling Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) for OTT and streaming distribution via Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: simulcast_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether content scheduled in this daypart is eligible for simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast) across linear, OTT, and digital channels. When True, Ericsson MediaFirst can trigger simulcast distribution workflows for this daypart's programming.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65; DVB-SI EN 300 468; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: The clock time (HH:mm:ss, 24-hour format) at which the daypart begins each applicable day. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst for automated playout boundary detection and by Wide Orbit for ad scheduling slot assignment. Stored as STRING to support broadcast day conventions (e.g., 25:00:00 for post-midnight).
attributes.references: ATSC A/65; Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: sweeps_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this daypart definition has special audience measurement and programming rules applied during Nielsen sweeps periods (intensive ratings measurement periods in February, May, July, and November). When True, enhanced content scheduling and ad pricing rules may apply.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Sweeps Measurement Periods

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Primary audience demographic profile associated with this daypart, expressed using Nielsen standard demographic notation (e.g., A18-49, W25-54, M18-34, HH, P2+). Drives audience targeting in ad sales proposals, GRP/TRP calculations, and content scheduling decisions. Sourced from Nielsen Media Research Platform audience measurement data.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Taxonomy; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: timezone_code
attributes.description: The IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London) governing the clock boundaries of this daypart. Critical for multi-market broadcast operations where the same daypart definition must be applied across different time zones for network affiliates and regional channels.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ATSC A/65; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this daypart record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: upfront_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether ad inventory within this daypart is offered during the upfront advance advertising sales event. Prime Time and key dayparts are typically upfront-eligible. Drives Salesforce Media Cloud opportunity and proposal configuration for annual upfront sales cycles.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; Salesforce Media Cloud

attributes.name: wide_orbit_daypart_code
attributes.description: The corresponding daypart identifier as configured in the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system. Used to reconcile internal daypart definitions with ad scheduling, sales orders, and affidavit records in Wide Orbit. Enables cross-system traceability for revenue assurance.

products.name: program_schedule
products.description: The authoritative linear channel grid (EPG backbone) representing the planned broadcast schedule for a channel on a given broadcast date. Captures schedule version, channel, broadcast date, schedule status (draft, approved, transmitted, as-run), total runtime, blackout flags, must-carry compliance status, and the Ericsson MediaFirst automation rundown reference. One record per channel per broadcast day per schedule version.

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the program schedule record. One record per channel per broadcast date per schedule version. This is the primary key of the program_schedule data product.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Schedules executed at specific facilities - required for playout coordination, facility capacity planning, multi-site broadcast operations, and as-run log reconciliation. Essential for distributed bro

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Program schedules must comply with license terms including children's programming quotas, must-carry requirements, and public interest obligations. Required for FCC quarterly compliance reports and li

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel for which this schedule is defined. Identifies the linear channel in the channel master (e.g., NBC East, CNN HD). Drives Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation for the specific channel.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Program schedules incur production and transmission costs tracked to cost centers. Schedule cost reconciliation, budget variance analysis, and production accounting require this mapping. Standard broa

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Program schedules can be invoiced as sponsored blocks or packaged programming deals (e.g., branded content blocks, sponsored dayparts). Required for package billing, sponsorship revenue recognition, a

attributes.name: scheduler_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Program schedules are created by specific scheduling coordinators. Critical for workflow tracking, quality control, and accountability when schedule conflicts or errors occur. Standard broadcast traff

attributes.name: ad_pod_count
attributes.description: Total number of ad pods (groups of ads in a break) planned in the schedule for this channel day. An ad pod is a contiguous block of commercial spots within a program break. Used for inventory planning and SCTE-35 cue marker validation.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the programming operations staff member who approved this schedule version. Required for audit trail and accountability in the schedule approval workflow. Populated when schedule_status transitions to 'approved'.
attributes.references: Internal Schedule Approval Workflow; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule version was formally approved by the programming team. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'approved' status. Used for SLA tracking of schedule readiness lead time before broadcast date.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; Internal SLA Compliance Standard

attributes.name: as_run_confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the as-run log was confirmed and reconciled against the planned schedule. Marks the transition to 'as-run' status. Used for Wide Orbit affidavit generation, Nielsen ratings reconciliation, and revenue assurance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Nielsen Media Research Platform

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any geographic broadcast blackout restriction applies to this schedule. True = one or more programs in this schedule are subject to blackout in specific markets (e.g., sports rights blackout). Triggers downstream blackout enforcement in distribution and CDN systems.
attributes.references: FCC Syndicated Exclusivity and Network Non-Duplication Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this program schedule is planned and transmitted. Represents the broadcast day (which may span midnight for overnight programming). Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd per enterprise date convention.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: broadcast_standard
attributes.description: The broadcast technical standard under which this schedule is transmitted. ATSC = Advanced Television Systems Committee (North America); DVB = Digital Video Broadcasting (Europe/international); ISDB = Integrated Services Digital Broadcasting (Japan/Brazil); NTSC/PAL = legacy analog standards.
attributes.references: ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee; DVB Project Digital Video Broadcasting; ISO/IEC 13818 MPEG-2

attributes.name: content_rating_advisory
attributes.description: The highest content rating advisory applicable to any program in this schedule for the broadcast day. Used for parental control systems, V-chip compliance, and FCC content standards reporting. Ratings follow the TV Parental Guidelines system mandated by the FCC.
attributes.references: FCC V-Chip and TV Ratings Rules (47 CFR Part 15); Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; TV Parental Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this program schedule record was first created in the system. Represents the business event time of schedule initiation. Used for audit trail, SLA measurement of schedule build lead time, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Internal Controls; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dalet_workflow_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Dalet Galaxy media asset management workflow instance associated with this schedule's content preparation and ingest activities. Links the schedule to the MAM workflow for asset readiness validation prior to playout.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: daypart_code
attributes.description: Primary daypart classification for the schedule's dominant programming block. Daypart is the time segment of the broadcast day used for audience measurement, ad sales, and programming strategy. Values align with Nielsen daypart definitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EARLY_MORNING|MORNING|DAYTIME|EARLY_FRINGE|PRIME_ACCESS|PRIME|LATE_NEWS|LATE_FRINGE|OVERNIGHT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Definitions; IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: emergency_alert_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether the schedule has been configured with Emergency Alert System (EAS) interrupt capability for this broadcast date. True = EAS interrupt slots are provisioned in the Ericsson MediaFirst rundown. Required for FCC EAS compliance.
attributes.references: FCC Emergency Alert System Rules (47 CFR Part 11); Federal Communications Commission (FCC)

attributes.name: epg_grid_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned to this schedule in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) distribution system. Used by downstream EPG aggregators, set-top box providers, and digital guide services to reference the channel day grid. Aligns with DVB SI/EIT table identifiers.
attributes.references: DVB Project ETSI EN 300 468 Service Information; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard

attributes.name: fcc_children_programming_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule meets FCC children's educational and informational (E/I) programming requirements for the broadcast date. True = minimum required hours of qualifying children's programming are scheduled. Required for FCC license renewal compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act (47 CFR Part 73.671); COPPA Children's Online Privacy Protection Act; Federal Communications Commission (FCC)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this program schedule record. Tracks the last update across any field change, version increment, or status transition. Used for change detection in downstream EPG distribution and playout systems.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: mediafirst_rundown_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the automation rundown object in Ericsson MediaFirst that corresponds to this program schedule. Used to reconcile the planned schedule with the playout automation system's rundown for failover and as-run log generation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: must_carry_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule satisfies must-carry obligations for the channel on this broadcast date. Must-carry is the mandatory channel inclusion requirement imposed on cable and satellite MVPDs by the FCC. True = compliant; False = compliance issue requiring resolution.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76, Subpart D); Federal Communications Commission (FCC)

attributes.name: playout_failover_mode
attributes.description: Indicates the Ericsson MediaFirst playout failover configuration active for this schedule. 'primary' = normal automated playout; 'backup' = failover to backup playout server; 'manual_override' = operator has taken manual control of playout. Used for SLA and incident reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Internal SLA Standard

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Aggregate rights clearance status for all programs in this schedule as verified against Rightsline rights management. 'cleared' = all programs have confirmed broadcast rights for this date and territory; 'pending' = clearance in progress; 'partial' = some programs cleared; 'failed' = one or more rights conflicts identified.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Syndicated Exclusivity Rules (47 CFR Part 76)

attributes.name: schedule_end_time
attributes.description: The planned end timestamp of the broadcast schedule for this channel day, including timezone offset. Typically 23:59:59 local broadcast time but may extend past midnight for overnight programming blocks. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the schedule, typically combining channel name and broadcast date (e.g., 'CNN-HD 2024-06-15 v2'). Used by scheduling operations staff to identify and reference the schedule in Ericsson MediaFirst and Wide Orbit Traffic systems.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by scheduling staff regarding special instructions, exceptions, or context for this schedule (e.g., 'Breaking news override applied to 8PM slot', 'Live sports event extends prime block by 30 min'). Not used for automated processing.

attributes.name: schedule_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this schedule was generated. 'manual' = built by scheduling staff; 'automated' = generated by Ericsson MediaFirst automated schedule engine; 'imported' = ingested from an external programming supplier or network feed; 'template' = derived from a recurring schedule template.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: schedule_start_time
attributes.description: The planned start timestamp of the broadcast schedule for this channel day, including timezone offset. Typically 00:00:00 local broadcast time but may differ for overnight schedules that begin at a non-midnight boundary. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the program schedule. 'draft' = initial build in progress; 'approved' = signed off by programming team; 'transmitted' = sent to Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation; 'as-run' = actual broadcast log confirmed; 'cancelled' = schedule voided and replaced.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Internal Scheduling Workflow Standard

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule by programming strategy type. 'standard' = regular broadcast day; 'special_event' = live event or breaking news override; 'holiday' = holiday programming grid; 'sweeps' = Nielsen sweeps period intensive ratings schedule; 'upfront_preview' = advance advertising sales event programming.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Sweeps Period Definitions; Internal Programming Strategy Standard

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for the schedule on a given channel and broadcast date. Enables tracking of schedule revisions from initial draft through final as-run. Version 1 is the initial draft; each approved revision increments the version.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; Internal Schedule Versioning Standard

attributes.name: scte35_cue_count
attributes.description: Total number of SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers embedded in the schedule for this channel day. SCTE-35 cues signal ad break opportunities for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) in both linear and OTT streams. Used to validate DAI readiness.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is configured for simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast). True = the schedule is transmitted concurrently across linear broadcast and one or more OTT/streaming platforms. Drives Ericsson MediaFirst simulcast automation configuration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_platform_count
attributes.description: Number of platforms on which this schedule is simultaneously broadcast when simulcast_flag is True. Used for multi-platform distribution planning and rights compliance verification across linear, OTT, and vMVPD delivery channels.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the broadcast timezone in which this schedule's times are expressed (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Critical for accurate EPG display, daypart classification, and regulatory compliance reporting across markets.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard

attributes.name: total_ad_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned advertising airtime in seconds across all ad pods in the schedule for this channel day. Used for commercial inventory management, FCC commercial limits compliance, and revenue forecasting against Wide Orbit traffic orders.
attributes.references: FCC Commercial Limits Rules (47 CFR Part 73); Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

attributes.name: total_program_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned programming (non-commercial) airtime in seconds for this channel day schedule. Equals total_runtime_seconds minus total_ad_time_seconds. Used for content utilization reporting and rights compliance verification.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: total_runtime_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned runtime of all program items in the schedule, expressed in seconds. Used to validate that the schedule fills the full broadcast day (86,400 seconds for a 24-hour schedule) and to detect gaps or overlaps in the rundown.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; SMPTE ST 12-1 Timecode Standard

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary mode of content delivery for this schedule. 'linear' = traditional scheduled broadcast; 'vod_window' = on-demand programming window; 'fast_channel' = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST) channel; 'simulcast' = simultaneous multi-platform broadcast.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee Standards

attributes.name: transmitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the approved schedule was transmitted to the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system. Marks the transition from 'approved' to 'transmitted' status. Used for playout readiness SLA monitoring and failover preparation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: wide_orbit_log_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the corresponding traffic log in Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing system. Links the program schedule to the ad scheduling and affidavit records for commercial break reconciliation and proof-of-broadcast (affidavit) generation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: schedule_slot
products.description: Individual time slot within a program schedule representing a single content event or break event on a linear channel. Captures slot sequence number, planned start time, planned duration, actual start time (as-run), actual duration, slot type (program, promo, commercial break, filler, PSA, EAS), content reference, daypart assignment, and live/tape flag. The atomic unit of the EPG rundown managed in Ericsson MediaFirst.

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual schedule slot record within the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) rundown. Primary key for the schedule_slot data product managed in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: ad_pod_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ad pod (group of commercials within a break) associated with this slot when the slot type is a commercial break. Populated only for commercial break slots; null for program and promo slots.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the linear broadcast channel on which this schedule slot is programmed. Identifies the originating channel within the EPG grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: compliance_content_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.content_rating. Business justification: Each scheduled slot requires verified content rating for daypart appropriateness (watershed compliance), V-chip encoding, and parental guidance systems. Real-time compliance verification prevents regu

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the daypart classification assigned to this slot (e.g., Prime Time, Late Night, Morning Drive). Dayparts are standard time segments of the broadcast day used for audience targeting and advertising rate-card pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; IAB Daypart Standards

attributes.name: media_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.media_asset. Business justification: Schedule slots must reference the specific media file for playout automation systems (MediaFirst, WideOrbit) to execute. Critical for broadcast operations - automation pulls the actual file URI from t

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent broadcast schedule or rundown document that contains this slot. Links the atomic slot to its daily or weekly schedule container in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Schedule slots generate revenue through ad sales, sponsorships, and carriage fees. ASC 606 revenue recognition, sales order fulfillment, and revenue assurance all require slot-to-revenue-stream mappin

attributes.name: scheduling_availability_window_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active rights window in Rightsline that authorizes the broadcast of the content in this slot. Validates that the airing falls within the licensed holdback and windowing period for the territory and platform.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Windowing and Holdback Standards

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.talent_profile. Business justification: On-air talent (hosts, anchors, guests) are scheduled in broadcast slots. Scheduling systems track which talent appears in which slot for call sheets, union reporting, rights clearance verification, an

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the content asset or media item assigned to this slot. Links to the Digital Asset Management (DAM) record in Dalet Galaxy for the program, promo, commercial, or filler material.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry)

attributes.name: traffic_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Traffic coordinators assign and manage individual schedule slots, handle preemptions, and coordinate with sales. Standard broadcast traffic operations workflow requires tracking who manages each slot

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: Slots may require specific transmission equipment for live events, special broadcasts, or equipment-specific configurations - supports technical coordination, equipment allocation, and signal routing

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Real-world duration of the slot in seconds as recorded in the as-run log. Compared against planned_duration_seconds to identify overruns, underruns, and schedule compliance deviations. Used in affidavit reconciliation and makegoods processing.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst As-Run Log; Wide Orbit Affidavit

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Real-world start time of the slot as recorded in the as-run log by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation. May differ from planned_start_time due to live events, technical delays, or schedule overruns. Critical for affidavit generation in Wide Orbit and Nielsen audience measurement reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst As-Run Log; Wide Orbit Affidavit; FCC Broadcast Record-Keeping Rules

attributes.name: aspect_ratio
attributes.description: Video aspect ratio of the content assigned to this slot. Drives playout automation letterboxing/pillarboxing decisions in Ericsson MediaFirst and ensures compliance with broadcast technical standards.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Technical Standards

attributes.name: audio_format
attributes.description: Audio encoding format for the content in this slot (e.g., stereo, Dolby 5.1, Dolby Atmos, mono). Required for playout automation configuration in Ericsson MediaFirst and compliance with broadcast audio loudness standards.
attributes.references: ATSC A/85 Techniques for Establishing and Maintaining Audio Loudness; Ericsson MediaFirst

attributes.name: automation_event_code
attributes.description: Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system event identifier for this slot. The native key from the MediaFirst rundown used for as-run reconciliation, failover event tracking, and technical operations audit.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this slot is scheduled to air, expressed in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used as the primary partition key for EPG queries, Nielsen ratings alignment, and daily schedule reporting. Represents the broadcast day which may span midnight for overnight programming.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Measurement; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: closed_caption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captioning is present and enabled for this slot (True). Mandatory for FCC compliance under the Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA) for applicable programming.
attributes.references: FCC Closed Captioning Rules 47 CFR Part 79; Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule slot record was first created in the EPG system. Supports audit trail requirements, schedule change history analysis, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; FCC Broadcast Record-Keeping Rules

attributes.name: eas_alert_type
attributes.description: Type of Emergency Alert System (EAS) message associated with this slot when slot_type is 'eas' (e.g., EAN — Emergency Action Notification, NPT — National Periodic Test, RWT — Required Weekly Test). Null for non-EAS slots. Mandatory for FCC EAS compliance logging. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EAN|NPT|RWT|SVR|TOR|FFW|HUW|WSW — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Emergency Alert System Rules 47 CFR Part 11; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: episode_number
attributes.description: Episode identifier for serialized program content in this slot (e.g., S02E05 for Season 2, Episode 5). Used for rights window tracking in Rightsline, repeat detection, and EPG metadata publication.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; Rightsline Rights Management; ISAN (International Standard Audiovisual Number)

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether a geographic broadcast restriction (blackout) applies to this slot (True). Blackout rules are enforced at the distribution layer and must be flagged at the slot level for rights compliance and audience measurement exclusion.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights Management; FCC Syndicated Exclusivity and Network Non-Duplication Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: is_live
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot carries a live broadcast event (True) or pre-recorded/taped content (False). Live slots require different playout automation handling, DAI configuration, and rights clearance verification in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: is_repeat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is a repeat airing of previously broadcast content (True) rather than a first-run premiere (False). Affects talent residuals calculations in Rightsline and Nielsen audience measurement weighting.
attributes.references: Rightsline Royalty Calculations; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: is_simulcast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms or channels (True). Simulcast slots require coordinated playout across linear and OTT/streaming distribution paths and may trigger additional rights obligations.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: isan_code
attributes.description: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) uniquely identifying the audiovisual work airing in this slot. Enables cross-platform content identification, rights clearance verification in Rightsline, and royalty calculation for residuals.
attributes.references: ISO 15706 International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN); ISAN International Agency

attributes.name: isci_code
attributes.description: Industry Standard Commercial Identification (ISCI) code for the commercial spot airing in this slot. An 8-character alphanumeric code used by Wide Orbit and ad agencies to uniquely identify a specific commercial creative. Null for non-commercial slot types.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; ISCI/Ad-ID Standard (American Association of Advertising Agencies)

attributes.name: must_carry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is subject to must-carry obligations requiring MVPDs to include this channel/content in their basic tier (True). Flags slots that cannot be blacked out or substituted under FCC must-carry rules.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules 47 CFR Part 76; Cable Television Consumer Protection and Competition Act

attributes.name: nielsen_program_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Media Research proprietary program code assigned to the content in this slot. Used to match as-run schedule data with Nielsen ratings data for audience measurement, GRP/TRP calculation, and advertiser reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Measurement Platform

attributes.name: planned_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Intended duration of the slot in seconds as scheduled in the EPG rundown. Used for schedule integrity validation, ad pod capacity planning, and compliance with broadcast standards for minimum program duration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35

attributes.name: planned_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end date and time for this slot as defined in the EPG rundown. Derived from planned_start_time plus planned_duration_seconds but stored explicitly to support EPG grid queries and boundary validation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 EPG Standard

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start date and time for this slot as defined in the EPG rundown prior to broadcast. Expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for EPG publication, audience measurement alignment, and ad trafficking in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 EPG Standard

attributes.name: program_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the program or content event airing in this slot as it appears in the published EPG. Used for audience-facing program guides, Nielsen ratings matching, and schedule reporting.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 EPG Standard; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.description: Video resolution classification of the content in this slot (SD, HD, UHD, 4K). Determines the playout chain and CDN delivery profile used by Akamai and affects carriage fee agreements with MVPDs.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Project Technical Standards

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number of the schedule rundown in which this slot was last modified. Incremented each time the EPG rundown is revised in Ericsson MediaFirst. Supports schedule change audit trails and version comparison for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scte35_cue_in_time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-in signal marking the return to primary program content after an ad break. Paired with scte35_cue_out_time to define the exact ad avail window for DAI and Wide Orbit ad scheduling.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable and Satellite Distribution

attributes.name: scte35_cue_out_time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-out signal marking the start of an ad break or content interruption within this slot. Used by Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) systems and downstream distribution platforms to trigger ad replacement. Null for non-break slot types.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable and Satellite Distribution

attributes.name: secondary_audio_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Secondary Audio Program (SAP) track is available for this slot (True), typically used for audio description (AD) for visually impaired viewers or alternate language audio. Required for FCC video description compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Video Description Rules 47 CFR Part 79; CVAA

attributes.name: slot_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this slot within the daily rundown for the channel. Determines the playout order in Ericsson MediaFirst automation. Sequence numbers are contiguous integers starting at 1 for each broadcast day.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the schedule slot within the EPG workflow. Values: scheduled (initial EPG entry), confirmed (locked for playout), on_air (currently broadcasting), completed (as-run recorded), cancelled (removed from schedule), replaced (substituted with alternate content). Drives Ericsson MediaFirst automation state machine.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule slot by content category. Values: program (primary editorial content), promo (promotional spot), commercial_break (paid advertising break), filler (interstitial padding content), psa (Public Service Announcement), eas (Emergency Alert System message). Drives playout automation logic and ad insertion rules in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message; ATSC A/65; FCC Emergency Alert System Rules 47 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: traffic_order_number
attributes.description: Wide Orbit traffic system order number associated with this slot when it carries a commercial or promotional spot. Links the EPG slot to the ad sales order for affidavit generation, billing reconciliation, and makegood processing.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Ad Trafficking Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule slot record was last modified. Tracks EPG edits, schedule revisions, and as-run updates. Used in conjunction with schedule_version for change management and compliance audit.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

products.name: epg_entry
products.description: Published Electronic Program Guide record distributed to MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, and digital platforms for viewer-facing program discovery. Captures program title, episode title, series name, genre, content rating (MPA), short and long synopsis, start/end time, channel, language, closed-caption flag, HDR/resolution flag, ISAN/EIDR identifier, and distribution window. Derived from approved schedule slots and enriched with content metadata for consumer-facing EPG feeds.

attributes.name: epg_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Electronic Program Guide (EPG) entry record in the scheduling domain. Serves as the primary key for this Silver Layer data product.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel on which this EPG entry is scheduled for playout. Links to the channel master record in the scheduling domain.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: compliance_content_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.content_rating. Business justification: EPG displays must show accurate content ratings for viewer guidance, V-chip filtering, and watershed compliance. Regulatory requirement in UK (Ofcom) and US (FCC) for electronic program guides. Denorm

attributes.name: media_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media content asset in the Digital Asset Management system (Dalet Galaxy) that is being broadcast for this EPG entry.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: rights_availability_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.rights_availability_window. Business justification: EPG publication workflow requires real-time validation that content is within its rights availability window before displaying to viewers. Prevents publishing unavailable content and supports automate

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved schedule slot from which this EPG entry was derived. Represents the authoritative playout scheduling record in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scheduling_daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: EPG entries require daypart linkage for audience reach estimation, program discovery optimization, and daypart-based content recommendations. Creates new scheduling_daypart_id FK (role-prefixed to avo

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.talent_profile. Business justification: EPG metadata includes featured talent names for viewer discovery, search functionality, and promotional purposes. Broadcasters link talent profiles to EPG entries to enable 'find shows with this actor

attributes.name: ad_pod_count
attributes.description: The number of ad pods (groups of advertisements within a break) scheduled within this program. Used for advertising inventory planning, Wide Orbit traffic scheduling, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35

attributes.name: blackout_region_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic region or market codes where this program is subject to broadcast blackout restrictions. Used by distribution systems to suppress EPG entry delivery in restricted markets. Populated only when is_blackout is True.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this program is scheduled to air, in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for day-level EPG grid display, daypart assignment, and schedule reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: distribution_window
attributes.description: The distribution window or release strategy under which this EPG entry is being broadcast, reflecting the windowing strategy for sequential content release. Determines rights availability and platform eligibility per Rightsline contract terms.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total scheduled duration of the program in seconds, derived from the difference between scheduled start and end times. Used for EPG display, ad pod planning, and playout automation validation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35

attributes.name: eidr
attributes.description: The Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) identifier for this content, providing a universal content identifier used across the media supply chain for content tracking, rights management, and EPG data exchange with MVPDs and vMVPDs.
attributes.references: Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) Association; Motion Picture Association (MPA)

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this EPG entry within the scheduling workflow. 'draft' indicates pending review; 'approved' indicates cleared for distribution; 'published' indicates actively distributed to EPG feeds; 'cancelled' indicates removed from schedule; 'expired' indicates the broadcast window has passed.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: epg_entry_code
attributes.description: Externally distributed business identifier for this EPG entry, used in feeds delivered to MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, and digital platforms for program discovery. Format: EPG-{CHANNEL}-{YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: epg_feed_version
attributes.description: The version number of this EPG entry record as distributed in the EPG feed. Incremented each time the entry is updated and redistributed to MVPDs, vMVPDs, and digital platforms. Enables downstream systems to detect and apply updates.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: episode_number
