attributes.description: The sequential episode number within the season for this EPG entry. Used for viewer navigation and content ordering in EPG feeds. Null for non-episodic content.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: episode_title
attributes.description: The title of the specific episode within a series, as displayed in the EPG. Null for non-episodic content such as feature films or standalone specials.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: genre_primary
attributes.description: The primary content genre classification for this EPG entry as distributed in the EPG feed (e.g., Drama, Comedy, News, Sports, Documentary, Reality). Used for viewer discovery, content filtering, and audience analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drama|comedy|news|sports|documentary|reality|entertainment|children|film|music — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DVB SI EN 300 468 Content Descriptor; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: genre_secondary
attributes.description: An optional secondary genre sub-classification providing more granular content categorization for EPG discovery and audience targeting (e.g., Crime Drama, Political Comedy, Investigative Documentary).

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast restrictions (blackout) apply to this EPG entry (True). When True, the program is subject to blackout rules that restrict distribution in specific geographic markets per rights agreements managed in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Must-Carry and Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: is_closed_caption
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captioning (CC) is available for this program (True). Distributed in EPG feeds for accessibility compliance and viewer information. Required for FCC closed captioning regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79 Closed Captioning; Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: is_hdr
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is available in High Dynamic Range (HDR) format (True). Distributed in EPG feeds to inform viewers and set-top boxes of enhanced picture quality availability.
attributes.references: ATSC A/341 High Dynamic Range; DVB HDR Specification

attributes.name: is_live
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPG entry represents a live broadcast event (True) as opposed to a pre-recorded or time-shifted program (False). Drives playout automation configuration in Ericsson MediaFirst and is distributed in EPG feeds for viewer-facing live indicators.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_new_episode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPG entry represents a new, first-run episode (True) or a repeat/rerun broadcast (False). Distributed in EPG feeds for viewer-facing 'NEW' indicators and drives audience measurement prioritization.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_simulcast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is being simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms or channels (simulcast). When True, the same content is distributed concurrently on linear and digital/OTT platforms.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: isan
attributes.description: The International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) uniquely identifying this audiovisual work globally. Used for rights management, content identification across platforms, and interoperability with Rightsline and international content registries.
attributes.references: ISO 15706-2 International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN); ISAN International Agency

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The primary audio language of the program, expressed as a three-letter ISO 639-2 language code (e.g., 'eng' for English, 'spa' for Spanish). Used in EPG feeds for language filtering and accessibility compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes; ATSC A/65; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG entry record was most recently modified, including schedule changes, metadata updates, or status transitions. Used for change detection in downstream EPG feed distribution and audit trail.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: program_title
attributes.description: The primary viewer-facing title of the program as it appears in the Electronic Program Guide. Used for consumer-facing program discovery across all distribution platforms.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG entry was first published and distributed to external EPG feeds (MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, digital platforms). Serves as the record audit created timestamp for this data product.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rights_window_end
attributes.description: The end date of the broadcast rights window during which this content is cleared for transmission on this channel. After this date, the content enters a holdback period and cannot be broadcast without rights renewal in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: rights_window_start
attributes.description: The start date of the broadcast rights window during which this content is cleared for transmission on this channel. Derived from Rightsline contract availabilities and used to validate schedule compliance.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this program is scheduled to end broadcast on the channel. Used to calculate program duration and to sequence adjacent EPG entries in the linear channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this program is scheduled to begin broadcast on the channel, expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. This is the principal business event timestamp for the EPG entry and drives all downstream playout automation in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: scte35_cue_out_time
attributes.description: The timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-out signal marking the start of an ad break opportunity within this program. Used by Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) systems and Wide Orbit traffic systems for ad pod placement and automated ad scheduling.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: season_number
attributes.description: The season number within the series for this episode. Used for EPG display and content navigation. Null for non-episodic or non-seasonal content.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: series_name
attributes.description: The name of the parent series or franchise to which this episode belongs. Enables series-level grouping and discovery in EPG interfaces. Null for non-series content.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: synopsis_long
attributes.description: A detailed program description (typically up to 500 characters) distributed in EPG feeds for display on digital platforms, OTT apps, and web-based program guides. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy content metadata.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: synopsis_short
attributes.description: A brief program description (typically up to 100 characters) distributed in EPG feeds for display on set-top boxes and digital platforms with limited screen real estate. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy content metadata.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: total_ad_break_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total cumulative duration in seconds of all scheduled ad breaks within this program. Used for advertising inventory management, compliance with ad load regulations, and Wide Orbit traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Commercial Limits in Children's Programming; IAB

attributes.name: video_resolution
attributes.description: The video resolution format of this program as distributed in the EPG feed (e.g., SD, HD, FHD, UHD/4K). Used for viewer-facing display in EPG interfaces and for platform compatibility routing.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Digital Video Broadcasting Standards

products.name: ad_break
products.description: Commercial break (ad pod) within a schedule slot — capturing break position (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll), sequence number, planned and maximum pod duration, break type (local avail, network avail, promotional), SCTE-35 cue-in/cue-out marker references, DAI eligibility flag, and Wide Orbit traffic system break ID. The structural container for sellable ad inventory within the linear schedule, linking scheduling to advertising sales fulfillment.
products.reference: SCTE-35 Ad Pod / Wide Orbit Break

attributes.name: ad_break_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ad break (ad pod) record within the scheduling domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ad_billing_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.ad_billing_order. Business justification: Ad breaks are the inventory units sold in ad orders. Direct link required for order-to-inventory reconciliation, flight pacing analysis, and verifying contracted vs. delivered spots in advertising bil

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel on which this ad break is scheduled for playout. Supports multi-channel scheduling and channel-level inventory reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Business justification: Linear ad breaks drive DAI stitching rules when simulcast to OTT. Operations teams configure DAI parameters (max pod duration, fill rate targets, frequency caps) per break type and daypart to ensure c

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Ad break currently stores daypart_code as a STRING. This should be normalized to FK to the daypart reference table. Ad break pricing, GRP targets, and inventory management all depend on daypart attrib

attributes.name: political_ad_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.political_ad_record. Business justification: Political ad breaks require detailed public inspection file documentation per FCC Section 315 (reasonable access, lowest unit charge). Each political ad break must link to compliance record for public

attributes.name: primary_ad_scte_marker_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the SCTE-35 splice_insert or time_signal cue-out marker that signals the start of the ad break to downstream distribution systems and Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) platforms. References the specific SCTE-35 message that triggers break entry.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; SCTE Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Ad breaks are the primary advertising revenue mechanism. Revenue recognition, sales reconciliation, and makegood accounting all depend on ad-break-to-revenue-stream mapping. Essential for advertising

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent schedule slot within which this ad break is positioned. Links the ad break to its containing program or interstitial window in the linear channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: traffic_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ad breaks are managed by traffic personnel who handle avail sales, makegoods, and preemptions. Core advertising operations workflow requires tracking responsible traffic manager for each break for acc

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: Ad breaks inserted via specific playout/transmission equipment - enables affidavit verification, SCTE-35 signal path validation, and equipment-level ad insertion troubleshooting. Critical for DAI oper

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The actual total duration of the ad break as recorded during playout by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for post-log reconciliation, affidavit generation, and makegood assessment when actual duration deviates from planned.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits)

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: The actual wall-clock time at which the ad break commenced during playout, as recorded by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for affidavit generation and post-log reconciliation against the scheduled start time.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits)

attributes.name: affidavit_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a proof-of-broadcast affidavit has been generated for this ad break in the Wide Orbit traffic system following confirmed playout. Affidavits are required for advertiser billing reconciliation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits); FCC Sponsorship Identification Rules

attributes.name: automation_event_code
attributes.description: The event identifier assigned by the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system to the break trigger event. Used to correlate the scheduled ad break with the actual playout automation log for post-log reconciliation and technical fault analysis.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: avail_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual advertising avail slots (unit positions) within this ad break pod. Each avail represents a discrete sellable unit (e.g., a 30-second spot position). Used for inventory capacity planning and traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Advertising Standards

attributes.name: blackout_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is subject to geographic blackout restrictions that prevent its broadcast or streaming in specific markets or regions. When true, downstream distribution systems must apply blackout logic per rights and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: break_position
attributes.description: Positional classification of the ad break relative to the surrounding program content. 'pre-roll' = before program content begins; 'mid-roll' = within program content; 'post-roll' = after program content ends; 'interstitial' = between programs in the schedule grid.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard

attributes.name: break_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ad break within the scheduling and playout workflow. 'scheduled' = planned but not yet confirmed; 'confirmed' = traffic-confirmed with sold inventory; 'aired' = playout completed and affidavit-eligible; 'cancelled' = removed from schedule; 'hold' = temporarily suspended pending resolution.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: break_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ad break by inventory ownership and commercial purpose. 'local_avail' = inventory sold by local affiliate; 'network_avail' = inventory sold by the network; 'promotional' = house promotional content; 'public_service' = public service announcements; 'emergency' = emergency alert system override. Drives revenue attribution and traffic scheduling rules.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Public Service Announcement Requirements

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this ad break is scheduled to air, expressed in the channel's broadcast day convention (which may differ from the wall-clock date for late-night programming). Used for daily traffic scheduling, affidavit generation, and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Affidavit Requirements

attributes.name: content_restriction_code
attributes.description: A code indicating any content category restrictions applicable to advertising within this break (e.g., no alcohol ads during children's programming, no competitor ads). Enforced by the traffic system during ad assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NO_ALCOHOL|NO_GAMBLING|NO_PHARMA|NO_COMPETITOR|CHILDREN_SAFE|NONE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act (COPPA); Ofcom Broadcasting Code; MPA Content Rating Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad break record was first created in the scheduling system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Data Integrity Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rate card CPM and any monetary values associated with this ad break (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations for international broadcast networks.

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is enabled for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), allowing server-side ad replacement for OTT/streaming simulcast audiences. When true, the break is eligible for addressable advertising via DAI platforms such as those integrated with Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: epg_break_label
attributes.description: The human-readable label or descriptor for this ad break as it appears in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and scheduling rundown. Used by traffic coordinators and scheduling operators to identify breaks in the EPG interface.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: grp_target
attributes.description: The target Gross Rating Point (GRP) value for this ad break, representing the expected total audience delivery as a percentage of the total target population. Used for audience guarantee tracking and campaign delivery reporting against Nielsen ratings.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: makegood_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a makegood (compensatory ad spot) is required for this break due to a failure to air as contracted — for example, due to preemption, technical failure, or underdelivery. Triggers makegood workflow in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Advertising Standards (Makegoods)

attributes.name: max_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The maximum allowable duration of the ad break in seconds, representing the hard ceiling for total ad content that may be inserted. Exceeding this value would cause schedule overrun. May differ from planned duration when flex time is permitted.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: nielsen_program_rating
attributes.description: The Nielsen audience rating for the program surrounding this ad break, representing the percentage of total TV households tuned in. Used for CPM calculation, audience guarantee assessment, and scatter market pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: planned_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The planned total duration of the ad break (ad pod) in seconds as defined in the program schedule. Represents the total sellable commercial time allocated to this break. Standard pod durations are typically 30, 60, 90, 120, or 180 seconds.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: pod_number
attributes.description: The pod number identifying this ad break within the broadcast day for the channel. Distinct from sequence_number (which is relative to the program); pod_number is the channel-day-level ordinal used in traffic scheduling and affidavit reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: preemption_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this ad break was preempted or cancelled if it did not air as scheduled. Used for makegood processing, revenue assurance, and operational reporting. 'none' when the break aired as planned.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Emergency Alert System Rules

attributes.name: rate_card_cpm
attributes.description: The published rate card CPM (Cost Per Mille — cost per 1,000 audience impressions) for this ad break, expressed in the local currency. Represents the base pricing for inventory in this break before negotiated discounts. Used for revenue forecasting and yield management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales; IAB CPM Pricing Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned wall-clock date and time at which the ad break is scheduled to begin on the linear channel. Expressed in the channel's broadcast timezone. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the break.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this ad break within the parent schedule slot or program. Used to order multiple breaks within a single program (e.g., break 1, break 2, break 3) for traffic scheduling and playout automation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: simulcast_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is included in the simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast) of the channel. When false, the break may be suppressed or replaced on simulcast streams (e.g., OTT, vMVPD).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: sold_avail_count
attributes.description: The number of individual avail slots within this break that have been sold and assigned to advertiser spots in the Wide Orbit traffic system. Used with avail_count to compute sellout rate and unsold inventory.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales

attributes.name: sold_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total duration in seconds of ad inventory within this break that has been sold to advertisers via the Wide Orbit traffic system. Used to calculate unsold (remnant) inventory and sellout rate for revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad break record was most recently modified in the scheduling system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Data Integrity Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: wide_orbit_break_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wide Orbit Traffic System Break ID
attributes.description: The externally-known break identifier assigned by the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system. Used to reconcile ad break inventory between the scheduling domain and the ad sales/traffic fulfillment workflow. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the break as known to the traffic system.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: scte_marker
products.description: SCTE-35 splice information message record embedded in the broadcast transport stream to signal ad insertion, blackout, and program boundary events. Captures splice command type (splice_insert, time_signal, bandwidth_reservation), PTS timestamp, pre-roll duration, segmentation type ID (SCTE-104 descriptor), unique program ID, avail number, avails expected, and processing status. Critical for DAI systems and MVPD ad insertion compliance.

attributes.name: scte_marker_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE) Marker ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SCTE-35 splice information message record in the broadcast transport stream. Primary key for the scte_marker data product.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard

attributes.name: ad_pod_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ad pod record that this SCTE-35 marker is intended to open or close. An Ad Pod is a group of ads scheduled within a single break. Links the splice event to the Wide Orbit traffic system ad pod for campaign reconciliation and affidavit generation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic System; IAB Ad Pod Standard

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the linear broadcast channel on which this SCTE-35 marker was embedded. Links the splice event to the originating playout channel managed in Ericsson MediaFirst.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: SCTE marker currently stores daypart_code as a STRING. Normalizing to FK enables retrieval of daypart attributes for ad insertion rules and DAI eligibility checks. Remove daypart_code as it becomes re

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: SCTE-35 markers trigger dynamic ad insertion (DAI) events that generate billable impressions in programmatic advertising. Link required for DAI billing, impression-based invoicing, and programmatic re

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program schedule entry or rundown record that triggered this SCTE-35 marker. Ties the splice event to the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) scheduling context.

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.schedule_slot. Business justification: SCTE-35 markers signal ad insertion points at specific schedule slots. Currently scte_marker links to program_schedule (schedule_id) but not to the specific schedule_slot where the cue is embedded. Ad

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program or content asset record associated with this splice event. Links the SCTE-35 marker to the content catalogue in Dalet Galaxy for rights verification, blackout enforcement, and audience measurement attribution.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM; Ericsson MediaFirst EPG

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: SCTE-35 markers generated by specific equipment - critical for DAI troubleshooting, signal integrity verification, and equipment-level splice event tracking. Supports NOC operations and ad insertion d

attributes.name: auto_return
attributes.description: Indicates whether the playout system should automatically return to network programming at the end of the break_duration without waiting for an explicit splice-in command. When True, the break is time-bounded; when False, an explicit splice-in SCTE-35 message is required.

attributes.name: avail_num
attributes.description: The avail_num field from the SCTE-35 splice_insert() command, indicating the sequential number of this ad avail within the current program. Used alongside avails_expected to track avail inventory completeness for a given program break sequence.

attributes.name: avails_expected
attributes.description: The avails_expected field from the SCTE-35 splice_insert() command, indicating the total number of ad avails expected within the current program. Enables DAI systems and Wide Orbit to validate that all avail windows have been signalled and filled.

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SCTE-35 marker is associated with a geographic broadcast blackout restriction. When True, downstream MVPDs and vMVPDs must suppress the content in the affected geographic region and substitute alternate programming or a blackout slate.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022 Section 10.3.3; FCC Must-Carry and Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: blackout_region_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or proprietary DMA/region code identifying the geographic area subject to the blackout restriction signalled by this marker. Populated only when blackout_flag is True. Used for MVPD compliance and retransmission consent enforcement.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022; FCC Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: break_duration_ms
attributes.description: The total duration of the ad break or content replacement window in milliseconds, as signalled in the SCTE-35 break_duration() structure. Defines the length of the avail window available for ad pod insertion. Used by Wide Orbit traffic system for avail reconciliation.

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Number of elementary stream components (video, audio tracks, data) included in the splice command when component_splice_flag is set. Indicates multi-component splice operations for multi-language or multi-audio broadcast streams.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this SCTE-35 marker record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(1)(f) — Integrity and Confidentiality

attributes.name: cw_index
attributes.description: The cw_index field from the SCTE-35 splice_info_section, referencing the encryption control word used when the splice message is encrypted. A value of 0xFF indicates no encryption. Relevant for DRM-protected transport streams.

attributes.name: descriptor_loop_length
attributes.description: The total byte length of the splice descriptor loop in the SCTE-35 splice_info_section. Indicates the presence and size of additional descriptors such as segmentation_descriptor, DTMF_descriptor, or avail_descriptor. Used for message parsing validation.

attributes.name: encrypted_packet
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SCTE-35 splice_info_section payload is encrypted. When True, the cw_index field identifies the applicable decryption key. Relevant for secure ad insertion in DRM-protected broadcast streams.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022 Section 9.6; Digital Rights Management (DRM) Standards

attributes.name: out_of_network
attributes.description: The out_of_network_indicator bit from the SCTE-35 splice_insert() command. True indicates the splice point transitions to out-of-network content (e.g., local ad insertion); False indicates a return to in-network programming. Fundamental for MVPD local ad insertion compliance.

attributes.name: pre_roll_duration_ms
attributes.description: The pre-roll duration in milliseconds between the time the SCTE-35 message is detected and the actual splice point. Allows downstream DAI systems and MVPDs sufficient lead time to prepare and insert the ad content before the avail window opens.

attributes.name: processing_error_code
attributes.description: Proprietary error code assigned when processing_status is 'failed'. Identifies the specific failure reason (e.g., CRC mismatch, invalid PTS, unsupported command type, descriptor parse error). Used for operational monitoring and SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing lifecycle status of this SCTE-35 marker record in the Silver layer pipeline. 'received' = ingested from transport stream; 'validated' = passed SCTE-35 structural validation; 'processed' = forwarded to DAI/MVPD systems; 'failed' = processing error; 'skipped' = intentionally bypassed (e.g., duplicate or test signal).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout Automation; Akamai CDN DAI Integration

attributes.name: program_number
attributes.description: The MPEG-2 program_number (PAT/PMT) identifying the specific program within the transport stream to which this SCTE-35 message applies. Enables precise association of the splice event with the correct elementary stream in multi-programme multiplexes.

attributes.name: pts_time
attributes.description: The 33-bit Presentation Time Stamp (PTS) value in 90 kHz clock ticks at which the splice event is to occur in the MPEG-2 transport stream. Stored as BIGINT to accommodate the full 33-bit range. Fundamental for frame-accurate ad insertion by DAI systems and Akamai CDN delivery.

attributes.name: pts_time_utc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Presentation Time Stamp (PTS) UTC Wall-Clock Time
attributes.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp derived from the PTS value after applying the PCR/PTS offset for the channel. Enables correlation of splice events with EPG schedules, ad trafficking records in Wide Orbit, and audience measurement windows in Nielsen.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: segmentation_type_code
attributes.description: Numeric segmentation_type_id from the SCTE-35 segmentation_descriptor (SCTE-104 descriptor table). Identifies the semantic purpose of the marker: e.g., 0x10 = Program Start, 0x11 = Program End, 0x20 = Chapter Start, 0x30 = Provider Advertisement Start, 0x34 = Distributor Advertisement Start. Critical for MVPD ad insertion compliance and blackout enforcement.

attributes.name: segmentation_type_label
attributes.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the segmentation_type_id, derived from the SCTE-35 segmentation descriptor table (e.g., 'Provider Advertisement Start', 'Program Blackout Override', 'Chapter Start'). Facilitates operational reporting and EPG reconciliation without requiring lookup joins.

attributes.name: segmentation_upid_type
attributes.description: Numeric code identifying the type of the segmentation UPID carried in the segmentation_descriptor, per SCTE-35 Table 22. Common values: 0x01=URI, 0x03=Ad-ID, 0x08=ISAN, 0x09=TID, 0x0A=TI, 0x0C=MPU, 0x0E=ADS Information. Determines how the segmentation_upid_value should be interpreted.

attributes.name: segmentation_upid_value
attributes.description: The actual UPID value carried in the segmentation_descriptor, interpreted according to segmentation_upid_type. May contain an Ad-ID, ISAN, URI, or other content identifier. Used to link the splice event to content records in Dalet Galaxy MAM and rights records in Rightsline.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022 Table 22; Ad-ID Standard (ISCI successor); ISAN ISO 15706

attributes.name: signal_detected_timestamp
attributes.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp at which the SCTE-35 splice_info_section was first detected and extracted from the transport stream by the playout or monitoring system. Represents the business event time of signal receipt. Used for pre-roll lead time calculation and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated or forwarded this SCTE-35 marker record. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation, Dalet Galaxy MAM, and Wide Orbit traffic systems.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst; Dalet Galaxy; Wide Orbit

attributes.name: splice_command_type
attributes.description: The SCTE-35 splice command type encoded in the splice_info_section. Determines the action to be taken by downstream DAI and playout systems. splice_insert signals a direct ad avail; time_signal carries segmentation descriptors; bandwidth_reservation reserves capacity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: splice_null|splice_insert|time_signal|bandwidth_reservation|private_command — promote to reference product if additional vendor-specific types are required]
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022 Section 9.7; IAB Digital Ad Insertion Standards

attributes.name: splice_event_number
attributes.description: Unique 32-bit splice_event_id as defined in the SCTE-35 splice_insert() command structure. Identifies the specific splice event within the transport stream and is used by Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) systems to correlate splice-in and splice-out pairs.

attributes.name: splice_immediate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the splice should occur immediately upon receipt of the SCTE-35 message (True) rather than at the specified PTS time (False). When True, the pts_time field is not applicable. Used for emergency override and live event boundary signalling.

attributes.name: splice_insert_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this splice_insert command is a splice-out (entering an ad avail or blackout) or splice-in (returning to network programming). Applicable when splice_command_type is splice_insert. Used by DAI systems to bracket the ad pod window.

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: The 12-bit tier field from the SCTE-35 splice_info_section, used to address specific MVPDs or distribution tiers. A value of 0xFFF indicates the message applies to all tiers. Enables selective ad insertion targeting for specific distribution partners.

attributes.name: transport_stream_number
attributes.description: The MPEG-2 transport stream identifier in which this SCTE-35 message was embedded. Used to correlate the splice event with the specific multiplex or virtual channel carrying the broadcast signal, particularly relevant for DVB and ATSC multi-programme transport streams.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 2022; ISO/IEC 13818-1 MPEG-2 Systems; ATSC A/65; DVB SI Standards

attributes.name: unique_program_code
attributes.description: The unique_program_id field from the SCTE-35 splice_insert() command, identifying the program associated with this splice event. Used by MVPDs and DAI systems to associate the avail with a specific program for audience targeting and ad campaign attribution.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this SCTE-35 marker record was last modified in the Silver layer data product, such as when processing_status is updated after DAI system acknowledgement.

products.name: simulcast_config
products.description: Configuration record defining a simulcast relationship where a single program or schedule is broadcast simultaneously across multiple channels or platforms (e.g., linear + OTT, HD + SD, primary + secondary feed). Captures source channel, target channel or platform, simulcast type (full-feed, partial, time-shifted), offset in seconds, audio/video profile mapping, and active date range. Drives Ericsson MediaFirst multi-feed automation.

attributes.name: simulcast_config_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the simulcast configuration record. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: abr_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) streaming profile applied to the target simulcast feed for OTT delivery. Defines the bitrate ladder (HLS or MPEG-DASH renditions) used by Akamai CDN for adaptive streaming to end-user devices.
attributes.references: ISO 23009 MPEG-DASH; HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) Apple Specification; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: billing_carriage_fee_invoice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing Carriage Fee Invoice Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_carriage_fee_invoice. Business justification: Simulcast configurations drive multi-platform carriage fee calculations (linear + streaming). Link required for platform-specific fee allocation, subscriber count apportionment, and multi-platform car

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Business justification: Simulcast routes require DAI stitching rules when ad insertion differs between linear SCTE-35 cues and OTT server-side stitching. Technical operations configure DAI per simulcast to handle ad pod subs

attributes.name: origin_broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Simulcast originates from specific facility - required for signal routing, redundancy planning, facility failover configuration, and multi-platform distribution. Role prefix 'origin_' distinguishes fr

attributes.name: primary_simulcast_backup_source_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the backup or secondary source channel used by Ericsson MediaFirst failover automation when the primary source channel becomes unavailable. Supports broadcast continuity and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: retransmission_consent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retransmission consent agreement authorizing the rebroadcast of the source channel content on the target distribution platform. Required for MVPD and cable carriage of broadcast signals under FCC retransmission consent rules.
attributes.references: FCC Retransmission Consent Rules (47 CFR Part 76.64); Federal Communications Commission (FCC); Rightsline

attributes.name: simulcast_partner_partner_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Simulcast Partner Partner Partner Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Simulcast distribution agreements are with specific partners (cable operators, streaming platforms, syndication partners). Critical for multi-platform distribution tracking, partner SLA compliance, an

attributes.name: source_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating linear broadcast channel whose feed is being simulcast to one or more target channels or platforms. Drives Ericsson MediaFirst multi-feed automation as the master playout source.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: streaming_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.streaming_endpoint. Business justification: Simulcast configurations map linear channels to specific OTT delivery endpoints for live streaming workflows. Operations teams configure CDN routing, failover paths, and geo-restrictions per simulcast

attributes.name: target_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination channel or platform that receives the simulcast feed from the source channel. May represent a linear channel, OTT platform feed, HD/SD variant, or secondary distribution outlet.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: technical_director_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Simulcast configurations are managed by technical operations/engineering staff responsible for multi-platform distribution. Broadcast engineering workflow requires tracking responsible technical direc

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: Simulcast uses specific transmission equipment - critical for signal path configuration, equipment redundancy planning, and simulcast failover operations. Supports multi-platform distribution technica

attributes.name: ad_pod_substitution
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ad pods (groups of ads in a break) from the source linear feed are substituted with alternative ad content on the target simulcast feed. Distinct from DAI — covers cases where static alternate ad content replaces source pods without dynamic targeting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; SCTE-35; IAB

attributes.name: audio_description_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audio description (video description) secondary audio track is passed through from the source to the target simulcast feed. Required for FCC accessibility compliance for visually impaired audiences on qualifying broadcast and MVPD platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Audio Description Rules (47 CFR Part 79.3); Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: audio_profile_code
attributes.description: Reference to the audio encoding and channel configuration profile applied to the target simulcast feed (e.g., stereo, 5.1 surround, Dolby Atmos, audio description track). Ensures correct audio mapping from source to target platform.
attributes.references: ATSC A/52 Digital Audio Compression Standard; DVB Audio Standards; Ericsson MediaFirst

attributes.name: blackout_enforced
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast blackout restrictions are enforced on the target simulcast feed. When true, blackout rules (e.g., sports rights geographic restrictions) are applied to suppress content in restricted territories on the target platform.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: cdn_origin_path
attributes.description: The Akamai CDN origin ingest path or stream key for the target simulcast feed. Used to route the encoded simulcast stream from Ericsson MediaFirst playout to the CDN origin for OTT and digital distribution.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN Content Delivery Network; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: closed_caption_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed caption data from the source channel feed is passed through to the target simulcast feed. Required for FCC accessibility compliance on all broadcast and MVPD distribution platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Closed Captioning Rules (47 CFR Part 79); Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this simulcast configuration, used in Ericsson MediaFirst automation rules, runsheets, and operational documentation. Unique across all active configurations.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: config_description
attributes.description: Free-text operational description of the simulcast configuration, including business rationale, special handling instructions, and notes for scheduling and playout operations teams.

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the simulcast configuration (e.g., 'CNN HD to CNN SD Full-Feed', 'Linear to OTT Time-Shifted +1hr'). Used in EPG management and scheduling operations.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: content_rating_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum content rating permitted on the target simulcast feed per Motion Picture Association (MPA) and FCC content rating standards. Ensures age-appropriate content controls are applied on the target platform, particularly for COPPA-regulated children's platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Content Rating Rules; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this simulcast configuration record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for configuration lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: dai_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) is active on the target simulcast feed, replacing linear ad pods with dynamically served targeted advertisements. Applicable primarily to OTT and AVOD distribution platforms.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: distribution_platform
attributes.description: The delivery platform type of the target channel or feed. Distinguishes linear broadcast from OTT (Over-The-Top), MVPD (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor), vMVPD (Virtual MVPD), FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television), cable, satellite, IPTV, or web delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear|ott|mvpd|vmvpd|fast|cable|satellite|iptv|web — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); DVB Project Digital Video Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: drm_scheme
attributes.description: The Digital Rights Management (DRM) encryption scheme applied to the target simulcast feed for content protection on OTT and digital distribution platforms. Widevine for Android/Chrome, FairPlay for Apple, PlayReady for Microsoft. None for unencrypted linear broadcast.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Anti-Piracy Standards; Akamai CDN Security; ISO/IEC 23009

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this simulcast configuration becomes operationally active and is applied by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation. Aligns with schedule activation windows in the EPG.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/76

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this simulcast configuration expires and is deactivated. Nullable for open-ended configurations with no planned end date. Supports windowing and holdback period management.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: epg_sync_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) metadata from the source channel schedule is automatically synchronized to the target simulcast channel's EPG. When true, program titles, descriptions, and ratings are mirrored to the target channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol (PSIP)

attributes.name: failover_mode
attributes.description: Defines the failover behavior for the simulcast target feed in Ericsson MediaFirst when the source channel signal is lost or degraded. Automatic triggers immediate failover to backup source; manual requires operator intervention; disabled means no failover is configured.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: graphics_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether on-screen graphics, lower-thirds, and channel branding overlays from the source channel are passed through to the target simulcast feed. When false, the target feed may apply its own branding or suppress source graphics.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: mediafirst_config_ref
attributes.description: The external configuration reference identifier assigned by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system to this simulcast configuration. Used for reconciliation between the data lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational playout system.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: must_carry_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this simulcast configuration satisfies must-carry obligations requiring MVPDs to carry local broadcast stations. Ensures regulatory compliance tracking for FCC must-carry and retransmission consent requirements.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76 Subpart D); Federal Communications Commission (FCC)

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this simulcast configuration when multiple configurations apply to the same source channel simultaneously. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst to resolve conflicts in multi-feed automation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rights_territory_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the geographic territory in which this simulcast configuration is licensed to operate. Enforces windowing and holdback obligations managed in Rightsline.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: scte35_cue_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers from the source channel are passed through to the target simulcast feed. When true, ad break triggers and blackout signals are propagated to the target. Critical for DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) on OTT platforms.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable Systems; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: simulcast_config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the simulcast configuration record. Active configurations are processed by Ericsson MediaFirst automation. Suspended configurations are temporarily halted (e.g., rights blackout). Draft configurations are under review prior to activation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the simulcast relationship: full_feed (identical content and timing), partial (selected programs only), time_shifted (offset delay applied), simulcast_only (live events only), ad_substituted (DAI replaces linear ad pods on target). Drives automation logic in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: ATSC A/76 Practice Recommended for Simulcasting; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: time_offset_seconds
attributes.description: The delay in seconds applied to the target feed relative to the source channel. Zero for true simultaneous simulcast. Positive values indicate a time-shifted delay (e.g., +3600 for a +1 hour catch-up feed). Used by Ericsson MediaFirst to schedule playout offset.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this simulcast configuration record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance for playout configuration governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: video_profile_code
attributes.description: Reference to the video encoding and resolution profile applied to the target simulcast feed (e.g., HD 1080i, SD 576p, UHD 4K, HDR10). Drives transcode and format conversion settings in Ericsson MediaFirst and Akamai CDN delivery.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 MPEG-2 Video Standard; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4; DVB Project Digital Video Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: watermark_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a forensic or visible watermark is applied to the target simulcast feed for content protection, piracy detection, and rights enforcement tracking. Supports MPA anti-piracy compliance.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Anti-Piracy Standards; Akamai CDN Security

products.name: scheduling_blackout_rule
products.description: Defines geographic or platform-specific broadcast restriction rules that prevent a program from airing in designated markets or on designated platforms, driven by rights holdback obligations or regulatory requirements. Captures content reference, restricted territory (DMA, country, postal region), restricted platform type, blackout start/end datetime, substitute content reference, and rights contract linkage. Enforced at playout by Ericsson MediaFirst and at CDN level by Akamai.

attributes.name: scheduling_blackout_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the blackout rule record in the scheduling domain. Primary key for the scheduling_blackout_rule data product.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Blackout rules have approved_by field tracking who approved the rights restriction. Natural FK to employee for compliance audit trail and rights management workflow. Removes denormalized approved_by i

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the linear broadcast channel on which the blackout rule is enforced, as managed in Ericsson MediaFirst. Identifies the specific channel playout stream subject to the geographic or platform restriction.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.credit_memo. Business justification: Blackout rules trigger credits/makegoods when contracted content cannot air due to rights restrictions. Direct link required for automated credit memo generation, makegood spot allocation, and blackou

attributes.name: license_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rights and licensing contract in Rightsline that mandates or authorizes this blackout rule. Links the blackout enforcement obligation to its contractual source for rights clearance and compliance auditing.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Internal Rights Governance

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Blackout rules often stem from partner-specific territorial restrictions in distribution agreements (e.g., regional sports blackouts, affiliate exclusivity zones). Essential for rights compliance, par

attributes.name: primary_scheduling_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the content asset subject to the blackout restriction, as catalogued in Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management. Links to the master content record for the program, film, or event being blacked out.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM; EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry)

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Blackout rules often stem from regulatory obligations (sports blackouts per FCC 76.67, retransmission consent restrictions). Links scheduling enforcement to underlying compliance obligation for audit

attributes.name: rights_availability_window_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific rights availability window in Rightsline that defines the holdback period driving this blackout rule. Links the blackout enforcement to the precise contractual window (e.g., theatrical window, home video window, broadcast window) in the rights management system.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Internal Windowing Policy

attributes.name: akamai_rule_code
attributes.description: The corresponding rule identifier in Akamai CDN configuration that enforces this blackout at the content delivery network level for OTT and streaming platforms. Enables traceability between the scheduling blackout rule and its CDN enforcement policy.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN Geo-Restriction and Security; IAB Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this blackout rule was formally approved for enforcement by the authorized approver. Distinct from the record creation timestamp; represents the business approval event in the rule lifecycle.
attributes.references: Internal Rights Clearance and Scheduling Governance; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: blackout_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (exclusive) at which the blackout restriction is lifted and normal playout/streaming of the content in the restricted territory may resume. Nullable for open-ended holdback obligations. Enforced by Ericsson MediaFirst and Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout Automation; Akamai CDN; Rightsline Windowing

attributes.name: blackout_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (inclusive) at which the blackout restriction becomes effective and playout/streaming of the content in the restricted territory must be suppressed. Enforced by Ericsson MediaFirst at playout and Akamai CDN at delivery. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout Automation; Akamai CDN; SCTE-35 Blackout Signaling

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current rights clearance verification status for this blackout rule. 'pending' indicates clearance is being verified; 'cleared' indicates the blackout obligation has been confirmed against the rights contract; 'disputed' indicates a conflict with the rights holder; 'waived' indicates the rights holder has waived the blackout requirement; 'escalated' indicates the clearance issue has been escalated for legal review.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Internal Rights Clearance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this blackout rule record was first created in the scheduling data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); SOX Compliance; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: dai_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) should be overridden or suppressed during the blackout window for the restricted territory. When True, DAI ad pods are not inserted into the substitute content stream, preventing ad revenue leakage or compliance violations during blackout periods.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 DAI Signaling; Internal Ad Operations Policy

attributes.name: eidr_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard EIDR identifier for the content asset subject to the blackout rule. Provides a globally unique, persistent content identifier enabling cross-system rights and blackout enforcement interoperability.

attributes.name: enforcement_scope
attributes.description: Defines where the blackout rule is enforced in the distribution chain. 'playout_only' restricts at Ericsson MediaFirst broadcast playout; 'cdn_only' restricts at Akamai CDN for streaming; 'playout_and_cdn' enforces at both layers; 'epg_suppression' additionally removes the program from EPG listings in the restricted territory.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout Automation; Akamai CDN; SCTE-35 Standard

attributes.name: epg_suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program should be suppressed from the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) listing in the restricted territory during the blackout window. When True, the program title and metadata are hidden from viewer-facing EPG displays in the blacked-out market.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol (PSIP); DVB SI Standards; Internal EPG Governance

attributes.name: holdback_type
attributes.description: The specific type of holdback obligation driving this blackout rule. 'exclusivity' indicates a contractual exclusivity period; 'windowing' indicates a sequential release window restriction; 'league_mandate' indicates a sports league blackout mandate; 'regulatory' indicates an FCC or Ofcom regulatory requirement; 'carriage_agreement' indicates a distribution carriage fee agreement restriction.
attributes.references: Rightsline Windowing and Holdback; FCC Sports Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76.111); Internal Rights Governance

attributes.name: mediafirst_rule_code
attributes.description: The corresponding blackout rule identifier in Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system. Used to synchronize blackout enforcement between the scheduling data product and the playout automation layer.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: must_carry_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this blackout rule is exempt from must-carry obligations under FCC regulations. When True, the blackout may override must-carry requirements for the specified territory, typically applicable to sports blackout rules under 47 CFR Part 76.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76.56); FCC Sports Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76.111)

attributes.name: restricted_platform_type
attributes.description: The distribution platform category on which the blackout is enforced. Supports platform-specific blackout enforcement across linear broadcast, SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand), AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand), TVOD (Transactional Video On Demand), OTT (Over-The-Top), MVPD (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor), vMVPD (Virtual MVPD), and FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear|svod|avod|tvod|ott|mvpd|vmvpd|fast — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); Internal Platform Taxonomy; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: restricted_territory_code
attributes.description: The specific geographic territory code where the blackout is enforced, aligned with the restricted_territory_type. For DMA, this is the Nielsen DMA code (e.g., '501' for New York); for country, this is ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (e.g., 'GBR'); for state/province, this is ISO 3166-2 (e.g., 'US-CA'). Used by Akamai CDN for geo-fencing enforcement.
attributes.references: Nielsen DMA Codes; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ISO 3166-2; Akamai CDN Geo-Restriction

attributes.name: restricted_territory_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the restricted geographic territory (e.g., 'New York DMA', 'United Kingdom', 'California'). Used in EPG displays, rights clearance reports, and operational dashboards.

attributes.name: restricted_territory_type
attributes.description: Granularity level of the geographic restriction applied by this blackout rule. 'dma' refers to Nielsen Designated Market Area; 'country' uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; 'postal_region' uses postal code ranges; 'state_province' uses ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes; 'designated_zone' refers to a custom broadcast zone defined in the rights contract.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research DMA Definitions; ISO 3166-1; FCC Geographic Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76)

attributes.name: retransmission_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this blackout rule is linked to a retransmission consent agreement. When True, the blackout is enforced as a condition of the retransmission consent negotiation between the broadcaster and the MVPD or vMVPD distributor.
attributes.references: FCC Retransmission Consent Rules (47 CFR Part 76.64); Internal Carriage Agreement Governance

attributes.name: rightsline_restriction_code
attributes.description: The restriction or holdback record identifier in Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management system that is the source of record for this blackout obligation. Enables bidirectional traceability between scheduling enforcement and rights contract management.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Internal Rights Governance

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the blackout rule, used in Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation and Akamai CDN enforcement configurations. Follows the BKO- prefix convention for operational traceability.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout Automation; SCTE-35 Blackout Signaling Standard

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the blackout rule, used in EPG management interfaces and rights clearance workflows (e.g., 'NFL Sunday Ticket DMA Blackout - New York'). Supports operational identification in Rightsline and Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Internal EPG Governance; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: rule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes providing additional context for the blackout rule, such as specific contractual conditions, exceptions, or instructions for the scheduling and playout teams. Not used for enforcement logic.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the blackout rule. 'draft' indicates the rule is being configured; 'active' indicates it is currently enforced at playout and CDN; 'suspended' indicates temporary non-enforcement; 'expired' indicates the rule window has passed; 'cancelled' indicates the rule was voided before activation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout Automation; Internal Scheduling Governance

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the blackout rule by its originating business driver. 'rights_holdback' indicates a contractual windowing restriction from Rightsline; 'regulatory' indicates FCC or Ofcom mandate; 'sports_blackout' indicates league-mandated local market blackout; 'network_exclusivity' indicates carriage agreement exclusivity; 'geographic_restriction' indicates a general territorial restriction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rights_holdback|regulatory|sports_blackout|network_exclusivity|geographic_restriction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry and Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA)

attributes.name: scte35_cue_code
attributes.description: The SCTE-35 splice_event_id or cue identifier associated with this blackout rule, used by Ericsson MediaFirst to insert the blackout signal into the transport stream at the correct splice point. Enables automated blackout triggering at playout.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; ATSC A/53

attributes.name: simulcast_blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the blackout rule applies to simulcast transmissions of the content across multiple platforms simultaneously. When True, the blackout is enforced on all simulcast streams in addition to the primary broadcast channel.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Simulcast Configuration; Internal Simulcast Policy

attributes.name: substitute_content_type
attributes.description: Classification of the substitute content to be delivered during the blackout window. 'alternate_program' is a scheduled replacement; 'local_affiliate_feed' is a local station feed; 'blackout_slate' is a static or animated blackout message; 'network_filler' is generic filler programming; 'none' indicates no substitute is configured.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76.120); Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: timezone_code
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the blackout window (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Ensures correct local-time interpretation of blackout_start_timestamp and blackout_end_timestamp for playout automation and CDN enforcement.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this blackout rule record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any attribute of the rule, supporting change management, audit trails, and downstream incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); SOX Compliance; Internal Data Governance

products.name: playout_event
products.description: As-run log record from Ericsson MediaFirst capturing actual transmission of each schedule slot as broadcast. Records actual start/end time, duration, content ID, channel, playout status (aired, skipped, substituted, failed), automation mode (auto, manual, override), operator ID, and deviation from planned schedule in seconds. The authoritative as-run record serving as the evidentiary basis for affidavit generation, rights usage reporting, advertiser billing reconciliation, and regulatory proof-of-performance.

attributes.name: playout_event_id

attributes.name: ad_pod_id

attributes.name: affidavit_id

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned program schedule entry from which this playout event was derived. Enables deviation analysis between planned and actual transmission.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.schedule_slot. Business justification: Playout events are as-run logs capturing actual transmission of schedule slots. Currently playout_event links to program_schedule but not to the specific schedule_slot that was transmitted. This FK en

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.talent_profile. Business justification: Playout systems log actual talent appearances for affidavit generation, residual payment calculation triggers, and as-run reconciliation against talent contracts. Required for guild reporting, usage r

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Supports as-run reconciliation and equipment maintena

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Actual transmitted duration of the playout event in seconds as recorded in the as-run log. Used for rights usage reporting, billing reconciliation, and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual transmission end time as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. Used with actual_start_time to confirm full transmission and calculate actual duration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual transmission start time as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. The authoritative timestamp for affidavit generation, rights usage reporting, and regulatory proof-of-performance.

attributes.name: affidavit_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a broadcast affidavit (proof-of-performance document) has been generated for this playout event in Wide Orbit. Affidavits are the evidentiary basis for advertiser billing and regulatory compliance.
