attributes.name: automation_mode
attributes.description: Operational mode of the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation at the time of this event. 'auto' = fully automated playout; 'manual' = operator-controlled; 'override' = scheduled automation overridden by operator; 'failover' = backup/failover system active.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was subject to a geographic broadcast blackout restriction. When true, the event was blacked out in one or more markets per rights or regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this playout event was transmitted, expressed in the channel's local broadcast day (which may differ from UTC date for overnight programming).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: broadcast_standard
attributes.description: Technical broadcast standard under which this playout event was transmitted. Determines encoding, modulation, and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee) Standards; DVB Project (Digital Video Broadcasting) Standards; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Content rating classification of the transmitted asset as defined by the Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines. Used for COPPA compliance, watershed enforcement, and FCC children's programming obligations.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines; FCC Children's Television Act; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this as-run playout event record was first ingested into the Silver layer from the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was eligible for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) on OTT/streaming platforms. Used for digital advertising reconciliation and DAI revenue attribution.
attributes.references: IAB DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) Standards; SCTE-35 Standard

attributes.name: dalet_asset_code
attributes.description: Asset identifier in the Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system for the content transmitted in this playout event. Used for digital asset reconciliation and archive linkage.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the playout event by content category. Determines applicable rights, billing rules, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: program|commercial|promo|interstitial|filler|ident|emergency_alert — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE Standards; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: failover_activated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Ericsson MediaFirst failover/backup playout system was active during this event. When true, the primary playout chain was unavailable and the backup system handled transmission.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: isan_code
attributes.description: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) identifying the programme or content asset transmitted. Used for rights usage reporting and royalty calculation in Rightsline.
attributes.references: ISAN (International Standard Audiovisual Number) ISO 15706; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: isci_code
attributes.description: Industry Standard Commercial Identification (ISCI) code for the commercial asset transmitted in this playout event. Used for advertiser billing reconciliation and affidavit generation in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; ISCI (Industry Standard Commercial Identification) Standard

attributes.name: mediafirst_event_code
attributes.description: Native event identifier assigned by Ericsson MediaFirst automation system for this as-run log entry. Used for reconciliation with the source playout system.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: must_carry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was subject to must-carry obligations requiring mandatory channel inclusion by MVPDs. Used for regulatory compliance reporting to the FCC.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76); MVPD (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor) Regulations

attributes.name: playout_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the playout event as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. 'aired' = transmitted as planned; 'skipped' = omitted from transmission; 'substituted' = replaced with alternate content; 'failed' = transmission error; 'partial' = incomplete transmission; 'delayed' = transmitted late.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Rights clearance status of the content asset at the time of transmission. 'cleared' = rights verified and valid; 'pending' = clearance in progress; 'expired' = rights window had lapsed; 'restricted' = transmission was restricted. Used for rights compliance audit and Rightsline reconciliation.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Compliance

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Planned duration of the playout event in seconds as defined in the program schedule rundown. Used as the baseline for duration deviation analysis.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned transmission start time for this event as defined in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and program schedule rundown. Used as the baseline for schedule deviation calculation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; EPG (Electronic Program Guide) Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms (simulcast). When true, the event was transmitted on additional channels or OTT platforms concurrently.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: start_deviation_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between actual_start_time and scheduled_start_time. Positive values indicate late start; negative values indicate early start. Key metric for schedule adherence and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the originally scheduled content was substituted with alternate content. Populated only when playout_status is 'substituted'. Used for rights compliance and editorial audit trails.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Compliance

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Mode of content delivery for this playout event. 'linear' = traditional scheduled broadcast; 'vod' = Video On Demand; 'simulcast' = simultaneous multi-platform; 'ott' = Over-The-Top streaming; 'fast' = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this playout event record was last modified in the Silver layer, for example following affidavit generation, rights clearance update, or schedule reconciliation.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: wide_orbit_log_code

attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

Used by Ericsson MediaFirst automation for live show playout control and by production teams for show preparation.

attributes.name: total_ad_time_seconds

attributes.name: total_runtime_seconds

attributes.name: transmitted_timestamp

attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Affidavit

attributes.name: wide_orbit_log_code

products.name: rundown_item

attributes.name: rundown_item_id

products.name: channel_carriage
products.description: This association product represents the carriage contract between a linear broadcast channel and an OTT platform. It captures the commercial and technical terms under which a specific channel is distributed on a specific OTT platform. Each record links one channel to one OTT platform with platform-specific configurations including simulcast timing, channel positioning, branding overrides, ad insertion rules, and blackout policies that exist only in the context of this distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, linear broadcast channels are distributed across multiple OTT platforms simultaneously (e.g., CNN appears on Hulu, YouTube TV, Peacock, Sling), and each OTT platform carries dozens to hundreds of channels in its lineup. Each channel-platform pairing requires a distinct carriage agreement with platform-specific commercial terms (carriage fees, contract dates) and technical configurations (channel numbering, branding, DAI settings, blackout overrides, EPG sync). The business actively manages these carriage agreements as operational contracts.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the linear broadcast channel being carried on the OTT platform

attributes.name: contract_end_date

attributes.description: The date on which this channel ceased or will cease simulcast distribution on this OTT platform. Null indicates ongoing carriage. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: simulcast_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this channel began or will begin simulcast distribution on this OTT platform. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

products.name: channel_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the media buying allocation between a broadcast channel and an advertising campaign. It captures the strategic distribution of campaign budget, GRP targets, and spot inventory across channels. Each record links one channel to one campaign with flight dates, allocated budget, target GRPs, spot counts, and delivery tracking that exist only in the context of this specific channel-campaign pairing.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, advertising campaigns are strategically distributed across multiple broadcast channels to reach target audiences, and each channel simultaneously carries multiple campaigns from different advertisers. Media buyers actively manage channel allocations as distinct planning and fulfillment entities, tracking budget distribution, GRP targets, flight schedules, spot counts, and delivery performance for each campaign-channel pairing.

attributes.name: channel_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this channel allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the advertising campaign being allocated to this channel

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broadcast channel where campaign ads will air

attributes.name: actual_grp_delivered
attributes.description: The actual Gross Rating Points delivered on this channel for this campaign as of the last measurement. Compared against target_grp to assess delivery performance.

attributes.name: actual_spots_aired
attributes.description: The actual number of ad spots that have aired on this channel for this campaign as of the last measurement. Compared against spot_count to track fulfillment.

attributes.name: allocated_budget_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total campaign budget allocated to this specific channel. Sum of all channel allocations should equal campaign total_budget_amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daypart_mix
attributes.description: The distribution of spots across dayparts (e.g., Prime: 40%, Early Fringe: 30%, Late Night: 30%) for this channel allocation. Defines when ads will air.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this channel allocation. Tracks whether the contracted spots and GRPs are being delivered as planned.

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: The date when ad spots for this campaign stop airing on this channel. Must fall within campaign_start_date and campaign_end_date.

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: The date when ad spots for this campaign begin airing on this channel. Must fall within campaign_start_date and campaign_end_date.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel allocation record was last modified.

attributes.name: spot_count
attributes.description: The total number of ad spots contracted to air on this channel for this campaign during the flight period.

attributes.name: target_grp
attributes.description: Target Gross Rating Points allocated to this channel for this campaign. Represents the reach and frequency goals specific to this channel allocation.

products.name: channel_license
products.description: This association product represents the broadcast rights grant between a content title and a linear channel. It captures the licensing agreement that authorizes a specific channel to broadcast a specific title within defined temporal, territorial, and usage constraints. Each record links one title to one channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this licensing relationship—including license windows, exclusivity terms, geographic restrictions, and run limits that govern how and when the content may be aired.. Existence Justification: In broadcast operations, content titles are licensed to multiple linear channels simultaneously under separate rights agreements, and each channel carries a portfolio of many titles under distinct license terms. The licensing relationship is an operational business entity actively managed by rights and scheduling teams—each license has its own temporal window, territorial restrictions, exclusivity terms, run limits, and financial terms that cannot be modeled as attributes of either the title or the channel alone. This is the core 'Channel License' or 'Broadcast Rights Grant' business concept.

attributes.name: channel_license_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel license record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the linear broadcast channel receiving the license

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the content title being licensed for broadcast

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this license record was created in the broadcast rights management system.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license grants exclusive broadcast rights to this channel within the specified territory, preventing other channels from airing the same title during the license window.

attributes.name: license_end_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the broadcast license window. Defines when the channel must cease airing the title unless the license is renewed.

attributes.name: license_fee_usd
attributes.description: The total licensing fee paid by the channel to acquire broadcast rights for this title, denominated in US dollars. Used for rights cost allocation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: license_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the broadcast license window. Defines when the channel is authorized to begin airing the title.

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the license. Active licenses are available for scheduling; expired licenses have passed their end date; suspended licenses are temporarily unavailable; pending licenses are awaiting activation.

attributes.name: runs_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of times the channel is permitted to broadcast this title under this license agreement. Null indicates unlimited runs.

attributes.name: runs_consumed
attributes.description: The cumulative count of times this title has been broadcast on this channel under this license. Incremented by playout automation after each airing. Used to enforce runs_allowed limits.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country or region code defining the geographic territory where this license is valid. Enforces territorial broadcast restrictions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this license record was last modified, typically when runs_consumed is incremented or license_status is changed.

products.name: channel_asset_playout
products.description: This association product represents the playout configuration between channel and media_asset. It captures channel-specific asset management for broadcast automation, including playout priority, backup designation, versioning, air history, and rotation scheduling. Each record links one channel to one media_asset with operational metadata that exists only in the context of this channel-asset relationship for Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation.. Existence Justification: In broadcast operations, the same media asset (e.g., syndicated show master, promotional spot, filler content) is licensed and configured for playout across multiple channels, and each channel maintains a library of multiple assets in rotation. The relationship is actively managed by broadcast operations teams who configure channel-specific playout rules, priority rankings, rotation schedules, and air history tracking for each channel-asset combination in the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system.

attributes.name: channel_asset_playout_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this channel-asset playout configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broadcast channel that will air this media asset

attributes.name: media_asset_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Asset Playout - Media Asset Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the media asset configured for playout on this channel

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset becomes available for playout on this channel. Supports embargo management and scheduled content releases.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset is no longer available for playout on this channel. Supports license expiration, seasonal content rotation, and rights window management.

attributes.name: air_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this asset has been broadcast on this channel. Used for rights management (license play limits), rotation analytics, and content performance tracking.

attributes.name: backup_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset serves as a backup/filler for this channel. Backup assets are used when primary scheduled content is unavailable or to fill unscheduled time slots.

attributes.name: channel_specific_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for channel-specific edits or adaptations of the media asset (e.g., regional edit, censored version, time-compressed version). Same base asset may have different versions per channel based on content rating, market, or time slot requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel-asset playout configuration was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_aired_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent playout of this asset on this channel. Used for rotation management to ensure content freshness and avoid excessive repetition.

attributes.name: max_plays_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this asset may be broadcast on this channel within a 24-hour period. Used to prevent over-rotation and maintain content variety.

attributes.name: min_hours_between_plays
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours that must elapse between consecutive airings of this asset on this channel. Prevents back-to-back repetition.

attributes.name: playout_priority
attributes.description: Channel-specific priority ranking for this asset in automated playout rotation. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst to select assets when multiple options are available.

attributes.name: playout_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this channel-asset playout configuration. Active=available for playout, Suspended=temporarily disabled, Expired=past active_to_date, Pending=before active_from_date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this channel-asset playout configuration.

products.name: channel_abr_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of Adaptive Bitrate encoding profiles to broadcast channels for multi-platform streaming delivery. It captures the technical configuration decisions made by broadcast operations teams to optimize encoding costs and viewer Quality of Experience (QoE) across different device classes and quality tiers. Each record links one channel to one ABR profile with effective dates, priority rankings, and device-specific overrides that exist only in the context of this streaming delivery configuration.. Existence Justification: In broadcast operations, a single channel requires multiple ABR profiles to serve different device classes (mobile, tablet, smart TV, desktop) and quality tiers (SD, HD, 4K, HDR) simultaneously. Conversely, a single ABR profile (e.g., 'Standard HD H.264') is reused across dozens or hundreds of channels to standardize encoding and reduce operational complexity. Broadcast operations teams actively manage these assignments with effective dates, priority rankings, device overrides, and cost estimates as a core operational process.

attributes.name: channel_abr_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel-to-ABR-profile assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: abr_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Abr Assignment - Abr Profile Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the ABR encoding ladder profile being assigned to the channel

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broadcast channel receiving the ABR profile assignment

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broadcast operations or encoding engineer who created this ABR profile assignment. Used for audit trail and operational accountability.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this ABR profile was assigned to this channel (e.g., 'Upgraded to 4K for premium sports content', 'Cost optimization - reduced bitrate ladder', 'New HDR support for flagship channel').

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assignment. Active assignments are used in production encoding; scheduled assignments will become active at effective_start_date; testing assignments are used in pre-production validation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: device_class_override
attributes.description: Optional device class override that restricts this ABR profile assignment to specific device types, overriding the profile's default target_device_class. Used when a channel requires different encoding strategies per device class (e.g., mobile-optimized profile for cellular delivery, 4K profile for smart TVs).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ABR profile assignment expires or is superseded by a new assignment. Null indicates the assignment is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ABR profile assignment becomes active for the channel. Used by the encoding farm to determine which profile to apply for transcode jobs initiated after this date.

attributes.name: encoding_cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated monthly encoding cost in USD for this channel-profile assignment, calculated based on channel broadcast hours, ABR profile complexity (rendition count, codec), and encoding farm pricing. Used for cost optimization and budget planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was last updated.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority or preference order of this ABR profile for the channel when multiple profiles are assigned simultaneously (e.g., primary HD profile = 1, fallback SD profile = 2). Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: qos_tier
attributes.description: Quality of Service tier designation for this specific channel-profile assignment, which may differ from the ABR profile's default qos_tier. Allows per-channel QoS tuning based on content importance, audience demographics, or commercial agreements.

products.name: channel_targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting strategy between channel and demographic_segment. It captures the commercial and programming relationship where each channel defines segment-specific rate cards, GRP guarantees, and daypart strategies for ad sales and upfront negotiations. Each record links one channel to one demographic segment with pricing, performance targets, and effectiveness metrics that exist only in the context of this channel-segment pairing.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, channels actively define and manage targeting strategies for multiple demographic segments simultaneously, with each channel-segment pairing having distinct rate cards, GRP guarantees, and daypart strategies used in upfront negotiations and ad sales. Conversely, each demographic segment (e.g., A18-49, W25-54) is targeted by multiple channels with different commercial terms and performance commitments. This is a core operational relationship managed by ad sales and programming teams, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: channel_targeting_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel-demographic targeting record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broadcast channel being targeted

attributes.name: demographic_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the demographic segment being targeted by this channel

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel targeting record was created in the system.

attributes.name: daypart_strategy
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of dayparts where this channel actively targets this demographic segment (e.g., Prime Time, Late Fringe, Early Morning). Drives programming and ad inventory allocation decisions.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this channel-demographic targeting strategy and rate structure became effective. Typically aligned with broadcast season or upfront period start.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this channel-demographic targeting strategy and rate structure remains effective. Null indicates current/ongoing targeting. Used to track historical targeting strategy changes.

attributes.name: guaranteed_grp
attributes.description: The guaranteed Gross Rating Points (GRP) committed to advertisers for this channel-demographic pairing during the upfront sales period. Drives make-good obligations if underdelivered.

attributes.name: is_primary_target
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demographic segment is designated as a primary target demographic for this channel (vs. secondary or tertiary). Primary targets drive programming decisions and receive highest sales priority.

attributes.name: rate_multiplier
attributes.description: The pricing multiplier applied to the base CPM rate for this demographic segment on this channel. Reflects the relative value and scarcity of this audience on this specific channel (e.g., 1.25 for premium demos, 0.80 for lower-value segments).

attributes.name: target_rating
attributes.description: The target rating point (percentage of demographic universe) that this channel aims to achieve for this specific demographic segment. Used in upfront guarantees and programming performance evaluation.

attributes.name: targeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this channel-demographic targeting relationship. Active indicates current targeting, Planned for future seasons, Suspended for temporary holds, Discontinued for ended strategies.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel targeting record was last modified.

products.name: daypart_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of employees to broadcast daypart coverage responsibilities. It captures which employees are scheduled to work during which dayparts, including their role during that time period, the days of week they cover, and whether this is their primary daypart responsibility. Each record links one daypart to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this staffing assignment.. Existence Justification: In 24/7 broadcast operations, employees are assigned to cover multiple dayparts (e.g., a master control operator may cover Early Morning MON-WED and Late Fringe THU-FRI), and each daypart requires multiple employees in different operational roles (producer, technical director, audio engineer, traffic coordinator, etc.). The business actively manages these staffing assignments with specific roles, day-of-week patterns, and time periods. This is an operational workforce scheduling relationship, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: daypart_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this daypart assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to workforce.employee - identifies which employee is assigned to this daypart

attributes.name: scheduling_daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to scheduling.daypart - identifies which broadcast daypart this assignment covers

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date this employee stopped covering this daypart (null for active assignments). Used for tracking assignment history and staffing transitions. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date this employee began covering this daypart in this role. Used for tracking assignment history and calculating tenure. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this daypart assignment. active = currently scheduled, on_leave = temporarily suspended, temporary = short-term coverage, ended = assignment completed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was created in the system

attributes.name: days_of_week
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of days this employee covers this daypart (e.g., MON|TUE|WED or SAT|SUN). Allows for split-week scheduling patterns common in 24/7 broadcast operations. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: primary_daypart_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the employees primary daypart assignment (true) or a secondary/backup assignment (false). Used for scheduling priority and resource allocation. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: shift_role
attributes.description: The operational role the employee performs during this daypart assignment. Examples: producer, director, technical_director, master_control_operator, traffic_coordinator. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was last modified

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dai_enabled

attributes.name: dai_provider

attributes.name: drm_system

attributes.name: epg_feed_url

attributes.name: fast_channel_enabled

attributes.name: free_trial_days

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable

attributes.name: hdr_supported

attributes.name: launch_date

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: The maximum number of simultaneous streams permitted per subscriber account on this platform. Enforced at the entitlement layer to prevent credential sharing and manage CDN bandwidth capacity. A key parameter in Zuora subscription plan configuration.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: max_download_devices
attributes.description: The maximum number of devices on which a subscriber may store downloaded content for offline viewing on this platform. Null if offline downloads are not supported. Governed by DRM policy and Rightsline windowing rules.

attributes.name: max_video_resolution

attributes.references: ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4

attributes.name: mvpd_carriage_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Multichannel Video Programming Distributor (MVPD) Carriage Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OTT platform's content or channels are eligible for carriage by MVPD or vMVPD partners (cable, satellite, virtual pay-TV operators). True = eligible for carriage agreements; False = direct-to-consumer only. Governs retransmission consent and must-carry negotiations.
attributes.references: FCC Retransmission Consent Rules; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: parent_brand
attributes.description: The overarching corporate or media brand under which this OTT platform operates (e.g., 'Media Broadcasting Group', 'MB Sports Network'). Supports brand hierarchy reporting, consolidated audience measurement, and multi-brand advertising sales in Salesforce Media Cloud.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to the OTT platform (e.g., 'MB_SVOD_WEB', 'MB_AVOD_CTV'). Used in operational systems, contracts, and partner integrations as the canonical platform identifier. Maps to the platform identifier used in Zuora subscription plans and Akamai CDN configuration.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; Akamai CDN Platform Configuration

attributes.name: platform_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the platform's content offering, target audience, and service proposition. Used in partner onboarding documentation, regulatory filings, and internal product catalogues.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Official commercial brand name of the OTT platform as presented to subscribers and partners (e.g., 'MediaBroadcast+', 'MB Sports Live'). Used in marketing materials, EPG listings, and subscriber-facing interfaces.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: platform_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the OTT platform. 'active' = live and serving audiences; 'beta' = limited release for testing; 'sunset' = scheduled for decommission; 'suspended' = temporarily offline; 'inactive' = decommissioned. Governs whether the platform is eligible for new subscriber acquisition, ad campaign targeting, and CDN resource allocation.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; FCC Broadcast Licensing

attributes.name: primary_streaming_protocol
attributes.description: The primary adaptive bitrate streaming protocol used for content delivery on this platform. HLS = HTTP Live Streaming (Apple standard, widely supported); MPEG-DASH = Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (ISO 23009 standard); RTMP = Real-Time Messaging Protocol (legacy live); SRT = Secure Reliable Transport (low-latency live). Drives CDN configuration in Akamai and player SDK selection.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH; ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; Akamai CDN Configuration

attributes.name: secondary_streaming_protocol
attributes.description: Fallback or secondary adaptive bitrate streaming protocol supported by the platform for device compatibility or redundancy. Null or 'NONE' if only one protocol is used. Supports multi-protocol CDN origin configuration in Akamai.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH; ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Business model classification of the OTT platform. SVOD = Subscription Video On Demand (recurring fee, no ads); AVOD = Advertising-Supported Video On Demand (free with ads); TVOD = Transactional Video On Demand (pay-per-view); FAST = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (linear-style free channel); HYBRID = combination of tiers. Drives revenue recognition logic in Zuora and ad inventory management in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); Zuora Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: sla_uptime_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Target Percentage
attributes.description: The contractually committed platform availability target expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.95). Governs CDN SLA enforcement with Akamai, incident escalation thresholds, and operational reporting. Distinct from actual measured uptime.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN SLA; SCTE Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: Current count of active paying or registered subscribers on this platform as of the last reconciliation cycle. A key operational metric for ARPU calculation, churn rate monitoring, and Zuora revenue reporting. Confidential as it represents commercially sensitive business performance data.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; Nielsen Media Research; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the OTT platform will be or was decommissioned. Null if the platform has no scheduled end-of-life. Used for subscriber migration planning, contract wind-down, and CDN resource deallocation.
attributes.references: Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; FCC Broadcast Licensing

attributes.name: supported_device_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of device categories supported by this platform (e.g., 'web,mobile,ctv,stb,gaming_console'). Drives device compatibility testing, app store distribution, and audience reach reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile|ctv|stb|gaming_console|smart_tv|tablet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: target_start_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: The minimum target bitrate in kilobits per second at which the ABR player should initiate playback on this platform. Drives ABR profile ladder configuration in Akamai CDN and QoS monitoring thresholds. Key parameter for streaming quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; Akamai CDN Configuration; ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OTT platform record was most recently modified. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: zuora_product_code
attributes.description: The product identifier in Zuora's subscription billing platform corresponding to this OTT platform's subscription offering. Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and subscription lifecycle management. Links the platform master record to Zuora's billing product catalogue.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI

products.name: device_type
products.description: Reference catalog of all device categories and models supported across OTT platforms — smart TVs, mobile phones, tablets, desktop browsers, streaming sticks, gaming consoles, and STBs. Captures device category, manufacturer, OS family, OS version range, screen resolution class, HDR capability, DRM compatibility (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay), ABR profile support, and certification status. Used for device-specific playback configuration and QoS segmentation.

attributes.name: device_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the device type record. Primary key.

attributes.name: broadcast_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_standard. Business justification: Device types support specific broadcast standards (ATSC 3.0, DVB-T2). Required for device certification and broadcast standard support matrix.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.maintenance_work_order. Business justification: Device types require maintenance tracking for firmware updates and recalls. Required for device firmware update campaigns and recall management.

attributes.name: abr_profile_dash
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) adaptive bitrate streaming protocol.

attributes.name: abr_profile_hls
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Profile HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) Supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) adaptive bitrate streaming protocol.

attributes.name: abr_profile_smooth
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Profile Smooth Streaming Supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports Microsoft Smooth Streaming adaptive bitrate protocol.

attributes.name: active_install_base
attributes.description: Estimated number of active devices of this type currently accessing the OTT platform, used for capacity planning and analytics.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the device successfully completed OTT platform certification testing.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the device certification expires and requires re-certification for continued platform support.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current certification status of the device for OTT platform compatibility (certified, pending, failed, not_tested).

attributes.name: codec_audio_support
attributes.description: List of audio codecs supported by the device (e.g., AAC, Dolby Digital, Dolby Atmos, DTS). Pipe-separated list.

attributes.name: codec_video_support
attributes.description: List of video codecs supported by the device (e.g., H.264, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1). Pipe-separated list.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4, VP9, AV1 Codec Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this device type record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dai_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) for server-side ad stitching in streaming content.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST), SCTE-35 Standards

attributes.name: device_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the device type (e.g., smart TV, mobile phone, tablet, desktop browser, streaming stick, gaming console, set-top box). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: smart_tv|mobile_phone|tablet|desktop_browser|streaming_stick|gaming_console|set_top_box — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drm_fairplay_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports Apple FairPlay DRM for content protection.

attributes.name: drm_playready_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports Microsoft PlayReady DRM for content protection.

attributes.name: drm_widevine_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Digital Rights Management (DRM) Widevine Security Level
attributes.description: Google Widevine DRM security level supported (L1 = hardware-backed, L2 = software-backed, L3 = software only, not_supported).

attributes.name: form_factor
attributes.description: Physical form factor of the device (handheld, television, desktop, wearable, embedded).

attributes.name: hdr_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports HDR (High Dynamic Range) video playback for enhanced color and contrast.

attributes.name: hdr_format
attributes.description: Specific HDR formats supported by the device (e.g., HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG). Pipe-separated list if multiple formats are supported.

attributes.name: input_method
attributes.description: Primary input method(s) supported by the device (e.g., touchscreen, remote_control, keyboard_mouse, voice, gamepad). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this device type is currently active and supported for OTT platform streaming.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the device manufacturer or brand (e.g., Samsung, Apple, Roku, Amazon, LG, Sony).

attributes.name: max_bitrate_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum streaming bitrate supported by the device in megabits per second (Mbps), used for ABR profile selection and QoS (Quality of Service) optimization.

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Specific model name or identifier assigned by the manufacturer (e.g., Galaxy S21, iPhone 13 Pro, Fire TV Stick 4K).

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Technical model number or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) used for precise device identification and inventory tracking.

attributes.name: network_capability
attributes.description: Network connectivity capabilities of the device (e.g., wifi, ethernet, cellular_4g, cellular_5g). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: os_family
attributes.description: Operating system family running on the device (e.g., Android, iOS, tvOS, webOS, Tizen, Roku OS, Fire OS, Windows, macOS, Linux, PlayStation, Xbox). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: android|ios|tvos|webos|tizen|roku_os|fire_os|windows|macos|linux|playstation|xbox — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: os_version_max
attributes.description: Maximum OS version tested and certified for compatibility. Null indicates no upper bound.

attributes.name: os_version_min
attributes.description: Minimum OS version required for OTT (Over-The-Top) platform compatibility and playback support.

attributes.name: qos_tier
attributes.description: QoS tier assigned to the device type for streaming quality segmentation and CDN (Content Delivery Network) routing (premium, standard, basic).

attributes.name: screen_resolution_class
attributes.description: Display resolution category supported by the device (SD, HD, Full HD, 4K UHD (Ultra High Definition), 8K UHD).

attributes.name: support_end_date
attributes.description: Date when platform support for this device type will be discontinued, after which playback may no longer be guaranteed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this device type record was last modified.

attributes.name: user_agent_string
attributes.description: Standard HTTP user agent string reported by the device, used for device detection and analytics.

products.name: app_version
products.description: Tracks all released and in-flight versions of the Media Broadcasting OTT client applications across platforms (iOS, Android, tvOS, Roku, Fire TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Xbox, PlayStation). Captures app version number, platform target, release date, minimum OS version, feature flags enabled, DRM library version, player SDK version, A/B test cohort assignments, force-upgrade threshold, and deprecation date. Critical for QoS root-cause analysis and rollout management.

attributes.name: app_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each application version release. Primary key for the app_version product.

attributes.name: accessibility_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accessibility_obligation. Business justification: Each app version must demonstrate compliance with accessibility standards. Version-specific accessibility features (screen reader support, caption rendering) are validated against applicable obligatio

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.ott_platform. Business justification: Each app version is built for a specific OTT platform. app_version.platform is STRING but should FK to ott_platform master. Removes platform_type (derivable from ott_platform.platform_code).

attributes.name: ab_test_cohort
attributes.description: Identifier for the A/B test cohort or experiment group assigned to this application version. Used for controlled feature testing and user experience optimization.

attributes.name: active_install_count
attributes.description: The current number of active installations of this application version across all users. Used for version adoption tracking and deprecation planning.

attributes.name: analytics_sdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the analytics SDK integrated for tracking user engagement, viewership metrics, and QoS (Quality of Service) data.

attributes.name: app_size_mb
attributes.description: The total download size of the application package in megabytes. Important for user download experience and app store requirements.

attributes.name: build_number
attributes.description: Internal build identifier assigned by the continuous integration system. Used for precise version tracking and debugging. May be numeric or alphanumeric.

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version meets CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) requirements for viewer data privacy in California.

attributes.name: cdn_endpoint_url
attributes.description: The primary CDN (Content Delivery Network) endpoint URL configured for this application version. Determines content delivery infrastructure and streaming performance.

attributes.name: closed_caption_support
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports closed captioning and subtitles for accessibility compliance.

attributes.name: crash_reporting_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated crash reporting and error tracking is enabled for this application version. Critical for QoS root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this application version record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and version history tracking.

attributes.name: dai_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) for server-side ad stitching in streaming content.

attributes.name: dash_support_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) protocol for video streaming.

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: The date when this application version will be officially deprecated and no longer supported. Nullable for current production versions.

attributes.name: dolby_atmos_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports Dolby Atmos immersive audio technology.

attributes.name: drm_library_version
attributes.description: Version of the DRM (Digital Rights Management) library integrated into this application build. Critical for content protection and license enforcement compliance.

attributes.name: feature_flags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or JSON string of feature flags enabled in this application version. Controls experimental features, A/B test variants, and gradual rollout capabilities.

attributes.name: force_upgrade_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum application version number below which users will be forced to upgrade. Used to enforce critical security patches or deprecate incompatible versions.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version meets GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) requirements for user data privacy and consent management in EU markets.

attributes.name: hdr_support_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports HDR (High Dynamic Range) video playback for enhanced picture quality.

attributes.name: hls_support_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) protocol for adaptive bitrate video delivery.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal technical notes and documentation for this application version. Includes deployment instructions, known issues, and rollback procedures.

attributes.name: max_bitrate_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Bitrate in Megabits Per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: The maximum streaming bitrate supported by this application version in Mbps. Determines highest video quality available through ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming).

attributes.name: minimum_os_version
attributes.description: The minimum operating system version required to run this application version. Format varies by platform (e.g., iOS 14.0, Android 10, Roku OS 9.4).

attributes.name: offline_playback_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version supports offline content download and playback for SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand) users.

attributes.name: parental_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application version includes parental control features for content rating enforcement and child safety.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The OTT (Over-The-Top) platform or operating system for which this application version was built. Determines device compatibility and distribution channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iOS|Android|tvOS|Roku|Fire TV|Samsung Tizen|LG webOS|Xbox|PlayStation|Web — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: player_sdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the video player SDK embedded in this application. Determines streaming capabilities, ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming) support, and playback features.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date when this application version was officially released to production and made available to end users through app stores or distribution channels.

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: User-facing description of new features, bug fixes, and improvements included in this application version. Published in app stores and update notifications.

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the application version. Tracks progression from development through production release to eventual deprecation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: development|alpha|beta|release_candidate|released|deprecated|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rollout_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of users to whom this application version is currently deployed. Used for gradual rollout and canary deployment strategies (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: supported_resolutions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of video resolutions supported by this application version (e.g., 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K). Determines playback quality options.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this application version record was last modified. Tracks changes to version metadata, status updates, and configuration changes.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the application release following major.minor.patch format (e.g., 3.2.1, 4.0.0-beta). This is the externally-known identifier for the release.

products.name: streaming_endpoint
products.description: Master record of all streaming origin and edge endpoints managed across the CDN infrastructure (Akamai CDN). Captures endpoint URL, CDN provider, PoP (Point of Presence) region, protocol (HLS, MPEG-DASH), ABR ladder configuration reference, DRM license server URL, token authentication scheme, geo-restriction rules, failover endpoint reference, SLA tier, and operational status. SSOT for the technical delivery address of each stream.

attributes.name: streaming_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the streaming endpoint. Primary key for the streaming endpoint master record.

attributes.name: abr_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.abr_profile. Business justification: Streaming endpoints use specific ABR profiles. streaming_endpoint.abr_profile_reference is STRING but should FK to abr_profile master. Removes abr_profile_reference STRING.

attributes.name: accessibility_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accessibility_obligation. Business justification: Streaming endpoints must meet accessibility standards (WCAG, CVAA). Each endpoint's technical capabilities (caption support, audio description) are validated against applicable accessibility obligatio

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Streaming endpoints are physically hosted in broadcast facilities. Required for facility outage impact analysis, power/cooling capacity planning, and physical security management.

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Streaming endpoints delivering broadcast content must comply with originating broadcast license terms for geographic restrictions, transmission standards, and regulatory reporting. License governs end

attributes.name: cdn_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.cdn_configuration. Business justification: Streaming endpoints use specific CDN configurations. streaming_endpoint.cdn_provider is STRING but should FK to cdn_configuration. Removes cdn_provider STRING.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Streaming endpoints incur CDN and hosting costs that must be allocated to technology cost centers for chargeback and budget management. Monthly CDN invoice reconciliation allocates bandwidth and compu

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Business justification: Streaming endpoints can have default DAI configurations. Removes dai_provider STRING (derivable from dai_configuration).

attributes.name: drm_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.drm_policy. Business justification: Streaming endpoints enforce specific DRM policies. streaming_endpoint.drm_system is STRING but should FK to drm_policy. Removes drm_system STRING (derivable from drm_policy.drm_system).

attributes.name: encoder_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.encoder_config. Business justification: Streaming endpoints receive feeds from encoder configurations. Required for encoder-endpoint signal routing and configuration management.

attributes.name: failover_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the backup streaming endpoint that should be used if this endpoint becomes unavailable. Supports high availability and disaster recovery.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.maintenance_work_order. Business justification: Streaming endpoints require maintenance work orders for updates and repairs. Required for endpoint maintenance history and downtime impact tracking.

attributes.name: market_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.market_coverage. Business justification: CDN endpoints serve specific DMAs for geo-restriction enforcement, local ad insertion, and market-specific content delivery. Required for retransmission consent compliance and must-carry obligations i

attributes.name: network_circuit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.network_circuit. Business justification: Streaming endpoints rely on network circuits for connectivity. Required for circuit capacity planning and endpoint failover configuration.

attributes.name: noc_monitor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.noc_monitor. Business justification: Streaming endpoints have assigned NOC monitors tracking uptime and latency. Required for NOC monitoring configuration and alert routing.

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.ott_platform. Business justification: Streaming endpoints are provisioned for specific OTT platforms. Each endpoint serves content for a platform. No visible platform_type column but relationship is essential for endpoint management.

attributes.name: outage_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.outage_record. Business justification: Streaming endpoints experience outages requiring tracking. Required for endpoint availability reporting and outage pattern analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Endpoint lifecycle events generate filing re

attributes.name: rights_territory_id

attributes.name: sla_definition_id

attributes.name: software_license_id

attributes.name: tech_project_id

attributes.name: tech_sla_id

attributes.name: technical_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Streaming endpoints are critical infrastructure requiring technical ownership for incident response, maintenance windows, configuration changes, and failover testing. Essential for on-call rotations,

attributes.name: technical_standard_cert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.technical_standard_cert. Business justification: Streaming endpoints must be certified against technical standards (HLS spec, DASH spec, DRM robustness, accessibility). Each endpoint references its certification records for compliance validation.

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: Streaming endpoints rely on transmission equipment (encoders, transcoders). Required for equipment failure impact analysis and encoder capacity management.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endpoint was first activated and began serving live traffic.

attributes.name: bandwidth_limit_gbps
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate bandwidth capacity in gigabits per second allocated to this endpoint. Used for capacity planning and cost management.

attributes.name: cache_ttl_seconds
attributes.description: The duration in seconds that content should be cached at edge locations before refreshing from origin. Balances freshness with CDN efficiency.

attributes.name: cost_per_gb
attributes.description: The CDN provider's charge per gigabyte of data transferred through this endpoint. Used for cost allocation and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this streaming endpoint record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dai_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this endpoint supports Dynamic Ad Insertion, allowing personalized ads to be stitched into the stream in real-time.

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endpoint was deactivated or taken out of service. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: drm_license_server_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Digital Rights Management (DRM) License Server URL
attributes.description: URL of the DRM license server that provides decryption keys and enforces content protection policies for this endpoint. Critical for securing premium content.

attributes.name: endpoint_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the streaming endpoint, used for identification and operational reference.

attributes.name: endpoint_type
attributes.description: Classification of the endpoint role within the CDN architecture. Origin endpoints serve as the source, edge endpoints serve end users, and backup endpoints provide failover capability.
attributes.references: SCTE - Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers Standards

attributes.name: endpoint_url
attributes.description: The full URL address of the streaming endpoint, including protocol, domain, and path. This is the technical delivery address for the stream.

attributes.name: geo_restriction_mode
attributes.description: Defines whether geo_restriction_rules represent an allow list (whitelist) or deny list (blacklist) for content delivery.

attributes.name: geo_restriction_rules
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO country codes or regions where content delivery is allowed or blocked. Enforces territorial licensing and rights management requirements.

attributes.name: health_check_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which automated health checks are performed against this endpoint.

attributes.name: health_check_url
attributes.description: URL endpoint used for automated health monitoring and availability checks. Returns status codes indicating endpoint health.

attributes.name: ipv6_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this endpoint supports IPv6 addressing in addition to IPv4, enabling delivery to modern network infrastructures.

attributes.name: last_health_check_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent successful health check performed on this endpoint.

attributes.name: manifest_format
attributes.description: The streaming manifest file format used by this endpoint. m3u8 for HLS, mpd for MPEG-DASH, ism for Smooth Streaming, f4m for Adobe HDS.

attributes.name: max_bitrate_mbps
attributes.description: The maximum streaming bitrate in megabits per second that this endpoint can deliver. Defines the upper quality limit for adaptive streaming.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this streaming endpoint record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the streaming endpoint. Active endpoints are serving traffic; inactive endpoints are provisioned but not in use; maintenance indicates scheduled downtime.

attributes.name: provisioned_date
attributes.description: The date when this streaming endpoint was initially provisioned and configured in the CDN infrastructure.

attributes.name: sla_uptime_target_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Target Percentage
attributes.description: The contractual uptime percentage target for this endpoint (e.g., 99.99%). Used for SLA compliance monitoring and vendor accountability.

attributes.name: ssl_certificate_expiry_date

attributes.name: streaming_protocol
attributes.description: The streaming protocol used by this endpoint for content delivery. HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) and MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) are the most common adaptive bitrate protocols.

attributes.name: supported_devices

attributes.name: token_authentication_scheme
attributes.description: The authentication mechanism used to secure access to the endpoint. Prevents unauthorized access and hotlinking through cryptographic token validation.

products.name: abr_profile
products.description: Defines Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) encoding ladder profiles used for multi-platform streaming delivery. Captures profile name, codec (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1, VP9), container format (fMP4, TS), rendition count, per-rendition bitrate/resolution/frame-rate specifications, audio codec and channel configuration, HDR/SDR flag, MPEG-DASH or HLS manifest template reference, and target device class. Governs the encoding farm (transcode) output specifications.
products.reference: ABR Encoding Ladder / MPEG-DASH ISO 23009 / HLS RFC 8216

attributes.name: abr_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ABR encoding ladder profile. Primary key.

attributes.name: broadcast_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_standard. Business justification: ABR profiles implement broadcast standards (HLS, DASH). Required for broadcast standard compliance verification and device interoperability testing.

attributes.name: encoder_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.encoder_config. Business justification: ABR profiles are generated by encoder configurations. Required for encoder profile assignment and video quality troubleshooting.

attributes.name: format_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.format_specification. Business justification: ABR profiles implement technical delivery standards (codec, bitrate ladder, resolution tiers) defined in format specifications. Broadcasters validate ABR configs against house specs for compliance. Qo

attributes.name: technical_standard_cert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.technical_standard_cert. Business justification: ABR profiles must comply with codec standards, streaming protocol specifications, and accessibility requirements. Profile certification validates compliance with technical standards before deployment.

attributes.name: audio_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Audio bitrate in kilobits per second (e.g., 128, 192, 256). Defines audio quality.

attributes.name: audio_channel_config
attributes.description: Audio channel layout (mono, stereo, 5.1 surround, 7.1 surround, Dolby Atmos). Defines spatial audio configuration.

attributes.name: audio_codec
attributes.description: Audio codec used for encoding (AAC, HE-AAC, AC-3/Dolby Digital, E-AC-3/Dolby Digital Plus, Opus).

attributes.name: cdn_optimization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the profile is optimized for CDN delivery with caching-friendly segment naming and structure. True if CDN-optimized; false otherwise.

attributes.name: color_space
attributes.description: Color space standard used for encoding (BT.709 for HD, BT.2020 for UHD/HDR, DCI-P3 for cinema).

attributes.name: container_format
attributes.description: Media container format for the encoded segments (fMP4 for DASH, TS for HLS, MP4, WebM). Defines how video and audio streams are packaged.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ABR profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: drm_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the profile supports DRM encryption. True if DRM is enabled; false otherwise.

attributes.name: drm_system
attributes.description: DRM system(s) supported by this profile (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay Streaming, Multi-DRM). Null if DRM is not enabled.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the ABR profile became active and available for use in production encoding workflows.

attributes.name: encoding_preset
attributes.description: Encoder speed/quality preset (fast, medium, slow, veryslow). Slower presets yield better compression but require more processing time.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the ABR profile is scheduled to be deprecated or retired. Null for profiles with no planned end date.

attributes.name: frame_rate
attributes.description: Target frame rate for video renditions (e.g., '23.976', '25', '29.97', '30', '50', '59.94', '60'). May vary by rendition.

attributes.name: hdr_format
attributes.description: Specific HDR format supported (HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG). Null if HDR is not supported.
attributes.references: ITU-R BT.2100 (HDR), SMPTE ST 2084 (PQ), SMPTE ST 2094 (Dynamic Metadata)

attributes.name: hdr_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the profile supports HDR (High Dynamic Range) video. True if HDR is enabled; false for SDR (Standard Dynamic Range) only.

attributes.name: keyframe_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Interval between keyframes (I-frames) in seconds. Aligns with segment duration for seamless ABR switching.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ABR profile record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: manifest_template_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the MPEG-DASH MPD or HLS M3U8 manifest template used for this profile. Defines playlist structure and metadata.

attributes.name: max_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Highest video bitrate in kilobits per second across all renditions in the ladder. Used for high-quality streaming on fast connections.

attributes.name: max_resolution
attributes.description: Highest video resolution in the ladder (e.g., '1920x1080', '3840x2160'). Defines the top quality tier.

attributes.name: min_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Lowest video bitrate in kilobits per second across all renditions in the ladder. Used for low-bandwidth scenarios.

attributes.name: min_resolution
attributes.description: Lowest video resolution in the ladder (e.g., '320x180', '640x360'). Typically used for mobile or constrained bandwidth.

attributes.name: owner_team

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the ABR profile used in transcode job requests and CDN configuration.

attributes.name: profile_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the ABR profile, including use cases, target audience, and technical notes.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the ABR profile (e.g., 'Premium 4K HDR', 'Standard HD', 'Mobile Optimized').

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ABR profile. Active profiles are used in production encoding; deprecated profiles are phased out; testing profiles are under validation; inactive profiles are disabled.

attributes.name: qos_tier
attributes.description: Quality of Service tier associated with this profile (premium, standard, basic). Influences CDN priority and SLA commitments.

attributes.name: rendition_count
attributes.description: Total number of video renditions (bitrate/resolution variants) in the ABR ladder. Typical range is 3-10 renditions.

attributes.name: segment_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of each media segment in seconds (e.g., 2, 4, 6, 10). Shorter segments enable faster ABR switching but increase overhead.

attributes.name: streaming_protocol
attributes.description: Adaptive bitrate streaming protocol supported by this profile (HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF, Smooth Streaming).

attributes.name: target_device_class
attributes.description: Primary device class this profile is optimized for (mobile, tablet, desktop, smart TV, set-top box, gaming console). Influences resolution and bitrate choices.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the ABR profile. Incremented with each significant change to the encoding ladder or configuration.

attributes.name: video_codec
attributes.description: Primary video codec used for encoding (H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, AV1, VP9). Determines compression efficiency and device compatibility.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 14496-10 (H.264), ISO/IEC 23008-2 (HEVC), AV1 Bitstream & Decoding Process Specification

Primary operational event for QoS monitoring and audience measurement.

attributes.description: The mode of content consumption: live linear broadcast, VOD (Video On Demand), DVR (time-shifted), or restart. Critical for audience measurement methodology and rights management.

attributes.name: rebuffering_events_count
attributes.description: Number of rebuffering (stalling) events that occurred during the session. Critical QoS metric for viewer experience and churn prediction.

attributes.name: session_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: subtitle_language

attributes.name: total_ad_duration_seconds

attributes.name: total_watch_duration_seconds

Includes timestamp, session reference, event type, severity, bitrate at event time, buffer level, CDN edge node, and player state. Enables root-cause analysis of streaming quality degradation.
products.reference: QoS Telemetry / SCTE-130 / IAB VAST QoS

These events are linked to caption compliance records for remediation tracking and regulatory
