attributes.references: Akamai CDN - Content Storage and Delivery, Dalet Galaxy MAM - Storage Tiering

attributes.name: subtitle_tracks
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-2 language codes for embedded subtitle or closed caption tracks (e.g., eng,spa,fra). Supports accessibility compliance (COPPA, FCC) and multi-language distribution.
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes, FCC Closed Captioning Requirements, COPPA

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this version passed quality control (QC) validation and was approved for use. Null if validation is pending or failed.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM - Quality Control Workflow

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential or semantic version identifier for this rendition (e.g., v1.0, v2.3, proxy_01). Tracks lineage from camera original through derivatives.

attributes.name: version_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this version: active (available for use), archived (moved to long-term storage), deprecated (superseded by newer version), corrupted (integrity check failed), pending_validation (awaiting QC approval), deleted (marked for removal).
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM - Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: video_codec
attributes.description: Video compression codec used in this version (e.g., H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1, ProRes). Determines video quality, file size, and decoding requirements.

attributes.name: watermark_payload
attributes.description: Forensic watermark identifier or payload embedded in this version for anti-piracy tracking and content protection. Applicable only when rendition_purpose is watermark. Supports DRM (Digital Rights Management) and content security.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) - Anti-Piracy Standards, DRM Standards

products.name: ingest_job
products.description: Transactional record of every media ingest operation executed in Dalet Galaxy — capturing ingest source (tape, file transfer, satellite feed, cloud upload), ingest start/end timestamps, operator identity, source format, target storage location, ingest status (queued/running/completed/failed), bytes transferred, transfer rate, and any error codes encountered. Provides the chain-of-custody entry point for all assets entering the MAM. Links to the resulting media_asset record upon successful completion.
products.reference: Dalet Galaxy Ingest Workflow; SMPTE ST 2110 (IP Media Transport)

attributes.name: ingest_job_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media ingest job. Primary key for the ingest_job data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Ingest operations incur labor, storage, and infrastructure costs allocated to technical operations cost centers. Enables operational cost tracking, budget variance analysis, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: created_asset_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.asset_version. Business justification: Ingest job creates a specific version (typically the mezzanine or raw master). This FK links the ingest job to the version it produced. Populated upon successful ingest completion.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or operator who initiated or is responsible for the ingest job. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: media_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the resulting media asset record created upon successful completion of the ingest job. Establishes chain-of-custody linkage.

attributes.name: source_partner_partner_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Partner Partner Partner Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Content ingested from partner feeds (satellite, FTP, aspera) requires tracking source partner for SLA compliance monitoring, billing reconciliation, delivery acceptance workflows, and automated partne

attributes.name: tech_change_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the automated workflow or orchestration process that triggered or manages this ingest job. Used for end-to-end process tracking.

attributes.name: aspect_ratio
attributes.description: Display aspect ratio of the ingested video content. Determines presentation format and compatibility with distribution channels.

attributes.name: audio_channels
attributes.description: Number of audio channels in the ingested media (e.g., 2 for stereo, 6 for 5.1 surround). Used for audio processing and compliance validation.

attributes.name: bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Average bitrate of the ingested media in kilobits per second. Indicator of media quality and storage requirements.

attributes.name: bytes_transferred
attributes.description: Total number of bytes successfully transferred during the ingest operation. Used for capacity planning and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used to verify file integrity during and after ingest. Critical for chain-of-custody and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: checksum_value
attributes.description: Computed checksum hash of the ingested media file. Used to verify data integrity and detect corruption or tampering.

attributes.name: closed_caption_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captions or subtitles are embedded in the ingested media. Required for FCC accessibility compliance validation.

attributes.name: codec
attributes.description: Video or audio codec used in the ingested media (e.g., H.264, H.265/HEVC, ProRes, AAC, AC-3). Critical for playback compatibility and transcoding decisions.

attributes.name: color_space
attributes.description: Color space standard of the ingested video content. Determines color accuracy and compatibility with HDR/SDR workflows.

attributes.name: content_type
attributes.description: Classification of the media content being ingested. Determines storage tier, retention policy, and downstream workflow routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_footage|mezzanine|proxy|graphics|music_bed|archived_asset|master — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ingest job record was first created in the MAM system. Audit trail entry point for chain-of-custody.

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the ingested media content in seconds. Null for non-time-based media such as still images or graphics.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System-generated error code if the ingest job failed or encountered issues. Null for successful jobs. Maps to error catalog for troubleshooting.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable description of any error encountered during ingest. Provides operational context for failure analysis and remediation.

attributes.name: frame_rate
attributes.description: Frame rate of the ingested video content in frames per second (e.g., 23.976, 25, 29.97, 50, 59.94). Critical for format compatibility and playout.

attributes.name: hdr_format
attributes.description: HDR format of the ingested video content. Null or SDR for standard dynamic range content. Critical for premium content workflows.

attributes.name: ingest_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ingest job completed or terminated. Null for jobs still in progress.

attributes.name: ingest_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the media source from which content is being ingested. Determines handling protocols and validation rules.

attributes.name: ingest_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ingest job began processing. Represents the actual start of media transfer, not the queued time.

attributes.name: job_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the ingest job, typically formatted as prefix-date-sequence (e.g., ING-20240115-0042). Used for operational tracking and reference.

attributes.name: job_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ingest job. Tracks progression from queued through execution to final disposition.

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingested media is subject to legal hold and must be preserved for litigation or regulatory investigation. Prevents deletion.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ingest job record was last modified. Tracks updates to job status, metadata corrections, or error resolution.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about the ingest job. Used for operational communication.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the ingest job. Determines queue position and resource allocation for time-sensitive content.

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.description: Spatial resolution of the ingested video content (e.g., 1920x1080, 3840x2160, 1280x720). Used for quality assessment and distribution planning.

attributes.name: retention_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the retention policy applied to the ingested media. Determines archival tier and deletion schedule per regulatory and business requirements.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Technical format of the source media file or stream (e.g., MPEG-4, ProRes, MXF, H.264). Used for transcode planning and compatibility validation.

attributes.name: source_location
attributes.description: Physical or logical location of the source media. May be a tape ID, file path, URL, satellite transponder identifier, or cloud storage bucket path.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the system or module that initiated the ingest job (e.g., Dalet Galaxy Ingest Module, automated workflow, manual operator console).

attributes.name: target_format
attributes.description: Desired output format for the ingested media. May differ from source format if transcoding is required during ingest.

attributes.name: target_storage_location
attributes.description: Destination storage path or tier where the ingested media asset will be stored. May reference nearline, online, or archive storage systems.

attributes.name: timecode_start
attributes.description: Starting timecode of the ingested media in SMPTE format (HH:MM:SS:FF). Used for frame-accurate editing and synchronization.

attributes.name: transfer_rate_mbps
attributes.description: Average data transfer rate achieved during ingest, measured in megabits per second. Key performance indicator for ingest infrastructure.

products.name: transcode_job
products.description: Transactional record of every format conversion operation performed on a media asset — including standard transcodes (ABR ladder generation, proxy creation, delivery package preparation) and format migrations (obsolescence-driven conversions such as MPEG-2 to H.265, tape digitisation, analogue-to-digital). Captures source asset version, target format specification, codec parameters, bitrate ladder configuration, output storage URI, job type (transcode/migration), migration reason (if applicable: format obsolescence/storage optimisation/distribution requirement), job priority, queue entry time, processing start/end timestamps, transcoding engine used, output file size, checksum, quality validation result, and job status (queued/processing/completed/failed/retrying). Single source of truth for all format conversion operations in the MAM.
products.reference: Dalet Galaxy Transcode Workflow; MPEG-4 ISO 14496; HLS; MPEG-DASH; ABR

attributes.name: transcode_job_id
attributes.description: Primary key for transcode_job

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Transcoding consumes compute resources and labor charged to post-production or technical operations cost centers. Required for project costing, vendor invoice reconciliation, and operational budgeting

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that initiated the transcode job request.

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical or virtual processing node that executed the transcode job, used for troubleshooting and resource tracking.

attributes.name: media_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source media asset being transcoded.

attributes.name: target_format_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.format_specification. Business justification: Normalization: transcode job targets an approved format specification from the catalog. The target_format_specification STRING attribute becomes a FK. Format details retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: abr_ladder_configuration
attributes.description: Configuration specification for ABR ladder generation, defining the set of bitrate/resolution variants to be created for adaptive streaming (e.g., 240p@400kbps, 360p@800kbps, 480p@1.2Mbps, 720p@2.5Mbps, 1080p@5Mbps). Applicable when job_type is abr_ladder_generation.

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to generate the output checksum.

attributes.name: codec_parameters
attributes.description: Detailed codec encoding parameters including profile, level, GOP structure, B-frames, reference frames, and other encoder-specific settings (e.g., x264 preset=medium, crf=23, profile=high, level=4.1).

attributes.name: cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated processing cost in US dollars for this transcode job, based on compute time, storage, and resource utilization. Used for chargeback and budget tracking.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System error code if the job failed, used for troubleshooting and automated retry logic.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure reason if job_status is failed.

attributes.name: job_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the transcode job, used for tracking and reference across systems.

attributes.name: job_priority
attributes.description: Processing priority level for the transcode job, determining queue position and resource allocation. Critical jobs are processed immediately, batch jobs during off-peak hours.

attributes.name: job_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transcode job. Tracks progression from queue entry through processing to completion or failure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: queued|processing|completed|failed|retrying|cancelled|paused — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transcode operation: standard transcode for routine format conversion, ABR (Adaptive Bitrate) ladder generation for streaming, proxy creation for editing workflows, delivery package preparation for distribution, or format migration for obsolescence-driven conversions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_transcode|abr_ladder_generation|proxy_creation|delivery_package|format_migration|tape_digitization|analogue_to_digital — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: migration_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for format migration jobs. Applicable only when job_type is format_migration, tape_digitization, or analogue_to_digital. Captures whether the conversion is driven by format obsolescence (e.g., MPEG-2 to H.265), storage optimization, distribution requirements, or regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: format_obsolescence|storage_optimization|distribution_requirement|quality_enhancement|compliance_mandate|archive_preservation|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the transcode job.

attributes.name: output_checksum
attributes.description: Cryptographic checksum (MD5, SHA-256, or SHA-512) of the output file for integrity verification and chain-of-custody audit trails.

attributes.name: output_file_size_gb
attributes.description: Total file size of the transcoded output in gigabytes. Populated upon job completion.

attributes.name: output_storage_uri
attributes.description: Storage location URI for the transcoded output file(s), including protocol, bucket/path, and filename pattern (e.g., s3://media-archive/transcoded/2024/01/asset_12345_1080p.mp4).

attributes.name: processing_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from processing start to completion, used for performance monitoring and capacity planning.

attributes.name: processing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transcoding engine completed or terminated processing of this job.

attributes.name: processing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transcoding engine began processing this job.

attributes.name: quality_validation_result
attributes.description: Outcome of automated quality validation checks performed on the transcoded output, including video integrity, audio sync, and compliance with target specifications.

attributes.name: quality_validation_score
attributes.description: Numeric quality score (0-100) assigned by automated validation tools, measuring output fidelity against source and target specifications.

attributes.name: queue_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transcode job was submitted to the processing queue.

attributes.name: retry_count

attributes.name: source_asset_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version of the source asset used for this transcode operation.

attributes.name: source_bitrate_mbps
attributes.description: Average bitrate of the source asset in megabits per second.

attributes.name: source_codec
attributes.description: Video codec of the source asset (e.g., H.264, H.265/HEVC, MPEG-2, ProRes, DNxHD).

attributes.name: source_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the source media asset in seconds.

attributes.name: source_file_size_gb
attributes.description: File size of the source asset in gigabytes.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original format specification of the source asset, including container format and codec (e.g., MXF/MPEG-2, MOV/ProRes, MP4/H.264).

attributes.name: source_resolution
attributes.description: Video resolution of the source asset in pixels (e.g., 1920x1080, 3840x2160, 1280x720).

attributes.name: transcoding_engine
attributes.description: Name and version of the transcoding engine or software used to perform the conversion (e.g., FFmpeg 5.1.2, AWS Elemental MediaConvert, Dalet Brio).

products.name: qc_inspection
products.description: Records the quality control inspection result for each media asset version — capturing QC type (automated/manual/hybrid), inspection timestamp, operator or automated QC tool identity, pass/fail status, loudness compliance result (EBU R128 / ATSC A/85), black frame detection, freeze frame detection, audio sync check, caption/subtitle validation, aspect ratio compliance, HDR metadata validation, and a structured list of detected defects with timecode references. Mandatory gate before asset is approved for playout or distribution.
products.reference: EBU R128 Loudness; ATSC A/85; SMPTE RP 2077; Dalet Galaxy QC Workflow

attributes.name: qc_inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality control inspection record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: QC activities incur labor and tooling costs allocated to quality assurance cost centers. Supports QC budget management, headcount planning, and cost-per-inspection metrics for operational efficiency.

attributes.name: format_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.format_specification. Business justification: QC inspections validate technical compliance (loudness LUFS, aspect ratio, codec) against format specifications. Broadcasters define acceptance criteria in format specs; QC tools reference these for p

attributes.name: media_asset_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version of the media asset that underwent this quality control inspection.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM - Asset Version Management

attributes.name: primary_qc_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the human operator who performed or supervised the manual or hybrid quality control inspection. Null for fully automated inspections.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Final approval decision for the media asset version based on QC inspection results. Approved assets are cleared for playout or distribution; rejected assets require remediation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the asset was approved for playout or distribution following QC inspection. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: aspect_ratio_compliance_result
attributes.description: Result of aspect ratio compliance check. Verifies that video aspect ratio (e.g., 16:9, 4:3, 21:9) matches expected format and Active Format Description (AFD) metadata is correct.

attributes.name: audio_codec_compliance_result
attributes.description: Result of audio codec format compliance check. Verifies that audio encoding conforms to expected codec standard (e.g., AAC, Dolby Digital, Dolby Atmos, MPEG-1 Layer II).
attributes.references: ISO 14496-3 (AAC), ATSC A/52 (Dolby Digital), SMPTE ST 2098

attributes.name: audio_sync_offset_ms
attributes.description: Measured audio-to-video synchronization offset in milliseconds. Positive values indicate audio leads video; negative values indicate audio lags video. Null if sync check not performed.

attributes.name: audio_sync_result
attributes.description: Result of audio-to-video synchronization check. Detects lip-sync errors or audio drift.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: black_frame_count
attributes.description: Total number of black frames detected in the media asset. Zero if none detected.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: black_frame_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether unintended black frames (video signal dropout or encoding error) were detected during inspection.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: caption_validation_result
attributes.description: Result of closed caption (CEA-608, CEA-708) or subtitle validation check. Verifies presence, format compliance, and synchronization of captions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this QC inspection record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: critical_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of critical-severity defects that block asset approval for playout or distribution. Critical defects require remediation.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of quality defects detected during inspection. Zero indicates no defects found.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: defect_summary
attributes.description: Structured JSON or delimited text summary of all detected defects with timecode references, severity levels, and defect type codes. Detailed defect records may be stored in a separate qc_defect child table.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: detected_aspect_ratio
attributes.description: Actual aspect ratio detected in the video stream (e.g., 16:9, 4:3, 1.85:1, 2.39:1). Null if aspect ratio check not performed.

attributes.name: freeze_frame_count
attributes.description: Total number of freeze frame incidents detected in the media asset. Zero if none detected.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: freeze_frame_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether freeze frames (static video for extended duration) were detected during inspection.
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: hdr_format
attributes.description: Detected High Dynamic Range format or Standard Dynamic Range designation. HLG = Hybrid Log-Gamma, SDR = Standard Dynamic Range.

attributes.name: hdr_metadata_validation_result
attributes.description: Result of High Dynamic Range (HDR) metadata validation check. Verifies presence and correctness of HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, or HLG metadata. Not applicable for Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) content.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2084, SMPTE ST 2086, ITU-R BT.2100

attributes.name: inspection_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds required to complete the quality control inspection process.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the inspection record, formatted as QC-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the quality control inspection process.

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the quality control inspection was performed or completed. Primary business event timestamp.

attributes.name: loudness_compliance_result
attributes.description: Result of audio loudness compliance check against regulatory standards (EBU R128 for Europe, ATSC A/85 for North America, ITU-R BS.1770 globally).

attributes.name: loudness_lufs

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: overall_result

attributes.name: qc_tool_name
attributes.description: Name and version of the automated quality control software or tool used for inspection (e.g., Baton, Interra, Venera, Dalet QC Module).
attributes.references: SMPTE RDD 48 - Quality Control Best Practices

attributes.name: qc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality control inspection method: automated (software-based), manual (human operator), or hybrid (combination of both).

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: video_codec_compliance_result
attributes.description: Result of video codec format compliance check. Verifies that video encoding conforms to expected codec standard (e.g., H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, MPEG-2, AV1).

products.name: storage_location

products.name: asset_storage_assignment
products.description: Tracks the complete storage placement history for every media asset version — recording which file resides at which storage location, when it was placed there, and why it moved. products.name: retention_policy
products.description: Defines the business retention rules applied to media assets — capturing policy name, asset class scope (raw/mezzanine/proxy/archive), minimum retention period, maximum retention period, retention trigger (ingest date / broadcast date / contract expiry / legal hold), post-retention action (purge/migrate-to-deep-archive/notify-rights-owner), regulatory basis (FCC, Ofcom, GDPR, SOX, legal hold), policy owner, effective date, and expiry date. Drives automated lifecycle management and ensures regulatory compliance for asset archival and deletion.

attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: hold_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the legal hold order became effective and preservation obligations commenced. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the legal hold order. Active holds prevent automated retention policy actions (purge, tier migration) on in-scope assets.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal hold based on the nature of the legal matter requiring preservation of media assets.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The entity or department that issued the legal hold order, such as internal legal department, court, Federal Communications Commission (FCC), or other regulatory body.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the specific authority, court, or regulatory body that issued the legal hold order.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the individual who last modified this legal hold record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this legal hold record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mam_system_lock_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Media Asset Management (MAM) System Lock Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a system-level lock has been applied in the Media Asset Management (MAM) system (Dalet Galaxy) to prevent modification or deletion of held assets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, instructions, or context regarding the legal hold order, including special handling requirements, scope clarifications, or communication history.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when formal notification of the legal hold was sent to relevant custodians, stakeholders, and Media Asset Management (MAM) system administrators. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: release_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when formal authorization was granted to release the legal hold, allowing normal retention policies to resume on previously held assets. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: release_authorized_by
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or authority who formally authorized the release of this legal hold order.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: retention_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal hold overrides standard retention policies and prevents automated purge, archival tier migration, or deletion actions on in-scope assets.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the media assets, content types, date ranges, and metadata criteria that define which assets are subject to this legal hold.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the individual who created this legal hold record in the system.

products.name: format_specification
products.description: Reference catalogue of all approved media format specifications used across the enterprise — capturing format name, container format (MXF, MP4, MOV, TS), video codec (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1, ProRes, DNxHD), audio codec (AAC, PCM, Dolby AC-3, Dolby Atmos), resolution class (SD/HD/UHD/4K/8K), frame rate, scan type (progressive/interlaced), HDR standard (HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision), audio loudness spec, subtitle/caption format, intended use case (ingest/mezzanine/proxy/playout/OTT-delivery/archive), and governing standard reference (ATSC, DVB, HLS, MPEG-DASH). Drives transcode job configuration and QC compliance checks.
products.reference: ATSC Standards; DVB Standards; ISO 14496 MPEG-4; ISO 23009 DASH; HLS RFC 8216; SMPTE

attributes.name: format_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the format specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this format specification was officially approved for production use.
attributes.references: Format Governance and Change Control Policy

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technical authority or committee that approved this format specification for production use.
attributes.references: Format Governance and Change Control Policy

attributes.name: aspect_ratio
attributes.description: Display aspect ratio of the video frame (e.g., 16:9 for widescreen, 4:3 for standard, 21:9 for cinematic).

attributes.name: audio_bit_depth
attributes.description: Audio bit depth in bits per sample (e.g., 16-bit for standard, 24-bit for professional, 32-bit float for mastering).

attributes.name: audio_channel_configuration
attributes.description: Audio channel layout and count (e.g., stereo 2.0, surround 5.1, immersive 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos, mono 1.0).
attributes.references: ITU-R BS.775 (Multichannel Audio), Dolby Atmos Technical Specification

attributes.name: audio_codec
attributes.description: Audio compression codec used for encoding (e.g., AAC, PCM, Dolby AC-3, Dolby E, Dolby Atmos, MPEG-1 Layer II).

attributes.name: audio_sample_rate_khz
attributes.description: Audio sampling frequency in kilohertz (e.g., 48.000 kHz for broadcast, 44.100 kHz for CD quality, 96.000 kHz for high-resolution).
attributes.references: AES3 (Digital Audio Interface), ITU-R BS.1116 (Audio Quality)

attributes.name: bit_rate_mbps
attributes.description: Target video bit rate in megabits per second (Mbps) for encoding, determining quality and file size.

attributes.name: bit_rate_mode
attributes.description: Encoding bit rate control mode: CBR (Constant Bit Rate), VBR (Variable Bit Rate), or ABR (Average Bit Rate / Adaptive Bitrate Streaming).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009-1 (MPEG-DASH ABR), HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) Specification

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used for file integrity verification and chain-of-custody audit (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, xxHash).

attributes.name: color_space
attributes.description: Color space standard used for video encoding (e.g., BT.709 for HD, BT.2020 for UHD, DCI-P3 for cinema).
attributes.references: ITU-R BT.709, ITU-R BT.2020, DCI (Digital Cinema Initiatives) Specification

attributes.name: container_format
attributes.description: File container format that wraps the encoded video and audio streams (MXF for broadcast, MP4 for web, MOV for production, TS for streaming, AVI legacy, MKV open-source).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this format specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: drm_compatibility
attributes.description: Digital Rights Management systems compatible with this format (e.g., Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady, none for unencrypted).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23001-7 (Common Encryption), W3C EME (Encrypted Media Extensions)

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this format specification becomes active and available for use in production workflows.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date when this format specification is scheduled to be deprecated or retired. Null for formats with no planned end date.

attributes.name: file_extension
attributes.description: Standard file extension for files encoded in this format (e.g., .mxf, .mp4, .mov, .ts, .m3u8).

attributes.name: format_category
attributes.description: Classification of the format by its intended use case in the media workflow: ingest (acquisition), mezzanine (high-quality intermediate), proxy (low-res editing), playout (broadcast transmission), OTT delivery (streaming), or archive (long-term preservation).

attributes.name: format_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the format specification used across systems and workflows.

attributes.name: format_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the media format specification (e.g., HD 1080p H.264 AAC, 4K UHD HEVC Dolby Atmos).

attributes.name: frame_rate
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 12 (Timecode), ATSC A/53 (Frame Rate Standards)

attributes.name: governing_standard
attributes.description: Primary industry or regulatory standard governing this format specification (e.g., ATSC 3.0, DVB-T2, SMPTE ST 2110, ISO/IEC 14496, ITU-R BT.2020).
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee), DVB (Digital Video Broadcasting), SMPTE, ISO/IEC, ITU-R

attributes.name: hdr_standard
attributes.description: High Dynamic Range standard applied to the format (e.g., HDR10, HDR10+, HLG (Hybrid Log-Gamma), Dolby Vision, none for SDR).
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2084 (HDR10), ITU-R BT.2100 (HLG), Dolby Vision Specification

attributes.name: horizontal_resolution
attributes.description: Horizontal pixel count of the video frame (e.g., 1920 for Full HD, 3840 for UHD).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this format specification record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the format specification: active (in production use), deprecated (phasing out), retired (no longer used), draft (under development), under_review (pending approval), or approved (ready for deployment).

attributes.name: loudness_standard
attributes.description: Audio loudness normalization standard applied (e.g., ITU-R BS.1770-4 LKFS, EBU R128 LUFS, ATSC A/85 for broadcast).
attributes.references: ITU-R BS.1770, EBU R128, ATSC A/85

attributes.name: mime_type
attributes.description: MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) type for HTTP delivery and content negotiation (e.g., video/mp4, application/mxf, video/MP2T).

attributes.name: qc_profile
attributes.description: Quality control validation profile applied to assets in this format, defining automated checks for technical compliance (e.g., video levels, audio loudness, format conformance).
attributes.references: EBU QC Recommendations, SMPTE RDD 48 (IMF QC)

attributes.name: resolution_class
attributes.description: Video resolution classification: SD (Standard Definition 480/576), HD (720p), FHD (Full HD 1080p), UHD (Ultra HD 2160p), 4K (4096x2160), 8K (7680x4320).
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee), DVB (Digital Video Broadcasting) Standards

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Minimum retention period in years for assets encoded in this format, driven by regulatory, legal hold, or business requirements.
attributes.references: FCC (Federal Communications Commission) Record Retention, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: scan_type
attributes.description: Video scanning method: progressive (all lines scanned sequentially, denoted 'p') or interlaced (alternating fields, denoted 'i').

attributes.name: storage_tier
attributes.description: Recommended storage tier for assets in this format based on access frequency and retention policy: hot (frequent access), warm (occasional access), cold (infrequent access), archive (long-term preservation), glacier (deep archive).
attributes.references: MAM (Media Asset Management) Storage Policy, AWS S3 Storage Classes

attributes.name: streaming_protocol
attributes.description: Streaming delivery protocol supported by this format (e.g., HLS (HTTP Live Streaming), MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP), RTMP, SRT, none for file-based).
attributes.references: RFC 8216 (HLS), ISO/IEC 23009-1 (MPEG-DASH), SMPTE ST 2110 (Professional Media over IP)

attributes.name: subtitle_format
attributes.description: Subtitle or closed caption format supported (e.g., SRT, WebVTT, TTML, CEA-608, CEA-708, EBU-TT-D, none if not applicable).
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 2052 (Timed Text), CEA-608/708 (Closed Captioning), W3C WebVTT

attributes.name: target_loudness_lufs
attributes.description: Target integrated loudness level in LUFS (Loudness Units relative to Full Scale) or LKFS, typically -23 LUFS for broadcast, -14 LUFS for streaming.

attributes.name: transcode_priority
attributes.description: Default processing priority for transcode jobs targeting this format: critical (immediate), high (expedited), normal (standard queue), low (off-peak), batch (scheduled bulk processing).
attributes.references: MAM (Media Asset Management) Workflow Orchestration Policy

attributes.name: vertical_resolution
attributes.description: Vertical pixel count of the video frame (e.g., 1080 for Full HD, 2160 for UHD).

attributes.name: video_codec
attributes.description: Video compression codec used for encoding (e.g., H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, AV1, Apple ProRes, Avid DNxHD, MPEG-2).

products.name: asset_collection
products.description: Defines logical groupings of media assets for editorial, distribution, or archival purposes — such as a series package, film franchise bundle, news story package, sports event clip collection, or music album. Captures collection name, type (series/film/news-package/sports-event/music-album/campaign-creative), description, creation date, owner department, status, and an ordered member list with membership role (primary/supplemental/bonus/trailer/promo), sequence position, and inclusion dates. Enables bulk operations (bulk QC, bulk rights check, bulk archive) and supports content packaging for distribution deals.
products.reference: MAM Collection/Package — Dalet Galaxy; Content Packaging

attributes.name: asset_collection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset collection. Primary key.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Collections drive revenue streams (box sets, franchise licensing, library sales) tracked by profit center. Critical for franchise P&L reporting, content portfolio valuation, and strategic investment d

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.retention_policy. This connects asset_collection to the relational graph and allows retrieving full polic

attributes.name: archive_tier
attributes.description: Storage tier classification for the collection: hot (frequent access), warm (occasional access), cold (rare access), glacier (long-term preservation), or deep-archive (regulatory retention).

attributes.name: asset_collection_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the collection's content, purpose, and editorial context. Used for cataloging and discovery.
attributes.references: Dublin Core Metadata Initiative (DCMI) - Description Element

attributes.name: asset_collection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collection: draft (being assembled), active (available for use), archived (preserved but not active), deprecated (superseded), under-review (pending approval), or locked (no modifications allowed).

attributes.name: audio_description_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether audio description tracks are available for visually impaired audiences (true) or not (false). Required for accessibility compliance.

attributes.name: bulk_operation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether bulk operations (bulk QC, bulk rights check, bulk archive, bulk transcode) are enabled for this collection (true) or must be performed individually (false).

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to generate checksums for integrity verification of the collection package (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, or xxHash).

attributes.name: checksum_value
attributes.description: Computed checksum value for the collection package, used to verify data integrity during transfer, storage, and archival.

attributes.name: closed_caption_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captions are available for all time-based assets in the collection (true) or not (false). Required for FCC compliance.

attributes.name: collection_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code for the collection, used for external reference and cataloging (e.g., 'GOT-S08-PKG', 'NEWS-ELEC24-001').

attributes.name: collection_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the asset collection (e.g., 'Breaking News Package - Election 2024', 'Game of Thrones Season 8 Bundle', 'Super Bowl LVIII Highlights').

attributes.name: collection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collection by content grouping purpose: series (episodic television), film-franchise (related films), news-package (story bundle), sports-event (game/match clips), music-album (music tracks), campaign-creative (advertising assets), documentary-series, special-event, archive-bundle, or promo-package. attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Age-appropriateness or content rating for the collection (e.g., 'TV-PG', 'TV-14', 'TV-MA', 'G', 'PG', 'PG-13', 'R'). Used for compliance and scheduling.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Rating System

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created the collection record in the MAM system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: curator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for curating and maintaining the collection.

attributes.name: distribution_window_end
attributes.description: End date of the distribution window after which the collection may no longer be distributed or broadcast. Part of windowing strategy.

attributes.name: distribution_window_start
attributes.description: Start date of the distribution window during which the collection may be distributed or broadcast. Part of windowing strategy.

attributes.name: eidr_identifier
attributes.description: Globally unique EIDR identifier for the collection, used for rights management and content identification across the industry.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Primary language of the collection content, using ISO 639-3 three-letter language codes (e.g., 'eng' for English, 'spa' for Spanish, 'fra' for French).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified the collection record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the collection or its membership (asset added, removed, or metadata updated).

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collection is under legal hold (true) or not (false). Assets under legal hold cannot be deleted or modified.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) - eDiscovery

attributes.name: metadata_completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the completeness of metadata across all assets in the collection. Used for quality assurance and discoverability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about the collection, used for internal communication, special handling instructions, or editorial context.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Business unit or department responsible for the collection (e.g., 'News Editorial', 'Sports Production', 'Entertainment Programming', 'Marketing Creative Services').

attributes.name: packaging_format
attributes.description: Technical packaging format used for distribution (e.g., 'IMF', 'DPP', 'AS-11', 'ProRes Package', 'MPEG-DASH Manifest'). Relevant for distribution deals.

attributes.name: primary_genre
attributes.description: Primary content genre or category for the collection (e.g., 'Drama', 'News', 'Sports', 'Documentary', 'Comedy', 'Music', 'Reality').

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Quality control status for the collection as a whole: not-started, in-progress, passed (all assets QC approved), failed (one or more assets failed QC), or waived (QC not required).

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of rights clearance for the entire collection: cleared (all rights verified), pending (clearance in progress), restricted (usage limitations), expired (rights lapsed), or not-required (no clearance needed).

attributes.name: syndication_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collection is eligible for syndication (resale to multiple outlets) based on rights and content suitability (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Intended audience demographic or segment for the collection (e.g., 'Adults 18-49', 'Children 6-11', 'General Audience', 'Sports Enthusiasts').

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic territory or market for which the collection is intended, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'CAN').

attributes.name: total_asset_count
attributes.description: Total number of media assets currently included in the collection.

attributes.name: total_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Cumulative playback duration of all time-based assets in the collection, measured in seconds.

attributes.name: total_storage_size_bytes
attributes.description: Total storage footprint of all assets in the collection, measured in bytes. Used for capacity planning and archival costing.

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date when the collection was first created in the MAM (Media Asset Management) system.

products.name: archive_record

Supports ISO 14721 OAIS compliance and provides the authoritative record for asset archival and retrieval operations.

attributes.name: archive_file_size_bytes

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: lto_tape_generation

attributes.name: oais_compliance_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this archive record complies with ISO 14721 OAIS reference model standards for long-term digital preservation.

attributes.description: Code identifying the physical off-site archival facility or vault location where the media is stored.

attributes.name: purge_approval_status

attributes.name: purge_scheduled_date

attributes.name: restore_completion_date

attributes.name: restore_sla_tier

attributes.name: restore_test_result

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date

attributes.name: retention_policy_code

attributes.name: storage_tier

attributes.name: tape_barcode

products.name: asset_rights_grant
products.description: This association product represents the licensing contract between media_asset and partner_partner. It captures the specific rights granted to a partner for a media asset, including territorial scope, distribution windows, exclusivity terms, and revenue arrangements. Each record links one media_asset to one partner_partner with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific rights grant.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting, a single media asset (film, episode, music track) is routinely licensed to multiple partners simultaneously under different terms - one partner may hold linear broadcast rights in North America, another holds streaming rights in Europe, and a third holds FAST channel rights globally. Conversely, each partner (studio, MVPD, streaming platform) holds rights to many assets in their content portfolio. The relationship itself carries critical business data including rights type, territorial scope, distribution windows, exclusivity terms, and revenue arrangements that cannot logically reside on either the asset or partner entity alone.

products.name: deal_asset_license
products.description: This association product represents the licensing relationship between individual media assets and acquisition deals. Each record captures the specific terms under which a single media asset is licensed as part of an acquisition deal, including territory-specific rights, financial terms, usage restrictions, and delivery status. This is the operational record that rights management, finance, and content operations teams use to track what content was acquired under which deals and the specific terms governing each asset's use.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, acquisition deals routinely license content packages containing multiple media assets (film libraries, TV series, documentary collections), and individual high-value assets (blockbuster films, premium sports content) are frequently licensed through multiple deals covering different territories, windows, or platforms. The detection phase explicitly identified an existing association product (acquisition_deal_line) that already implements this M:N relationship with deal-asset-specific attributes including license fees, territory codes, term dates, runs allowed, and delivery status.

products.name: collection_membership
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between asset collections and media assets. It captures which assets belong to which collections, when they were added, their sequence/ordering within the collection, their role (primary/supplemental/bonus/trailer/promo), and their membership status. Each record links one asset collection to one media asset with attributes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship. Enables curators to actively manage collection composition, track membership history, and support bulk operations on grouped assets.. Existence Justification: In media asset management operations, curators actively manage collection membership as a distinct business concept. A single media asset (e.g., a news clip, music track, or video segment) can simultaneously belong to multiple collections (e.g., a breaking news package, a year-end retrospective, and a topic-specific archive). Conversely, each collection contains many assets organized with specific sequencing, roles, and inclusion rationale. This is not a simple reference but a managed relationship with its own lifecycle, tracked through dates, statuses, and curator notes.

products.name: asset_legal_hold
products.description: This association product represents the legal preservation obligation between a media asset and a legal hold order. It captures the application and release of legal holds on specific media assets, tracking custodian acknowledgment, authorization details, and audit trail requirements. Each record links one media asset to one legal hold with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific hold assignment, enabling compliance tracking and preventing automated retention actions on held assets.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, a single media asset can be subject to multiple legal holds simultaneously (e.g., one asset relevant to both an FCC investigation and a copyright dispute), and a single legal hold order typically covers multiple media assets matching the scope criteria (date ranges, content types, metadata tags). Legal/compliance teams actively manage the assignment of holds to assets, track application and release dates per asset, assign custodians, apply MAM system locks, and maintain detailed audit trails for each asset-hold combination. This is an operational business process with its own lifecycle, not a derived analytical correlation.

products.name: syndication_inventory
products.description: This association product represents the operational inventory relationship between asset collections and syndication deals. It captures the specific content packages included in each syndication agreement, tracking episode-level delivery schedules, run counts per episode, market-specific clearances, and format requirements that exist only in the context of a specific collection being syndicated through a specific deal. Each record links one asset collection to one syndication deal with attributes that govern how that content is delivered and cleared in that specific deal.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting syndication operations, asset collections (series packages, film libraries, content bundles) are licensed through multiple syndication deals to different station groups and markets, and each syndication deal includes multiple collections to create attractive programming packages. The relationship between a specific collection and a specific deal carries operational data including episode delivery sequences, run counts per episode, market clearance status, delivery dates, and format specifications that vary by deal even for the same collection.

products.name: rights_content_window
products.description: Defines the sequential release window strategy (windowing) for a specific content asset across exploitation platforms, and computes the net availability status. Each record captures the window type (theatrical, PVOD, TVOD, SVOD, AVOD, linear, FAST, home video, syndication), platform or channel scope, window open and close dates, holdback start and end dates, territory, exclusivity tier, and computed availability status (available, held-back, blacked-out, expired). Enforces the windowing hierarchy that prevents simultaneous exploitation across competing platforms. The net availability (considering holdbacks and blackouts) is refreshed whenever upstream rights or holdback records change. Directly consumed by scheduling and distribution domains to validate playout eligibility. Powered by Rightsline Windows module.

products.name: holdback
products.description: Records exclusivity holdback restrictions that prevent a content asset from being exploited on a specific platform, territory, or channel during a defined period.
