products.name: ad_inventory
products.description: Available advertising inventory record representing sellable ad time or impression capacity for a specific channel, daypart, program, and date window. Tracks total available units (spots or impressions), sold units, remaining avails, rate card CPM/CPRP, audience delivery estimate (GRP/TRP), HUT/PUT index, blackout restrictions, and inventory status (available, held, sold, preempted). Feeds the avails system for sales proposals and scatter market pricing.

attributes.name: ad_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advertising inventory record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast or streaming channel where this inventory is available.

attributes.name: demographic_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.demographic_segment. Business justification: Inventory is forecasted, priced, and sold by Nielsen demographic segment for yield optimization and avails management. CPM/CPRP rates and GRP/TRP estimates vary by demographic. Essential for inventory

attributes.name: license_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.license_agreement. Business justification: Inventory forecasting depends on content rights availability. Sales planning tools must filter inventory by active license windows. Prevents overselling inventory in content with upcoming rights expir

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Inventory sourced from syndication partners, affiliate stations, or content distribution partners must track the supplying partner for revenue sharing calculations and inventory reconciliation. Real b

attributes.name: program_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific program or content during which this ad inventory is available.

attributes.name: scheduling_daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Inventory is bucketed by daypart for pricing and availability management. Rate card application, proposal generation, and avail queries require linking inventory to master daypart definitions. Removes

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.title. Business justification: Inventory is generated from title airings. Business process: inventory forecasting by title, avails management, sell-through reporting, title-level CPM pricing, program-based inventory allocation.

attributes.name: ad_pod_position
attributes.description: The sequential position of this inventory slot within an ad pod (group of ads in a break). Position 1 is the first ad in the break.

attributes.name: advertiser_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of advertiser categories or specific advertisers that are restricted from purchasing this inventory due to content, competitive, or regulatory reasons.

attributes.name: blackout_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of designated market areas (DMA) or geographic regions where this inventory cannot be sold due to blackout restrictions.

attributes.name: blackout_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory is subject to geographic broadcast restrictions (blackout) that prevent advertising in certain markets or regions.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: The television content rating for the program associated with this inventory, which may restrict certain advertiser categories.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this inventory record and its pricing become effective for sales purposes.

attributes.name: estimated_grp
attributes.description: The estimated gross rating point (GRP) delivery for this inventory, representing the total audience reach multiplied by frequency. GRP is a standard broadcast audience measurement metric.

attributes.name: estimated_impressions
attributes.description: The projected number of advertising impressions (individual ad views) this inventory will deliver, based on historical audience data.

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: The projected unique audience count (reach) that will be exposed to advertising in this inventory slot at least once.

attributes.name: estimated_trp
attributes.description: The estimated target rating point (TRP) delivery for this inventory, representing the rating within a specific demographic target audience. TRP is used for targeted advertising campaigns.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this inventory record is no longer valid or available for sale.

attributes.name: held_units
attributes.description: The number of advertising units currently held or reserved pending final commitment, typically during proposal negotiation.

attributes.name: hut_index
attributes.description: The percentage of homes using television during this inventory time period. HUT is a standard broadcast audience availability metric.

attributes.name: inventory_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for this inventory slot, used in sales proposals and trafficking systems.

attributes.name: inventory_date
attributes.description: The specific broadcast date for which this inventory is available.

attributes.name: inventory_end_time
attributes.description: The precise end time of the inventory window, including time zone information.

attributes.name: inventory_start_time
attributes.description: The precise start time of the inventory window, including time zone information.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the advertising inventory: available for sale, held pending commitment, sold and committed, preempted for higher-priority content, or blocked due to restrictions.

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the advertising inventory format: linear broadcast spot, video-on-demand (VOD) ad position, dynamic ad insertion (DAI) slot, free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) pod, or over-the-top (OTT) impression.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: makegood_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory is eligible to be used for makegoods (compensatory ad spots provided when original spots did not air as scheduled).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information about this inventory record.

attributes.name: preemptible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory can be preempted (bumped) for higher-priority programming or advertising. Preemptible inventory is typically sold at lower rates.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: The pricing tier classification for this inventory based on audience quality and demand: premium (highest value), standard, value, or remnant (lowest value, unsold inventory).

attributes.name: put_index
attributes.description: The percentage of persons using television during this inventory time period. PUT is a standard broadcast audience availability metric.

attributes.name: rate_card_cpm
attributes.description: The published rate card cost per thousand impressions (CPM) for this inventory. CPM is the standard pricing metric in advertising sales.

attributes.name: rate_card_cprp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rate Card Cost Per Rating Point (CPRP)
attributes.description: The published rate card cost per rating point (CPRP) for this inventory. CPRP is used in broadcast television pricing based on audience ratings.

attributes.name: remaining_avails
attributes.description: The number of advertising units still available for sale, calculated as total available minus sold and held units.

attributes.name: sales_category
attributes.description: The sales market category for this inventory: upfront (advance sales event), scatter (last-minute sales), local, national, digital, or programmatic.

attributes.name: sold_units
attributes.description: The number of advertising units that have been sold and committed to advertisers.

attributes.name: total_available_units
attributes.description: The total number of advertising units (spots or impressions) available for sale in this inventory record.

attributes.name: unit_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The standard duration in seconds for each advertising unit in this inventory (e.g., 15, 30, 60 seconds).

products.name: rate_card
products.description: Advertising rate card defining the standard pricing for ad inventory by channel, daypart, spot length, and audience demographic. Captures rate card version, effective date range, channel, daypart, spot length, gross rate, net rate, CPM basis, GRP value, audience demographic target, rate type (upfront, scatter, package, digital), and approval status. Used as the pricing baseline for ad order entry and proposal generation. Distinct from negotiated deal rates on individual orders.

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advertising rate card. Primary key for the rate card entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Rate card pricing requires formal approval by revenue management or pricing strategy employee for governance and audit compliance. Replaces text 'approved_by' field with proper FK for workforce integr

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broadcast channel or streaming platform to which this rate card applies.

attributes.name: demographic_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.demographic_segment. Business justification: Rate cards are priced by Nielsen demographic cell (A18-49, W25-54, etc.) - fundamental to broadcast advertising economics. CPM/CPRP rates vary by demographic segment. Essential for proposal generation

attributes.name: ad_pod_position
attributes.description: Position within the ad pod (group of ads in a commercial break) for which the rate applies. First and last positions typically command premium rates due to higher viewer attention.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rate card was formally approved for use in ad sales and order entry.

attributes.name: cpm_basis
attributes.description: Cost per thousand impressions or viewers that the rate is based on. CPM is a standard metric in advertising pricing used to normalize rates across different audience sizes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rate card record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time segment of the broadcast day for which the rate applies. Dayparts are standard time blocks used in media planning to segment audience availability and pricing (e.g., prime time 8-11pm, daytime 10am-4pm). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: early_morning|morning|daytime|early_fringe|prime_access|prime_time|late_fringe|late_night|overnight|weekend|sports|special_event — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: discount_eligibility
attributes.description: Description of volume discounts, frequency discounts, or package deals that can be applied to this rate card for qualifying advertisers.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate card expires and is no longer valid for new ad orders. Nullable for open-ended rate cards.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rate card becomes active and available for use in ad order pricing and proposals.

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Geographic market or Designated Market Area (DMA) to which the rate card applies. Can be national, regional, or local market identifier.

attributes.name: gross_rate
attributes.description: Published rate for the ad spot before any discounts, commissions, or agency fees are applied. This is the list price used as the baseline for negotiations.

attributes.name: grp_value
attributes.description: Gross Rating Point value associated with the rate, representing the percentage of the target audience reached multiplied by frequency. Used for planning and buying broadcast advertising.

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Type of advertising inventory covered by the rate card. Linear refers to traditional scheduled broadcast, VOD to video on demand, SVOD to subscription video on demand, AVOD to ad-supported video on demand, TVOD to transactional video on demand, OTT to over-the-top streaming, FAST to free ad-supported streaming television, and simulcast to simultaneous multi-platform broadcast. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear|vod|svod|avod|tvod|ott|fast|simulcast — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rate card record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: makegood_policy
attributes.description: Policy describing conditions under which makegoods (compensatory ad spots) will be provided if audience guarantees are not met or technical issues occur.

attributes.name: minimum_audience_guarantee
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed audience size (in thousands) for the daypart and demographic. If actual audience falls below this threshold, makegoods may be required.

attributes.name: net_rate
attributes.description: Rate after standard agency commission (typically 15%) and other standard deductions are applied. This is the effective rate paid by the advertiser.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, terms, conditions, or special instructions related to the rate card, such as blackout dates, special event pricing, or advertiser category restrictions.

attributes.name: preemption_priority
attributes.description: Indicates whether spots purchased at this rate can be preempted (bumped) for higher-paying advertisers. Non-preemptible rates are premium, while preemptible rates offer discounts but risk being moved or cancelled.

attributes.name: program_genre
attributes.description: Genre or category of programming for which the rate applies (e.g., News, Sports, Drama, Reality, Comedy). Certain genres command premium rates due to audience engagement and demographics.

attributes.name: rate_card_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the rate card for easy identification, typically includes year and market or channel reference (e.g., '2024 Prime Time National Rate Card').

attributes.name: rate_card_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the rate card, used for external reference and communication with sales teams and advertisers. Typically follows format RC-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: rate_card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate card indicating its operational state and usability for ad order entry.

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rate amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate card by sales market type. Upfront rates are negotiated in advance for the broadcast year, scatter rates are for last-minute inventory, package rates bundle multiple spots, digital rates apply to OTT/streaming, sponsorship rates for integrated content, and remnant rates for unsold inventory.

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base rates to account for seasonal demand variations (e.g., 1.25 for high-demand periods like holidays, 0.85 for low-demand summer months).

attributes.name: spot_length_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the advertising spot in seconds for which the rate applies. Common lengths are 15, 30, 60, and 120 seconds.

attributes.name: trp_value
attributes.description: Target Rating Point value for the specific demographic audience segment. TRP is similar to GRP but focuses on a specific target demographic rather than total audience.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the rate card to track revisions and updates. Follows semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 1.1, 2.0).

domains.name: subscriber
domains.description: SSOT for all subscriber and membership identities across SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and bundled service tiers. Manages subscriber profiles, household linkage, plan enrollment, authentication credentials, device registrations, viewing entitlements, parental controls, churn tracking, and ARPU/LTV metrics. Integrates with Zuora for subscription billing and Adobe Experience Platform for personalization. Enforces GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA compliance for subscriber data.

products.name: subscriber
products.description: Master identity record for every subscriber across SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and bundled service tiers. Serves as the SSOT for subscriber identity, capturing registration source, registration timestamp, account status, service tier, demographic attributes, ARPU, LTV, churn risk score, GDPR/CCPA/COPPA consent flags, and integration keys to Zuora (billing) and Adobe Experience Platform (personalization). Each subscriber has a unique identity independent of household or device.
products.reference: Zuora Subscription Account / Adobe Experience Platform Profile

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscriber. Primary key for the subscriber master record across all service tiers (SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, bundled). System-generated surrogate key independent of household or device.

attributes.name: audience_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.audience_profile. Business justification: Links subscribers to Nielsen panel profiles and ACR measurement identities. Required for cross-platform audience measurement, ratings attribution, and MRC-accredited viewership reporting. Standard pra

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscriber account. Determines access entitlements and billing state. Active subscribers have full access; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked; cancelled accounts are terminated; trial accounts are in promotional period; churned accounts have completed cancellation.

attributes.name: adobe_profile_reference
attributes.description: External identifier linking this subscriber to their unified profile in Adobe Experience Platform. Used for personalization, segmentation, and journey orchestration.

attributes.name: arpu
attributes.description: Average monthly revenue generated by this subscriber across all revenue streams (subscription, transactional, advertising). Key metric for subscriber value assessment and segmentation.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency of subscription billing. Monthly, quarterly, and annual are recurring; lifetime is one-time payment; pay-per-view is transactional.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether California subscriber has opted out of personal data sale. Required for CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when CCPA opt-out was recorded. Required for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Predictive score (0.0000 to 1.0000) indicating likelihood of subscriber cancellation within next billing cycle. Generated by machine learning model based on engagement, payment history, and behavioral signals.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscriber account is subject to COPPA restrictions (under 13 years old). When true, data collection and advertising are restricted.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing subscriber's primary geographic location. Used for content rights windowing, regional pricing, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this subscriber record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subscriber's date of birth. Used for age verification, parental controls, COPPA compliance, and demographic segmentation.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for subscriber communication, authentication, and personalization. Used as primary contact channel and login credential.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the subscriber, typically used for integration with Zuora billing and Adobe Experience Platform. May be customer-facing account number or external system key.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Subscriber's given name as provided during registration. Used for personalization and customer service interactions.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscriber has provided explicit consent for data processing under GDPR. Required for EU subscribers.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when GDPR consent was obtained. Required for audit trail and consent management.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Subscriber's self-identified gender. Used for demographic analytics and content personalization. Optional field respecting subscriber privacy preferences.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking subscriber to their household group. Multiple subscribers may share a household for family plans and concurrent stream management.

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of subscriber's most recent authentication. Used for engagement tracking and churn prediction.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Subscriber's family name as provided during registration. Used for personalization and customer service interactions.

attributes.name: last_viewing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of subscriber's most recent content viewing session. Used for engagement analysis and retention modeling.

attributes.name: ltv
attributes.description: Predicted total revenue this subscriber will generate over their entire relationship with the service. Used for acquisition cost justification and retention prioritization.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscriber has consented to receive marketing communications. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous video streams allowed for this subscriber based on their service tier. Enforced by playout and CDN systems.

attributes.name: max_registered_devices
attributes.description: Maximum number of devices that can be registered to this subscriber account. Used for device management and anti-piracy enforcement.

attributes.name: parental_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental controls are active on this subscriber account. When true, content access is restricted based on rating thresholds and PIN protection.

attributes.name: parental_control_pin
attributes.description: Encrypted PIN code required to access age-restricted content when parental controls are enabled. Stored in hashed format for security.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for subscriber support and account recovery. May be used for two-factor authentication.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Subscriber's postal or ZIP code. Used for geographic segmentation, local content recommendations, and blackout enforcement.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code representing subscriber's preferred interface and content language. Used for UI localization and content recommendations.

attributes.name: registration_source
attributes.description: Channel through which the subscriber originally registered. Used for acquisition analytics and channel effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the subscriber account was first created. Used for cohort analysis, LTV calculation, and subscriber lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Current subscription service tier. SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand) includes basic and premium tiers; AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand) is free with ads; TVOD (Transactional Video On Demand) is pay-per-view; bundle includes multiple services.

attributes.name: subscription_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current subscription is scheduled to end or renew. Null for active recurring subscriptions. Used for churn prediction and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: subscription_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the current subscription tier became effective. Used for billing cycle calculation and tenure analysis.

attributes.name: total_viewing_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative hours of content viewed by this subscriber since registration. Key engagement metric for LTV calculation and content recommendation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this subscriber record was last modified. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: zuora_account_reference
attributes.description: External identifier linking this subscriber to their billing account in Zuora subscription management system. Used for payment processing and revenue recognition integration.

products.name: household
products.description: Represents a logical household grouping of one or more subscribers sharing a service plan. Tracks household-level attributes including address, geographic market (DMA), household size, primary account holder reference, parental control settings, simultaneous stream limits, and household verification status. Supports MVPD household-based entitlement models, family plan billing, and account sharing enforcement.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the household grouping. Primary key for the household entity.

attributes.name: primary_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary account holder or subscriber who owns this household account. This subscriber has administrative privileges for the household.

attributes.name: account_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the household account was first created in the system. Used for tenure analysis and customer lifetime value (LTV) calculations.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the household's service location. Used for geographic market assignment and service delivery.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional field for additional address detail.

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household subscription automatically renews at the end of each billing period. When false, subscription expires unless manually renewed.

attributes.name: average_revenue_per_user
attributes.description: Average monthly revenue generated by this household, calculated as total revenue divided by number of active months. Key metric for household value assessment.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of the month when the household's recurring subscription charge is processed. Typically set at initial subscription and remains consistent.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Predictive score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the likelihood of this household cancelling their subscription in the next billing period. Generated by machine learning models based on engagement and payment patterns.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the household is located. Used for geographic segmentation and local content availability.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the household location. Determines applicable content rights, pricing, and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this household record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has consented to sharing their viewing data with third parties for analytics and advertising purposes. Required for privacy compliance.

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Designated Market Area code identifying the geographic television market for this household. Used for local content availability, blackout enforcement, and advertising targeting.

attributes.name: household_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the household, typically derived from the primary account holder's name or a custom household designation.

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the household account. Determines access rights and billing state.

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household based on its composition and purpose. Determines applicable service tier rules and entitlement models.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code representing the household's preferred content and interface language. Used for content recommendations and UI localization.

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent authentication event for any member of this household. Used for engagement tracking and inactive account identification.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful payment received from this household. Used for delinquency tracking and churn prediction.

attributes.name: lifetime_value
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by this household since account creation, including subscription fees, transactional purchases (TVOD), and advertising revenue attribution. Used for customer segmentation and retention investment decisions.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has consented to receive marketing communications and promotional offers. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous video streams allowed for this household based on their service plan. Enforced by the streaming platform to prevent account sharing abuse.

attributes.name: max_content_rating
attributes.description: Highest content rating level allowed for viewing in this household when parental controls are active. Based on Motion Picture Association (MPA) and TV Parental Guidelines ratings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-Y7|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MPA Film Ratings, TV Parental Guidelines

attributes.name: max_registered_devices
attributes.description: Maximum number of devices that can be registered to this household account. Used to enforce device limits per service tier.

attributes.name: mvpd_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the MVPD or vMVPD provider if this household accesses content through a cable/satellite/virtual provider authentication. Used for TV Everywhere entitlement validation.

attributes.name: parental_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental control restrictions are active for this household. When enabled, content access is filtered based on rating thresholds and PIN protection.
attributes.references: COPPA Compliance, FCC Parental Control Guidelines

attributes.name: parental_control_pin
attributes.description: Encrypted PIN code required to access age-restricted content when parental controls are enabled. Stored in hashed format for security.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument on file for this household's subscription billing. Determines payment processing flow and retry logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|bank_transfer|gift_card|carrier_billing|app_store — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the household address. Used for geographic market (DMA) assignment and service availability determination.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Current subscription service tier for the household. Determines content library access, stream quality (SD/HD/4K), and feature availability.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Number of registered members or subscribers within this household. Used for family plan eligibility and simultaneous stream limit enforcement.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region code for the household address. Used for regulatory compliance and regional content licensing.

attributes.name: subscription_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the household's current subscription is scheduled to end or renew. Null for active auto-renewing subscriptions.

attributes.name: subscription_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the household's current paid subscription began. May differ from account creation date if there was a trial period or reactivation.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the household location. Used for scheduling, program guide display, and live event timing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this household record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the household's identity and location. Multiple methods may be used in combination for higher confidence.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of household identity and address verification process. Used to enforce geographic entitlements and prevent fraudulent account creation.

products.name: subscription_plan
products.description: Catalog of all available subscription plans and service tiers offered to subscribers — SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, FAST, bundled, and add-on plans. Captures plan name, tier classification, billing frequency, base price, trial eligibility, concurrent stream limit, download allowance, ad-supported flag, and plan lifecycle status. Managed in Zuora as the product catalog.

attributes.name: subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscription plan. Primary key for the subscription plan catalog.

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.ott_platform. Business justification: Subscription plans are platform-specific products (Disney+ Basic vs Hulu Live TV). Billing, entitlement provisioning, and subscriber reporting all require knowing which OTT platform a plan belongs to.

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Each subscription plan maps to specific revenue streams for financial reporting, revenue recognition policies, and segment analysis. Finance requires this mapping for ASC 606 compliance and management

attributes.name: target_demographic_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.demographic_segment. Business justification: Subscription tiers are designed targeting specific Nielsen demographics (A18-49, A25-54 key demos). Required for pricing strategy, tier optimization, and validating that plan design attracts target au

attributes.name: ad_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription plan includes advertising (AVOD/FAST model) or is ad-free (SVOD model).

attributes.name: addon_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan can be purchased as an add-on to another base subscription plan (e.g., premium sports channel add-on).

attributes.name: audio_quality_max
attributes.description: Maximum audio quality format available under this subscription plan (e.g., stereo, surround 5.1, Dolby Atmos, DTS:X).

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscriptions under this plan automatically renew at the end of each billing period by default.

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Standard recurring price for the subscription plan before any discounts, promotions, or taxes. Expressed in the default currency.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which subscribers are billed for this plan (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual, biannual, one-time, usage-based).

attributes.name: blackout_restrictions
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription plan is subject to geographic blackout restrictions for certain live sports or regional content.
attributes.references: Rights and Licensing Management - Retransmission Consent

attributes.name: bundled_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a bundled subscription plan that combines multiple services or content packages (e.g., streaming + live TV + music).

attributes.name: cancellation_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing subscriber cancellation: anytime (immediate), end of billing period, no refund, or prorated refund.
attributes.references: Subscriber Terms of Service - Churn Management Policy

attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of the parental control PIN. Stored as a one-way hash for security. Never stored in plaintext. Used to authenticate access to restricted content or settings changes.

attributes.name: pin_protection_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIN is required to access content above the rating threshold or to modify parental control settings. True if PIN protection is active, False otherwise.

attributes.name: purchase_lock_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactional purchases (TVOD - Transactional Video On Demand) are blocked for this profile. True if purchase lock is active (preventing rentals/purchases), False if purchases are allowed.

attributes.name: search_restriction_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether search functionality is restricted to only show age-appropriate content. True if search results are filtered by parental controls, False if unrestricted search is allowed.

attributes.name: viewing_time_restriction_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether time-of-day viewing restrictions are enforced for this profile. True if time restrictions are active, False otherwise.

products.name: viewer_profile
products.description: Individual viewing profile within a subscriber account or household — supporting multi-profile accounts (e.g., up to 5 profiles per account). Captures profile name, avatar, language preference, content genre preferences, maturity rating level, is_kids_profile flag, and Adobe Experience Platform segment IDs for personalization. Distinct from the subscriber master record — one subscriber may have multiple viewer profiles.
products.reference: Adobe Experience Platform Profile / OTT Multi-Profile

attributes.name: viewer_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the viewer profile within a subscriber account or household. Primary key.

attributes.name: device_registration_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the last device used to access this viewer profile. Used for device tracking, security monitoring, and cross-device analytics. May reference device registration records.

attributes.name: favorite_genre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.genre. Business justification: Personalization and recommendation engines require explicit genre preferences. Drives content discovery, homepage curation, and email marketing. Complements behavioral signals with declared preference

attributes.name: personalization_engine_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.personalization_engine. Business justification: A/B testing and personalization require tracking which recommendation engine serves each profile. Critical for measuring algorithm performance, cold-start strategy effectiveness, and experimentation i

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent subscriber account that owns this viewer profile. One subscriber may have multiple viewer profiles (e.g., up to 5 profiles per account).

attributes.name: aep_segment_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Adobe Experience Platform segment IDs that this viewer profile belongs to. Used for personalized content recommendations, targeted advertising, and dynamic user experience customization.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Membership Schema

attributes.name: audio_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code for preferred audio track language. Used for multi-language content with multiple audio tracks.

attributes.name: autoplay_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether autoplay of next episode or content is enabled for this profile. True enables automatic playback; false requires manual selection.

attributes.name: autoplay_previews_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automatic preview playback is enabled when browsing content. True enables preview autoplay; false disables previews.

attributes.name: avatar_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the profile avatar image stored in the Media Asset Management (MAM) system or Content Delivery Network (CDN). Used for visual identification in profile selection interfaces.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the viewer has opted out of personal data sale under CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act). True indicates opt-out; false indicates consent. Required for California viewer data privacy compliance.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profile is subject to COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) compliance requirements. True for profiles of children under 13; false for adult profiles. Enforces enhanced privacy protections and parental consent requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the viewer profile was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, lifecycle tracking, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standard; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: data_saver_mode
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether data saver mode is enabled to reduce bandwidth consumption. True limits video quality and disables high-bandwidth features; false allows full quality streaming.

attributes.name: download_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profile is entitled to download content for offline viewing. True enables download feature; false restricts to streaming only. Controlled by subscription tier and DRM (Digital Rights Management) policies.
attributes.references: DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; Zuora Subscription Entitlements

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) consent was obtained for this viewer profile. Required for EU audience data privacy compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: genre_preferences
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of preferred content genre identifiers for personalization and recommendation algorithms. Derived from viewing history and explicit user selections. Used by Adobe Experience Platform for segment targeting.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Schema; Content Genre Taxonomy

attributes.name: is_default_profile
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the default profile that is automatically selected when the subscriber logs in. True for default profile; false for secondary profiles. Only one profile per subscriber should be marked as default.

attributes.name: is_kids_profile
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a dedicated kids profile with enhanced parental controls, age-appropriate content filtering, and COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) compliance enforcement. True for kids profiles; false for adult/general profiles.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code with optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'es-MX'). Determines the language for user interface, content metadata, and audio/subtitle defaults.

attributes.name: last_access_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the viewer profile was last accessed or used for content viewing. Used for engagement analytics, churn prediction, and inactive profile identification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the viewer profile was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standard; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: last_platform
attributes.description: Platform type of the last device used to access this viewer profile. Used for platform-specific analytics and Over-The-Top (OTT) distribution tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_ios|mobile_android|smart_tv|roku|fire_tv|apple_tv|chromecast|gaming_console — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Device Schema; OTT (Over-The-Top) Platform Taxonomy

attributes.name: marketing_consent
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the viewer profile has consented to receive marketing communications and promotional content. True allows marketing; false opts out. Required for GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 6; CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: maturity_rating_level
attributes.description: Maximum content maturity rating level allowed for this viewer profile. Enforces parental controls and content filtering based on Motion Picture Association (MPA) film ratings and TV Parental Guidelines. Content exceeding this rating is blocked from playback. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-Y7|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; TV Parental Guidelines

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of concurrent video streams allowed for this viewer profile. Enforces Digital Rights Management (DRM) and subscription tier entitlements. Typical values range from 1 to 4 streams.
attributes.references: DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy; Zuora Subscription Entitlements

attributes.name: max_downloads
attributes.description: Maximum number of content titles that can be downloaded for offline viewing on this profile. Enforces subscription tier limits and storage management policies.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Entitlements; DRM (Digital Rights Management) Policy

attributes.name: personalization_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether personalized content recommendations and user experience customization are enabled for this profile. True enables Adobe Experience Platform personalization; false provides generic content discovery. Impacts GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) consent requirements.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Consent Schema; GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: pin_code_hash
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profile Personal Identification Number (PIN) Code Hash
attributes.description: Hashed PIN code for profile access control and parental lock enforcement. Used to restrict access to mature content or prevent unauthorized profile switching. Stored as cryptographic hash for security.
attributes.references: Internal Security Standard; PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: pin_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profile Personal Identification Number (PIN) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether PIN protection is enabled for this profile. True requires PIN entry for profile access; false allows unrestricted access.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the viewer profile (e.g., 'Dad', 'Kids', 'Guest'). Used for profile selection and personalization.

attributes.name: profile_sort_order
attributes.description: Integer value determining the display order of this profile in the profile selection interface. Lower values appear first. Used for user experience optimization.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform User Interface Schema

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the viewer profile. Active profiles can access content; inactive profiles are temporarily disabled; suspended profiles are blocked due to policy violations; deleted profiles are soft-deleted and retained for compliance.

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the viewer profile within the household. Primary profiles have full account privileges; secondary profiles may have restricted access; kids profiles enforce parental controls; guest profiles are temporary.

attributes.name: subtitle_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code for preferred subtitle language. Used when subtitle_preference is enabled.

attributes.name: subtitle_preference
attributes.description: Default subtitle display preference for this viewer profile. Off disables subtitles; on always displays subtitles; auto displays subtitles based on content language and user language mismatch.

attributes.name: total_viewing_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative total viewing hours for this viewer profile across all content and sessions. Used for engagement metrics, Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) analysis, and Lifetime Value (LTV) calculations.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Measurement; ARPU (Average Revenue Per User); LTV (Lifetime Value)

attributes.name: video_quality_preference
attributes.description: Preferred video streaming quality for this profile. Auto uses Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (ABR) based on bandwidth; low/medium/high/ultra_hd enforce specific quality tiers. Impacts Content Delivery Network (CDN) delivery and bandwidth consumption.
attributes.references: HLS (HTTP Live Streaming); MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP); ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming)

attributes.name: viewing_history_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether viewing history is tracked and stored for this profile. True enables history tracking for recommendations and resume playback; false disables tracking for privacy. Impacts GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation); CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

products.name: churn_event
products.description: Operational record of a subscriber cancellation or lapse event. Captures cancellation timestamp, cancellation channel (self-service, customer care, payment failure, MVPD drop), stated cancellation reason, win-back offer presented flag, win-back offer accepted flag, and reactivation eligibility date. Supports churn rate reporting and retention campaign targeting. Distinct from analytics — this is the operational event record.
products.reference: Zuora Subscription Cancellation / Churn Rate KPI

attributes.name: churn_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscriber churn event record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Churn events are analyzed by cost center for retention program budgeting and departmental accountability. Marketing and customer success teams track churn metrics against their cost center budgets for

attributes.name: distribution_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Multichannel Video Programming Distributor (MVPD) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the MVPD or vMVPD partner through which the subscription was provisioned. Null for direct-to-consumer subscriptions. Used for partner churn analysis.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household to which the churned subscriber belonged. Used for household-level churn analysis and multi-subscriber household retention strategies.

attributes.name: last_viewed_title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.title. Business justification: Churn analysis tracks last content engagement to identify content gaps and inform win-back campaigns. Critical for retention analytics, content investment decisions, and personalized re-engagement off

attributes.name: outage_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.outage_record. Business justification: Churn analysis must correlate service cancellations with technical outages to quantify revenue impact of infrastructure failures and prioritize reliability investments. Retention analytics require lin

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Churn analysis by profit center is critical for segment profitability reporting and EBITDA calculation. Media companies track subscriber retention by business unit for strategic resource allocation an

attributes.name: retention_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Retention specialists (workforce) are assigned to at-risk subscribers for win-back campaigns. Critical for churn prevention workflow tracking, agent performance metrics, and retention campaign ROI ana

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who churned. Links to the subscriber master record.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific subscription that was cancelled. Links to the subscription master record.

attributes.name: win_back_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific retention or win-back offer that was presented to the subscriber. Null if no offer was presented.

attributes.name: auto_renew_disabled_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscriber disabled auto-renewal for their subscription. Null if auto-renewal was never disabled. Used to identify planned churn versus reactive churn.

attributes.name: cancellation_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the cancellation was initiated. Supports analysis of churn patterns by customer touchpoint. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_self_service|mobile_app|customer_care|email|chat|ivr|mvpd_drop|system_automated — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the stated reason for cancellation. Used for churn analytics and product improvement initiatives. Empty value_regex indicates reference to external reason code lookup table with more than 6 values.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or additional details provided by the subscriber explaining the reason for cancellation. Supports qualitative churn analysis.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber exercised CCPA opt-out rights regarding data sale or sharing. Used for privacy compliance and marketing eligibility.

attributes.name: churn_prediction_score
attributes.description: The machine learning model-generated churn risk score that was assigned to the subscriber prior to the churn event. Range 0.0000 to 1.0000, where higher values indicate higher churn risk. Used for model validation and predictive accuracy assessment.

attributes.name: churn_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the subscriber cancellation or lapse event occurred. This is the business event timestamp representing when the subscriber relationship ended.

attributes.name: churn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the churn event based on the nature of cancellation. Voluntary indicates subscriber-initiated cancellation, involuntary indicates business-initiated termination, payment failure indicates cancellation due to billing issues.

attributes.name: competitor_service_mentioned_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber mentioned switching to a competitor service during the cancellation process. Used for competitive intelligence and market positioning analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this churn event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the last payment amount. Supports multi-currency subscription operations.

attributes.name: customer_care_contact_count
attributes.description: The number of customer care interactions the subscriber had in the 30 days prior to churn. Used to identify service quality issues and early warning signals.

attributes.name: days_since_last_viewing
attributes.description: The number of days between the last viewing activity and the churn event. Used for engagement-based churn prediction models.

attributes.name: device_count_at_churn
attributes.description: The number of registered devices associated with the subscriber at the time of churn. Used for multi-device engagement analysis.

attributes.name: final_access_date
attributes.description: The last date the subscriber had active access to content and services. May differ from churn_timestamp due to grace periods or paid-through dates.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_deletion_requested_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Deletion Requested Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber requested deletion of their personal data under GDPR right to erasure at the time of churn. Used for privacy compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the last successful payment received from the subscriber before churn. Used for ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) and revenue impact analysis.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the last successful payment received from the subscriber before churn. Used for revenue recognition and payment failure analysis.

attributes.name: last_viewing_date
attributes.description: The date of the subscribers last content viewing activity before churn. Used to identify engagement drop-off patterns and at-risk subscriber signals.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the churn event captured by customer care agents or system processes.

attributes.name: parental_control_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether parental controls were enabled on the subscription at the time of churn. Used for family-oriented subscriber segmentation and churn analysis.

attributes.name: payment_failure_count
attributes.description: The number of consecutive payment failures that occurred before the churn event. Used to identify involuntary churn patterns and dunning effectiveness.

attributes.name: promotional_discount_active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber had an active promotional discount at the time of churn. Used to analyze price sensitivity and promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: reactivation_eligibility_date
attributes.description: The date when the churned subscriber becomes eligible for reactivation campaigns or promotional offers. Used for win-back campaign targeting and timing.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: The subscription service tier that was cancelled. SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand), AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand), TVOD (Transactional Video On Demand).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this churn event. Typically Zuora for subscription billing events or Adobe Experience Platform for digital engagement tracking.

attributes.name: subscription_tenure_months
attributes.description: The total number of months the subscriber maintained an active subscription before churning. Used for cohort analysis and LTV (Lifetime Value) calculations.

attributes.name: total_lifetime_revenue
attributes.description: The cumulative revenue generated from this subscriber across their entire subscription tenure. Used for LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis and churn impact assessment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this churn event record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: win_back_offer_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber accepted the win-back offer. True indicates acceptance and retention, False indicates rejection and churn completion. Null if no offer was presented.

attributes.name: win_back_offer_presented_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a retention or win-back offer was presented to the subscriber during the cancellation process. True indicates an offer was made, False indicates no offer was presented.

products.name: subscription_change
products.description: Audit trail of all plan changes, upgrades, downgrades, pauses, reinstatements, and promotional offer redemptions on a subscriber's subscription. Captures previous plan, new plan, change type (upgrade, downgrade, pause, reactivate, add-on attach, add-on detach, offer redemption), effective date, change channel, proration amount, applied discount, offer reference, redemption status, and Zuora amendment reference. Enables subscription lifecycle analysis, promotion effectiveness tracking, and revenue reconciliation.

attributes.name: subscription_change_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscription change event. Primary key.

attributes.name: add_on_id
attributes.description: Reference to the add-on product attached or detached during this change. Populated only for add-on attach and add-on detach change types.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Subscription changes originating from partner-driven campaigns (MVPD upgrade offers, bundling promotions, affiliate retention programs) require tracking the partner for revenue attribution, partner pe

attributes.name: primary_subscription_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user account (subscriber self-service or internal agent) that initiated the subscription change. Used for audit trails and agent performance tracking.

attributes.name: primary_subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscription plan that was active before this change. Null for new subscriptions or add-on attach events.

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Plan upgrades/downgrades affect revenue stream classification for financial reporting. Finance tracks MRR changes by revenue stream for forecasting, variance analysis, and segment performance reportin

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns this subscription. Enables subscriber-level change analysis and churn tracking.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscription that was modified. Links to the parent subscription record in the subscriber domain.

attributes.name: zuora_invoice_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Zuora invoice generated for this subscription change. Links the change event to billing and revenue recognition processes.

attributes.name: applied_discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to the new plan as part of this change. Includes promotional offers, retention discounts, and loyalty rewards.

attributes.name: applied_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the new plan subscription fee. Used for promotion effectiveness analysis and revenue impact modeling.

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic renewal is enabled for the subscription after this change. Critical for churn prediction and renewal revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: change_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the subscription change was initiated. Enables channel effectiveness analysis and self-service adoption tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile app|call center|chat|email|api|admin portal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscription change became effective and billing adjustments were applied. Critical for revenue recognition and proration calculations.

attributes.name: change_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the agent or system during the change process. Captures context, customer feedback, and special handling instructions.

attributes.name: change_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the system completed processing the change and updated the subscription state. Used for operational efficiency metrics.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason provided or inferred for the subscription change. Critical for churn analysis, retention strategy, and product improvement.
attributes.value_regex: customer request|price increase|content preference|financial hardship|technical issue|retention offer

attributes.name: change_request_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the subscriber or agent initiated the change request. Used for time-to-fulfillment analysis and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: The type of change applied to the subscription. Categorizes the nature of the modification for lifecycle analysis and revenue impact assessment.

attributes.name: content_entitlement_change
attributes.description: Describes changes to content library access, premium channel entitlements, or windowing rights resulting from this subscription change. Critical for content licensing and rights management.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: The length of the new subscription contract term in months resulting from this change. Used for commitment analysis and churn risk modeling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription change record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: device_limit_new
attributes.description: The maximum number of concurrent devices allowed under the new subscription plan. Enables analysis of device limit impact on upgrade and downgrade decisions.

attributes.name: device_limit_previous
attributes.description: The maximum number of concurrent devices allowed under the previous subscription plan. Used to track device entitlement changes and household sharing patterns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription change record was last updated in the data platform. Supports change data capture and incremental processing workflows.

attributes.name: mrr_impact_amount
attributes.description: The net change in monthly recurring revenue resulting from this subscription change. Positive for upgrades, negative for downgrades. Calculated as new_monthly_recurring_revenue minus previous_monthly_recurring_revenue.

attributes.name: new_billing_period
attributes.description: The billing frequency of the new subscription plan. Enables analysis of billing period changes and their impact on cash flow and retention.

attributes.name: new_monthly_recurring_revenue
attributes.description: The monthly recurring revenue amount from the new plan after this change. Used to calculate MRR expansion, contraction, and net revenue retention metrics.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: The promotional code or coupon code entered by the subscriber during the change process. Used for campaign tracking and fraud detection.

attributes.name: offer_redemption_status
attributes.description: The status of promotional offer redemption at the time of subscription change. Tracks successful and failed offer applications for campaign effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: previous_billing_period
attributes.description: The billing frequency of the previous subscription plan. Used to analyze billing period migration patterns and payment preference trends.

attributes.name: previous_monthly_recurring_revenue
attributes.description: The monthly recurring revenue amount from the previous plan before this change. Critical for MRR movement analysis and revenue waterfall reporting.

attributes.name: promotional_offer_code
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional offer or retention campaign that was redeemed during this subscription change. Null if no offer was applied.

attributes.name: proration_amount
attributes.description: The prorated credit or charge amount applied to the subscriber account due to mid-cycle plan changes. Positive values represent charges, negative values represent credits.

attributes.name: proration_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the proration amount. Supports multi-currency subscription operations.

attributes.name: service_tier_change
attributes.description: Describes the service tier transition for this subscription change. Specific to media streaming business models including AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand), SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand), and tiered SVOD offerings.
attributes.value_regex: AVOD to SVOD|SVOD to AVOD|SVOD Basic to Premium|Premium to Basic|no tier change

attributes.name: zuora_amendment_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Zuora subscription amendment record that represents this change. Enables reconciliation with the billing system of record.

products.name: payment_instrument
products.description: Subscriber's stored payment instruments used for subscription billing. Captures payment method type (credit card, debit card, PayPal, direct debit, gift card, MVPD billing), masked card/account number, card brand, expiry date, billing address, is_default flag, and PCI DSS tokenization reference. Managed in Zuora as the payment method entity. Distinct from actual payment transactions owned by the billing domain.
products.reference: Zuora Payment Method / PCI DSS Token

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment instrument record. Primary key.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns this payment instrument. Links to the subscriber master record.

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: High-value or fraud-flagged payment methods require manual verification by billing/fraud teams. Critical for payment fraud prevention workflows, chargeback dispute resolution, and fraud analyst perfor

attributes.name: zuora_payment_method_id
attributes.description: External identifier for this payment method in the Zuora subscription billing system. Used for system integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account for direct debit or ACH payment methods. Null for card-based payment methods.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number (ABA number in USA) for direct debit transactions. Masked or tokenized per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment instrument. Used for address verification and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address associated with the payment instrument.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Used for address verification service (AVS) fraud checks.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter state code for USA).

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: The brand of the credit or debit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club). Null for non-card payment methods.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment instrument. Required for card-based payment methods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment instrument record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment instrument (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Determines the currency for all transactions using this instrument.

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment instrument was deactivated or closed. Null for active instruments. Used for lifecycle tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the payment instrument was deactivated. Used for churn analysis and payment method lifecycle management.

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: The month (1-12) when the payment instrument expires. Used for card expiration validation and renewal reminders.

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: The four-digit year when the payment instrument expires. Used for card expiration validation and renewal reminders.

attributes.name: failed_transaction_count

products.name: offer_redemption

attributes.name: partner_id

attributes.name: qualifying_title_id
