attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Segment Regulatory Compliance - Audience Segment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the audience segment being evaluated for regulatory compliance

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when this audience segment was activated for use under this specific regulatory obligation. Represents when the segment was first deployed in campaigns subject to this regulation.

attributes.name: audit_findings
attributes.description: Summary of findings from the most recent compliance audit. Documents any violations, concerns, or confirmations of compliance. Used for audit trail and remediation tracking.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_honored
attributes.description: Indicates whether California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) opt-out signals are honored when activating this segment for California residents. When True, individuals who have exercised their CCPA right to opt out of sale/sharing of personal information are excluded from segment activation. Required for compliance with CCPA and its amendment CPRA. [Moved from audience_segment: CCPA opt-out handling is a compliance attribute specific to the CCPA regulatory obligation. This should be tracked in the segment-obligation compliance relationship where it can be audited, dated, and linked to the specific CCPA obligation record. The segment itself shouldn't carry obligation-specific compliance flags.]
attributes.references: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) Cal. Civ. Code §1798.100; CPRA Amendment; IAB CCPA Compliance Framework

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of this segment with respect to this specific obligation. Values: compliant (segment meets all requirements), non_compliant (violations identified), under_review (audit in progress), remediation_in_progress (corrective actions underway), exempt (exemption granted).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance record was created in the system.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment was deactivated or removed from use under this obligation. Null if segment remains active. Used to track compliance history.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the segment was deactivated under this obligation. Examples: compliance violation, obligation no longer applicable, segment retired, business decision. Null if segment is active.

attributes.name: exemption_basis
attributes.description: Legal or regulatory basis for any exemption granted for this segment under this obligation. Null if no exemption applies. Examples: safe harbor provision, de minimis exception, grandfathered status, regulatory waiver reference.

attributes.name: exemption_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when any granted exemption expires and full compliance is required. Null if no exemption or if exemption is permanent.

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.description: The GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 6 lawful basis under which audience data is processed to build and activate this segment for EU audiences. 'consent' requires explicit opt-in; 'legitimate_interest' requires a balancing test; 'contract' applies to subscriber-based segments; 'not_applicable' for non-EU segments. Required for regulatory compliance reporting. [Moved from audience_segment: GDPR lawful basis is specific to the GDPR regulatory obligation and represents compliance metadata that belongs in the segment-obligation relationship. Different segments may have different lawful bases under GDPR, and this should be tracked as part of the compliance record with audit dates and status, not as a standalone attribute on the segment.]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing); GDPR Article 4; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: is_coppa_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is subject to COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) restrictions, meaning it includes or may include children under 13. COPPA-restricted segments are prohibited from behavioral targeting and require parental consent mechanisms. Critical compliance flag for ad sales and digital activation workflows. [Moved from audience_segment: This boolean flag indicates COPPA applicability but doesn't capture the compliance relationship details. The segment_regulatory_compliance association should track the actual COPPA obligation (via regulatory_obligation_id) with full audit history, compliance status, and exemption basis. The flag in audience_segment can remain as a derived/cached indicator for quick filtering, but the authoritative compliance relationship lives in the association.]
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) 15 U.S.C. §6501; FCC Children's Television Act; IAB COPPA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment-obligation pairing was last audited for compliance. Used to track audit frequency and schedule next review.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit of this segment under this obligation. Calculated based on obligation compliance_frequency and risk_level.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which remediation actions must be completed to avoid penalties or enforcement action. Null if no remediation required.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions planned or in progress to address any compliance gaps. Null if segment is compliant or exempt.

attributes.name: responsible_compliance_officer
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the compliance officer accountable for managing this segment-obligation compliance relationship.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed risk level specific to this segment-obligation combination. May differ from the obligation's general risk_level based on segment characteristics (e.g., a children's segment under COPPA has critical risk even if COPPA's general risk is high).

products.name: compensation_structure
products.description: Defines the detailed compensation terms attached to a talent contract — including base episode fee, weekly guarantee, daily rate, overtime multipliers, pension and health (P&H) contribution rates, residual base formula, backend gross participation percentage, deferred compensation schedule, and currency. Supports both union scale (SAG-AFTRA scale, DGA scale) and over-scale deals. Tracks step-up triggers (e.g., series pickup escalators), bonus thresholds, and pay-or-play provisions. Used by payroll and royalty workflows to calculate gross compensation and residual bases.
products.reference: SAG-AFTRA Scale Rate Card / DGA Rate Schedule

attributes.name: compensation_structure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation structure record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cba_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.cba_rate_card. Business justification: compensation_structure defines detailed compensation terms for talent contracts. Currently has union_scale_tier (STRING) and guild_affiliation (STRING) but no FK to the CBA rate card that defines mini

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Compensation structures define GL account classification for talent payments. Different compensation types (base fee, residuals, backend participation) map to specific GL accounts for expense recognit

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent talent contract to which this compensation structure is attached.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modified By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Business affairs employees modify compensation structures. Required for audit trails, approval workflows, financial controls, and compliance tracking. Column modified_by_user is denormalized employee

attributes.name: backend_gross_participation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of adjusted gross receipts or backend profits the talent is entitled to receive (e.g., 0.05 for 5% backend participation). Null if no backend participation is granted.

attributes.name: base_episode_fee
attributes.description: The guaranteed compensation amount per episode for episodic talent (actors, writers, directors). Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: The fixed or maximum bonus amount payable when the bonus threshold is met. Expressed in the contract currency. Null if no bonus provision exists.

attributes.name: bonus_threshold_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the performance or milestone thresholds that trigger bonus payments (e.g., 'Nielsen rating above 2.0 in key demo', 'box office exceeds $100M domestic').

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compensation arrangement: union scale (SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA minimum), over-scale (above union minimum), flat fee, episodic rate, weekly guarantee, daily rate, backend gross participation, deferred compensation, or residual-only deal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: union_scale|over_scale|flat_fee|episodic|weekly|daily|backend_participation|deferred|residual_only — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Basic Agreement, WGA Minimum Basic Agreement, DGA Basic Agreement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compensation structure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this compensation structure are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: daily_rate
attributes.description: The guaranteed daily compensation amount for talent engaged on a day-player or daily basis. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: deferred_compensation_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of compensation deferred to a future payment date or contingent event (e.g., series pickup, profitability milestone). Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: deferred_payment_trigger
attributes.description: The business event or milestone that triggers payment of deferred compensation (e.g., 'series_pickup', 'profitability_threshold_met', 'syndication_sale', 'specific_date').

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation structure ceases to be effective. Null for open-ended structures or those tied to contract termination.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation structure becomes effective and applicable to the talent contract.

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation structure includes an exclusivity provision restricting the talent from working on competing projects (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: guild_affiliation
attributes.description: The labor union or guild governing this compensation structure: SAG-AFTRA (Screen Actors Guild - American Federation of Television and Radio Artists), WGA (Writers Guild of America), DGA (Directors Guild of America), IATSE (International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees), or non-union.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA, IATSE collective bargaining agreements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compensation structure record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special provisions, or clarifications regarding this compensation structure that do not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: overtime_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base rate for overtime hours worked (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double-time). Null if overtime is not applicable.

attributes.name: pay_or_play_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation structure includes a pay-or-play provision, guaranteeing payment even if the talent is not used (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: pension_health_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate of gross compensation contributed to the guild pension and health plan (e.g., 0.185 for 18.5% SAG-AFTRA P&H). Used to calculate employer contributions.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Article 17, WGA Article 17, DGA Article 7-1200

attributes.name: residual_base_formula
attributes.description: The formula or method used to calculate the residual base for reuse payments (e.g., 'initial_compensation', 'applicable_minimum', 'pro_rata_share'). Defines how residuals are computed per guild rules.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Schedule B, WGA Article 15, DGA Article 7-300

attributes.name: residual_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the talent is eligible to receive residual payments for reuse of the content under this compensation structure (True) or not (False). Typically True for union deals, may be False for buyouts.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Article 20, WGA Article 15, DGA Article 7-300

attributes.name: step_up_amount
attributes.description: The incremental compensation increase amount when the step-up trigger is met. Expressed in the contract currency. Null if no step-up provision exists.

attributes.name: step_up_trigger
attributes.description: The condition or event that triggers an automatic increase in compensation (e.g., 'season_2_pickup', 'episode_13_renewal', 'ratings_threshold'). Null if no step-up provision exists.

attributes.name: structure_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for this compensation structure (e.g., 'Series Regular Season 1', 'Guest Star Rate Card').

attributes.name: structure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compensation structure: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), amended (modified after execution), superseded (replaced by a newer structure), or terminated (no longer applicable).

attributes.name: usage_rights_scope
attributes.description: Description of the media usage rights covered by this compensation structure (e.g., 'initial broadcast only', 'all media in perpetuity', 'theatrical and SVOD', 'domestic free television'). Defines what exploitation is covered by the base compensation.

attributes.name: weekly_guarantee
attributes.description: The guaranteed weekly compensation amount for talent engaged on a weekly basis (e.g., series regulars, production staff). Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Schedule A, DGA Schedule of Minimums

products.name: exclusivity_clause
products.description: Records the specific exclusivity and holdback restrictions embedded within or appended to a talent contract. Captures exclusivity type (category exclusivity, network exclusivity, platform exclusivity, geographic exclusivity), restricted competitor list, holdback window start and end dates, permitted carve-out activities, penalty provisions for breach, and waiver history. Enables rights and scheduling teams to validate talent availability for new productions and advertising campaigns without violating contractual obligations.

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the exclusivity clause record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent talent contract to which this exclusivity clause is attached. Links this clause to the overarching contractual agreement.

attributes.name: breach_incident_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times the talent has breached this exclusivity clause. Used to track compliance history and inform enforcement decisions.

attributes.name: clause_number
attributes.description: The business identifier or reference number assigned to this exclusivity clause within the contract document (e.g., Section 5.2, Clause EX-001). Used for legal and operational reference.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this exclusivity clause record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance; audit trail standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this exclusivity clause record became effective and enforceable within the talent contract. Represents the business event timestamp for this clause.

attributes.name: enforcement_status
attributes.description: Current enforcement state of the exclusivity clause. Active indicates the clause is fully enforceable. Suspended indicates temporary non-enforcement. Waived indicates a waiver is in effect. Expired indicates the holdback window has ended. Terminated indicates the clause has been permanently voided.

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the scope and boundaries of the exclusivity restriction. Defines what activities, roles, or engagements are covered by the exclusivity clause.

attributes.name: exclusivity_type
attributes.description: The category of exclusivity restriction imposed by this clause. Category exclusivity restricts talent from working in specific content genres or categories. Network exclusivity restricts talent from appearing on competing networks. Platform exclusivity restricts talent from appearing on competing streaming or distribution platforms. Geographic exclusivity restricts talent from working in specific territories. Time exclusivity restricts talent during specific dayparts or time windows. Project exclusivity restricts talent from working on competing projects or productions.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA (Screen Actors Guild - American Federation of Television and Radio Artists) collective bargaining agreements; WGA (Writers Guild of America) agreements; DGA (Directors Guild of America) agreements

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or territory identifiers where the exclusivity restriction applies (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). If empty or null, the exclusivity applies globally.

attributes.name: holdback_window_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exclusivity or holdback restriction expires. After this date, the talent is no longer bound by the exclusivity terms of this clause. Nullable for open-ended or perpetual exclusivity.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Windowing strategy standards

attributes.name: holdback_window_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exclusivity or holdback restriction becomes effective. Marks the beginning of the period during which the talent is bound by the exclusivity terms.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Windowing strategy standards

attributes.name: last_breach_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent breach of this exclusivity clause by the talent. Nullable if no breach has occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this exclusivity clause record was most recently updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: legal_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this exclusivity clause has been reviewed and approved by legal counsel. True indicates legal review is complete; False indicates pending or no review.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which legal counsel completed their review of this exclusivity clause. Nullable if legal review has not been completed.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; SOX compliance

attributes.name: legal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the legal counsel or attorney who reviewed and approved this exclusivity clause. Used for audit and accountability purposes.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; SOX compliance

attributes.name: negotiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business affairs executive, legal counsel, or talent agent who negotiated the terms of this exclusivity clause. Used for accountability and future reference.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or context regarding this exclusivity clause. May include negotiation history, special conditions, or operational guidance.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary penalty amount (in the contract currency) that the talent must pay if they breach the exclusivity clause. Represents liquidated damages or breach compensation. Nullable if penalty is non-monetary or not specified.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; contract law standards

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the penalty amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required if penalty_amount is populated.

attributes.name: penalty_provision
attributes.description: Detailed description of the financial or contractual penalties that apply if the talent breaches the exclusivity clause. May include liquidated damages amounts, contract termination rights, or other remedies available to the broadcaster.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; SAG-AFTRA agreements; contract law standards

attributes.name: permitted_carveout_activities
attributes.description: Textual description of specific activities, roles, or engagements that are explicitly exempted or carved out from the exclusivity restriction. Examples include charity appearances, personal social media, pre-existing commitments, or non-competing content categories.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; SAG-AFTRA agreements

attributes.name: restricted_competitor_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of specific competitors, networks, platforms, or entities with whom the talent is prohibited from engaging during the exclusivity period. May include network names, streaming platform identifiers, production company names, or brand names.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive, legal counsel, or business unit that approved the waiver to the exclusivity clause. Used for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which a granted waiver expires and the exclusivity clause becomes fully enforceable again. Nullable if the waiver is permanent or no waiver has been granted.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_date
attributes.description: The date on which a waiver or exception to the exclusivity clause was officially granted. Nullable if no waiver has been granted.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a waiver or exception to this exclusivity clause has been granted by the broadcaster. True indicates a waiver is in effect; False indicates the clause is fully enforceable.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation of the business or legal reason for granting a waiver to the exclusivity clause. Examples include strategic partnership, talent goodwill, promotional opportunity, or force majeure.

products.name: appearance_schedule
products.description: Operational schedule of talent time allocation — covering confirmed bookings, holds (first/second/third), first refusals, availability windows, and personal unavailability alongside specific call times for principal photography, ADR sessions, promotional appearances, press junkets, and live broadcast slots. Records production reference, call date/time, wrap time, location, appearance type, hold level, confirmation status, and release tracking. Integrates with production scheduling and playout systems to ensure talent availability aligns with broadcast calendars.

products.name: credit_attribution
products.description: Defines the on-screen and promotional credit entitlements for each talent on a specific production or content asset — capturing credit type (main title, end title, possessory credit, 'and' credit, 'with' credit), billing position (first position, second position, alphabetical), credit card size relative to title card, credit placement (opening, closing, both), contractually mandated credit language, and any approved credit waivers. Feeds EPG metadata, digital asset packaging, and streaming platform title cards. Governed by DGA, WGA, and SAG-AFTRA credit determination rules.

attributes.name: bank_account_name
attributes.description: The name on the bank account used for commission and residual payments to the agency.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number for electronic funds transfer of commissions and residuals to the agency.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The bank routing number (ABA number in the US, sort code in UK, or equivalent) for electronic funds transfer of commissions and residuals.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city or municipality where the agency's primary office is located.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 Standard; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code for the country where the agency's primary office is located (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this talent agency record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or doing-business-as name under which the agency operates, if different from the legal name.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: The date on which the talent agency was originally established or incorporated.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: The fax number for the agency, used for contract transmission and official correspondence in jurisdictions where fax is still required.

attributes.name: franchise_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SAG-AFTRA franchise agreement became effective for this agency.

attributes.name: franchise_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current SAG-AFTRA franchise agreement expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: franchise_number
attributes.description: The unique franchise identification number issued by SAG-AFTRA to franchised talent agencies.

attributes.name: franchise_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency holds a valid SAG-AFTRA franchise agreement, which authorizes the agency to represent union talent. Franchised agencies agree to standard commission rates and contract terms.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the talent agency or management company as it appears on contracts and official documents.

attributes.name: license_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state talent agency license became effective.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state talent agency license expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The state-issued license number authorizing the agency to operate as a talent agency. Required in jurisdictions such as California under the Talent Agencies Act.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 1700 - Talent Agencies Act

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: The state or province that issued the talent agency license. Use standard two-letter state/province codes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes field for additional context, special handling instructions, historical information, or relationship management details relevant to the agency.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The standard payment terms and conditions for commission remittance, including timing and method of payment (e.g., net 30 days, upon talent payment receipt).

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code for the agency's primary business address.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 Standard; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person at the agency for contract negotiations, deal correspondence, and residual remittances.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: The job title or role of the primary contact person (e.g., President, Partner, Agent, Business Affairs Manager).

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: The primary email address for official correspondence, contract delivery, and residual payment notifications.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: The primary telephone number for the agency, including country and area codes.

attributes.name: roster_size
attributes.description: The approximate number of talent clients currently represented by the agency. Used for agency scale assessment and negotiation context.

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: The primary area of talent specialization or focus for the agency (e.g., film and television actors, commercial talent, voice-over artists, writers, directors, below-the-line crew, music artists). Free-text field to accommodate multiple specializations.

attributes.name: standard_commission_rate
attributes.description: The standard commission rate percentage that the agency charges for talent representation, typically 10% for franchised agencies under SAG-AFTRA rules. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or region where the agency's primary office is located. Use standard two-letter codes where applicable.

attributes.name: status_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current status became effective.

attributes.name: talent_agency_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the talent agency: active (currently representing talent), inactive (not currently operating), suspended (temporarily not authorized), pending_verification (under review), or dissolved (permanently closed).

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The tax identification number (EIN in the US, VAT number in EU) for the agency, used for tax reporting and residual payment processing.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179; GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this talent agency record was last modified. Updated automatically on any change to the record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency information was last verified for accuracy and currency, typically through direct contact or regulatory registry check.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The primary website URL for the talent agency, used for public information and talent roster visibility.

products.name: representation_agreement
products.description: Records the formal representation relationship between a talent and their agency or management company — capturing representation type (exclusive agent, co-agent, manager, entertainment attorney), territory scope, commission percentage, agreement start and end dates, exclusivity flag, termination notice period, and current status. Tracks historical representation changes to support residual routing and deal negotiation audit trails. A talent may have multiple concurrent representation agreements across different territories or function types.

attributes.name: representation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the representation agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: talent_agency_id

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the talent being represented under this agreement.

attributes.name: agent_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the agent or representative, used for deal negotiation and residual routing communications.

attributes.name: agent_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the agent or representative.

attributes.name: agent_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual agent, manager, or attorney assigned as primary contact for this representation.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this representation agreement, used for contract reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: commission_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum commission amount per engagement or per year, if a cap is specified in the agreement. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of talent earnings paid to the representative as commission (typically 10% for agents, 15% for managers per industry standards).

attributes.name: contract_document_uri
attributes.description: URI or file path to the signed representation agreement contract document stored in the Media Asset Management (MAM) system or document repository.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this representation agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the representation agreement expires or terminates. Null for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the representation agreement becomes binding and the representative begins acting on behalf of the talent.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this representation is exclusive (true) or non-exclusive (false). Exclusive agreements prohibit the talent from engaging other representatives in the same category and territory.

attributes.name: guild_franchise_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency or representative is franchised by a talent guild (SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA). Franchised agents must comply with guild-mandated commission caps and contract terms.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special clauses, amendments, or contextual information about the representation agreement.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes an automatic renewal option or requires explicit renegotiation at expiration.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Description of renewal terms if renewal_option_flag is true, including renewal period length and any modified commission rates.

attributes.name: representation_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the representation agreement: active (in force), expired (end date reached), terminated (ended early by either party), suspended (temporarily inactive), or pending (signed but not yet effective).

attributes.name: representation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the representation relationship: exclusive agent (sole representation), co-agent (shared representation), manager (career management), entertainment attorney (legal counsel), business manager (financial management), or publicist (public relations).

attributes.name: residual_routing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether residual payments for work performed during this representation period should be routed through this representative for commission deduction.

attributes.name: scope_of_services
attributes.description: Detailed description of services the representative will provide: deal negotiation, career guidance, audition scheduling, contract review, brand partnerships, etc.

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: Date when the representation agreement was signed by both parties.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the representation agreement was terminated, if applicable. Used for residual routing cutoff and historical audit trails.

attributes.name: termination_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the representation agreement (commonly 30, 60, or 90 days).

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early termination of the representation agreement, if applicable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|talent_initiated|agent_initiated|breach_of_contract|expiration|non_performance|conflict_of_interest — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territory or market scope covered by this representation agreement (e.g., worldwide, North America, USA, specific states). Multiple territories may be comma-separated.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this representation agreement record was last modified.

products.name: usage_right
products.description: Defines the specific usage rights granted to Media Broadcasting for a talent's likeness, voice, name, and performance under a given contract, and tracks the clearance verification workflow for each right. Captures right type (broadcast, streaming, VOD, SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, FAST, home video, theatrical, promotional, social media, out-of-home), territory, language, platform, window dates, exclusivity flag, clearance status (pending, cleared, conditionally cleared, blocked), blocking reason, clearance granted by, and approval/consent tracking. Ensures talent usage is both contractually authorized and operationally verified before content goes to air or distribution.
products.reference: SAG-AFTRA New Media Agreement / Talent Likeness Rights

attributes.name: usage_right_id

attributes.name: content_license_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.content_license_deal. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.media_asset. Business justification: Usage rights vary by asset version (master vs proxy, theatrical vs broadcast, original vs dubbed). Specific assets have different distribution rights, platforms, and territorial restrictions. Required

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.title. Business justification: Usage rights (likeness, performance, name) are granted per title for specific platforms and territories. Fundamental to rights management, clearance workflows, and promotional material approval.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the person or entity with authority to approve usage under this right (e.g., talent agent, legal department, talent themselves).

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the usage right is blocked or conditionally cleared. Null if status is cleared or pending.

attributes.name: clearance_granted_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that granted clearance for this usage right.

attributes.name: clearance_granted_date
attributes.description: Date when clearance was granted for this usage right. Null if not yet cleared.

attributes.name: clearance_requested_date
attributes.description: Date when clearance verification was requested for this usage right.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current clearance verification status of the usage right. Tracks operational approval workflow.

attributes.name: consent_obtained_date
attributes.description: Date when talent consent was obtained for this usage right. Null if consent not obtained or not required.

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required consent has been obtained from the talent (True) or not (False). Null if consent not required.

attributes.name: consent_required_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_attribution_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether talent credit attribution is contractually required when this usage right is exercised (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: credit_attribution_text

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this usage right is exclusive to Media Broadcasting (True) or non-exclusive (False).

attributes.name: holdback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after initial use during which certain usage types are restricted (exclusivity period). Null if no holdback applies.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language(s) for which the usage right applies (e.g., English, Spanish, French).

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: platform

attributes.name: residual_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether usage under this right triggers residual payments to the talent (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: residual_rate_type
attributes.description: Type of residual payment structure for this usage right (e.g., flat fee, percentage of revenue, per-use rate, tiered schedule, or none).

attributes.name: right_type
attributes.description: Type of usage right granted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|streaming|vod|svod|avod|tvod|fast|home_video|theatrical|promotional|social_media|out_of_home — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: territory
attributes.description: Geographic territory where the usage right is valid (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, worldwide).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this usage right record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: usage_limit_type
attributes.description: Type of usage limitation applied to this right (e.g., unlimited, limited by number of runs, time duration, impressions, or revenue cap).

attributes.name: usage_limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the usage limit value (e.g., runs, days, impressions, currency code). Null if unlimited.

attributes.name: usage_limit_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the usage limit (e.g., 10 runs, 365 days, 1000000 impressions, 50000 USD revenue cap). Null if unlimited.

attributes.name: usage_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the usage right covers (e.g., likeness, voice, name, performance, image).

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify and clear this usage right (e.g., contract review, legal clearance, agent confirmation, automated system check).

attributes.name: window_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the usage rights window. Defines when the right expires. Nullable for perpetual rights.

attributes.name: window_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the usage rights window. Defines when the right becomes effective.

products.name: contract_option
products.description: Tracks option periods embedded in talent contracts — including option type (series pickup option, sequel option, spin-off option, overall deal extension), option number in sequence, option exercise window (start and end date), option fee, compensation step-up on exercise, exercise status (unexercised, exercised, lapsed, waived), and exercise notification date. Enables production and business affairs teams to proactively manage option deadlines and avoid inadvertent lapse of valuable talent commitments.

attributes.name: contract_option_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract option record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent talent contract that contains this option clause.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the option automatically renews or rolls over if not explicitly declined by the production company within the option window. True if auto-renewal applies, False if explicit exercise is required.

attributes.name: business_affairs_contact
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business affairs executive or legal representative responsible for managing this option and coordinating exercise decisions.

attributes.name: compensation_step_up_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage increase in base compensation upon exercise of the option, relative to the prior contract period or base rate. Common in multi-season series deals where talent compensation escalates with each renewal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract option record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the option includes an exclusivity provision that restricts the talent from accepting competing work during the option period or upon exercise. True if exclusivity applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exclusivity restrictions, including prohibited activities, competing networks or platforms, genre restrictions, and geographic limitations. Only applicable if exclusivity_clause_flag is True.

attributes.name: exercise_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the option exercise was formally approved by the authorized business affairs or executive authority. May differ from notification date in organizations requiring multi-level approval.

attributes.name: exercise_compensation_amount
attributes.description: The base compensation amount payable to the talent if the option is exercised. Represents the step-up or incremental payment beyond the option fee for the additional work commitment.

attributes.name: exercise_compensation_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the exercise compensation (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: exercise_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the production company formally notified the talent (or their representative) of the decision to exercise the option. Triggers contractual obligations and payment schedules.

attributes.name: exercise_notification_method
attributes.description: The communication channel or mechanism used to deliver the option exercise notification, as required by the contract terms. Important for legal compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: exercise_status
attributes.description: Current state of the option: unexercised (option window open, not yet acted upon), exercised (option formally invoked by production company), lapsed (option window closed without exercise), waived (option voluntarily released by production company), pending approval (exercise submitted awaiting legal or executive approval), or conditionally exercised (exercise subject to specific conditions being met).

attributes.name: guild_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the option exercise was reported to the applicable guild. Required for compliance audit trails when guild_notification_required_flag is True.

attributes.name: guild_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the option exercise must be reported to the talents guild (SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA) for compliance and residual tracking purposes. True if guild notification is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: lapse_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the option lapsed due to non-exercise within the option window. Recorded for audit and contract history purposes.

attributes.name: lapse_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale or explanation for why the option was allowed to lapse without exercise. May include creative decisions, budget constraints, performance issues, or strategic pivots.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special conditions, negotiation history, or operational notes related to the option. Used by business affairs and production teams for internal coordination.

attributes.name: option_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the option terms, scope, and conditions. May include specific deliverables, performance triggers, or creative commitments associated with the option.

attributes.name: option_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary consideration paid to the talent to secure the option right, regardless of whether the option is ultimately exercised. Typically non-refundable and may be applied against future compensation if exercised.

attributes.name: option_fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the option fee (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: option_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this option within the contract (e.g., 1 for first option, 2 for second option). Used to track multi-year or multi-project option sequences.

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: Classification of the option based on its business purpose: series pickup option for additional seasons, sequel option for follow-on films, spin-off option for derivative content, overall deal extension for multi-project agreements, season renewal for episodic content, or project continuation for phased productions.

attributes.name: option_window_end_date
attributes.description: The final date by which the option must be exercised or it will lapse. Critical deadline for business affairs teams to track to avoid inadvertent loss of talent commitments.

attributes.name: option_window_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which the option can be exercised by the production company or network. Marks the beginning of the exercise window.

attributes.name: performance_trigger_description
attributes.description: Description of any performance-based conditions or milestones that must be met before the option can be exercised (e.g., minimum ratings thresholds, box office targets, critical acclaim metrics, audience engagement benchmarks).

attributes.name: performance_trigger_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all performance-based conditions have been satisfied, enabling the option to be exercised. True if triggers are met or not applicable, False if triggers exist but are not yet satisfied.

attributes.name: residual_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether work performed under this option (if exercised) qualifies the talent for residual payments under guild collective bargaining agreements. True if residuals apply, False otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract option record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and compliance.

products.name: availability
products.description: Operational record of a talent's confirmed availability or unavailability for production bookings — capturing availability window start and end dates, availability type (available, hold, first refusal, confirmed booking, personal unavailability, conflicting production), hold level (first hold, second hold, third hold), requesting production, and release date if hold is dropped. Supports production scheduling, casting decisions, and conflict resolution across concurrent productions. Integrates with appearance_schedule and Dalet Galaxy workflow orchestration.

attributes.name: availability_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the talent availability record. Primary key.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Talent availability holds placed for sales opportunities requiring specific talent (celebrity host for advertiser-sponsored special, talent-driven content pitch). Real business process: sales team pit

attributes.name: production_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production requesting or holding this availability. Null if this is a general unavailability not tied to a specific production.

attributes.name: studio_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.studio_facility. Business justification: Availability holds are placed against specific studio resources when booking talent. Studio booking systems check talent availability before confirming studio reservations to prevent double-booking an

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the talent (actor, director, writer, producer, host, correspondent, crew member) whose availability is being tracked.

attributes.name: availability_type
attributes.description: Classification of the availability status: available (talent is free), hold (production has placed a hold), first_refusal (talent has granted first right to book), confirmed_booking (talent is booked), personal_unavailability (talent is unavailable for personal reasons), conflicting_production (talent is committed to another production).

attributes.name: booking_confirmed_date
attributes.description: The date when the booking was confirmed and the talent was officially committed to the production. Null if not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the availability record: tentative (hold placed but not confirmed), confirmed (booking finalized), cancelled (booking or hold cancelled), released (hold dropped by production), expired (hold expired without confirmation).

attributes.name: conflict_production_network
attributes.description: Network or studio associated with the conflicting production. Used to identify potential exclusivity clause violations.

attributes.name: conflict_production_title
attributes.description: Title of the conflicting production when availability_type is conflicting_production. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this availability record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this availability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the availability or unavailability window. Represents the last day the talent is available or unavailable. Null for open-ended availability.

attributes.name: exclusivity_conflict_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this availability record represents a conflict with an existing exclusivity clause in the talents contract. True if conflict exists, False otherwise.

attributes.name: guild_notification_date
attributes.description: The date when the guild was notified of this booking. Null if notification not yet sent or not required.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: guild_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether guild notification is required for this booking per collective bargaining agreement rules (SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA). True if notification required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: hold_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date by which the production must confirm the booking or the hold will expire. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: hold_level
attributes.description: Priority level of the hold when availability_type is hold or first_refusal. First hold has highest priority, second and third holds are backup options. Null if not a hold.

attributes.name: hold_placed_date
attributes.description: The date when the hold was initially placed on the talent. Null if availability_type is not hold or first_refusal.

attributes.name: hold_released_date
attributes.description: The date when the hold was released or dropped by the requesting production. Null if hold was not released.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, or instructions related to this availability record.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this availability request. High priority requests receive preferential treatment in conflict resolution.

attributes.name: requesting_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the production contact who placed the availability request.

attributes.name: requesting_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the production contact who placed the availability request.

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: The department or business unit that requested the availability hold or booking (e.g., Drama Production, News, Sports, Documentary Unit).

attributes.name: requesting_producer_name
attributes.description: Name of the producer or production manager who requested the availability hold or booking.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the availability or unavailability window. Represents the first day the talent is available or unavailable.

attributes.name: unavailability_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the talent is unavailable during this period (e.g., personal commitment, vacation, medical leave, prior contractual obligation).

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last updated this availability record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this availability record was last modified in the system.

products.name: partner_relationship
products.description: This association product represents the ongoing business relationship between talent and external partners (studios, networks, streamers, syndicators). It captures deal history, exclusivity arrangements, preferred status, and conflict tracking that exist only in the context of this specific talent-partner pairing. Each record links one talent to one partner with relationship-specific metadata used for deal sourcing, conflict management, and strategic talent roster management.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting, talent (actors, directors, writers, producers) routinely maintain simultaneous business relationships with multiple partners (studios, networks, streamers, syndicators) across their careers. Partners likewise maintain rosters of talent relationships spanning dozens to hundreds of individuals. The business actively manages these relationships as distinct entities with relationship-specific metadata including exclusivity windows, deal history, preferred status, and conflict tracking that cannot be attributed to either the talent or partner alone.

attributes.name: partner_relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this talent-partner relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Talent Partner Relationship - Partner Partner Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the partner entity in the partner master

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Talent Partner Relationship - Talent Profile Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the talent profile in the talent master

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are known conflicts of interest between this talent and partner that require disclosure or management (e.g., competing projects, contractual restrictions).

attributes.name: deal_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual deals or projects executed between this talent and partner under this relationship. Used for relationship strength assessment.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this talent-partner relationship ended or is scheduled to end. Null for ongoing relationships.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this talent-partner relationship became active. Used for exclusivity window tracking and deal history analysis.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship includes exclusivity provisions that restrict the talent from working with competing partners during the relationship period.

attributes.name: preferred_partner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner has preferred status for this talent, meaning the talent or their representation prioritizes opportunities from this partner.

attributes.name: relationship_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this talent-partner relationship record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the talent-partner relationship. Active indicates ongoing business engagement.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the business relationship type between talent and partner. Determines exclusivity scope and deal structure.

attributes.name: relationship_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this talent-partner relationship record was last modified.

attributes.name: total_deal_value
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of all deals executed between this talent and partner. Used for strategic tier assessment and relationship ROI analysis.

products.name: endorsement_deal
products.description: This association product represents the commercial contract between talent_profile and sales_account for endorsement, licensing, or brand ambassador arrangements. It captures the business terms, territorial scope, exclusivity constraints, and financial arrangements that exist only in the context of this specific talent-advertiser relationship. Each record links one talent to one sales account (advertiser/brand) with deal-specific attributes that belong to neither the talent profile nor the sales account alone.. Existence Justification: In the media broadcasting industry, talent can simultaneously hold endorsement deals with multiple non-competing advertisers (e.g., a celebrity endorses a car brand, a beverage brand, and a fashion brand at the same time), and each advertiser/sales account contracts with multiple talent for their campaigns. The business actively manages these endorsement deals as distinct commercial contracts with deal-specific terms including compensation, exclusivity scope, territorial rights, usage permissions, and performance deliverables that belong to neither the talent profile nor the sales account alone.

attributes.name: endorsement_deal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this endorsement deal record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or user who created this deal record. Used for sales attribution and commission tracking.

attributes.name: sales_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales account (advertiser/brand) who is party to this endorsement deal

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the talent who is party to this endorsement deal

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission percentage paid to the talent's agent or representation agency for this specific deal. This is deal-specific and may vary from the standard agency rate.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the endorsement contract. Defines when the talent's endorsement obligations and usage rights terminate.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the endorsement contract. Defines when the talent's endorsement obligations and usage rights begin.

attributes.name: deal_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endorsement deal record was first created in the system. Used for audit and deal pipeline tracking.

attributes.name: deal_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the deal value is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deal_last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endorsement deal record was last updated. Used for audit and change tracking.

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the endorsement deal. Tracks the deal from negotiation through active performance to completion or termination.

attributes.name: deal_value_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the endorsement deal. This is the contracted compensation amount for the talent's endorsement services, which varies by talent-advertiser combination and belongs to the deal itself.

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the exclusivity period. After this date, the talent may be free to endorse competitors even if the contract is still active.

attributes.name: exclusivity_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of any exclusivity period during which the talent cannot endorse competing brands in the same category. May differ from contract start date.

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Defines the product category or competitive scope of the exclusivity clause (e.g., 'automotive', 'luxury watches', 'soft drinks'). Determines which competing brands the talent cannot endorse during the exclusivity period.

attributes.name: morals_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal includes a morals clause allowing the advertiser to terminate if the talent engages in conduct that damages their brand reputation.

attributes.name: payment_schedule
attributes.description: The agreed payment schedule for the deal value (e.g., 'Lump Sum on Signing', 'Quarterly Installments', '50% upfront, 50% on completion'). Defines how the deal value is disbursed over time.

attributes.name: performance_deliverables
attributes.description: Description of the specific deliverables the talent must provide (e.g., '2 TV commercials, 4 social media posts per month, 1 live event appearance'). Defines the scope of work for this deal.

attributes.name: renewal_deadline_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the advertiser must exercise their renewal option, if applicable. After this date, the talent is free to negotiate with other advertisers.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the advertiser has an option to renew the endorsement deal under predefined terms. Used for pipeline forecasting and talent availability planning.

attributes.name: usage_media_types
attributes.description: The media channels where the advertiser is permitted to use the talent's endorsement (e.g., 'TV, Digital, Print', 'Social Media Only', 'All Media'). Defines the scope of usage rights.

attributes.name: usage_territory
attributes.description: The geographic territory or market where the advertiser has rights to use the talent's likeness and endorsement (e.g., 'North America', 'Global', 'EU + UK'). This is deal-specific and varies by advertiser.

products.name: facility_access
products.description: This association product represents the access authorization relationship between talent and broadcast facilities. It captures security clearance, physical access permissions, and compliance tracking for talent working at or visiting specific facilities. Each record links one talent profile to one broadcast facility with attributes that govern access rights, badge issuance, and security compliance requirements specific to that talent-facility combination.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, talent routinely work across multiple facilities (studios, remote locations, network operations centers) throughout their careers and even within single production cycles. Each facility hosts hundreds of different talent over time. Facility management and security teams actively manage access authorizations as a distinct operational process, tracking clearance status, badge issuance, access levels, and expiration dates specific to each talent-facility pairing to ensure security compliance, insurance verification, and union requirements are met.

attributes.name: access_purpose
attributes.description: Business reason for granting facility access to this talent (e.g., production work, rehearsal, meeting, interview, tour). Used for compliance and security auditing.

attributes.name: access_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this facility access authorization. Determines whether the access is currently valid and usable. Values: active, inactive, suspended, revoked.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when this facility access authorization was granted.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent background check was completed for this talent at this facility. Required for certain facility types with high security classification.

attributes.name: badge_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the access badge was issued to the talent for this facility.

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Unique physical or digital badge identifier issued to the talent for access to this specific facility. Used by access control systems to grant entry and track movement within the facility.

attributes.name: clearance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the security clearance for this talent at this facility expires and requires renewal. Critical for maintaining continuous access authorization and compliance with security policies.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current security clearance status for this talent at this specific facility. Determines whether the talent is authorized to access the facility. Values: active, pending, expired, revoked, suspended.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility access authorization record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: escort_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the talent must be accompanied by an authorized escort when accessing this facility. Used for visitors, contractors, or talent with limited clearance levels.

attributes.name: insurance_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether production insurance coverage has been verified for this talent at this facility. Required before granting access for production work.

attributes.name: last_access_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent physical access event when the talent entered this facility. Used for security auditing, compliance tracking, and identifying inactive access authorizations.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility access authorization record was most recently modified.

domains.name: sales

Owns accounts, opportunities, proposals, rate cards, upfront commitments, agency relationships, scatter market inventory, commission structures, and executed sales contracts. Powered by Salesforce Media Cloud, this domain tracks deal stages and feeds confirmed orders to advertising trafficking and billing.

attributes.name: equal_time_obligation_flag

attributes.name: lowest_unit_rate_applied

attributes.name: market_code

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: rate_class

attributes.name: reasonable_access_flag

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_email

attributes.name: total_spots_contracted

products.name: upfront_commitment
products.description: A binding advance advertising sales commitment made during the annual upfront market, representing a guaranteed spend level from an advertiser or agency across a broadcast season. Captures upfront year, advertiser account, agency, total committed spend, committed GRP or impression volume, platform allocation (linear, digital, streaming), cancellation option windows (typically 50% cancellable at defined dates), option exercise history (exercise date, exercised amount, cancelled amount per window, cancellation reason), resulting adjusted commitment after each option date, and fulfillment tracking against actual delivered orders. The SSOT for upfront deal obligations feeding scatter market inventory availability calculations — cancelled options release inventory to the scatter pool.
products.reference: Upfront Market Commitment — Media Broadcasting Industry Standard

products.name: scatter_order
products.description: A short-term advertising inventory purchase made in the scatter market outside of upfront commitments, typically placed weeks or days before air date. Captures order date, advertiser, agency, campaign flight dates, inventory type, platform, daypart, requested impressions or GRPs, negotiated CPM, total order value, priority level, preemption risk flag, and fulfillment status. Scatter orders are priced at prevailing market rates (typically at a premium to upfront) and are subject to preemption by higher-rated inventory. Feeds Wide Orbit traffic scheduling.

products.name: ad_sales_order

attributes.name: source_system
