products.name: rep
products.description: The sales representative or account executive profile within the sales domain, capturing the commercial assignment and quota context for each seller. Tracks rep name, employee ID (FK to HR/workforce), territory assignment, account portfolio, deal type specialization (national TV, digital, syndication, licensing), annual quota, quota period, commission plan type, manager, and active status. This is the sales-domain view of the seller — not a duplicate of HR employee master — focused on commercial assignment, quota, and territory rather than HR attributes.
products.reference: Salesforce Media Cloud — User / Sales Rep

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rep

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee master record in the HR/workforce domain. Links the sales rep to their core employee profile.

attributes.name: manager_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the sales manager or team lead who supervises this sales representative. Self-referential relationship within the sales rep hierarchy.

attributes.name: sales_team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_team. Business justification: rep product has sales_team_name (STRING) but no FK to sales_team. This is denormalized - the team name should be retrieved via JOIN to sales_team. Adding sales_team_id FK allows normalization. Standar

attributes.name: account_portfolio_segment
attributes.description: Classification of the account portfolio managed by the sales representative. Indicates whether they manage agency relationships, direct advertiser accounts, distribution partners (MVPD/vMVPD), OTT platforms, syndication buyers, or other client segments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agency|direct_advertiser|mvpd|vmvpd|ott_platform|syndicator|international|government — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: annual_quota_amount
attributes.description: Total annual revenue quota assigned to the sales representative for the current quota period. Measured in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date the sales representative's current territory or account portfolio assignment ended. Null if currently active in the assignment.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date the sales representative began their current territory or account portfolio assignment. May differ from hire date if reassigned.

attributes.name: commission_plan_type
attributes.description: Type of commission structure applied to the sales representative. Defines how commissions are calculated based on sales performance (e.g., base salary plus commission, commission-only, tiered rates, accelerators for exceeding quota).

attributes.name: commission_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Standard commission rate percentage applied to qualified sales revenue. May vary by deal type or quota attainment tier.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sales representative record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deal_type_specialization
attributes.description: Primary deal type or sales channel specialization for the representative. Indicates whether they focus on national TV advertising, digital campaigns, content licensing, syndication deals, or other revenue streams. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national_tv|local_tv|digital|syndication|licensing|upfront|scatter|programmatic|sponsorship|multi_platform — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: digital_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sales representative is certified and authorized to sell digital advertising inventory, including OTT, streaming, and programmatic channels.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the sales representative used for client communication and internal correspondence.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the sales representative was hired or onboarded into the sales organization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sales representative record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Primary office location or city where the sales representative is based. May be a physical office or designated home office location.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance classification or tier assigned to the sales representative based on quota attainment and sales metrics. Used for recognition, compensation adjustments, and coaching.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the sales representative used for client outreach and deal negotiations.

attributes.name: quota_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the quota amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: quota_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current quota period for the sales representative.

attributes.name: quota_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current quota period for the sales representative. Typically aligns with fiscal year or calendar year.

attributes.name: rep_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the sales representative as it appears in business records and communications.

attributes.name: rep_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the sales representative within the sales organization. Indicates whether they are actively selling, on leave, or no longer with the company.

attributes.name: salesforce_user_reference
attributes.description: Unique user identifier in Salesforce Media Cloud CRM system. Links the sales rep record to their Salesforce user profile for opportunity tracking and pipeline management.

attributes.name: territory_assignment
attributes.description: Geographic or market territory assigned to the sales representative. May be defined by region, DMA (Designated Market Area), or account segment.

attributes.name: upfront_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sales representative is certified and authorized to negotiate and close upfront advertising deals. Upfront deals are advance commitments made during the annual upfront sales event.

products.name: sales_territory
products.description: Defines the geographic, account-based, or vertical market territory assigned to sales teams and individual reps. Captures territory name, territory type (geographic region, account segment, vertical — automotive, pharma, retail, entertainment), assigned sales rep or team, revenue target, account count, and effective date range. Supports territory management, quota allocation, and pipeline reporting by market segment. Managed within Salesforce Media Cloud territory management module.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales territory. Primary key.

attributes.name: assigned_sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary sales representative or account executive assigned to this territory.

attributes.name: assigned_sales_team_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales team collectively responsible for this territory, if team-based assignment is used.

attributes.name: parent_territory_sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent territory in a hierarchical territory structure. Null for top-level territories.

attributes.name: primary_sales_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales manager or director responsible for overseeing this territory and its assigned reps.

attributes.name: account_count
attributes.description: Number of active advertiser or agency accounts assigned to this territory.

attributes.name: account_segment
attributes.description: Classification of accounts within this territory by size or relationship type: enterprise (largest accounts), major (key accounts), mid_market, small_business, agency (advertising agencies), or direct (direct advertisers).

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage rate applied to sales within this territory for compensation calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this territory record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dma_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Nielsen DMA codes or names included in this territory for broadcast market segmentation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this territory definition expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended territories.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this territory definition becomes active and assignments take effect.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic area covered by this territory (e.g., states, DMAs, postal codes, countries). Free-form field for complex geographic definitions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this territory record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about this territory, including special instructions, historical context, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Strategic priority assigned to this territory for resource allocation and management focus: high, medium, low, or strategic (top-tier focus).

attributes.name: product_line_focus
attributes.description: Primary advertising product lines or inventory types this territory is authorized to sell (e.g., Linear TV, Digital Video, OTT/Streaming, Radio, Display, Sponsorships). Comma-separated for multiple product lines.

attributes.name: revenue_target_amount
attributes.description: Annual or period revenue quota assigned to this territory, used for quota allocation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: revenue_target_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the revenue target amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel or go-to-market approach for this territory: direct (direct sales team), agency (sold through agencies), programmatic (automated buying), self_service (online self-serve), or partner (channel partners).

attributes.name: scatter_market_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory handles scatter market (last-minute, short-term) ad inventory sales. True if scatter sales are part of territory scope.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the territory for reporting and system integration (e.g., NE-01, AUTO-WEST, MAJ-CA).

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the territory scope, coverage rules, special conditions, and strategic objectives.

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Business name of the sales territory (e.g., Northeast Region, Automotive Vertical, Major Accounts West).

attributes.name: territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory: active (in use), inactive (not currently assigned), pending (awaiting activation), suspended (temporarily disabled), or archived (historical record).

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the territory structure: geographic (region-based), account_segment (by account size or tier), vertical (industry-based such as automotive, pharma, retail, entertainment), hybrid (combination), national (entire country), or regional (multi-state or multi-market).

attributes.name: upfront_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory participates in annual upfront advertising sales events. True if territory is included in upfront planning and commitments.

attributes.name: vertical_industry_focus
attributes.description: Primary industry vertical or sector this territory specializes in (e.g., Automotive, Pharmaceutical, Retail, Entertainment, Financial Services, Technology). Used for vertical-based territory models.

products.name: rfp
products.description: A Request for Proposal received from an advertiser, agency, or content buyer soliciting inventory availability, pricing, and audience delivery options for an upcoming campaign or content acquisition. Captures RFP source (agency, direct, programmatic platform), submission date, response due date, campaign objectives, target audience demographics (age, gender, HHI, geography), budget range, platform preferences (linear, CTV, digital, cross-platform), daypart requirements, content adjacency restrictions, competitive separation requirements, desired flight dates, and RFP status (received, in-review, responded, awarded, lost). The upstream trigger for proposal creation and opportunity qualification in the sales pipeline. Response quality and turnaround time are key competitive differentiators in winning agency business.
products.reference: RFP — IAB / Salesforce Media Cloud Campaign Brief

attributes.name: rfp_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the request for proposal record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or brand issuing the RFP. Links to the advertiser master entity.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: RFPs feed the opportunity pipeline. When an RFP is qualified, it becomes an opportunity. This FK enables tracing opportunities back to their originating RFPs. N:1 relationship (one RFP can lead to one

attributes.name: sales_agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising agency representing the advertiser and submitting the RFP on their behalf. Nullable if direct advertiser submission.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account executive responsible for managing this RFP and preparing the response proposal.

attributes.name: award_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the advertiser or agency communicated their final decision on the RFP (awarded or lost). Nullable until decision is made.

attributes.name: awarded_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of the campaign if the RFP was awarded to the broadcaster. Nullable if RFP was lost or still pending. Used for revenue forecasting and sales performance tracking.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures consistent financial reporting across international campaigns.

attributes.name: budget_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum budget amount the advertiser is willing to commit for the campaign. Defines the upper bound for proposal pricing.

attributes.name: budget_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum budget amount the advertiser is willing to commit for the campaign. Used for opportunity qualification and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: campaign_objective
attributes.description: High-level business goal or marketing objective the advertiser seeks to achieve through this campaign (e.g., brand awareness, product launch, direct response, seasonal promotion).

attributes.name: competitive_separation_requirements
attributes.description: Rules for separating this advertiser's spots from competing brands within the same ad pod or program. Typically specifies minimum time separation or exclusivity within a break.

attributes.name: content_adjacency_restrictions
attributes.description: Advertiser-specified restrictions on content types or genres where ads should not appear (e.g., no violent content, no political programming, no competitive sports). Used for brand safety and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFP record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: daypart_requirements
attributes.description: Specific broadcast daypart preferences or requirements (e.g., Prime Time, Early Morning, Late Night, Weekend). Dayparts are time segments of the broadcast day used for scheduling and pricing.

attributes.name: desired_frequency
attributes.description: Target average number of times each unique viewer should be exposed to the advertisement during the campaign. Frequency is a key metric for message reinforcement.

attributes.name: desired_grp_target
attributes.description: Target Gross Rating Points the advertiser seeks to achieve. GRP is a standard audience measurement metric representing the sum of all rating points delivered by a campaign.

attributes.name: desired_impressions
attributes.description: Total number of ad impressions the advertiser seeks to purchase. An impression represents a single ad view by a viewer.

attributes.name: desired_reach_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of unique audience members the advertiser wants to reach at least once during the campaign. Reach is a key audience delivery metric.

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: Desired end date for the advertising campaign flight. Defines the conclusion of the campaign delivery window.

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: Desired start date for the advertising campaign flight. Defines the beginning of the campaign delivery window.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFP record was last updated. Tracks changes throughout the RFP review and response process.

attributes.name: loss_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or categorization of why the RFP was lost if not awarded. Used for competitive analysis and sales process improvement. Nullable if RFP was awarded or still pending.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional context, special requirements, internal comments, or follow-up actions related to the RFP. Used for collaboration and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: platform_preference
attributes.description: Advertiser's preferred distribution platforms for the campaign. May include linear television, Connected TV (CTV), digital video, streaming (OTT), or cross-platform packages. Multiple platforms may be specified.

attributes.name: pricing_model_preference
attributes.description: Advertiser's preferred pricing structure for the campaign. Options include Cost Per Mille (CPM), Cost Per Rating Point (CPRP), flat rate, performance-based, or hybrid models.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Internal priority classification assigned to the RFP based on strategic value, budget size, client relationship, or competitive factors. Used for resource allocation and response sequencing.

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the broadcaster must submit a response proposal to the RFP. Critical for sales team prioritization and workflow management.

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the broadcaster submitted their proposal response to the RFP. Nullable until response is completed. Used to track response turnaround time.

attributes.name: rfp_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the RFP, typically assigned by the source system or agency. Used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: rfp_source
attributes.description: Origin channel through which the RFP was received. Distinguishes between agency-mediated, direct advertiser, programmatic platform, upfront market, scatter market, or network referral submissions.

attributes.name: rfp_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RFP in the sales pipeline. Tracks progression from receipt through final disposition.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud - Sales Stage Management

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the RFP was received or submitted by the advertiser, agency, or content buyer. Principal business event timestamp for the RFP lifecycle.

attributes.name: target_age_range
attributes.description: Specific age demographic range requested by the advertiser (e.g., 18-34, 25-54, 35-49). Used for audience targeting and rate card selection.

attributes.name: target_audience_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the desired audience demographics and psychographics, including age range, gender, household income (HHI), geography, interests, and behavioral attributes.

attributes.name: target_gender
attributes.description: Gender demographic targeting requirement specified in the RFP. May be male, female, all genders, or unspecified.

attributes.name: target_geography
attributes.description: Geographic targeting requirements, including designated market areas (DMAs), regions, states, or national coverage. May include multiple geographies separated by delimiters.

products.name: avail
products.description: An inventory availability record representing a specific advertising slot, sponsorship position, or content window that is available for sale at a given point in time. Captures channel or platform, program or content title, daypart, air date or window, unit type (spot, sponsorship, integration, digital pre-roll), spot length, available impressions or GRPs, audience demographic projection, floor CPM, hold status (available, first hold, second hold, released, sold), holding account reference, hold expiry date, and source system (Wide Orbit, programmatic SSP). Avails are the sellable inventory units that sales reps present to buyers and that proposals are built from. Sourced from Wide Orbit inventory management and EPG scheduling. Updated in near-real-time as holds are placed and orders confirmed.
products.reference: Avails — Wide Orbit Inventory / TVB Avail Standard

attributes.name: avail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advertising inventory availability record.

attributes.name: ad_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the confirmed ad order line that has purchased this inventory, if sold.

attributes.name: ad_pod_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.ad_pod. Business justification: Avails represent inventory availability within ad pods. This FK links the available inventory slot to its containing ad pod for proper inventory management and scheduling. Nullable because some avails

attributes.name: avail_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this availability record.

attributes.name: avail_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this availability record.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Advertising avails are facility-specific inventory units for local/regional sales. Facility identification enables inventory management, geographic targeting, and transmission capacity planning. Criti

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Available inventory slots are station-specific and must reference the broadcast license for regulatory tracking, compliance verification, and ensuring sold inventory matches licensed station capabilit

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel or platform where this inventory is available.

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate card that defines pricing for this inventory type and daypart.

attributes.name: sales_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or agency account that currently holds this inventory.

attributes.name: sales_proposal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales proposal that includes this availability, if applicable.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative responsible for selling this inventory.

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.schedule_slot. Business justification: When an avail is sold and confirmed, it maps to a specific schedule slot for playout. Business process: order fulfillment, traffic-to-playout handoff, as-run reconciliation, affidavit generation.

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program or content title during which this advertising slot is available.

attributes.name: ad_pod_position
attributes.description: Position of this spot within the ad pod or commercial break (1 for first position, 2 for second, etc.).

attributes.name: air_date
attributes.description: Scheduled broadcast date when this advertising slot will air.

attributes.name: air_time
attributes.description: Precise scheduled broadcast timestamp when this advertising slot will air.

attributes.name: avail_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for this availability record, typically generated by the traffic system.

attributes.name: break_type
attributes.description: Type of commercial break where this inventory is positioned (opening, mid-break, closing, standalone).

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Parental guidance rating of the program content surrounding this advertising slot (TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-G, TV-PG, TV-14, TV-MA).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this availability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time segment of the broadcast day when this inventory is available (early morning, morning, daytime, early fringe, prime access, prime time, late fringe, late night, overnight). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: early_morning|morning|daytime|early_fringe|prime_access|prime_time|late_fringe|late_night|overnight — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: floor_cpm_usd
attributes.description: Minimum Cost Per Thousand Impressions (CPM) rate in USD that the seller will accept for this inventory.

attributes.name: floor_rate_usd
attributes.description: Minimum unit rate in USD that the seller will accept for this advertising slot.

attributes.name: genre
attributes.description: Content genre or category of the program where this advertising slot is available (e.g., News, Sports, Drama, Comedy, Reality).

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Designated Market Area (DMA) or geographic market where this inventory will be broadcast or streamed.

attributes.name: hold_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the current hold on this inventory will expire if not confirmed.

attributes.name: hold_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the current hold was placed on this inventory.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current reservation status of this inventory (available, first hold, second hold, third hold, released, sold, expired). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|first_hold|second_hold|third_hold|released|sold|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Type of advertising unit available for sale (spot, sponsorship, integration, digital pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll, overlay, branded content). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spot|sponsorship|integration|pre_roll|mid_roll|post_roll|overlay|branded_content — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this availability record was last updated.

attributes.name: makegood_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory is eligible for makegood compensation if performance guarantees are not met.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or special instructions related to this availability (e.g., creative restrictions, special positioning requirements).

attributes.name: platform_type
attributes.description: Distribution platform type where this inventory is available (linear, VOD, SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, OTT, FAST, digital). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear|vod|svod|avod|tvod|ott|fast|digital — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preemptible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory can be preempted by higher-priority advertising (true) or is guaranteed (false).

attributes.name: projected_grp
attributes.description: Estimated Gross Rating Points this slot is expected to deliver, representing the percentage of the target audience reached multiplied by frequency.

attributes.name: projected_impressions
attributes.description: Estimated number of viewer impressions this advertising slot is expected to deliver based on historical audience data.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record that generated this availability record (Wide Orbit, Salesforce, programmatic SSP, manual entry).

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Primary audience demographic segment this inventory is projected to reach (e.g., Adults 18-49, Women 25-54, Men 18-34).

attributes.name: unit_length_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the advertising unit in seconds (e.g., 15, 30, 60 for traditional spots).

attributes.name: window_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the availability window for content licensing or sponsorship opportunities.

attributes.name: window_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the availability window for content licensing or sponsorship opportunities.

products.name: upfront_option_exercise
products.description: Records the exercise or cancellation of option windows within an upfront commitment, capturing the advertiser's decision to confirm, reduce, or cancel a portion of their advance commitment at each contractual option date. Captures upfront commitment reference, option window number, option exercise date, original committed spend for the window, exercised amount, cancelled amount, reason for cancellation, and resulting adjusted commitment. Critical for scatter market inventory release calculations — cancelled upfront options free inventory for scatter sales.
products.reference: Upfront Option Exercise — Media Broadcasting Industry Standard

attributes.name: upfront_option_exercise_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the upfront option exercise record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser (brand or company) that holds the upfront commitment and is exercising this option.

attributes.name: primary_upfront_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (typically sales manager or director) who approved this option exercise, if approval was required.

attributes.name: sales_agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising agency representing the advertiser in this upfront commitment and option exercise, if applicable.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative who managed this option exercise transaction and communicated with the advertiser or agency.

attributes.name: tertiary_upfront_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently modified this option exercise record.

attributes.name: upfront_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent upfront commitment contract under which this option exercise occurs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud - Upfront Commitment Object

attributes.name: adjusted_commitment_amount
attributes.description: The resulting total commitment amount for the parent upfront deal after this option exercise is applied. Used to track the cumulative impact of option exercises on the overall upfront commitment.

attributes.name: amendment_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the contract amendment document associated with this option exercise, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this option exercise requires internal management approval before being finalized. True for exercises that deviate from standard terms or involve significant cancellations.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this option exercise was approved by management, if approval was required.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason the advertiser cancelled or reduced this option window commitment.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the cancellation or reduction decision. Captured from sales representative or advertiser communication.

attributes.name: cancelled_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount the advertiser cancelled or declined to commit for this option window. Calculated as original_committed_spend minus exercised_amount.

attributes.name: cancelled_grp_volume
attributes.description: The Gross Rating Point volume cancelled or declined for this option window. Calculated as committed_grp_volume minus exercised_grp_volume.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research - Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: committed_grp_volume
attributes.description: The Gross Rating Point volume originally committed for this option window. GRP is a standard audience measurement metric representing reach multiplied by frequency.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research - Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: contract_amendment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this option exercise triggers a formal contract amendment or addendum to the original upfront agreement. True for material changes that require legal documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this option exercise record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this option exercise record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: daypart_allocation
attributes.description: The broadcast daypart(s) allocated for this option window (e.g., Prime Time, Early Morning, Late Night, Weekend). Daypart is a time segment of the broadcast day used for scheduling and pricing.

attributes.name: digital_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the exercised amount allocated to digital platform inventory (web, mobile app, connected TV).

attributes.name: exercise_method
attributes.description: The communication channel or method through which the advertiser submitted their option exercise decision (e.g., email notification, phone call, self-service portal, in-person meeting, automatic per contract terms).

attributes.name: exercise_status
attributes.description: Current status of this option exercise. Confirmed means the advertiser exercised the full option amount; partially_confirmed means a reduced amount was exercised; cancelled means the option was declined; expired means the deadline passed without action; pending means the option window is open but not yet exercised.

attributes.name: exercised_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount the advertiser confirmed and committed to spend for this option window. May equal original_committed_spend (full exercise) or be less (partial exercise).

attributes.name: exercised_grp_volume
attributes.description: The Gross Rating Point volume the advertiser confirmed for this option window after exercise. May be less than committed_grp_volume if partially exercised.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research - Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: inventory_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which cancelled inventory from this option exercise was released to scatter market availability. Critical for scatter market inventory planning and sales.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit - Traffic and Inventory Management

attributes.name: inventory_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cancelled inventory from this option exercise has been released back to scatter market availability. True means inventory is available for scatter sales; False means it is still held or being reallocated.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit - Traffic and Inventory Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this option exercise record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: linear_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the exercised amount allocated to traditional linear (scheduled) television broadcast inventory.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes and comments about this option exercise, including negotiation details, special terms, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: option_deadline_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline date by which the advertiser must exercise this option window. Failure to exercise by this date may result in automatic cancellation or confirmation per contract terms.

attributes.name: option_exercise_date
attributes.description: The date on which the advertiser exercised (confirmed or cancelled) this option window. This is the business event date when the decision was made.

attributes.name: option_exercise_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this option exercise event, typically formatted as commitment number plus option window sequence.

attributes.name: option_window_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the option window within the upfront commitment (e.g., 1 for first option, 2 for second option, 3 for third option). Upfront deals typically have multiple option dates where advertisers can confirm or cancel portions of their commitment.

attributes.name: original_committed_spend
attributes.description: The original dollar amount committed for this option window at the time the upfront deal was signed. This is the baseline amount subject to the option exercise decision.

attributes.name: streaming_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the exercised amount allocated to Over-The-Top (OTT) streaming platform inventory (SVOD, AVOD, FAST channels).

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: The audience demographic segment this option window commitment was intended to reach (e.g., Adults 18-49, Women 25-54, Men 18-34). Standard Nielsen demographic notation.

products.name: forecast
products.description: Revenue forecast record capturing projected bookings by sales rep, territory, account segment, deal type (upfront, scatter, licensing, syndication, carriage), and time period (quarter, broadcast year). Tracks forecast version, submission date, forecast category (commit, best case, pipeline, omitted), total forecasted revenue, weighted pipeline value, variance to quota, and manager override amount. Enables sales leadership to project revenue attainment against quota, identify pipeline gaps, and allocate resources. Updated weekly during active selling periods and daily during upfront season.

attributes.name: forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the revenue forecast record.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Sales forecasts are segmented by daypart for revenue planning. Business process: daypart-level revenue forecasting, quota allocation, inventory yield optimization by daypart.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales manager who approved this forecast submission.

attributes.name: sales_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the account this forecast is associated with, if forecast is account-specific.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales representative who submitted this forecast.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_territory. Business justification: Forecasts are often segmented by sales territory for territory-level revenue projections and quota tracking. This FK enables territory-based forecasting. N:1 relationship. New attribute needed to esta

attributes.name: account_segment
attributes.description: Segmentation of the account type for this forecast: enterprise (large advertisers), mid-market, small business, agency (media buying agencies), direct (direct-to-advertiser).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast was approved by the sales manager.

attributes.name: attainment_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of quota represented by the total forecasted revenue (forecasted revenue / quota * 100).

attributes.name: best_case_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue amount in the best case forecast category (optimistic scenario including stretch opportunities).

attributes.name: broadcast_year
attributes.description: Broadcast year (September to August cycle) this forecast applies to, represented as the starting calendar year.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Industry Standard - Broadcast Calendar

attributes.name: carriage_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted revenue from carriage fee agreements (distribution payments from cable/satellite providers).
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Industry Standard - Carriage Fee

attributes.name: closed_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue amount from deals already closed and won during this forecast period.

attributes.name: commit_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue amount in the commit forecast category (high confidence deals expected to close).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this forecast.

attributes.name: deal_type
attributes.description: Type of sales deal being forecasted: upfront (advance commitment), scatter (last-minute inventory), licensing (content rights), syndication (content resale), carriage (distribution fee), sponsorship (branded integration).

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter this forecast applies to (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

attributes.name: forecast_category
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast confidence level: commit (high confidence), best case (optimistic), pipeline (possible), omitted (excluded from forecast), closed (already won).
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud - Forecast Category Standard

attributes.name: forecast_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the forecast record, typically including period and rep name.

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the forecast submission.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was last modified.

attributes.name: licensing_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted revenue from content licensing deals (selling rights to broadcast or distribute content).

attributes.name: manager_override_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount adjusted by sales manager override, used when manager believes rep forecast needs correction.

attributes.name: manager_override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by sales manager for any override adjustment to the forecast.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and commentary from the sales representative about assumptions, risks, or opportunities in this forecast.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period this forecast covers.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period this forecast covers.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Time period granularity for this forecast: quarter, broadcast year (Sept-Aug), calendar year, or month.

attributes.name: pipeline_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue amount in the pipeline forecast category (possible deals still in early stages).

attributes.name: quota_amount
attributes.description: Assigned sales quota target for this sales rep and period.

attributes.name: scatter_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted revenue from scatter market deals (last-minute ad inventory sales outside upfront commitments).
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Industry Standard - Scatter Market

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when this forecast version was submitted by the sales representative.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this forecast version was submitted.

attributes.name: syndication_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted revenue from syndication deals (reselling content to multiple outlets).

attributes.name: total_forecasted_revenue
attributes.description: Total projected revenue amount for this forecast period across all deal types and categories.

attributes.name: update_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency of forecast updates for this period: weekly (standard selling periods), daily (upfront season), monthly (long-range planning), ad hoc (as needed).

attributes.name: upfront_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted revenue from upfront deals (advance advertising commitments made during upfront season).

attributes.name: variance_to_quota
attributes.description: Difference between total forecasted revenue and quota amount (positive indicates over-quota forecast, negative indicates gap).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this forecast submission, incremented with each revision for the same period.

attributes.name: weighted_pipeline_value
attributes.description: Total pipeline value adjusted by probability weights for each opportunity, providing a risk-adjusted forecast.

attributes.name: prior_forecast_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on forecast (prior_forecast_id)

products.name: sales_deal_approval
products.description: Workflow record capturing the approval chain and sign-off status for high-value or non-standard commercial deals requiring management, legal, or finance authorization before execution. Tracks deal reference (opportunity or order), approval tier triggered (value threshold, non-standard terms, extended payment, below-floor pricing), approver role, approver identity, approval status (pending, approved, rejected, escalated), approval timestamp, conditions attached, and delegation rules. Critical for deals exceeding rate card floors, extended cancellation options, or custom barter arrangements.

attributes.name: sales_deal_approval_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales deal approval workflow record.

attributes.name: ad_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising sales order requiring approval. Used when the approval is triggered at the order stage rather than opportunity stage.

attributes.name: carriage_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.carriage_deal. Business justification: Carriage deals require approval due to their strategic importance and long-term nature. This FK enables tracking approval workflow for carriage deals. N:1 relationship. New attribute needed for approv

attributes.name: content_license_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.content_license_deal. Business justification: Content license deals require approval due to rights complexity and deal value. This FK enables tracking approval workflow for license deals. N:1 relationship. New attribute needed for approval workfl

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity requiring approval. Links to the opportunity being evaluated for non-standard terms or high-value thresholds.

attributes.name: primary_sales_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user assigned to review and approve this deal. Links to the employee or user record in the system.

attributes.name: quaternary_sales_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the approval workflow record. Typically the sales representative or system automation that initiated the approval request.

attributes.name: quinary_sales_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the approval record. Tracks who made the most recent update for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: sales_proposal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_proposal. Business justification: Proposals may require approval before being sent to clients, especially for non-standard pricing or terms. This FK enables tracking approval workflow for proposals. N:1 relationship. New attribute nee

attributes.name: sales_scatter_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_scatter_order. Business justification: Scatter orders may require approval when they involve non-standard pricing, extended payment terms, or high-value deals. This FK enables tracking approval workflow for scatter orders. N:1 relationship

attributes.name: sales_syndication_deal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the syndication deal requiring approval. Used for content licensing and syndication agreements that exceed standard authority levels.

attributes.name: tertiary_sales_submitted_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales representative or user who submitted the deal for approval. Tracks originator for accountability and commission purposes.

attributes.name: upfront_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.upfront_commitment. Business justification: Upfront commitments typically require approval due to their high value and multi-year nature. This FK enables tracking approval workflow for upfront commitments. N:1 relationship. New attribute needed

attributes.name: approval_conditions
attributes.description: Specific conditions, stipulations, or requirements attached to the approval. May include contingencies such as legal review, credit check, or contract amendments that must be satisfied before execution.

attributes.name: approval_decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approver made their decision (approved, rejected, or escalated). Used to calculate approval cycle time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: approval_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time by which the approval decision must be made. If no decision is rendered by this time, the approval may auto-escalate or expire.

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments and observations recorded by the approver during the review process. Captures context, concerns, or additional instructions.

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the approval workflow instance. Format: APV-YYYYMMDD followed by sequence number for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the approval workflow. Tracks progression from submission through final decision or escalation to higher authority.

attributes.name: approval_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical approval level triggered by deal characteristics. Higher tiers required for larger values, extended terms, or non-standard conditions.

attributes.name: approval_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for why this deal requires management approval. May include multiple reasons such as value threshold exceeded, below-floor pricing, extended payment terms, custom barter arrangement, or non-standard cancellation options.

attributes.name: approver_email
attributes.description: Email address of the approver for notification and communication regarding the approval request.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned to approve this deal. Captured for audit trail and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: Functional role or title of the individual authorized to approve at this tier. Examples: Sales Manager, Finance Director, VP Sales, CFO.

attributes.name: below_floor_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the negotiated rate falls below the established rate card floor, requiring pricing exception approval.

attributes.name: compliance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal requires compliance review for regulatory adherence, political advertising rules, or industry standards compliance.
attributes.references: FCC - broadcast licensing, GDPR - audience data privacy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approval workflow record was first created in the system. Marks the initiation of the approval process.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deal value amount. Ensures proper financial evaluation across multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: custom_barter_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal involves non-cash barter or trade arrangements requiring special approval and valuation review.

attributes.name: deal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial deal requiring approval. Determines which approval tier and rules apply based on deal structure and risk profile. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: upfront|scatter|syndication|sponsorship|barter|digital|streaming|linear — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deal_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the deal requiring approval. Used to determine appropriate approval tier based on value thresholds.

attributes.name: escalated_to_tier
attributes.description: The higher approval tier to which this request has been escalated. Tracks the escalation path through the approval hierarchy.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Justification for escalating the approval to a higher tier. Documents why the current approver is unable or unwilling to make the decision at their level.

attributes.name: extended_payment_terms_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal includes payment terms that exceed standard credit policy, requiring finance approval.

attributes.name: finance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal requires finance department review for credit risk, revenue recognition, or payment terms validation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approval record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, approver assignments, or conditions throughout the workflow lifecycle.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal requires legal department review before final approval. Triggered by contract complexity, liability concerns, or regulatory considerations.

attributes.name: non_standard_cancellation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal includes cancellation options or terms that deviate from standard contract provisions.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the approver when rejecting the deal. Captures business rationale for denial to inform sales team and support future negotiations.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approval decision was made within the target SLA timeframe. Used for performance monitoring and process improvement.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours within which the approval decision should be made. Defines the expected response time for this approval tier.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approval request was submitted into the workflow. Marks the start of the approval cycle for SLA tracking.

attributes.name: value_threshold_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deal value exceeds the sales representative's approval authority limit, triggering escalation to management.

attributes.name: escalated_sales_deal_approval_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sales_deal_approval (escalated_sales_deal_approval_id)

products.name: proposal_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution event between sales_proposal and sales_contact. It captures the operational tracking of which contacts received which proposals, their engagement with the proposal materials, and their responses. Each record links one sales_proposal to one sales_contact with attributes that exist only in the context of this distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting sales operations, a single proposal is routinely distributed to multiple contacts within an advertiser organization and agency (e.g., media buyer, brand manager, legal counsel, CFO for approval), and each contact receives and responds to multiple proposals over time. The business actively manages proposal distribution as an operational process with engagement tracking (who opened it, when, what feedback they provided) to prioritize follow-ups and refine proposals. This is not an analytical correlation but a core sales workflow that humans create, update, and query.

attributes.name: proposal_distribution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this proposal distribution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contact_sales_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales contact who received the proposal.

attributes.name: primary_proposal_sales_proposal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales proposal that was distributed to the contact.

attributes.name: sales_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the sales contact who received the proposal.

attributes.name: feedback_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing the contacts specific feedback, questions, objections, or comments about the proposal. Used for proposal refinement and competitive intelligence.

attributes.name: opened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has opened or viewed the proposal materials. Tracked via email tracking pixels or document management system access logs.

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the first time this contact opened or accessed the proposal. Null if never opened. Used for engagement scoring and follow-up prioritization.

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Role of the contact in receiving this proposal: primary recipient, carbon copy, blind carbon copy, internal reviewer, or approver. Determines routing and notification behavior.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact provided formal feedback or response to the proposal. Null if no response received. Used for conversion tracking and sales cycle analysis.

attributes.name: response_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contacts response to the proposal: accepted, rejected, revision requested, questions raised, or no response. Drives workflow routing and follow-up actions.

attributes.name: sent_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proposal was sent or distributed to this specific contact. Used for tracking response time and follow-up scheduling.

products.name: facility_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual service agreement between a sales account and a broadcast facility. It captures the commercial terms under which a sales account (advertising agency, direct advertiser, content licensee, or distribution partner) contracts for services at a specific broadcast facility (studio, transmission site, uplink center, or NOC). Each record links one sales account to one broadcast facility with attributes that define the service type, capacity allocation, pricing, and contract lifecycle dates that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, large sales accounts (networks, station groups, advertising agencies, content licensees) routinely contract for services across multiple broadcast facilities simultaneously—a major advertiser may need studio access at multiple production facilities, transmission services at regional sites, and uplink capacity at satellite centers. Conversely, each broadcast facility serves multiple sales accounts concurrently, with different service types, capacity allocations, and commercial terms per account. The business actively manages these facility service agreements as distinct commercial contracts with lifecycle tracking, capacity management, and account-specific pricing.

attributes.name: facility_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the facility service agreement record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Service Agreement - Broadcast Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the broadcast facility where services are being provided. Identifies the physical infrastructure location (studio, transmission site, uplink center, or NOC) covered by the service agreement.

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account executive responsible for managing this facility service agreement. This is the person who negotiated the contract and handles renewals, amendments, and account relationship for this specific facility service.

attributes.name: sales_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Service Agreement - Sales Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales account that has contracted for facility services. Identifies the commercial entity (agency, advertiser, licensee, or partner) in the service agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the facility service agreement. Draft indicates negotiation in progress, active indicates services are being provided, suspended indicates temporary hold, expired indicates contract period ended, terminated indicates early cancellation, renewed indicates contract was extended.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which the sales account is invoiced for facility services under this agreement. Defines whether billing occurs monthly (most common for ongoing services), quarterly (for larger contracts), annually (for full facility leases), per-use (for ad-hoc studio rentals), or at milestones (for project-based services).

attributes.name: contracted_capacity
attributes.description: The amount or extent of facility capacity allocated to this sales account under the agreement. Format varies by service type: hours per month for studio rental, bandwidth allocation for transmission, rack units for colocation, percentage of facility for full lease. This defines the resource commitment.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility service agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and contract lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this facility service agreement expires or is terminated. After this date, the sales account no longer has contracted access to the facility services unless the agreement is renewed. Null indicates an open-ended or evergreen agreement.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this facility service agreement becomes active and the sales account gains access to the contracted facility services. Marks the beginning of the contract period and the start of billing.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility service agreement record was last updated. Tracks changes to contract terms, capacity allocations, or status changes.

attributes.name: rate_card_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the pricing rate card or pricing schedule that governs billing for this service agreement. Links to the commercial pricing structure negotiated for this account-facility combination, which may differ from standard rates based on volume commitments or strategic relationship.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service being provided under this agreement. Defines what type of facility access or service the sales account has contracted for (e.g., studio rental for production, transmission services for broadcast distribution, uplink services for satellite feeds, colocation for equipment hosting, managed services for technical operations, or full facility lease).

products.name: campaign_funding
products.description: This association product represents the funding relationship between sales opportunities and advertising campaigns in media broadcasting. It captures how opportunity pipeline deals are allocated to fund specific campaigns, tracking the portion of each opportunity's budget committed to each campaign. Each record links one opportunity to one campaign with allocation amounts, percentages, flight dates, and funding status that exist only in the context of this relationship. Critical for revenue recognition, upfront commitment tracking, and reconciling sales pipeline to campaign delivery.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting sales operations, large advertisers frequently split a single campaign across multiple sales opportunities representing different budget sources, quarters, or sales representatives. Conversely, umbrella deals and portfolio buys result in a single opportunity funding portions of multiple campaigns. Sales teams actively manage these funding allocations during upfront negotiations, tracking allocation amounts, percentages, and flight date ranges for each opportunity-campaign pairing.

attributes.name: campaign_funding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this campaign funding allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the advertising campaign being funded by this opportunity allocation

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sales opportunity providing funding for this campaign

attributes.name: allocation_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount from this opportunity allocated to fund this specific campaign. Sum of all allocation_amounts for an opportunity should not exceed the opportunity's estimated_value.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the opportunity's total estimated value allocated to this campaign. Used for portfolio buys and umbrella deals where a single opportunity funds multiple campaigns.

attributes.name: campaign_funding_status
attributes.description: Current status of this funding allocation. Proposed = opportunity not yet closed, Committed = opportunity closed-won and funding committed, Active = campaign is running with this funding, Completed = flight dates passed, Cancelled = allocation removed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocation_amount. Typically matches both the opportunity and campaign currency codes.

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: The end date for this specific opportunity-campaign allocation. May differ from the campaign's overall end date if the opportunity only funds a portion of the campaign's flight window.

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: The start date for this specific opportunity-campaign allocation. May differ from the campaign's overall start date if the opportunity only funds a portion of the campaign's flight window.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding allocation record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context about this funding allocation, such as special terms, budget source details, or reconciliation notes.

products.name: brand
products.description: Master reference table for brand. Referenced by brand_id.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Primary key for brand

attributes.name: parent_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent brand in a brand hierarchy. Used for sub-brands, regional variants, or digital extensions of a master brand. Null for top-level brands.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used as a unique business identifier for the brand in sales systems, rate cards, and trafficking systems. Typically 3-10 uppercase characters.

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the brand, its positioning, audience, and content offering. Used in sales proposals, syndication packages, and agency presentations.

attributes.name: brand_logo_url
attributes.description: URL to the official brand logo asset. Used in sales proposals, rate cards, and advertising creative materials.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The official name of the brand as recognized in the market and used in advertising sales, content licensing, and syndication deals.

attributes.name: brand_owner
attributes.description: The legal entity or corporate parent that owns the brand. Used for rights management, licensing, and syndication agreements.

attributes.name: brand_tagline
attributes.description: The official marketing tagline or slogan associated with the brand. Used in advertising creative and promotional materials.

attributes.name: brand_tier
attributes.description: The commercial tier or positioning of the brand in the sales hierarchy. Premium brands command higher CPM rates; value brands offer lower-cost inventory.

attributes.name: brand_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brand by its primary distribution or business model: network (broadcast network), station (local affiliate), digital_platform (online property), streaming_service (SVOD/AVOD), syndication (content distributor), or studio (production house).

attributes.name: brand_website_url
attributes.description: The primary website URL for the brand. Used for digital advertising integration, content syndication links, and agency reference.

attributes.name: call_sign
attributes.description: The FCC-assigned call sign for broadcast stations (e.g., WABC-TV, KNBC). Null for non-broadcast brands.

attributes.name: content_genre
attributes.description: The primary content genre or programming category associated with the brand. Used for content licensing, syndication categorization, and advertiser alignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this brand record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The primary distribution channel through which the brand delivers content to audiences.

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: The Nielsen Designated Market Area code representing the geographic television market. Used for local advertising sales and market-specific rate cards.

attributes.name: is_ad_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand carries advertising inventory. True for ad-supported brands (AVOD, linear TV); false for subscription-only or ad-free brands (SVOD).

attributes.name: is_subscription_based
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand operates on a subscription revenue model (SVOD, cable subscription). Used to distinguish revenue streams in sales reporting.

attributes.name: is_syndication_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is eligible for content syndication deals. True if the brand can license content to third-party distributors; false otherwise.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date the brand was officially launched or made available for commercial sales and distribution.

attributes.name: nielsen_station_code
attributes.description: The unique station or network code assigned by Nielsen for audience measurement and ratings reporting. Critical for upfront commitments and post-campaign analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the brand. Used by sales teams for context and deal-specific information.

attributes.name: primary_market
attributes.description: The primary geographic market or country where the brand operates, represented as a 3-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).

attributes.name: programmatic_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand supports programmatic advertising sales through automated buying platforms and real-time bidding (RTB).

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date the brand was retired or discontinued from active sales and distribution. Null for active brands.

attributes.name: sales_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for sales inquiries and agency outreach for this brand. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: sales_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for sales inquiries and agency outreach for this brand. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: The unique Salesforce Account ID linking this brand to the Salesforce Media Cloud CRM system. Used for opportunity tracking, pipeline management, and sales contract association.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the brand. Active brands are available for sales and trafficking; inactive brands are no longer sold; pending brands are in setup; retired brands are archived; suspended brands are temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: The primary demographic or psychographic audience segment the brand targets (e.g., Adults 18-49, Kids 2-11, Upscale Millennials). Used for advertising sales targeting and rate card positioning.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last updated this brand record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this brand record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: upfront_participation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand participates in the annual upfront advertising sales market. True for brands that sell inventory in upfront commitments; false for scatter-only brands.

products.name: sales_team
products.description: Master reference table for sales_team. Referenced by sales_team_id.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for all revenue transactions — subscriber invoices, advertising billing, carriage fee invoicing, syndication license fees, and payment processing. Manages billing cycles, payment methods, PCI DSS-compliant card processing, revenue recognition (ASC 606), dispute management, and makegoods. Integrates with Zuora (subscription billing), Wide Orbit (ad billing), and SAP S/4HANA (financial posting).

products.name: invoice
products.description: Master billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to a subscriber, advertiser, MVPD partner, or syndication licensee. Captures invoice number, billing period, total amount due, currency, tax amounts, invoice status (draft, issued, paid, disputed, void), due date, payment terms, revenue category (subscription, advertising, carriage, syndication), ASC 606 revenue recognition period, and source system reference (Zuora, Wide Orbit, SAP S/4HANA). Supports stream-specific extended attributes: subscription plan/proration for SVOD billing, Wide Orbit order ID/ISCI codes for ad billing, MVPD subscriber count basis for carriage fees, and license window/installment schedule for syndication. Serves as the SSOT for all billing documents across all revenue streams.
