attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: The type of payment instrument used for the transaction. Indicates the financial mechanism (credit card, ACH, wire, check, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ach|wire_transfer|check|cash|paypal|direct_debit — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the payment transaction. Used for special instructions, dispute details, or reconciliation notes.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment transaction was initiated or received by the business. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique payment transaction number used for customer communication and reconciliation. Format: PAY-XXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: payment_source
attributes.description: Type of business relationship generating the payment (subscriber, advertiser, distributor, syndicator, licensee, other).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Tracks progression from pending through cleared or failed states. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|processing|cleared|failed|reversed|cancelled|refunded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment transaction was processed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount refunded to the customer if payment status is refunded. May be partial or full refund.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed and issued to the customer. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for payment reversal if status is reversed. Includes chargeback reason codes and dispute details.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment funds were settled and cleared in the business bank account. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount that remains unapplied and is held as credit on the account. Calculated as payment_amount minus applied_amount.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: payment_method
products.description: Stored and tokenized payment instrument registered by a subscriber or advertiser for recurring or one-time billing. Captures payment method type (credit card, debit card, ACH, SEPA, wire), PCI DSS-compliant token (never raw PAN), card brand, last four digits, expiry month/year, billing address, bank routing number (masked), mandate reference for direct debit, is_default flag, verification status, and expiry alert date. Managed in Zuora for subscriber billing.

attributes.name: payment_method_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment method record. Primary key.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber or advertiser who owns this payment method. Links to the subscriber master record in Zuora.

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Payment method verification (especially for high-value advertiser/MVPD accounts) is performed by billing operations staff. Tracking verifier employee supports fraud prevention and compliance with paym

attributes.name: bank_account_number_last_four
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Account Number Last Four Digits
attributes.description: The last four digits of the bank account number. Used for customer identification without exposing full account details. Applicable for ACH, SEPA, and wire transfer methods.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Account Data Protection

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The routing number for ACH or wire transfer payment methods. Stored in masked or tokenized format per PCI DSS requirements. Used for direct debit and electronic funds transfer.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules, SEPA Direct Debit Scheme

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address line associated with the payment method. Used for Address Verification Service (AVS) checks and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional field for complete billing address capture.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality of the billing address. Used for AVS verification and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address. Used for international payment processing and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, PCI DSS regional requirements).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical for AVS verification and accurate sales tax calculation.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or region of the billing address. Used for AVS verification and regional tax compliance.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: The brand or network of the payment card (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, American Express). Applicable only when payment method type is credit or debit card. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visa|mastercard|amex|discover|jcb|diners_club|unionpay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or entity as it appears on the payment card. Used for billing verification and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and payment method age analysis.

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method was deactivated or closed. Null if the payment method is still active. Used for lifecycle tracking and retention analysis.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why the payment method was deactivated. Used for churn analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: expiry_alert_date
attributes.description: The date when the system should trigger an alert to the subscriber about upcoming payment method expiration. Typically set 30-60 days before card expiry to enable proactive customer outreach and reduce involuntary churn.

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: The month (1-12) when the payment card expires. Used to validate card validity and trigger expiry alerts for subscription renewals.

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: The four-digit year when the payment card expires. Used in conjunction with expiry_month to determine card validity and schedule proactive customer outreach.

attributes.name: failed_transaction_count
attributes.description: The cumulative count of failed transaction attempts using this payment method. Used to identify problematic payment methods and trigger dunning workflows.

attributes.name: gateway_customer_profile_reference
attributes.description: The unique customer profile identifier in the payment gateway system. Used to link this payment method to the gateway's customer vault for secure transaction processing.

attributes.name: gateway_payment_method_reference
attributes.description: The unique payment method identifier assigned by the payment gateway. Used for transaction processing and reconciliation with gateway records.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the default payment method for the subscriber. Used to determine which payment method to charge for recurring subscriptions and invoices.

attributes.name: last_failure_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent failed transaction attempt. Used in conjunction with failed_transaction_count to manage retry logic and customer communication.

attributes.name: last_failure_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or message returned by the payment gateway for the most recent failed transaction. Used for troubleshooting and customer support.

attributes.name: last_four_digits
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Four Digits of Payment Card
attributes.description: The last four digits of the payment card number. Used for customer identification and verification without exposing full card details. PCI DSS permits storage of last four digits.

attributes.name: last_transaction_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the most recent successful transaction in the subscriber's billing currency. Used for fraud detection and transaction pattern analysis.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent successful transaction using this payment method. Used for payment method activity tracking and dormancy analysis.

attributes.name: mandate_reference
attributes.description: The unique reference identifier for the direct debit mandate authorizing recurring payments. Required for SEPA Direct Debit and other regulated direct debit schemes.
attributes.references: SEPA Direct Debit Core Scheme Rulebook

attributes.name: mandate_signed_date
attributes.description: The date when the customer signed the direct debit mandate. Required for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution in direct debit transactions.
attributes.references: SEPA Direct Debit Core Scheme Rulebook

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system process that last modified this payment method record. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment method record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: payment_gateway
attributes.description: The payment gateway or processor used to tokenize and process transactions for this payment method (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, Authorize.Net). Used for routing transactions and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_method_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the payment method. Determines whether the payment method can be used for new transactions. Inactive or expired methods require customer action to reactivate.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: The type of payment instrument registered. Indicates the payment mechanism used for billing transactions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ach|sepa|wire_transfer|paypal|apple_pay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: token
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Compliant Token
attributes.description: PCI DSS-compliant tokenized representation of the payment instrument. Never stores raw Primary Account Number (PAN). Used for secure payment processing without exposing sensitive cardholder data.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment method was last verified. Used to track verification currency and trigger re-verification workflows.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The current verification status of the payment method. Indicates whether the payment instrument has been successfully validated through AVS, CVV check, or micro-deposit verification.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system process that created this payment method record. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Billing-domain representation of a billable entity — a subscriber household, an advertising agency account, an MVPD operator, or a syndication licensee. Distinct from the subscriber or advertiser master record in their respective domains; this entity owns the financial relationship: billing address, billing currency, payment terms, credit limit, account balance, billing cycle assignment, tax exemption status, dunning level, and SAP customer account number. SSOT for the financial account identity within billing.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key for the billing account entity.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.cycle. Business justification: Billing account belongs to ONE billing cycle schedule (monthly, quarterly, annual). Currently stores billing_cycle_code as STRING; need FK to cycle table for full cycle configuration. Remove billing_c

attributes.name: default_communication_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.communication_template. Business justification: Billing account can have ONE default communication template for invoice delivery (customer preference). Need FK to track account-level communication preferences. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: default_payment_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_method. Business justification: Billing account has ONE default payment method for auto-pay and recurring charges. Currently only stores payment_method_type as STRING; need FK to the actual payment_method record. Remove default_paym

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Large broadcast accounts (MVPDs, major advertisers, syndication partners) have dedicated account managers from sales or client services. Tracking account manager is critical for relationship managemen

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Legal or business name associated with the billing account. For subscriber accounts, this is the account holder name; for corporate accounts, this is the registered business name.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number assigned to the billing account. Used on invoices, statements, and customer correspondence.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account. Active accounts are in good standing and can transact; suspended accounts have temporary holds due to payment issues or policy violations; closed accounts are permanently terminated; pending activation accounts are awaiting initial setup completion; delinquent accounts have overdue balances and may face service interruption; write-off accounts have uncollectible balances removed from active receivables.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account based on the nature of the billable relationship. Subscriber accounts are for SVOD/AVOD/TVOD end-users; advertiser accounts are for agencies and direct advertisers; MVPD accounts are for multichannel video programming distributors paying carriage fees; syndication licensee accounts are for content resale partners; production vendor accounts are for production service providers; talent accounts are for residuals and royalty payments.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this account. When true, invoices are automatically charged to the default payment method on the due date.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for billing correspondence and invoice delivery.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in which this account is billed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). All invoices and payments for this account are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) on which recurring invoices are generated for monthly billing cycles. Null for non-monthly cycles.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region for the billing address.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this billing account was permanently closed. Null for active and suspended accounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for this account before credit hold is applied. Null indicates no credit limit (cash-in-advance or unlimited credit).

attributes.name: current_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance on the account, calculated as sum of unpaid invoices minus unapplied credits and payments. Positive values indicate amounts owed to the business; negative values indicate credit balances owed to the customer.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current stage in the collections escalation process for overdue accounts. 0 indicates no dunning (account current); higher values indicate progressive escalation steps (e.g., 1=reminder notice, 2=warning, 3=service suspension notice, 4=final notice before write-off).

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering invoices to this account. Email sends PDF invoices; postal mail sends printed invoices; electronic portal makes invoices available for download in customer self-service portal; EDI transmits invoices via Electronic Data Interchange (X12 810 or EDIFACT INVOIC).

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent dunning notice or collections contact sent to this account.

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent invoice generated for this account. Used for billing cycle tracking and account activity monitoring.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment received. Used for payment pattern analysis.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received and applied to this account. Used for payment behavior analysis and credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date on which this billing account was first established and activated.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment is due. Common values are 0 (immediate), 15, 30, 60, or 90 days. Used to calculate invoice due dates and aging buckets.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary billing contact. Used for invoice delivery, payment reminders, and billing notifications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary billing contact or accounts payable representative for this account. Used for billing inquiries and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary billing contact. Used for urgent billing inquiries and collections calls.

attributes.name: sap_customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer master record number in SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) module. Used for GL posting, accounts receivable management, and financial reconciliation. This is the authoritative financial system identifier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Master Data Standard

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is exempt from sales tax, VAT, or other consumption taxes. True for tax-exempt organizations (e.g., non-profits, government entities, resellers with valid exemption certificates); false for standard taxable accounts.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Government-issued certificate or registration number authorizing tax exemption. Required for audit trail when tax_exempt_flag is true.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tax exemption certificate expires and must be renewed. Null for permanent exemptions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was last modified.

attributes.name: wideorbit_account_reference
attributes.description: Account identifier in WideOrbit traffic and billing system. Used for advertising sales order management, spot scheduling, and ad billing for advertiser and agency accounts.
attributes.references: WideOrbit Traffic and Billing Data Model

attributes.name: zuora_account_reference
attributes.description: Account identifier in Zuora subscription billing platform. Used for subscription lifecycle management, recurring billing, and revenue recognition for SVOD/AVOD subscriber accounts.

products.name: cycle
products.description: Defines the recurring billing schedule configuration for a billing account or product plan — monthly, quarterly, annual, or custom. Captures cycle name, frequency, cycle start day, billing run date, proration rules, advance vs. arrears billing flag, next bill date, and last bill date. Used by Zuora subscription billing engine to trigger invoice generation. Reference entity that governs when invoices are produced for each account.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cycle

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscriptions on this billing cycle automatically renew at the end of the term. True enables automatic renewal in Zuora subscription management.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) when the service period covered by the invoice ends. Used to calculate service period duration for revenue recognition. Null for non-monthly frequencies.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) when the service period covered by the invoice begins. May differ from cycle_day for advance billing scenarios. Null for non-monthly frequencies.

attributes.name: billing_run_day_offset
attributes.description: Number of days before or after the cycle day when the billing run executes. Positive values indicate days after cycle day; negative values indicate days before. Used to schedule invoice generation in advance of service period.

attributes.name: billing_timing
attributes.description: Indicates whether billing occurs in advance (invoice before service period) or in arrears (invoice after service period). Critical for revenue recognition under ASC 606.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this billing cycle configuration. Used for audit trail and accountability under SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle configuration record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for invoices generated under this billing cycle (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). All charges in the cycle are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the billing cycle (e.g., MONTHLY_01, QUARTERLY_Q1, ANNUAL_FY). Used in Zuora subscription billing engine for cycle identification.

attributes.name: cycle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the billing cycle configuration, including business rules, special handling instructions, and usage notes for billing operations team.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the billing cycle (e.g., Monthly Standard, Quarterly Advance, Annual Arrears).

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing cycle configuration. Active cycles are available for new subscriptions; inactive cycles are closed to new assignments but continue for existing subscribers; deprecated cycles are phased out; pending cycles are configured but not yet live.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing cycle by revenue stream: subscription (SVOD/AVOD subscriber billing), advertising (ad campaign billing via Wide Orbit), carriage (MVPD/vMVPD distribution fees), syndication (content licensing fees), usage (pay-per-view/TVOD), or custom (non-standard arrangements).
attributes.references: Revenue Assurance and Financial Reconciliation Framework

attributes.name: day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) when the billing cycle starts or billing run executes. For monthly cycles, this is the anchor date. Null for non-monthly frequencies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing cycle configuration is retired and no longer available for new assignments. Null for currently active cycles with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing cycle configuration becomes active and available for assignment to billing accounts or product plans.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Recurrence interval for invoice generation: daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, or custom. Determines how often billing runs execute in Zuora. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|semiannual|annual|custom — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA where revenue from this billing cycle is posted. Used for financial reconciliation and reporting.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after payment due date before late fees or service suspension actions are triggered. Provides customer buffer for payment processing delays.

attributes.name: invoice_generation_day
attributes.description: Specific day of the month (1-31) when invoices are generated for this cycle. Calculated from cycle_day and billing_run_day_offset. Null for non-monthly frequencies.

attributes.name: last_billing_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when a billing run was successfully completed for this cycle. Null if no billing run has occurred yet.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this billing cycle configuration. Used for audit trail and accountability under SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle configuration record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: next_billing_date
attributes.description: Next date when a billing run will execute for accounts assigned to this cycle. Updated after each billing run completion. Used by Zuora billing engine for scheduling.

attributes.name: payment_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after invoice generation when payment is due. Used to calculate invoice due date. Standard terms are Net 30, Net 15, or immediate (0 days).

attributes.name: proration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether partial-period charges are prorated when subscription starts/ends mid-cycle. True enables proration calculation in Zuora.

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method for calculating prorated charges: daily (per-day calculation), monthly (per-month calculation), or none (no proration). Used when proration_enabled is true.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before cycle renewal when customer notification is sent. Used for auto-renew reminders and cancellation windows. Null if auto_renew_enabled is false.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_rule
attributes.description: Code identifying the ASC 606 revenue recognition rule applied to invoices generated under this cycle. Determines how revenue is recognized over time (e.g., straight-line, milestone-based). Maps to SAP S/4HANA revenue recognition configuration.

attributes.name: tax_calculation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic tax calculation is enabled for invoices generated under this cycle. True triggers tax engine integration (e.g., Avalara, Vertex) during invoice generation.

products.name: subscription_invoice
products.description: Specialized invoice record for SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and bundled subscription billing generated through Zuora. Extends the core invoice with subscription-specific attributes: subscription plan name, service period start/end, proration amount, trial period credit, promotional discount code, renewal type (auto-renew vs. manual), churn risk flag at time of billing, and Zuora invoice ID for system reconciliation. Supports ASC 606 revenue recognition for subscription revenue streams.

attributes.name: subscription_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscription invoice record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: External billing account identifier from Zuora. Used for multi-subscription account consolidation and billing hierarchy management.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.cycle. Business justification: Subscription invoice follows ONE billing cycle schedule. Currently stores billing_cycle as STRING; need FK to cycle table for full cycle configuration. Remove billing_cycle string as it can be retriev

attributes.name: processed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Subscription billing runs are executed by billing operations staff. Tracking which employee processed each subscription invoice batch supports operational oversight, error resolution, and performance

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Subscription invoices need revenue stream classification for deferred revenue tracking, ASC 606 compliance, and subscription revenue reporting distinct from advertising. Essential for streaming platfo

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.run. Business justification: Subscription invoice is generated by ONE billing run. Need to track which batch execution generated this subscription invoice for operational audit trail. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber (customer/account holder) who is billed by this invoice.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent subscription account that this invoice bills. Links to the subscription master record.

attributes.name: zuora_invoice_id
attributes.description: Native invoice identifier from Zuora subscription billing system. Used for system reconciliation and API integration.

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: Total amount paid by subscriber against this invoice to date. Used to calculate outstanding balance and track partial payments.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this invoice. True means payment will be attempted automatically on due date.

attributes.name: balance_due
attributes.description: Outstanding amount remaining to be paid on this invoice. Calculated as total_amount minus amount_paid.

attributes.name: churn_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber was flagged as high churn risk at the time of invoice generation. Used for retention campaign targeting and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Predictive churn probability score (0-100) calculated at invoice generation time. Higher scores indicate greater likelihood of cancellation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this invoice record was first created in the billing system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected from the subscriber. Calculated based on invoice date plus payment terms.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the invoice is delivered to the subscriber. Determines communication channel and delivery tracking requirements.

attributes.name: paid_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the invoice was fully paid by the subscriber. Null if invoice is unpaid or partially paid.

attributes.name: payment_gateway
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway or processor used for this invoice (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Braintree). Used for reconciliation and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument on file for this subscription. Indicates how the subscriber will be charged.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the invoice was posted (finalized and made available to subscriber). Marks transition from draft to official invoice.

attributes.name: promotional_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied from promotional campaigns, coupon codes, or special offers. Reduces the net amount due.

attributes.name: promotional_discount_code
attributes.description: Coupon or promotion code applied to this invoice. Used for marketing campaign tracking and discount attribution analysis.

attributes.name: proration_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment amount for partial billing periods due to mid-cycle subscription changes, upgrades, downgrades, or cancellations. Can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice represents an automatic renewal, manual renewal, trial-to-paid conversion, plan upgrade, or plan downgrade.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue from this invoice was or will be recognized in financial statements per ASC 606 rules.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Current status of revenue recognition for this invoice under ASC 606 accounting standards. Tracks whether revenue has been recognized in financial statements.

attributes.name: service_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the subscription service period covered by this invoice. Defines the performance obligation delivery window.

attributes.name: service_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the subscription service period covered by this invoice. Critical for ASC 606 revenue recognition and proration calculations.

attributes.name: subscription_plan_name
attributes.description: Name of the subscription plan being billed (e.g., Premium Monthly, Basic Annual, Sports Bundle). Identifies the service tier and feature set.

attributes.name: subscription_type
attributes.description: Classification of subscription model: SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand), AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand), TVOD (Transactional Video On Demand), or bundled offering.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Base subscription charge amount before taxes, fees, discounts, and credits. Represents the gross recurring revenue component.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this invoice based on subscriber location and applicable tax jurisdictions. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST as applicable.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount due from subscriber after all charges, prorations, credits, discounts, and taxes. This is the amount the subscriber must pay.

attributes.name: trial_period_credit
attributes.description: Credit amount applied for free trial period. Typically offsets the full subscription charge during trial, resulting in zero net amount due.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this invoice record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data lineage.

products.name: ad_billing_order
products.description: Advertising billing record derived from Wide Orbit traffic system representing a finalized ad sales order ready for invoicing. Captures Wide Orbit order ID, advertiser name, agency name, campaign flight dates, total contracted amount, makegoods value, affidavit status, ISCI codes for aired spots, daypart breakdown, CPM/GRP rate basis, and billing status (unbilled, invoiced, paid, disputed). Links advertising campaign execution to the financial billing process.

products.name: billing_carriage_fee_invoice
products.description: Invoice issued to MVPDs and vMVPDs for channel carriage fees under retransmission consent or must-carry agreements. Captures MVPD operator name, channel lineup, subscriber count basis, per-subscriber fee rate, total carriage fee amount, billing period, contractual escalation clause applied, blackout adjustment credits, and SAP posting reference. Distinct from subscription invoices due to B2B wholesale billing mechanics and regulatory retransmission consent framework.

attributes.name: channel

Supports subscriber churn prevention and revenue recovery workflows.

attributes.name: dunning_event_id

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Integrates with SAP S/4HANA revenue accounting module.

attributes.description: Reference to the customer or counterparty receiving the service or content (subscriber, advertiser, MVPD, syndication buyer). Links to the customer master data for reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for the revenue recognition schedule. Required for SOX compliance and segregation of duties. Pending Approval (awaiting finance review), Approved (authorized for recognition posting), Rejected (requires correction or additional documentation).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the revenue recognition schedule was approved for posting. Part of the SOX audit trail for revenue recognition controls.

attributes.name: last_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revenue recognition posting. Used to track recognition progress and identify schedules requiring current-period processing.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: monthly_recognized_amount

attributes.name: next_recognition_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next revenue recognition posting. Used by automated revenue recognition jobs to process monthly or quarterly recognition batches.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or audit notes related to the revenue recognition schedule (e.g., 'Upfront deal with makegood provision', 'Syndication license with holdback period', 'Early termination - prorated final month').

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the performance obligation under ASC 606 (e.g., 'Provide streaming access to content library for 12 months', 'Deliver 52 episodes of syndicated series', 'Deliver 1000 GRPs in Q4 upfront commitment'). Documents the basis for revenue recognition timing.

attributes.name: recognition_end_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition is scheduled to complete. Corresponds to the contract expiration date or end of the performance obligation period. Null for evergreen contracts until termination notice.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: ASC 606 revenue recognition method applied to this contract. Straight-Line (equal monthly recognition for subscriptions), Milestone-Based (triggered by delivery events for syndication), Usage-Based (actual consumption for AVOD/TVOD), Proportional Performance (percentage-of-completion for production contracts), Point-in-Time (immediate recognition for transactional sales).

attributes.name: recognition_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which revenue will be recognized. Calculated from recognition start date to end date. Used for straight-line recognition calculations and forecasting.

attributes.name: recognition_start_date

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue recognition schedule. attributes.name: sap_deferred_revenue_account_code

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_contract_reference

attributes.name: total_contract_value

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Tax record can be associated with ONE payment (tax withholding on payments, especially for international syndication payments). Need FK to payment for tax withholding tracking and compliance. No redun

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tax records are prepared by tax accounting staff for compliance reporting and remittance. Tracking preparer employee supports audit trail, tax authority inquiries, and operational oversight in broadca

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Tax records for international syndication (withholding tax, VAT) may require regulatory filing references for cross-border compliance (e.g., IRS Form 1042, EU VAT MOSS filings). Links tax and regulato

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the taxable and tax amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax classification of the customer for determining applicable tax treatment. Business (B2B), Individual (B2C), Government, Non-Profit, Exempt Organization.

attributes.name: customer_tax_number
attributes.description: The customer's tax identification number (TIN, VAT number, GST number, EIN, etc.) used for tax reporting and validation. Format varies by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: OECD Common Reporting Standard, Local Tax Authority Standards

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax record is under dispute with the tax authority or customer (True = disputed, False = not disputed).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the tax dispute (e.g., Incorrect jurisdiction, Rate disagreement, Exemption certificate rejected, Nexus challenge). Populated when dispute_flag is True.

attributes.name: nexus_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where tax nexus is established (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA, CAN).

attributes.name: nexus_state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the business has established tax nexus (physical or economic presence triggering tax obligation). Critical for US sales tax and Canadian GST/PST compliance.
attributes.references: US Supreme Court South Dakota v. Wayfair, Local Tax Nexus Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, manual adjustments, or audit notes related to this tax calculation.

attributes.name: remittance_date
attributes.description: Date when the tax amount was remitted (paid) to the tax authority. Null if remittance_status is pending or disputed.

attributes.name: remittance_reference_number
attributes.description: Payment reference or confirmation number from the tax authority acknowledging receipt of the tax remittance. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of tax payment to the tax authority. Pending (not yet paid), Remitted (paid in full), Partially Remitted (partial payment made), Disputed (under review or appeal), Waived (exempted or forgiven).

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reverse charge mechanism applies (True = customer is responsible for self-assessing and remitting VAT/GST, False = supplier charges and remits tax). Common in EU cross-border B2B transactions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this tax record (e.g., Zuora, Wide Orbit, SAP S/4HANA FI, Avalara AvaTax). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_tax_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this tax record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the originating system.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Calculated tax amount for this jurisdiction and tax type (taxable_amount × tax_rate). Denominated in the invoice currency.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governmental tax authority responsible for collection and enforcement (e.g., IRS, HMRC, California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques).

attributes.name: tax_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax amount. Automated (system-calculated), Manual (finance team entry), Third-Party Service (Avalara, Vertex, TaxJar), Override (manual adjustment to automated calculation).

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Business categorization of the taxable item or service (e.g., Subscription Services, Advertising Services, Content Licensing, Equipment Rental, Digital Downloads). Used for tax rate determination and reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate on file, if applicable. Required for audit trail when exemption is claimed.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption was applied to this transaction (True = exemption applied, False = no exemption).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or regulatory basis for the tax exemption (e.g., Non-profit organization, Government entity, Educational institution, Resale certificate, Export transaction).

attributes.name: tax_filing_due_date
attributes.description: The statutory due date for filing the tax return that includes this transaction, based on the tax jurisdiction and filing period.

attributes.name: tax_filing_period
attributes.description: The tax reporting period to which this transaction applies, formatted as YYYY-Q# for quarterly or YYYY-M## for monthly (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-M03). Aligns with jurisdiction-specific filing schedules.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, province, county, or municipality) where the tax obligation arises. Format: ISO country code optionally followed by subdivision code (e.g., US-CA, GB, FR-75).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., California, United Kingdom, Paris) for human-readable reporting and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: tax_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number for this tax record within the parent invoice, supporting multiple tax jurisdictions or tax types per invoice.

attributes.name: tax_point_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax liability arises according to tax regulations (also known as time of supply). May differ from transaction_date based on jurisdiction-specific rules for services, advance payments, or continuous supplies.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC, Local Tax Authority Standards

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate applied to the taxable amount, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0825 for 8.25%). Supports precision to six decimal places for complex multi-jurisdictional calculations.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Internal or regulatory code defining the specific tax treatment applied (e.g., standard rate, reduced rate, zero-rated, exempt, out-of-scope). Maps to jurisdiction-specific tax rules.
attributes.references: Local Tax Authority Standards, Internal Tax Policy

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Type of tax applied to the transaction. Sales Tax (US state/local), VAT (Value-Added Tax, EU/international), GST (Goods and Services Tax), Withholding Tax (international syndication/licensing), Excise Tax (specific content types), Use Tax (cross-border digital services).
attributes.references: OECD Tax Standards, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice amount subject to taxation in this jurisdiction, after applying exemptions and exclusions. Denominated in the invoice currency.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: third_party_tax_service
attributes.description: Name of the external tax calculation service provider if third-party method was used (e.g., Avalara AvaTax, Vertex Cloud, TaxJar, Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the underlying billing transaction that triggered the tax calculation. Used to determine applicable tax rates and rules in effect at the time of transaction.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoices it partially or fully settles, enabling many-to-many payment-to-invoice matching. Captures payment reference, invoice reference, allocated amount, allocation date, allocation type (full settlement, partial payment, advance deposit, unapplied credit), and allocation status. Critical for revenue assurance and accounts receivable aging accuracy when a single payment covers multiple invoices or a payment is split across periods.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.credit_memo. Business justification: Payment allocation can apply to ONE credit memo (not just invoices). Payments can be allocated to credit memos to settle negative balances. Need FK to credit_memo for complete payment allocation track

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice receiving the payment allocation. Links to the invoice record that is being settled or partially paid by this allocation.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction being allocated. Links to the payment record that is being distributed across one or more invoices.

attributes.name: primary_payment_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person or automated process that created this allocation. Used for audit trails, accountability, and troubleshooting allocation errors. May be system account for automated allocations.

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.refund. Business justification: Payment allocation can be reversed by ONE refund. When a refund is issued, the original payment allocation needs to be tracked for audit trail. Need FK to refund for allocation reversal tracking. No r

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The financial accounting period (YYYY-MM format) to which this allocation is posted. Determines which month/quarter/year the revenue and cash receipt are recognized. Used for period close, financial reporting, and revenue assurance.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional adjustment applied during allocation, such as currency conversion differences, rounding adjustments, or billing corrections. Can be positive or negative. Used for reconciliation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that is allocated to this specific invoice. For partial payments, this represents the portion applied to this invoice. For full settlements, this equals the invoice outstanding balance. Critical for accounts receivable aging and revenue assurance calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date when the payment allocation was executed and applied to the invoice. This date determines the accounting period for revenue recognition and accounts receivable aging. Critical for financial reporting and compliance with ASC 606.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The business rule or algorithm used to determine this allocation. Manual indicates user-specified allocation; Automatic indicates system-applied based on aging rules; Prorated indicates proportional distribution across multiple invoices; FIFO (First In First Out) indicates oldest invoice paid first; LIFO (Last In First Out) indicates newest invoice paid first; Specific indicates customer-directed allocation to particular invoice.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the payment allocation record. Format: PA-YYYYMMDD-NNNN where YYYYMMDD is allocation date and NNNN is sequence number.

attributes.name: allocation_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order number for this allocation within the parent payment transaction. When a single payment is split across multiple invoices, this field indicates the application order. Used for FIFO/LIFO allocation logic and audit trails.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment allocation. Pending indicates allocation is awaiting confirmation; Applied indicates allocation has been posted to accounts receivable; Reversed indicates allocation has been undone; Voided indicates allocation was cancelled before application; Disputed indicates allocation is under review; Reconciled indicates allocation has been verified and closed.

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment allocation was processed in the billing system. Used for audit trails and transaction sequencing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment allocation method. Full Settlement indicates payment completely satisfies invoice balance; Partial Payment indicates payment covers portion of invoice; Advance Deposit indicates payment received before invoice generation; Unapplied Credit indicates payment not yet matched to specific invoice; Overpayment indicates payment exceeds invoice amount; Prepayment indicates payment for future services.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation was approved by authorized personnel. Null if no approval required or pending approval. Used for audit trails and compliance with financial controls. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this payment allocation record was first created in the database. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and troubleshooting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Immutable after initial insert.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Must match the currency of both the payment and invoice for proper reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount or settlement discount applied at the time of this allocation. Reduces the allocated amount required to satisfy the invoice balance. Common in advertising billing for prompt payment incentives.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is currently under dispute by the customer or internal review. True if disputed; False if not disputed. Disputed allocations may be reversed or adjusted pending resolution.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Business explanation for why this allocation is disputed. Examples include incorrect invoice matching, payment amount mismatch, duplicate allocation, unauthorized payment application, or customer contest of charges. Required when dispute_flag is True.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this allocation is considered effective for revenue recognition purposes. May differ from allocation_date for backdated or future-dated allocations. Used in revenue assurance and financial period close processes.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA general ledger document number generated when this allocation was posted to the financial system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails between billing and finance.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this allocation was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA. Used for financial reconciliation between billing system and ERP. May differ from allocation_date due to batch processing or period close timing.

attributes.name: invoice_reference_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of the invoice receiving this allocation. Denormalized from invoice table for quick reference and reporting without joins. Typically matches invoice_number from the invoice product.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special instructions, or explanatory comments about this allocation. Used for documenting unusual allocation scenarios, customer requests, or manual intervention reasons.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment transaction, such as check number, wire transfer confirmation, credit card authorization code, or ACH trace number. Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when this allocation was successfully reconciled between billing and financial systems. Null if reconciliation is pending or variance exists. Used for revenue assurance reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation has been reconciled between billing system and general ledger. Unreconciled indicates pending reconciliation; Reconciled indicates amounts match across systems; Variance indicates discrepancy requiring investigation; Under Review indicates active reconciliation in progress.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date when revenue from this allocation is recognized in financial statements. May differ from allocation_date based on revenue recognition rules for subscription services, advance payments, or deferred revenue scenarios. Critical for ASC 606 compliance.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date when this allocation was reversed or voided. Null if allocation is still active. Used for audit trails and accounts receivable reconciliation when allocations are corrected or disputed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business explanation for why the allocation was reversed or voided. Examples include payment dispute, incorrect invoice matching, duplicate allocation, customer refund request, or billing error correction. Required when allocation_status is reversed or voided.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system that created this payment allocation record. Zuora for subscription billing allocations; Wide Orbit for advertising billing allocations; SAP for direct financial postings; Manual for user-entered allocations; Batch Import for bulk allocation uploads.

attributes.name: source_system_allocation_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this allocation in the source system (Zuora, Wide Orbit, or SAP). Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracking, and troubleshooting integration issues.

attributes.name: unapplied_balance
attributes.description: Remaining payment amount not allocated to any invoice after this allocation. Represents credit balance available for future invoice matching. Critical for cash application and accounts receivable management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this payment allocation record was last modified. Updated automatically on every change to track data currency and support incremental processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: writeoff_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the invoice balance written off as uncollectible at the time of this allocation. Used when accepting partial payment as final settlement. Impacts bad debt reserves and revenue recognition adjustments.

products.name: run
products.description: Operational record of a scheduled billing cycle execution — the batch process that generates invoices for all accounts in a billing cycle. Captures billing run date, billing cycle reference, run type (regular, off-cycle, final), total accounts processed, total invoices generated, total amount billed, run status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, failed), error count, and Zuora billing run ID. Enables billing operations monitoring and revenue assurance reconciliation.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for run

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing cycle for which this run was executed. Links to the billing cycle configuration that defines the schedule and account population.

attributes.name: communication_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.communication_template. Business justification: Billing run uses ONE communication template for invoice delivery (batch invoice distribution). Need FK to track which template was used for this run for audit purposes. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: run_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this billing run for distribution. Null if approval not required or run not yet approved.

attributes.name: run_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or automated process that triggered this billing run. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: accounts_with_errors
attributes.description: Count of customer accounts that failed to process successfully during this billing run. Used to identify accounts requiring manual intervention.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the billing run execution began. Used to measure processing delays and operational performance.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing run requires management approval before invoice distribution. True for high-value runs, correction runs, or runs with significant adjustments.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run was approved for invoice distribution. Null if approval not required or run not yet approved.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: The effective billing date applied to all invoices generated in this run. Determines invoice date, due date calculation, and revenue recognition period.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period covered by invoices in this billing run. Defines the cutoff for usage charges and subscription calculations.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period covered by invoices in this billing run. Used for subscription proration and usage aggregation.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run finished execution, whether successfully or with errors. Null for runs still in progress or suspended.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing run record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all amounts in this billing run (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures consistent currency handling across invoices.

attributes.name: distribution_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when invoice distribution to customers completed. Null for runs still distributing or not yet started.

attributes.name: distribution_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when invoice distribution to customers began. Used to track delivery SLA and customer communication timing.

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: Total number of errors encountered during billing run execution. Includes account processing failures, invoice generation errors, and system exceptions.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed description of the error or issue that caused the billing run to fail. Null for successful runs. Used for root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: invoice_distribution_status
attributes.description: Status of invoice delivery to customers. Pending runs await distribution; in-progress runs are actively sending; completed runs finished delivery; failed runs encountered distribution errors; cancelled runs were stopped.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes about this billing run. May include special instructions, manual adjustments applied, or explanations for off-cycle execution.

attributes.name: processing_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from actual start to completion of the billing run. Used for performance monitoring and capacity planning.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this billing run has been retried after failure. Used to identify chronic processing issues and trigger escalation.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Primary revenue classification for this billing run. Subscription runs bill SVOD/linear subscribers; advertising runs bill CPM/GRP campaigns; carriage runs bill MVPD distribution fees; syndication runs bill content licensing; transactional runs bill TVOD purchases.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business-friendly identifier for the billing run, typically formatted as cycle-sequence (e.g., 2024-01-R001). Used for operational tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing run. Scheduled runs are queued; in-progress runs are actively generating invoices; completed runs finished successfully; failed runs encountered errors; cancelled runs were aborted; suspended runs are paused pending resolution.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing run execution. Regular runs follow standard cycle schedules; off-cycle runs address mid-period changes; final runs close out terminated accounts; correction runs fix prior errors; makegood runs issue compensatory credits; adjustment runs apply manual corrections.

attributes.name: sap_posting_batch_reference
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA batch identifier for financial posting of billing run results. Links billing transactions to general ledger entries.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the billing run was scheduled to begin execution. Used for operational planning and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: total_accounts_processed
attributes.description: Total count of customer accounts included in this billing run execution. Used for operational monitoring and reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_amount_billed
attributes.description: Sum of all invoice totals generated in this billing run, representing gross revenue before payments. Used for revenue assurance and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_invoice_lines_generated
attributes.description: Total count of invoice line items created across all invoices in this billing run. Used for detailed processing metrics and performance analysis.

attributes.name: total_invoices_generated
attributes.description: Total count of invoices successfully generated during this billing run. May differ from accounts processed if some accounts had zero charges or errors.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing run record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: Total number of warnings generated during billing run execution. Warnings indicate potential issues that did not prevent invoice generation but require review.

attributes.name: wide_orbit_batch_reference
attributes.description: External identifier from Wide Orbit traffic and billing system for advertising billing runs. Used for ad sales invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: zuora_billing_run_reference
attributes.description: External identifier from Zuora subscription billing system for this billing run. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.

products.name: write_off
products.description: Record of a bad debt write-off decision for an uncollectable invoice balance — capturing write-off amount, write-off date, reason code (subscriber churn, advertiser insolvency, dispute settled at zero, statute of limitations), approving authority, SAP bad debt expense account posting, collection agency referral flag, and recovery amount if subsequently collected. Supports revenue assurance, EBITDA reporting, and accounts receivable aging management.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bad debt write-off record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Write-offs require management approval per financial policy. Tracking approver employee (replacing text field approving_authority) is mandatory financial control for bad debt management and supports a

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account under which the invoice was issued.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Write-offs must be attributed to cost centers for bad debt expense allocation and departmental impact tracking. Enables media orgs to track uncollectible revenue by department or business unit for acc

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.credit_memo. Business justification: Write-off can be accompanied by ONE credit memo (formal credit document for the written-off amount). Write-offs often generate credit memos for accounting purposes. Need FK to credit_memo for write-of

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice that contains the uncollectable balance being written off.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Write-offs attributed to profit centers for segment-level bad debt expense and EBITDA impact. Critical for media broadcasters tracking uncollectible revenue by channel or platform for accurate segment

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or advertiser associated with the uncollectable invoice.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_at_write_off
attributes.description: Accounts receivable aging category of the invoice at the time of write-off (e.g., current, 30 days, 60 days, 90 days, 120+ days).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the uncollectable balance being written off as bad debt.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the authorized authority.

attributes.name: collection_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external collection agency to which the debt was referred, if applicable.

attributes.name: collection_agency_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the uncollectable debt was referred to an external collection agency before or after the write-off decision (True/False).

attributes.name: collection_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debt was referred to the external collection agency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this write-off record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the write-off amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: days_outstanding_at_write_off
attributes.description: Number of days the invoice was outstanding (from invoice date to write-off date) at the time the write-off decision was made.

attributes.name: ebitda_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off has a material impact on EBITDA reporting for the period (True/False).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-01) in which the write-off was recorded for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the write-off was recorded.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA general ledger account code to which the bad debt expense is posted (typically a bad debt expense account).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the write-off decision, approval process, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: original_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The total amount originally invoiced before any payments, adjustments, or write-offs were applied.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_at_write_off
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the invoice at the time the write-off decision was made.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the write-off decision (e.g., subscriber churn, advertiser insolvency, dispute settled at zero, statute of limitations, bankruptcy, fraud, uncollectable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subscriber_churn|advertiser_insolvency|dispute_settled_zero|statute_limitations|bankruptcy|fraud|uncollectable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances and business justification for the write-off decision.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount subsequently recovered from the customer after the write-off was recorded, if any partial or full recovery occurred.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which a recovery payment was received after the write-off, if applicable.

attributes.name: recovery_gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA general ledger account code to which any recovered amount is posted (typically a bad debt recovery income account).

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue stream associated with the written-off invoice (e.g., subscription, advertising, carriage fee, syndication, licensing).

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was reversed, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off has been reversed due to subsequent payment or correction (True/False).

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the write-off was reversed (e.g., customer payment received, accounting error correction).

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA financial document number generated when the write-off was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: sap_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off transaction was posted in SAP S/4HANA for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this write-off record was last modified.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bad debt write-off decision was executed and recorded in the financial system.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the write-off transaction, used for tracking and audit purposes.

products.name: ad_billing_reconciliation
products.description: Consolidated advertising billing reconciliation record combining proof-of-broadcast affidavits and compensatory makegood spots for advertising revenue settlement — the billing-side view of ad delivery confirmation and remediation

attributes.name: ad_billing_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advertising billing reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ad_billing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising billing order that this reconciliation record is associated with.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

attributes.name: ad_order_id

attributes.name: reconciliation_date

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for this reconciliation record, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reconciliation process indicating whether the advertising delivery has been verified and settled.

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
