attributes.name: reconciliation_type

attributes.name: resolution_date

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date

attributes.name: sap_posting_reference
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA document number or posting reference for the financial transaction associated with this reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_spots_aired

attributes.name: total_spots_missed

attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

attributes.name: total_spots_ordered
attributes.description: The total number of advertising spots that were contracted and ordered for this campaign flight.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: variance_percentage

attributes.name: wide_orbit_order_reference
attributes.description: External order identifier from the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system for cross-system reconciliation.

products.name: communication_template

attributes.name: communication_template_id

attributes.name: approval_required_flag

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: attachment_file_name_pattern

attributes.name: attachment_required_flag

attributes.name: bcc_recipients

attributes.name: body_content
attributes.description: Main content body of the communication template. May contain HTML markup and merge field placeholders for dynamic data insertion.

attributes.name: cc_recipients
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to be copied on communications generated from this template.

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Delivery channel through which the communication is sent to the recipient.

attributes.name: compliance_category
attributes.description: Classification of the communication for regulatory compliance purposes (e.g., CAN-SPAM, GDPR, TCPA).

attributes.name: content_format
attributes.description: Format type of the template content defining how the body content is structured and rendered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this template record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this communication template is no longer active. Null indicates no end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this communication template becomes active and available for use.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (with optional ISO 3166-1 country code) indicating the language of the template content.

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this template was most recently used to generate a communication.

attributes.name: merge_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of merge field placeholders available in this template for dynamic data insertion (e.g., customer_name, invoice_number, amount_due).

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this template record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes or comments about the template for administrative reference.

attributes.name: opt_out_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether recipients can opt out of receiving communications generated from this template.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for communications sent using this template, affecting delivery queue and recipient notification settings.

attributes.name: reply_to_email

attributes.name: retention_period_days

attributes.name: sender_email

attributes.name: sender_name

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: subject_line

attributes.name: template_name

attributes.name: template_type

attributes.name: trigger_event

attributes.name: usage_count

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: product
products.description: Master reference table for product. Referenced by product_id.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Primary key for product

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Standard list price for the product before any discounts, promotions, or volume adjustments. Expressed in the default currency (USD).

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the product is billed to customers: one-time (single charge), daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or usage-based (billed based on consumption).

attributes.name: billing_system
attributes.description: Source billing system that processes transactions for this product: Zuora (subscription billing), Wide Orbit (advertising billing), SAP S/4HANA (financial posting), legacy (older systems), or manual (manually invoiced).

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Content rating classification for media products, indicating age-appropriateness and content warnings. Follows MPAA (film) and TV Parental Guidelines standards. NR indicates not rated or not applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for the product, used for internal financial reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the product record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the product pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the product, including features, benefits, and target audience. Used in marketing materials and billing communications.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the product is discontinued and no longer available for new sales. Null for products with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the product becomes available for sale and billing. Products cannot be sold before this date.

attributes.name: genre
attributes.description: Primary genre or content category for media products (e.g., Drama, Comedy, News, Sports, Documentary, Reality, Kids). Used for content classification and recommendation engines.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which revenue from this product is posted in SAP S/4HANA financial system.

attributes.name: is_bundled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is sold as part of a bundle or package. True if bundled, False if sold standalone.

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is offered as a promotional or limited-time offer. True if promotional, False if standard offering.

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is subject to sales tax, VAT, or other consumption taxes. True if taxable, False if tax-exempt.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the product record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: last_price_change_date
attributes.description: Date when the base price was last modified. Used for pricing history tracking and customer communication.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was first introduced to the market. Used for product lifecycle analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: minimum_commitment_period_months
attributes.description: Minimum contract commitment period in months required for the product. Null if no minimum commitment.

attributes.name: pci_dss_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product involves payment card processing and falls under PCI DSS compliance scope. True if in scope, False if out of scope.

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms where the product is available (e.g., iOS, Android, Web, Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Smart TV). Used for distribution planning and customer support.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the product by distribution channel: linear TV (broadcast/cable), streaming (OTT/SVOD), digital (web/mobile), audio (radio/podcast), print (magazine), bundle (multi-service package), or ancillary (merchandise/licensing).

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the product, used across billing systems and customer communications.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the product as displayed to customers and used in billing statements.

attributes.name: product_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit or individual responsible for managing the product lifecycle, pricing, and strategy.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product by revenue model: subscription (recurring subscriber fees), advertising (ad inventory sales), carriage fee (distribution fees from cable/satellite operators), syndication (content licensing), pay-per-view (one-time event purchases), or transactional (on-demand rentals/purchases).

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center to which product revenue and costs are allocated for P&L reporting and business unit performance measurement.

attributes.name: requires_contract
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires a formal contract or subscription agreement. True if contract required, False if available without contract.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_rule
attributes.description: ASC 606 revenue recognition treatment for the product: point-in-time (recognize at delivery), over-time (recognize ratably over contract period), proportional (recognize based on performance obligations), or deferred (recognize upon specific milestone).

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel through which the product is distributed: direct (direct sales team), retail (physical stores), online (e-commerce), partner (third-party distributors), affiliate (affiliate marketing), or call_center (telesales).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), discontinued (permanently retired), pending_launch (approved but not yet available), or sunset (scheduled for retirement).

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment the product is designed for: consumer (individual subscribers), business (small/medium business), enterprise (large corporations), government (public sector), education (schools/universities), or nonprofit (charitable organizations).

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code used to determine applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST rates for the product. Integrates with tax calculation engines.

attributes.name: trial_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days for free trial period offered for the product. Null if no trial period available.

attributes.name: parent_product_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on product (parent_product_id)

domains.name: partner
domains.description: Manages relationships, contracts, and negotiations with studios, syndicators, content providers, MVPDs, and third-party distribution partners. Tracks partner agreements, content acquisition deals, co-production arrangements, and affiliate relationships that feed into rights, distribution, and finance domains.

products.name: partner_partner
products.description: Master record for all external business partners including studios, syndicators, content providers, MVPDs, vMVPDs, FAST channel operators, and third-party distribution partners. Serves as the SSOT for partner identity, classification, legal entity details, and relationship status. Tracks partner type (studio, syndicator, MVPD, OTT aggregator, co-production house), corporate hierarchy, domicile jurisdiction, and onboarding lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner_partner data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner entity. Primary key for the partner master record.

attributes.name: parent_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent partner entity in cases where this partner is a subsidiary or division of a larger corporate entity. Enables tracking of corporate hierarchies and consolidated relationships. Null for top-level parent entities.

attributes.name: annual_content_volume_hours
attributes.description: Estimated or actual annual volume of content hours acquired from or distributed through this partner. Used for capacity planning, content pipeline forecasting, and partner performance evaluation.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_contribution_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Revenue Contribution in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated or actual annual revenue contribution from this partner relationship in USD. Includes content licensing fees, distribution revenue share, advertising revenue, or other monetization streams. Used for partner valuation and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: content_specialization
attributes.description: Primary content genres, formats, or categories that the partner specializes in producing or distributing. Examples include scripted drama, unscripted reality, sports, news, children's programming, documentary, or multi-genre. Supports content acquisition strategy and partner matching.

attributes.name: contract_renewal_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for master agreement renewal or renegotiation with this partner. Used for relationship management planning, contract pipeline tracking, and ensuring continuity of content supply or distribution.

attributes.name: corporate_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the corporate hierarchy tree where 1 represents the ultimate parent entity and higher numbers represent deeper subsidiary levels. Used for roll-up reporting and consolidated analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and record age analysis.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by rating agencies such as Moody's, S&P, or Fitch. Used for financial risk assessment, contract negotiation, and determining payment terms or guarantees required.

attributes.name: distribution_territories
attributes.description: Geographic territories or markets where the partner operates or holds distribution rights. Stored as comma-separated list of country codes or region identifiers. Critical for rights management and windowing strategy.

attributes.name: domicile_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the legal domicile jurisdiction where the partner entity is incorporated or registered. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks and tax treaties.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to identify business entities globally. Used for credit assessment, vendor management, and corporate hierarchy tracking.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the physical headquarters address including street number and street name. Used for legal correspondence, contract execution, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the physical headquarters address for suite, floor, building name, or other secondary address details.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the partner headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the headquarters location. May differ from domicile_country_code if the operational headquarters is in a different jurisdiction than legal incorporation.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the headquarters address. Format varies by country postal system.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or primary administrative subdivision where the partner headquarters is located. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partnership includes exclusivity provisions that restrict either party from engaging with competing partners in specified territories, content categories, or distribution channels. Critical for rights management and competitive strategy.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that performed the most recent modification to this partner record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special considerations, relationship history, or operational notes about the partner that do not fit structured fields. Used by relationship managers for institutional knowledge capture.

attributes.name: onboarding_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the partner onboarding workflow. Tracks progression from initial prospect through due diligence, contract negotiation, legal review, approval, and final onboarding completion.

attributes.name: partner_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the partner used in operational systems, contracts, and inter-company communications. Typically assigned during onboarding.

attributes.name: partner_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the partner organization as registered with governing authorities. Used for contracts, invoicing, and legal documentation.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the partner based on their role in the media ecosystem. Studios produce original content, syndicators distribute content to multiple outlets, content providers supply licensed material, MVPDs are traditional cable/satellite distributors, vMVPDs are virtual distributors, and OTT aggregators operate streaming platforms.

attributes.name: preferred_payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the partner for content licensing, royalties, or service fees. Examples include Net 30, Net 60, advance against royalties, or milestone-based payments. Feeds into accounts payable and cash flow planning.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the main business contact at the partner organization. Used for operational communications, contract notifications, and relationship management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the partner organization responsible for day-to-day relationship management and operational coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the main business contact at the partner organization. Includes country code and extension where applicable.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this partner was formally terminated or is scheduled to end. Null for active ongoing relationships. Used for historical analysis and transition planning.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this partner was formally established, typically corresponding to the first executed agreement or onboarding completion. Used for relationship tenure analysis and anniversary tracking.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the business relationship. Active indicates ongoing business, pending indicates onboarding in progress, suspended indicates temporary hold, inactive indicates no current agreements, and terminated indicates relationship ended.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Internal risk classification based on financial stability, contract compliance history, operational reliability, and strategic importance. Used for relationship management prioritization and escalation protocols.

attributes.name: strategic_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the partner's strategic importance to the business. Tier 1 represents critical strategic partners with significant content volume or distribution reach, Tier 2 represents important but not critical partners, Tier 3 represents transactional relationships, and emerging represents new partners under evaluation.

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the partner type. Examples include major studio vs independent studio, first-run syndicator vs off-network syndicator, FAST channel operator, co-production house, or affiliate network.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the partner entity. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in other regions). Used for tax reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179, OECD Tax Identification Standards

products.name: partner_contact

attributes.name: partner_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner organization this contact is associated with. Links to the partner master record.

attributes.name: talent_profile_id

attributes.name: assistant_email
attributes.description: The email address of the contacts executive assistant, used for meeting coordination and scheduling.

attributes.name: assistant_name
attributes.description: The name of the contacts executive assistant or administrative support person, if applicable. Used for scheduling and coordination.

attributes.name: assistant_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the contacts executive assistant, used for urgent scheduling needs and coordination.

attributes.name: communication_language
attributes.description: The preferred language for business communications with this contact, specified using ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes (e.g., EN, ES, FR).

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partner contact. Indicates whether the contact is actively engaged, temporarily unavailable, or no longer with the partner organization.

attributes.name: contract_signatory
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact has legal authority to sign contracts and binding agreements on behalf of the partner organization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this partner contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: decision_making_authority
attributes.description: The level of decision-making authority the contact has within their organization for partnership matters, contract negotiations, and business agreements.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or division within the partner organization where the contact works (e.g., Legal, Finance, Content Operations, Business Development).

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the partner contact. Used for official communications, contract negotiations, and business correspondence.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when this individual ceased to be an active contact, either due to role change, departure from the partner organization, or relationship termination.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The first name or given name of the partner contact individual.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete formatted name of the partner contact, typically combining first, middle, and last names.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact is the primary or main point of contact for the partner organization.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position of the contact within the partner organization (e.g., Vice President of Content Acquisition, Director of Business Development, Legal Counsel).

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent business interaction or communication with this partner contact. Used for relationship health tracking.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The last name or family name of the partner contact individual.

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: The URL to the contacts professional LinkedIn profile, used for professional networking and background verification.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the partner contact, used for urgent communications and on-the-go accessibility.

attributes.name: nda_signed_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact signed a non-disclosure agreement with Media Broadcasting, if applicable. Used to track confidentiality obligations.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_contact_date
attributes.description: The planned date for the next scheduled interaction or follow-up with this partner contact. Supports proactive relationship management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional information, preferences, interaction history, or special considerations related to the partner contact.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: The physical office location or city where the contact is based within the partner organization.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the partner contact, including country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_method

products.name: license_ownership
products.description: This association product represents the ownership and control relationship between partners and broadcast licenses. It captures the attributable interest that partners (equity investors, parent companies, affiliated entities) hold in licensed broadcast stations, including ownership percentages, control relationships, and regulatory disclosure requirements for FCC Form 323 and license transfer applications. products.name: deal_compliance_obligation

attributes.name: risk_rating

attributes.name: small_business_flag

attributes.name: state_province

attributes.name: tax_identification_number

attributes.name: vendor_code

attributes.name: vendor_name

attributes.name: vendor_status

attributes.name: vendor_type

attributes.name: website_url

attributes.name: woman_owned_flag

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: partner_agreement

attributes.name: partner_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for partner_agreement

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity within the organization that is party to this agreement.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner entity (studio, syndicator, content provider, MVPD, distributor) that is party to this agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_name

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the partner agreement, used in contracts and communications.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partner agreement indicating its operational state.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the partner agreement based on its business purpose: content acquisition, syndication, co-production, distribution, affiliate, or licensing.

attributes.name: amendment_count

attributes.name: approval_authority

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag

attributes.name: confidentiality_period_years

attributes.name: content_category
