attributes.name: contract_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit or individual responsible for managing this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the partner agreement over its full term.

attributes.name: contract_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method specified in the agreement for resolving disputes between parties.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or storage location for the physical or digital contract document.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner agreement expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner agreement becomes legally binding and operational.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement grants exclusive rights to the partner.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement was signed or executed by all parties.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law applicable to this agreement (e.g., State of California, UK Law).

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment to the agreement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner agreement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount specified in the agreement for breach or damages.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the partner agreement.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for termination or non-renewal of the agreement.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of payment schedule, milestones, and conditions specified in the agreement.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of performance guarantees or minimum commitments specified in the agreement.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement is scheduled for renewal review or automatic renewal.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for each renewal period if auto-renewal is enabled.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of revenue shared with the partner under this agreement, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the agreement was terminated, if applicable.

attributes.name: territory_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic territories or regions covered by this partner agreement (e.g., North America, EMEA, Global).

attributes.name: master_partner_agreement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on partner_agreement (master_partner_agreement_id)

products.name: payment_schedule
products.description: Master reference table for payment_schedule. Referenced by payment_schedule_id.

attributes.name: payment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_schedule

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner contract or agreement that governs this payment schedule.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the studio, syndicator, content provider, MVPD (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor), or third-party distribution partner receiving payment.

attributes.name: advance_amount
attributes.description: Upfront payment amount advanced to the partner against future royalties or revenue share, to be recouped from subsequent earnings.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The number of times this payment schedule has been amended or modified since its original creation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user or executive who approved this payment schedule for activation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment schedule was formally approved and authorized for execution.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment schedule automatically renews at the end of its term unless explicitly terminated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payment schedule (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this payment schedule expires or is no longer in effect. Nullable for open-ended schedules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this payment schedule becomes effective and binding.

attributes.name: escalation_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment schedule includes an escalation clause that increases payment amounts over time or based on performance milestones.

attributes.name: escalation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage increase applied to payment amounts under the escalation clause, if applicable (e.g., 5.00 represents 5% annual increase).

attributes.name: final_payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the final payment under this payment schedule, marking the end of the payment obligation.

attributes.name: first_payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the first payment under this payment schedule.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: The minimum guaranteed payment amount that must be paid to the partner regardless of performance or revenue, common in content licensing and distribution agreements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment schedule record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the payment schedule.

attributes.name: payment_account_number
attributes.description: The partner's bank account number or payment account identifier to which payments under this schedule are remitted.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The standard payment amount for each scheduled payment installment, in the specified currency. May be fixed or variable depending on schedule type.

attributes.name: payment_calculation_basis
attributes.description: The basis or formula used to calculate payment amounts: fixed amount, gross revenue, net revenue, subscriber count, viewership metrics, per episode, or per season.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which payments are scheduled to be made under this schedule: one-time, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, upon delivery, or upon broadcast.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute payments: wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), check, letter of credit, escrow, or direct deposit.

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this payment schedule for cash flow management and payment processing sequencing.

attributes.name: payment_routing_number
attributes.description: The bank routing number or SWIFT code for the partner's payment account, used for wire transfers and ACH transactions.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date or trigger event within which payment must be made (e.g., Net 30, Net 60).

attributes.name: payment_trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event or milestone that triggers payment obligation, such as content delivery, broadcast date, subscriber threshold, or contract execution.

attributes.name: recoupment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advances or minimum guarantees are subject to recoupment from future revenue or royalty payments.

attributes.name: recoupment_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of future payments that will be withheld to recoup advances or minimum guarantees (e.g., 100.00 represents full recoupment).

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required before the renewal date to terminate or modify the payment schedule.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of revenue to be shared with the partner, applicable for revenue-sharing payment schedules (e.g., 25.00 represents 25%).

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: The royalty rate percentage or per-unit rate applied to calculate royalty payments for content usage, licensing, or distribution.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for this payment schedule, used in partner communications and financial reporting.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment schedule: draft (under negotiation), active (in effect), suspended (temporarily paused), completed (all payments made), terminated (cancelled), or amended (modified).

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment schedule based on the nature of the financial obligation: content acquisition, licensing fee, royalty, revenue share, minimum guarantee, advance, or co-production arrangement.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of all payments scheduled under this payment schedule over its entire term, in the specified currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax withholding rate percentage applied to payments for cross-border transactions or as required by tax regulations (e.g., 15.00 represents 15%).

attributes.name: revised_payment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_schedule (revised_payment_schedule_id)

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Manages enterprise financial reporting, general ledger, cost centers, production budgets, EBITDA tracking, and financial reconciliation across all revenue streams (advertising, subscription, carriage fees, syndication). Integrates with SAP S/4HANA (FI/CO modules) for chart of accounts, period-end close, intercompany eliminations, and SOX-compliant financial controls. Provides the authoritative financial data layer for revenue assurance and corporate reporting.
domains.references: SOX, IFRS, US GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: SAP S/4HANA FI-authoritative chart of accounts defining the complete hierarchy of general ledger account codes used across all Media Broadcasting entities. Captures account number, account type (P&L, balance sheet), account group, functional area, cost element category, currency, consolidation account mapping, and SOX control classification. Serves as the foundational reference for all financial postings, period-end close, and intercompany eliminations.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chart of accounts entry. Primary key for the chart of accounts master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: GL accounts are defined per legal entity in SAP S/4HANA. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. FK enables proper chart of accounts management per legal entity.

attributes.name: account_currency
attributes.description: The primary currency in which this account is maintained, using ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Determines the currency for postings and balance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: SAP account group classification that controls field status, number range assignment, and screen layout for the account. Groups accounts with similar characteristics and processing rules (e.g., 'REVENUE', 'COGS', 'OPEX', 'CAPEX').

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the general ledger account, providing clear business context for the account's purpose (e.g., 'Advertising Revenue - Linear TV', 'Content Production Costs', 'Subscription Revenue - SVOD').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, usage guidelines, or special instructions related to this account. Used to document account-specific policies, restrictions, or business context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master Configuration

attributes.name: account_short_text
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or short description of the account used in reports and transaction displays where space is limited.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account: active (available for posting), inactive (not available for new postings but retains history), blocked (temporarily suspended), or pending_approval (awaiting activation approval).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master Configuration

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the account into fundamental accounting categories: asset (balance sheet), liability (balance sheet), equity (balance sheet), revenue (P&L), or expense (P&L). Determines which financial statement the account appears on.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Statement Classification, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: An alternative or legacy account number used for mapping to previous chart of accounts structures, external reporting systems, or consolidation systems. Supports migration and integration scenarios.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_classification
attributes.description: For balance sheet accounts, specifies whether the account is classified as current asset, non-current asset, current liability, non-current liability, or equity. Not applicable for P&L accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Balance Sheet Classification, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: The chart of accounts identifier to which this account belongs. Media Broadcasting may maintain multiple charts of accounts for different regions or business units (e.g., 'USGA' for US GAAP, 'IFRS' for international operations).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code (legal entity) to which this chart of accounts entry applies. Supports multi-entity environments where different legal entities may have entity-specific account configurations.

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The consolidation account code used for corporate consolidation and intercompany eliminations. Maps local entity accounts to group-level chart of accounts for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Consolidation Configuration, IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: cost_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center must be specified when posting to this account. True for expense accounts requiring cost center assignment; false for balance sheet and revenue accounts.

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Classification of the account as a cost element for controlling purposes: primary (direct posting from FI), secondary (internal allocations/assessments), revenue (revenue postings), or none (not a cost element). Links financial accounting to management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Configuration

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this chart of accounts entry in SAP S/4HANA. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for master data governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: The line item code on the financial statement (balance sheet or income statement) where this account's balance is reported. Used for financial statement generation and external reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting Standards, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classification used for segment reporting and cost-of-sales accounting. Represents business functions such as 'Content Production', 'Distribution', 'Sales & Marketing', 'Technology', 'Corporate'. Enables P&L reporting by business function per IFRS requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Functional Area Configuration, IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The unique account code used to identify this general ledger account across all financial postings. This is the authoritative account identifier used in SAP S/4HANA FI module for all financial transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Structure, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this chart of accounts entry. Used for change tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was last modified. Part of the audit trail for master data change management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: line_item_display_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items (transaction details) can be displayed for this account. True enables drill-down to transaction level; false shows only account balance. Typically true for balance sheet accounts, false for P&L accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master Configuration

attributes.name: materiality_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold above which transactions or balances in this account are considered material for audit and control purposes. Used to determine testing scope and control frequency for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses open item management, tracking individual postings until they are cleared (e.g., for receivables, payables, clearing accounts). True enables clearing transactions; false for standard balance accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Open Item Management Configuration

attributes.name: pl_statement_classification
attributes.description: For P&L accounts, specifies the detailed classification within the income statement (e.g., 'Operating Revenue', 'Cost of Sales', 'Operating Expenses', 'Depreciation', 'Interest Expense', 'Tax Expense'). Not applicable for balance sheet accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Income Statement Structure, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: The planning level or budget category assigned to this account for financial planning and budgeting purposes. Links the account to budget planning hierarchies and enables budget vs. actual reporting.

attributes.name: posting_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct postings to this account are currently blocked. True prevents new transactions; false allows normal posting. Used to freeze accounts during period-end close or for inactive accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center must be specified when posting to this account. True for accounts requiring segment profitability tracking; false otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting Configuration

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Identifies if this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) and its type: customer (accounts receivable), vendor (accounts payable), asset (fixed assets), or none (standard GL account). Reconciliation accounts are automatically posted from subledgers.

attributes.name: sox_control_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the account for SOX compliance purposes: key_control (critical accounts requiring enhanced controls and testing), supporting_control (accounts with standard controls), or not_in_scope (accounts outside SOX scope). Drives audit testing requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax category classification for this account, determining how tax is calculated and posted (e.g., 'Input Tax', 'Output Tax', 'Non-Taxable', 'Tax Exempt'). Used for VAT/GST/sales tax processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: trading_partner_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a trading partner (intercompany entity) must be specified when posting to this account. True for intercompany accounts requiring elimination tracking; false for standard accounts.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account becomes active and available for posting. Supports time-dependent chart of accounts changes and new account activation.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this account remains active. After this date, the account is no longer available for posting. Null indicates the account is currently active with no planned end date.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP CO-authoritative cost center master data representing organizational units responsible for incurring costs across Media Broadcasting — including production studios, broadcast operations, digital platforms, sales regions, and corporate functions. Tracks cost center code, hierarchy node, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, currency, validity period, and budget allocation reference. Enables granular cost tracking for EBITDA reporting and departmental P&L.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key.

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Station cost centers map to licensed facilities for regulatory cost reporting (ownership reports, financial qualifications). Cost center structure typically mirrors license structure in broadcast oper

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Cost centers belong to legal entities in SAP CO organizational structure. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy, enabling hierarchical cost roll-ups and departmental P&L aggregation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center to which this cost center is assigned for internal management reporting and EBITDA tracking.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The primary activity type or service provided by this cost center for internal cost allocation purposes (e.g., Studio Hours, Editing Hours, Transmission Hours).
attributes.references: SAP CO Activity Type Master Data

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total annual budget allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, in the cost center's currency.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the annual or periodic budget allocation document for this cost center, used for budget vs. actual variance analysis.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or division within Media Broadcasting to which this cost center belongs (e.g., Linear Broadcasting, Streaming Platforms, News Division, Sports Division).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity to which this cost center is assigned for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP Controlling Area code to which this cost center belongs. Controlling area represents the organizational unit for cost accounting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate costs from this cost center to other cost objects (e.g., direct assignment, activity-based costing, percentage allocation, driver-based).

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by cost behavior: direct costs attributable to specific content/programs, indirect costs supporting operations, overhead, or capital expenditure.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The business identifier code for the cost center as defined in SAP Controlling (CO) module. Used for financial reporting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities within the organization.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., 'Digital Platform Operations', 'News Production Studio A', 'Ad Sales Northeast Region').

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center indicating whether it is operational and available for cost posting.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by functional area within the media broadcasting business. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|operations|sales|distribution|corporate|technology|content_acquisition — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: The primary cost element group or category that this cost center typically incurs (e.g., Personnel Costs, Production Costs, Technology Costs, Rights & Licensing).
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Element Master Data

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this cost center record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this cost center's budget and actual costs are tracked (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department code within the organizational structure to which this cost center is assigned.

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_segment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Reporting Segment
attributes.description: The EBITDA reporting segment to which this cost center's costs are allocated for executive and investor reporting.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional classification of the cost center for financial statement reporting (e.g., Production, Distribution, Sales & Marketing, General & Administrative).

attributes.name: hierarchy_node
attributes.description: The position of this cost center within the organizational cost center hierarchy, used for roll-up reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in intercompany transactions requiring elimination entries during consolidation.

attributes.name: is_revenue_generating
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this cost center directly generates revenue (e.g., Ad Sales regions) or is purely a cost-incurring unit.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this cost center record in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The physical location or facility code where this cost center operates (e.g., studio location, broadcast center, regional office).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or context about this cost center's purpose or operational considerations.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX financial controls and requires enhanced audit trail and approval workflows.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center becomes active and available for cost posting in the financial system.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center remains active. Null indicates an open-ended validity period.

products.name: profit_center
products.description: SAP CO-authoritative profit center master representing autonomous business units within Media Broadcasting that are evaluated on profitability — such as SVOD platform, linear broadcast network, advertising sales division, and syndication unit. Captures profit center code, hierarchy, controlling area, responsible manager, currency, and segment classification. Underpins segment reporting, EBITDA tracking, and management accounting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the profit center record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Profit centers align with licensed stations for financial and regulatory reporting. License-level EBITDA is required for debt covenants, ownership attribution rules, and FCC financial qualification re

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Profit centers belong to legal entities in SAP CO organizational structure. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. This is essential for P&L consolidation.

attributes.name: responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: The unique employee identifier of the manager responsible for this profit center. Links to HR master data for organizational reporting.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this profit center was activated and began accepting financial postings. Used for historical analysis and lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: budget_allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used for allocating budgets to this profit center. Top-down allocates from corporate targets; bottom-up aggregates from operational plans; zero-based requires justification of all expenses; incremental adjusts prior year budgets.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The higher-level business unit or division to which this profit center belongs. Used for hierarchical rollup in management reporting. Examples: Digital Media, Broadcast Networks, Content Production.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which this profit center was closed and ceased operations. Null for active profit centers. Used for historical reporting and archival.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The company code representing the legal entity to which this profit center belongs. Used for financial statement preparation and legal reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The controlling area to which this profit center is assigned. Controlling area is the organizational unit in SAP CO that represents a closed system for cost accounting purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cost centers can be directly assigned to this profit center for cost allocation and internal charging purposes.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The primary country of operation for this profit center. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this profit center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The functional currency in which this profit center conducts its operations and reports financial results. Three-letter ISO 4217 code.

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center is included in EBITDA segment reporting for management and investor communications. EBITDA is a key profitability metric in media broadcasting.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The primary geographic region or market in which this profit center operates. Used for regional performance analysis and geographic segment reporting. Examples: North America, EMEA, APAC, Latin America.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node
attributes.description: The node identifier within the profit center standard hierarchy. Used for multi-level aggregation and drill-down reporting in management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions involving this profit center require intercompany elimination adjustments during financial consolidation. Used in multi-entity corporate structures.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this profit center record. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this profit center record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing additional context, special instructions, or historical information about the profit center. Used by finance teams for operational reference.

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_code
attributes.description: The code of the parent profit center in the organizational hierarchy, if this profit center rolls up to another. Enables hierarchical consolidation for segment EBITDA and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the profit center within the controlling area. Used in SAP CO for segment reporting and management accounting. Examples: SVOD-US, LINEAR-UK, ADSALES-NA.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the profit centers business purpose, scope of operations, and strategic role within the enterprise. Used for documentation and onboarding.

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the profit center. Human-readable label used in financial reports and management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center. Active profit centers are operational and accept postings; inactive are temporarily suspended; planned are future entities; closed are historical and no longer accept transactions.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center based on its accountability model. Revenue centers are responsible for revenue generation; cost centers for cost control; investment centers for return on invested capital; service centers provide internal services.

attributes.name: revenue_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue transactions can be posted directly to this profit center. Used to control which profit centers participate in revenue recognition workflows.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: The segment classification for external segment reporting under IFRS 8 and US GAAP. Segments represent distinguishable components of the business for which discrete financial information is available and regularly reviewed by the chief operating decision maker. Examples: Streaming, Linear Broadcasting, Advertising, Syndication.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the profit center, used in condensed reports and system displays where space is limited.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: sox_control_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center is within the scope of SOX financial controls and requires enhanced audit trails and segregation of duties for financial postings.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The method used for pricing internal transactions between this profit center and other organizational units. Examples: cost-plus, market-based, negotiated. Critical for accurate profit center performance measurement.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this profit center configuration is effective. Used for time-dependent master data versioning in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Time-Dependent Master Data

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this profit center configuration is effective. Null indicates open-ended validity. Used for time-dependent master data versioning.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Time-Dependent Master Data

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: SAP FI general ledger representing period-level account balances and individual line items for all Media Broadcasting legal entities. Each record captures a GL account balance within a company code, fiscal year, and posting period — storing debit/credit totals, functional and transaction currency amounts, document type references, and SOX control indicators. Serves as the authoritative source for trial balance generation, statutory financial statements, and period-end close validation. Distinguished from journal_entry (which holds individual postings) by representing the aggregated account state.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger record. Primary key for the general ledger data product.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: GL entries reference chart of accounts for account metadata. The gl_account STRING is a business key that should be supplemented with FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id. The gl_account_descr

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: General ledger entries belong to legal entities in SAP S/4HANA FI. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. This is the foundational relationship for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: GL entries can be allocated to cost centers for cost tracking. The cost_center STRING column will be replaced by FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: GL entries can be allocated to profit centers for P&L tracking. The profit_center STRING column will be replaced by FK to profit_center.profit_center_id.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the general ledger account into one of the five fundamental accounting categories: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Used for financial statement preparation and trial balance categorization.

attributes.name: budget_amount_functional_currency
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated to the general ledger account for the fiscal period, expressed in functional currency. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial planning. Particularly relevant for production budgets, content acquisition costs, and operational expense management.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Four-character code representing the business area or division for cross-company code reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities within the same business segment (e.g., linear broadcasting, streaming platforms, syndication).

attributes.name: closing_balance_functional_currency
attributes.description: Closing balance of the general ledger account at the end of the fiscal period, expressed in functional currency. Calculated as opening balance plus net period activity. Represents the ending position for trial balance and financial statement generation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric identifier for the legal entity within the Media Broadcasting enterprise. Represents the organizational unit for which separate financial statements are prepared. Maps to SAP S/4HANA company code structure.

attributes.name: consolidation_unit
attributes.description: Consolidation unit code representing the entity for group consolidation and statutory reporting. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and corporate-level financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: credit_amount_functional_currency
attributes.description: Total credit amount posted to the general ledger account for the period, expressed in the functional currency of the company code. Represents increases to liability, equity, and revenue accounts or decreases to asset and expense accounts.

attributes.name: credit_amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: Total credit amount posted to the general ledger account for the period, expressed in the original transaction currency. Maintained for audit trail and foreign exchange reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: debit_amount_functional_currency
attributes.description: Total debit amount posted to the general ledger account for the period, expressed in the functional currency of the company code. Represents increases to asset and expense accounts or decreases to liability, equity, and revenue accounts.

attributes.name: debit_amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: Total debit amount posted to the general ledger account for the period, expressed in the original transaction currency. Maintained for audit trail and foreign exchange reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code representing the type of accounting document that generated the general ledger entry (e.g., SA for G/L account document, DR for customer invoice, KR for vendor invoice, DZ for payment). Used for document classification and posting control.

attributes.name: ebitda_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the general ledger account is included in EBITDA calculation for management reporting and investor disclosures. True if the account contributes to EBITDA (operating revenues and expenses), false if excluded (interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year for which the general ledger balance is recorded. Represents the accounting period year aligned with the company's financial reporting calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional area code representing the business function or operational domain (e.g., content production, advertising sales, distribution, subscriber management). Used for cross-organizational reporting and functional cost analysis.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency of the company code (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). The functional currency is the primary currency in which the legal entity conducts business and prepares financial statements.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number from the chart of accounts. Represents the specific account classification (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense) for financial transactions. Structured according to the enterprise chart of accounts hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: last_posting_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction posted to this general ledger account within the fiscal period. Used for audit trail and period-end reconciliation validation.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Ledger group code representing the accounting principle or reporting standard (e.g., 0L for leading ledger, 2L for IFRS, 3L for US GAAP). Enables parallel accounting for multiple reporting frameworks within a single system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New General Ledger

attributes.name: net_balance_functional_currency
attributes.description: Net balance of the general ledger account for the period, calculated as debit amount minus credit amount (or vice versa depending on account type), expressed in the functional currency. Represents the aggregated account state for trial balance and financial statement generation.

attributes.name: opening_balance_functional_currency
attributes.description: Opening balance of the general ledger account at the beginning of the fiscal period, expressed in functional currency. Represents the carried-forward balance from the previous period for balance sheet accounts.

attributes.name: period_lock_status
attributes.description: Status of the posting period indicating whether the period is open for new postings, closed for regular postings but open for adjustments, or locked for all postings. Used for period-end close control and financial statement finalization.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit numeric code that controls the posting behavior and determines whether the entry is a debit or credit (e.g., 40 for debit, 50 for credit). Used for transaction validation and account determination logic.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: Numeric posting period within the fiscal year (typically 1-12 for monthly periods, with additional special periods 13-16 for year-end adjustments). Represents the accounting period for transaction posting and period-end close.

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the general ledger account is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that must reconcile with subsidiary ledgers such as accounts receivable, accounts payable, or fixed assets. True if reconciliation account, false otherwise.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general ledger record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture time for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general ledger record was last modified. Represents the most recent change time for audit trail and change tracking. Updated whenever period balances are adjusted or corrected.

attributes.name: revenue_stream_category
attributes.description: Classification of revenue accounts by primary revenue stream type for Media Broadcasting business. Categories include advertising (linear and digital ad sales), subscription (SVOD/AVOD), carriage fees (MVPD/vMVPD distribution), syndication (content resale), licensing (rights monetization), transactional (TVOD), and other. Used for revenue assurance and segment reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: advertising|subscription|carriage_fees|syndication|licensing|transactional|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Segment code for external segment reporting as required by IFRS 8 and US GAAP. Represents reportable business segments for statutory financial reporting and investor disclosures (e.g., content production, advertising, subscription services).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system that originated the general ledger data. Typically SAP S/4HANA FI module, but may include other ERP systems or consolidation platforms for multi-system environments. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sox_control_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the general ledger account is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act internal control requirements and audit procedures. True if SOX-controlled account requiring enhanced documentation and approval workflows, false otherwise.

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: Trading partner code identifying the intercompany counterparty for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany eliminations and consolidated financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the original transaction currency if different from functional currency. Used for multi-currency transactions requiring foreign exchange conversion and revaluation.

attributes.name: variance_amount_functional_currency
attributes.description: Variance between actual net balance and budgeted amount for the fiscal period, expressed in functional currency. Calculated as actual minus budget. Positive variance indicates over-budget for expense accounts or under-budget for revenue accounts.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Individual accounting document posted to the SAP S/4HANA general ledger capturing all financial transactions across Media Broadcasting — including revenue recognition postings, accruals, prepayments, intercompany charges, and period-end adjustments. Records document number, company code, posting date, document date, document type, reference, reversal indicator, posting user, and SOX approval workflow status. The atomic unit of financial record-keeping.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Standard

attributes.name: approver_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the individual who approved this journal entry for posting, as required by SOX internal control procedures. Null if no approval was required or entry is still pending approval.

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Journal entries belong to legal entities in SAP S/4HANA FI. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. This is essential for financial consolidation and SOX controls.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries in media broadcasting post to cost centers for production cost allocation, departmental expense tracking, and budget monitoring. Enables drill-down from GL to cost center detail for va

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.maintenance_work_order. Business justification: Maintenance costs (labor, parts, vendor services) are journalized from completed work orders. Finance posts work order costs to GL accounts for facility/equipment maintenance expense tracking, cost ce

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the individual who posted this journal entry into the system. Used for audit trail and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entries for revenue recognition, intercompany eliminations, and P&L postings require profit center assignment for segment reporting and EBITDA calculation. Critical for media broadcasting busi

attributes.name: recurring_entry_template_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the recurring entry template from which this journal entry was generated. Populated only when recurring_entry_indicator is True.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Journal entries support regulatory filings (ownership change accounting, financial certifications in license applications, spectrum auction payments). Audit trail from filing to supporting GL entries

attributes.name: source_document_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the source document in the originating system that generated this journal entry. Used for traceability and reconciliation back to operational systems.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the SOX internal control that governs the posting and approval of this journal entry type. Links the entry to the company's SOX compliance framework.

attributes.name: accrual_reversal_date
attributes.description: The future posting date on which this accrual entry will automatically reverse. Populated only when accrual_reversal_indicator is True.

attributes.name: accrual_reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is an automatic accrual reversal. True if this entry will automatically reverse in the subsequent period.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by its accounting purpose: standard operational posting, period-end accrual, prepayment amortization, account reclassification, intercompany elimination, or error correction.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry was approved by the designated approver. Null if no approval was required or entry is still pending approval.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: The name of the batch input session if this journal entry was posted via batch processing rather than manual entry. Empty for manually posted entries.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the legal entity within the Media Broadcasting enterprise for which this journal entry is posted. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the journal entry amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). All line items within this document share this currency.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract) that gave rise to this journal entry. May differ from posting date when entries are posted retrospectively.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text at the document header level providing context or explanation for the journal entry, such as the business purpose, transaction description, or special instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Header Text

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP document number assigned to this journal entry at posting time. This is the business identifier used across financial reporting and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Standard

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the nature of the accounting document (e.g., SA=General Ledger Document, DR=Customer Invoice, KR=Vendor Invoice, DZ=Customer Payment, KZ=Vendor Payment, AB=Accounting Document). Controls the number range and field status for the entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the journal entry was physically entered into the SAP system by the user, which may differ from both document date and posting date.

attributes.name: entry_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the journal entry was created in the SAP system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert document currency amounts to local currency amounts at the time of posting. Expressed as local currency per one unit of document currency.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating the type of exchange rate used (e.g., M=Average Rate, B=Bank Buying Rate, G=Bank Selling Rate). Determines which rate table is consulted for currency conversion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate Type

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted, following the company's financial calendar. Used for period-end close and annual financial reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between different legal entities within Media Broadcasting. True for intercompany entries requiring elimination in consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry record was last modified in the system. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger group to which this journal entry belongs. Supports parallel accounting for different accounting principles (e.g., 0L=Leading Ledger, 2L=IFRS Ledger, 3L=Tax Ledger).

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency of the company code. Used for parallel accounting and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: parked_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is in parked status (saved but not yet posted). True if parked, False if fully posted.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the accounting date that determines the fiscal period and is used for financial statement reporting. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (typically 1-12 for monthly periods, with additional special periods 13-16 for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year when this entry was posted.

attributes.name: recurring_entry_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is part of a recurring entry template (e.g., monthly depreciation, rent accruals). True if generated from a recurring template.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Free-text reference field used to store external document identifiers such as invoice numbers, purchase order numbers, contract references, or other source system identifiers that link this journal entry to originating business transactions.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted document. True if this entry reverses another entry, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the business reason for reversing the original document (e.g., 01=Error Correction, 02=Accrual Reversal, 03=Period-End Adjustment). Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason Codes

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system from which this journal entry was interfaced into SAP S/4HANA (e.g., WideOrbit for advertising revenue, Zuora for subscription billing, Rightsline for royalty accruals). Empty for entries created directly in SAP.

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Populated only when intercompany_indicator is True. Used for intercompany reconciliation and consolidation eliminations.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: The SAP transaction code (T-Code) used to post this journal entry (e.g., FB01, FB50, F-02). Indicates the posting interface and provides context for the entry method.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the journal entry within the SOX-compliant approval workflow. Tracks the document through draft, approval, posting, and potential reversal stages.

Productions book broadcast facilities (studios, control rooms) and production accounting allocates facility rental/usage charges to

attributes.name: actual_spend_to_date

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: budget_expiry_date

attributes.name: reference_document

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo field providing additional context about this receivable entry.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
