attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Accounts payable records must be associated with a legal entity for consolidation and reporting. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. FK will enable proper legal entity consol

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: AP records can be allocated to cost centers for expense tracking. The cost_center STRING column will be replaced by FK to cost_center.cost_center_id, enabling proper cost allocation and budget trackin

attributes.name: equipment_procurement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.equipment_procurement. Business justification: AP invoices are matched to equipment purchase orders for three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice). Finance validates invoice against PO terms for payment approval, purchase price variance analysis

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.vendor_contract. Business justification: AP invoices are paid under vendor contracts (maintenance agreements, service contracts, equipment leases, support agreements). Finance validates invoice terms, pricing, and payment terms against maste

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor to whom payment is owed. Links to talent agencies, production vendors, content licensors, technology providers, and distribution partners.

attributes.name: assignment_reference
attributes.description: Free-text reference field for additional assignment information (e.g., production code, content title, project ID). Used for detailed cost tracking.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the document date or goods receipt date, used to determine the due date.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the payable was fully cleared (paid). Null if still open or partially cleared.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number of the payment document that cleared this payable. Null if not yet cleared.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Current clearing status of the payable. Open=unpaid, Partially Cleared=partial payment applied, Fully Cleared=completely paid.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP company code representing the legal entity responsible for this payable. Used for financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accounts payable record was first created in the SAP FI-AP system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Potential cash discount amount available if payment is made by the discount due date, in document currency.

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be made to qualify for early payment discount. Null if no discount terms apply.

attributes.name: document_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Currency in which the vendor billed.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the vendor invoice or credit memo. Typically the invoice date provided by the vendor.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit SAP FI document number uniquely identifying this payable within the company code and fiscal year. The externally-known business identifier for this payable.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the nature of the payable. KR=Vendor Invoice, KG=Vendor Credit Memo, KN=Net Vendor Invoice, RE=Invoice Receipt, DR=Debit Memo.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due to the vendor. Calculated from baseline date and payment terms. Critical for cash management and avoiding late payment penalties.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert document currency to local currency at posting date. Null if document currency equals local currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year when the document was posted. Used for monthly financial close.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which the document was posted. Used for period-end close and financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: Ten-digit general ledger account number to which this payable is posted. Determines the expense or asset classification in the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions, in document currency. Represents the full amount billed by the vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_reference
attributes.description: Vendor-provided invoice number or reference identifier. Used for vendor reconciliation and payment matching.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accounts payable record was last modified (e.g., payment block added, partial payment applied). Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net payable amount converted to the company code local currency for general ledger posting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount payable to vendor after all deductions (discounts, withholding tax), in document currency. This is the amount that will be paid.

attributes.name: open_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding unpaid amount remaining on this payable, in document currency. Reduced as partial payments are applied. Zero when fully cleared.

attributes.name: payment_block
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating if payment is blocked (e.g., A=Blocked for Payment, R=Blocked for Review, blank=Not Blocked). Prevents automatic payment until resolved.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why payment is blocked (e.g., pending approval, invoice dispute, missing documentation). Null if not blocked.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating the payment method (e.g., C=Check, T=Wire Transfer, E=Electronic Funds Transfer, A=ACH). Determines payment run processing.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the payment terms negotiated with the vendor (e.g., net 30, 2/10 net 30). Determines due date and cash discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the accounts payable document was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for financial reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit purchase order number if this payable originated from a PO-based procurement. Used for three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payable is subject to SOX financial controls and requires additional approval workflows. True for material transactions.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the invoice (VAT, sales tax, GST), in document currency. May include multiple tax jurisdictions.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the payable, typically describing the goods or services invoiced (e.g., 'Q4 2023 content licensing fees', 'Studio equipment rental').

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from vendor payment per tax regulations (e.g., talent residuals withholding, foreign vendor withholding), in document currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether withholding tax applies to this payable. True if withholding tax is calculated and deducted.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Financial transaction record between legal entities within the Media Broadcasting corporate group — capturing content licensing charges between production subsidiaries and broadcast networks, shared service allocations, management fees, technology recharges, and intercompany loans. Each record identifies sending and receiving company codes, transaction type, amount, currency, bilateral netting status, consolidation elimination flag, and reconciliation period. Essential for monthly intercompany reconciliation, consolidated financial statement preparation, and elimination entries at group level.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record within the Media Broadcasting corporate group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Intercompany Posting Standards

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Intercompany charges for facility usage (one legal entity using another's broadcast facility) require facility identification for transfer pricing documentation, intercompany billing, and consolidatio

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Intercompany transactions post to GL accounts. The gl_account_code STRING is a business key that should be supplemented with FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Intercompany transactions require disclosure in FCC ownership reports (attribution of revenue/expenses in JSA/SSA arrangements) and financial qualification filings. Regulatory filings reference specif

attributes.name: sending_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be allocated to sending cost center. The sending_cost_center STRING column will be replaced by FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: sending_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Intercompany transactions have a sending legal entity. The sending_company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. FK enables proper intercompany elimination and netting.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this intercompany transaction requires formal approval workflow before posting, typically based on transaction amount thresholds or type.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction was formally approved, recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the authorized person who approved the intercompany transaction for posting, maintaining audit trail for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA User Master Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany transaction amount is due for settlement between the legal entities, calculated based on payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Due Date Standards

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this intercompany transaction requires elimination entries during consolidated financial statement preparation at group level.

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: Current status of the consolidation elimination process for this intercompany transaction in the group financial consolidation system.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to local or group currency, typically sourced from the corporate treasury system.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: The type of exchange rate used for currency conversion (e.g., spot rate, monthly average rate, budget rate, or fixed contractual rate).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate Type Configuration

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the intercompany transaction is posted, following the corporate chart of accounts structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Standards

attributes.name: group_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the corporate group reporting currency (typically USD for Media Broadcasting).

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the corporate group reporting currency for consolidated financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Group Currency Translation Standards

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional business context for the intercompany transaction, such as the specific content title licensed, service provided, or purpose of the charge.

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency of the receiving company code.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the local currency of the receiving company code for local statutory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was last modified, recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX), supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intercompany transaction is subject to bilateral netting arrangements to reduce cash settlement volumes between legal entities.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and settlement terms for the intercompany transaction (e.g., NET30, NET60, IMM for immediate).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger, determining the fiscal period for financial statement inclusion.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code of the legal entity receiving or being charged for the intercompany transaction (the entity consuming the service, content, or financing).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Master Data Standards

attributes.name: receiving_cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center within the receiving company code that is being charged for the intercompany transaction, enabling detailed cost allocation and budget tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) in which this intercompany transaction is subject to monthly intercompany reconciliation procedures.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the intercompany reconciliation process indicating whether the transaction has been matched and confirmed by both sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this intercompany transaction to source documents such as content licensing agreements, service invoices, or loan agreements.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code of the legal entity originating or charging the intercompany transaction (the entity providing the service, content, or financing).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Master Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the intercompany transaction was settled through cash payment or netting between the legal entities.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of cash settlement for the intercompany transaction, tracking whether payment has been made between the legal entities.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) identifying whether this intercompany transaction is subject to SOX-compliant financial controls and requires additional audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency, representing the gross charge before any adjustments or netting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Amount Field Standards

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the intercompany transaction occurred or was initiated, used for period assignment and financial reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the intercompany transaction, typically following the format IC-XXXXXXXXXX for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction indicating its position in the approval, posting, and reconciliation workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|reconciled|disputed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Posting Status Standards

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the charge or transfer between legal entities (e.g., content licensing charges between production subsidiaries and broadcast networks, shared service allocations, management fees, technology recharges, intercompany loans, royalty payments).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Transaction Type Configuration

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for interest calculation and cash flow purposes, particularly relevant for intercompany loans and financing arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Treasury Value Date Standards

products.name: period_close
products.description: Record of each financial period-end close cycle executed in SAP S/4HANA for Media Broadcasting legal entities. Tracks fiscal year, accounting period, company code, close phase (pre-close, soft close, hard close), close status, scheduled date, actual completion date, responsible controller, open items count, unreconciled items, and SOX sign-off status. Provides the authoritative audit trail for the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process.

attributes.name: period_close_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial period close record. Primary key for the period close entity.

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Period close is executed per legal entity in SAP S/4HANA. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity. FK enables proper period-end close tracking and SOX controls.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Period close triggers regulatory filing deadlines (FCC Form 323 ownership reports, annual EEO reports, biennial ownership reports). Close calendar must track associated regulatory filings to ensure fi

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the period close was completed and the period was locked for further postings. Null if close is not yet completed.

attributes.name: close_checklist_completion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of period-end close checklist tasks that have been completed. Ranges from 0.00 to 100.00. Provides visibility into close progress.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Workflow

attributes.name: close_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the period close process was completed and the period was locked. Null if close is not yet completed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Audit Trail

attributes.name: close_initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the period close process was formally initiated in the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Audit Trail

attributes.name: close_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting significant events, issues, or observations during the period close process. Provides context for future reference and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Documentation

attributes.name: close_phase
attributes.description: Current phase of the period-end close process. Pre-close for preliminary activities, soft close for initial close with limited posting allowed, hard close for final close with restricted access, final close for locked period after SOX sign-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Process

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Current status of the period close execution. Tracks the lifecycle state from initiation through completion or failure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Workflow

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric identifier for the legal entity in SAP S/4HANA. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.

attributes.name: consolidation_status
attributes.description: Status of financial consolidation processing for this company code and period. Tracks whether the legal entity data has been successfully consolidated into group reporting.

attributes.name: controller_email
attributes.description: Email address of the responsible controller for communication and notification purposes during the close process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this period close record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code local currency. All monetary amounts in this record are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: ebitda_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Amount
attributes.description: Calculated EBITDA for this company code and period in local currency. Key profitability metric for media broadcasting operations and corporate reporting.

attributes.name: external_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period close requires external auditor review and sign-off. Typically true for quarterly and annual closes for publicly traded entities.

attributes.name: external_audit_status
attributes.description: Status of external auditor review for this period close. Tracks the progress of third-party audit activities.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period number within the fiscal year (typically 1-12 for monthly periods, or 1-4 for quarterly periods). Represents the specific reporting period being closed.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the period close is being executed. Represents the 12-month financial reporting period for the organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_status
attributes.description: Status of intercompany transaction elimination processing for consolidated financial reporting. Indicates whether intercompany balances have been identified and eliminated.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this period close record. Audit trail field for accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this period close record was most recently updated. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_reopen_date
attributes.description: Date when the period was most recently reopened for adjustments. Null if the period has never been reopened.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Audit Trail

attributes.name: open_items_count
attributes.description: Number of open line items (uncleared documents) remaining in the general ledger at the time of close execution. Indicates outstanding reconciliation work.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Management

attributes.name: period_lock_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the posting period was locked in the system. Null if the period is not yet locked.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accounting period being closed. Monthly for standard month-end close, quarterly for quarter-end, annual for year-end, special for adjustment periods.

attributes.name: posting_period_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the posting period has been locked to prevent further transactions. True when the period is closed and locked, false when still open for postings.

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this period has been reopened after initial close. Tracks the frequency of post-close adjustments and indicates close process quality.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Audit Trail

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent period reopen. Documents the reason for post-close adjustments for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period-End Closing Audit Trail

attributes.name: responsible_controller
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the financial controller responsible for executing and certifying the period close for this company code and period.

attributes.name: revenue_assurance_status
attributes.description: Status of revenue assurance validation for this period. Indicates whether all revenue streams (advertising, subscription, carriage fees, syndication) have been reconciled and verified.

attributes.name: scheduled_close_date
attributes.description: The planned target date for completing the period close process. Established based on the financial calendar and reporting deadlines.

attributes.name: sox_control_status
attributes.description: Status of SOX internal control testing and certification for this period close. Required for publicly traded companies to ensure financial reporting compliance.

attributes.name: sox_signoff_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who provided the SOX control sign-off for this period close.

attributes.name: sox_signoff_date
attributes.description: Date when the SOX control certification was completed and signed off by the responsible controller or compliance officer. Null if not yet signed off.

attributes.name: unreconciled_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of unreconciled items in the company code currency. Represents the financial exposure from incomplete reconciliations.

attributes.name: unreconciled_items_count
attributes.description: Number of accounts or subledger items that have not been reconciled to the general ledger at the time of close. Critical metric for close quality.

attributes.name: variance_to_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Monetary variance between actual period results and forecasted amounts in company code currency. Positive indicates favorable variance, negative indicates unfavorable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Planning and Forecasting

products.name: legal_entity

attributes.name: parent_entity_legal_entity_id

attributes.name: activation_date

attributes.name: broadcast_license_holder_flag

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.name: consolidation_group

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the legal entity is incorporated and registered. Determines primary legal jurisdiction and regulatory framework.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this legal entity record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the credit control area assigned to this legal entity in SAP S/4HANA. Used for credit management and accounts receivable monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Credit Management Configuration

attributes.name: deactivation_date

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_flag

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity based on its primary business function within the Media Broadcasting corporate structure. Determines the operational model and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the fiscal year structure for this legal entity, including the number of periods, period start and end dates, and year-end closing rules. Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: functional_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the primary currency in which the entity conducts its business and maintains its books of account. Used for financial statement preparation and consolidation.

attributes.name: incorporation_date

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the group of entities for which intercompany transactions must be eliminated during consolidation. Used to ensure accurate consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this legal entity record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the entity as registered with the governing authority. This is the official name used in all legal documents, contracts, regulatory filings, and financial statements.

attributes.name: legal_form
attributes.description: The legal structure or incorporation type of the entity (e.g., Corporation, Limited Liability Company, Partnership, Public Limited Company). Determines liability, taxation, and regulatory obligations.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage

attributes.name: primary_contact_email

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the official registered address of the legal entity as filed with the incorporation authority. Used for legal correspondence and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the official registered address (suite, floor, building name). Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the registered address. Typically matches the country of incorporation.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the registered address. Uses standard postal abbreviations where applicable.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or incorporation number assigned by the government authority in the country of incorporation. Used for legal identification and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_obligations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory reporting frameworks and obligations applicable to this legal entity (e.g., SEC 10-K, FCC Form 323, Ofcom Annual Return). Determines mandatory filings and disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FCC Regulations, SEC Reporting Requirements, Ofcom Broadcasting Code

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency used for external financial reporting and consolidation at the corporate level.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes, IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trade name of the legal entity used for internal reporting and operational purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: sox_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this legal entity is within the scope of SOX compliance and internal control testing. True if the entity is material to consolidated financial statements and subject to SOX Section 404 requirements.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Primary tax identification number assigned by the tax authority in the country of incorporation. Used for all tax filings, withholding, and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT or GST registration number for entities operating in jurisdictions requiring VAT registration. Used for VAT reporting and cross-border transactions.

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Record of cost allocation and recharge transactions executed within SAP CO — distributing shared costs (facilities, technology infrastructure, corporate overhead, shared services) from sender cost centers to receiver cost centers or profit centers across Media Broadcasting. Captures allocation cycle, sender cost center, receiver cost center/profit center, allocation method (direct, statistical, activity-based), allocated amount, allocation key, and fiscal period. Enables accurate departmental P&L and EBITDA calculation.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation transaction record. Primary key for the cost allocation entity.
attributes.references: SAP CO (Controlling) Module - Cost Allocation Documentation

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Shared facility costs (power, cooling, security, building maintenance) are allocated from central cost centers to user departments/productions. Finance allocates facility overhead based on usage metri

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Cost allocations occur within legal entities for internal cost distribution. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity.

attributes.name: cost_element_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Element Chart Of Accounts Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Cost elements in SAP CO are GL accounts from the chart of accounts. The cost_element STRING is a business key that should be supplemented with FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id.

attributes.name: original_allocation_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the original cost allocation record that this record reverses. Null if this is not a reversal transaction.

attributes.name: primary_sender_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the cost center from which costs are being allocated (the source of the shared costs being distributed).

attributes.name: receiver_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the profit center receiving the allocated costs. Null if the receiver is a cost center instead of a profit center.

attributes.name: studio_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.studio_facility. Business justification: Studio costs are allocated to productions or departments based on booking hours and usage. Finance tracks studio utilization and allocates studio overhead (depreciation, maintenance, utilities) for pr

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount allocated from the sender cost center to the receiver cost center or profit center in the transaction currency. This is the core financial value of the allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_key
attributes.description: The allocation key or driver used to determine the proportion of costs allocated to the receiver (e.g., headcount, square footage, revenue, FTE, transaction volume). Defines the basis for cost distribution.

attributes.name: allocation_key_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the allocation key used for this specific allocation (e.g., 15 FTEs, 2500 square feet, 1000000 transactions). Used to calculate the allocated amount.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate costs from sender to receiver. Direct: one-to-one allocation. Statistical: based on statistical key figures. Activity-based: based on activity quantities consumed. Assessment: periodic allocation without traceability. Distribution: proportional distribution based on allocation keys.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of total sender costs allocated to this receiver, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.75 for 15.75%). Derived from the allocation key value relative to total allocation base.

attributes.name: allocation_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the allocation cycle was executed and this allocation record was created. May differ from posting date if allocations are run in advance and posted later.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost allocation record. Posted: successfully posted to CO ledger. Pending: awaiting approval or posting. Reversed: allocation has been reversed. Cancelled: allocation was cancelled before posting. Error: allocation failed validation or posting.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the cost allocation indicating the nature of costs being distributed (e.g., overhead, shared services, facilities, technology infrastructure, corporate overhead, intercompany charges).

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation requires managerial approval before posting (True) or can be posted automatically (False). Used for governance and control of high-value or sensitive allocations.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Cost Allocation Approval Policy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost allocation was approved for posting. Null if no approval was required or allocation is still pending approval.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who approved this cost allocation for posting. Null if no approval was required or allocation is still pending approval.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The SAP business area to which this allocation is assigned. Used for segment reporting and cross-company code consolidation in Media Broadcasting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code under which this cost allocation is recorded. Represents the legal entity for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP controlling area within which this cost allocation is executed. Represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal reporting.

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: The SAP CO cost element (account assignment) under which the allocated cost is recorded. Maps to the general ledger account in SAP FI.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that created this cost allocation record. Part of standard audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost allocation record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The SAP CO document number assigned to this cost allocation transaction. Provides traceability and audit trail for the allocation posting.

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_segment
attributes.business_glossary_term: EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) Reporting Segment
attributes.description: The EBITDA reporting segment to which this allocation contributes. Used for segment-level EBITDA calculation and executive reporting in Media Broadcasting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the allocation was posted (1-12 or 1-13 for special periods). Used for monthly financial close and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the cost allocation was posted (e.g., 2024). Used for period-based financial reporting and EBITDA tracking.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area classification for this allocation (e.g., production, distribution, sales, administration). Used for cost-of-sales accounting and functional P&L reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation crosses company code boundaries and represents an intercompany charge (True) or is intra-company (False). Used for consolidation and elimination processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that last modified this cost allocation record. Part of standard audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost allocation record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Part of standard audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or business context regarding this cost allocation. Used for documentation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cost allocation transaction was posted to the SAP CO ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and financial reporting period.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation record is a reversal of a previous allocation (True) or an original allocation (False). Used for correction and adjustment tracking.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation is subject to SOX financial controls and requires additional audit documentation (True) or is outside SOX scope (False).

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Represents the currency in which the allocation was originally recorded.

products.name: capex_project
products.description: Capital expenditure project master record tracking Media Broadcasting infrastructure investments from approval through capitalization — covering broadcast tower upgrades, OTT platform builds, studio construction, transmission equipment, and enterprise technology implementations. Captures project code, classification (infrastructure/technology/facilities), approved budget, cumulative spend, asset-under-construction (AUC) account, planned capitalization date, depreciation parameters, responsible cost center, and governance status. Links to fixed_asset upon settlement and to journal_entry for actual cost postings.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure project record. Primary key.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Capital projects (facility upgrades, equipment installations, infrastructure improvements) are executed at specific broadcast facilities. Finance tracks capex spend by facility location for asset capi

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Broadcast equipment capex (transmitter upgrades, tower modifications, EAS equipment) is license-specific and requires FCC notification/approval. Capital planning and asset capitalization must track wh

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Capex projects belong to legal entities for asset ownership and depreciation tracking. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for the capital project. Links to the organizational unit that owns the asset and will bear depreciation expense post-capitalization.

attributes.name: actual_capitalization_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the project was settled to fixed assets and depreciation commenced. Used for SOX compliance and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Asset Master

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when project was completed and ready for asset settlement. Triggers capitalization workflow and depreciation start date calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System - Actual Dates

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when project execution commenced. Used for variance analysis against planned timeline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System - Actual Dates

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital project received formal budget approval from the investment committee or authorized governance body. Marks the start of the capital commitment period.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total capital budget approved for the project by the investment committee. Represents the authorized spending limit for the capital investment.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Fixed asset class code that the project will be capitalized into upon completion. Determines depreciation method, useful life, and GL account assignment. Examples include broadcast equipment, buildings, IT infrastructure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Asset Class

attributes.name: auc_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for the asset under construction balance sheet account. All project costs are accumulated in this account until capitalization. Typically a fixed asset sub-account per chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area or segment for internal management reporting. Examples include Linear Broadcasting, OTT Streaming, News Division, Sports Network. Used for EBITDA segment reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns the capital project. Used for financial statement consolidation and intercompany eliminations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) - Company Code

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the capital project record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cumulative_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure incurred to date on the capital project. Aggregates all posted costs from journal entries and purchase orders. Used for budget variance analysis and capitalization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System - Actual Costs

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all project financial amounts. Typically matches the company code currency for domestic projects.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Planned depreciation method to be applied once the asset is capitalized. Straight line is most common for buildings and infrastructure; declining balance may be used for technology assets; units of production for usage-based assets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Depreciation Key

attributes.name: governance_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the capital project governance review by the investment committee or capital allocation board. Tracks approval workflow and conditional requirements.

attributes.name: investment_justification
attributes.description: Primary business rationale for the capital investment. Capacity expansion includes new studios or transmission capacity; technology upgrade covers platform modernization; regulatory compliance addresses FCC or technical standards; cost reduction targets operational efficiency; revenue generation supports new monetization channels.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Investment Management - Business Case

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the capital project record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the capital project record. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional project context, change history, or special instructions. Used for audit trail and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System - Long Text

attributes.name: planned_capitalization_date
attributes.description: Target date for transferring the asset under construction (AUC) to fixed assets and beginning depreciation. Aligns with asset placed-in-service date for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Asset Master

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for project completion and readiness for capitalization. Used for depreciation planning and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for project execution to begin. Used for resource planning and timeline tracking.

attributes.name: project_classification
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the capital project type. Infrastructure includes broadcast towers and transmission equipment; technology covers OTT platforms and enterprise systems; facilities encompasses studio construction and office build-outs; equipment includes production gear and IRDs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Investment Management - Asset Class

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the capital project, used across financial systems and reporting. Typically follows organizational coding standards for capital investment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) - Project Definition

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the capital project scope, objectives, and deliverables. Provides context for investment justification and asset capitalization.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the capital project, such as 'OTT Platform Infrastructure Upgrade' or 'Studio B Renovation'.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital project. Planning indicates pre-approval stage; approved means budget authorized; in_progress reflects active execution; completed indicates project finished but not yet capitalized; capitalized means transferred to fixed assets; cancelled indicates project terminated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|approved|in_progress|on_hold|completed|capitalized|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System - System Status

attributes.name: remaining_budget_amount
attributes.description: Unspent budget balance available for the project. Calculated as approved budget minus cumulative spend. Used for commitment control and budget monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Investment Management - Budget Control

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment for the capital project considering technical complexity, budget size, timeline, and strategic importance. Used for governance escalation and monitoring frequency.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital project is subject to SOX internal controls for financial reporting. True for projects above materiality thresholds or involving critical financial systems.

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive sponsor or business owner who approved and champions the capital investment. Typically a VP or C-level executive.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation calculation. Determined by asset class and regulatory/tax guidelines. Broadcast towers may be 20-30 years; technology platforms 3-7 years; studio facilities 15-40 years.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) - Useful Life

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: SAP FI-AA authoritative master record for all capitalized fixed assets owned by Media Broadcasting — including broadcast transmission towers, satellite uplink equipment, studio facilities, OTT server infrastructure, production equipment, and capitalized software. Captures asset number, asset class, description, acquisition date, acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value, depreciation method, useful life, cost center, and disposal status. Supports balance sheet reporting and CAPEX-to-asset lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: Fixed assets (cameras, switchers, transmitters, servers) are physically located at broadcast facilities. Finance requires facility location for insurance valuation, property tax allocation, depreciati

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Broadcast transmission assets (transmitters, antennas, towers) are licensed assets with regulatory obligations. Asset register must track license association for FCC technical compliance, insurance, a

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital expenditure project under which this asset was approved and funded. Links the asset to CAPEX budget tracking and project lifecycle.

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Fixed assets belong to legal entities for ownership and depreciation tracking. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this asset. Links the asset to organizational responsibility and budget allocation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: Transmission equipment (transmitters, encoders, satellite uplinks) are capitalized as fixed assets. Finance tracks these for depreciation calculation, insurance valuation, disposal accounting, and reg

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense recognized to date since acquisition. Used to calculate net book value.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The original purchase price or capitalized cost of the asset at the time of acquisition, excluding accumulated depreciation. Represents the gross book value.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was acquired or capitalized. This is the principal business event timestamp marking when the asset entered the company's balance sheet.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification code that categorizes the asset type (e.g., broadcast equipment, studio facilities, transmission towers, OTT infrastructure, production equipment, capitalized software). Determines depreciation rules and financial treatment.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fixed asset including make, model, specifications, and location details. Provides human-readable context for the asset.

attributes.name: asset_location
attributes.description: Physical location or site where the asset is installed or deployed (e.g., transmission tower site, studio facility, data center). Used for asset tracking and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: asset_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the asset. Used for operational context and exception documentation.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique asset number assigned by SAP FI-AA for tracking and identification purposes. This is the business identifier used across financial reporting and asset management processes.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset indicating whether it is in active use, under construction, disposed, retired, or impaired.

attributes.name: asset_sub_number
attributes.description: Sub-asset number used when a main asset is divided into multiple components for separate depreciation tracking (e.g., building structure vs. HVAC system).

attributes.name: asset_super_number
attributes.description: Parent asset number when this asset is part of a larger asset hierarchy (e.g., individual broadcast equipment within a transmission tower complex).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or division to which this asset is allocated (e.g., broadcast operations, streaming platform, production studio). Used for segment reporting.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was placed in service and capitalization began. May differ from acquisition date for assets under construction.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns this asset. Used for financial consolidation and legal reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts associated with this asset (acquisition cost, depreciation, net book value).

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: SAP depreciation area code indicating the valuation view (e.g., 01 for book depreciation, 15 for tax depreciation). Supports parallel accounting.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense for this asset. Determines how the asset's cost is allocated over its useful life.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was disposed, sold, or retired from service. Null for active assets.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: The method by which the asset was disposed (e.g., sale, scrap, donation, trade-in, transfer to another entity, write-off). Null for active assets.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: The amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal. Null for active assets.

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_segment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Reporting Segment
attributes.description: The EBITDA reporting segment to which this asset's depreciation expense is allocated. Used for segment profitability analysis and corporate reporting.

attributes.name: gain_loss_on_disposal
attributes.description: The financial gain or loss recognized upon disposal, calculated as disposal proceeds minus net book value at disposal. Null for active assets.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy number covering this asset. Used for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fixed asset record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or vendor who produced the asset. Used for warranty claims and vendor management.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model number or product code for the asset. Used for parts ordering and technical specifications lookup.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The current carrying value of the asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the asset's current financial value.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number under which the asset was originally procured. Links the asset to procurement records.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The number of years remaining in the asset's useful life as of the current reporting period. Used for forward-looking depreciation planning.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's serial number or unique equipment identifier for the physical asset. Used for warranty tracking and maintenance records.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this asset is subject to SOX financial controls and requires enhanced audit trails and approval workflows.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated number of years over which the asset is expected to provide economic benefit and be depreciated. Used in depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Used for vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manufacturer's warranty for this asset expires. Used for maintenance planning and cost forecasting.

products.name: depreciation_run
products.description: Record of each periodic depreciation calculation and posting run executed in SAP FI-AA for Media Broadcasting fixed assets. Captures depreciation run date, company code, asset class, depreciation area, planned depreciation amount, posted depreciation amount, depreciation method, fiscal period, run status, and error count. Provides the audit trail for asset value reduction postings and supports period-end close and balance sheet accuracy.

attributes.name: depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the depreciation calculation and posting run. Primary key for the depreciation run record.

attributes.name: company_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Depreciation runs are executed per legal entity in SAP FI-AA. The company_code is a business key reference to legal_entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Depreciation can be allocated to cost centers for expense tracking. The cost_center_code STRING column will be replaced by FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Depreciation can be allocated to profit centers for P&L tracking. The profit_center_code STRING column will be replaced by FK to profit_center.profit_center_id.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification code grouping fixed assets by type (e.g., broadcast equipment, studio facilities, transmission towers, vehicles, IT infrastructure). Determines default depreciation methods, useful life, and general ledger account assignments.

attributes.name: asset_count
attributes.description: The total number of fixed asset records processed in this depreciation run for the specified company code, asset class, and depreciation area. Used for run completeness validation and audit trail.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Four-character code representing the business area (e.g., broadcast operations, digital streaming, production services) for segment reporting. Enables EBITDA tracking and financial analysis by business line.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the legal entity within the SAP enterprise structure for which depreciation is calculated. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation run record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and supports SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which depreciation amounts are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Aligns with company code currency and general ledger posting currency.

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: Two-digit code representing the depreciation area (e.g., 01 for book depreciation, 15 for tax depreciation, 20 for group consolidation). Allows parallel valuation of assets according to different accounting principles and legal requirements.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the depreciation calculation method applied (e.g., straight-line, declining balance, units of production). Determines how asset value reduction is calculated over the useful life.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The document date assigned to the general ledger posting document created by the depreciation run. Typically matches the last day of the posting period for period-end depreciation postings.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit SAP financial document number generated when depreciation amounts are posted to the general ledger. Provides the link between asset accounting and financial accounting for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_segment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Reporting Segment
attributes.description: The EBITDA reporting segment to which this depreciation run contributes. Used for segment-level financial analysis and executive reporting of operating performance before depreciation impact.

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: The number of asset records that encountered errors during the depreciation calculation or posting process. Non-zero values trigger exception handling and require investigation before period-end close.

attributes.name: error_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the detailed error log generated during the depreciation run. Used for troubleshooting and resolving posting errors before period-end close.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the depreciation run was executed. Represents the accounting period year in which the depreciation expense is recognized.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation run record was last updated. Tracks changes to run status, posted amounts, or other attributes for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: posted_depreciation_amount

attributes.name: repeat_run_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this run is a repeat execution for a period that was previously processed. True indicates repeat run to correct prior errors; false indicates initial run for the period.

attributes.name: reversal_date

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP financial document number of the reversal posting if this depreciation run was reversed. Null if no reversal has occurred. Links to the reversing document for audit trail.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this depreciation run was subsequently reversed due to errors or period adjustments. True indicates the run was reversed; false indicates the run remains active.

attributes.name: run_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the depreciation run completed processing (successfully or with errors). Used to calculate run duration and monitor period-end close performance.

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the depreciation calculation and posting run was executed. Used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: run_initiated_by_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person or system account that initiated the depreciation run. Provides accountability and audit trail for period-end close activities and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the depreciation run. Tracks progression from initiation through completion or failure, supporting period-end close monitoring and exception management.

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the depreciation run was initiated in the SAP FI-AA system. Provides granular audit trail for period-end close activities.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Categorization of the depreciation run execution. Planned runs are scheduled periodic calculations; unplanned runs address mid-period adjustments; repeat runs correct prior errors; test runs validate configuration without posting.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this depreciation run is subject to SOX internal control requirements for financial reporting accuracy. True indicates SOX-controlled process requiring additional audit trail and approval workflows.

attributes.name: test_run_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this was a test run executed to validate depreciation calculations without posting to the general ledger. True indicates test mode; false indicates production posting run.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between planned depreciation amount and posted depreciation amount (posted minus planned). Positive variance indicates over-posting; negative variance indicates under-posting. Used for reconciliation and exception investigation.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: The number of asset records that generated warnings during the depreciation run. Warnings indicate potential data quality issues or configuration anomalies that do not prevent posting but require review.

products.name: facility_legal_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the legal and financial relationship between a legal entity and a broadcast facility. It captures ownership structure, cost allocation, and operational responsibility for facilities that may be owned, leased, or shared across multiple legal entities within the Media Broadcasting corporate structure. Each record links one legal entity to one broadcast facility with attributes that define the nature of the legal and financial relationship, supporting intercompany charging, tax compliance, and regulatory reporting.. Existence Justification: In Media Broadcasting corporate structures, legal entities commonly operate multiple broadcast facilities (studios, NOCs, transmission sites) across geographic regions, and facilities are frequently shared across multiple legal entities through co-location arrangements, shared services models, or intercompany leasing. The business actively manages these assignments for financial reporting (cost allocation, intercompany charging), tax compliance (property tax responsibility, VAT registration), and regulatory reporting (SOX scope, broadcast license holder designation). This is an operational relationship tracked in ERP and financial systems, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: project_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between capex_project and employee. It captures the formal assignment of employees to capital expenditure projects in various roles beyond the single project manager. Each record links one capex_project to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this project assignment relationship, including role, time allocation, assignment dates, and billability status.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting capital projects, multiple employees participate in different specialized roles (project manager, technical lead, finance controller, procurement specialist, engineers, architects) with varying time allocations and assignment periods. Employees work on multiple concurrent capex projects (e.g., a finance controller may oversee budget compliance for 3-4 projects simultaneously at 25% allocation each). The business actively manages these assignments as a workforce planning and project governance process, tracking who is assigned to which project, in what role, for what time period, and at what allocation percentage.

products.name: obligation_gl_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the mapping between regulatory obligations and chart of accounts entries. It captures how each regulatory obligation flows through specific general ledger accounts for financial tracking, cost allocation, and regulatory reporting. Each record links one regulatory obligation to one GL account with mapping rules that govern how compliance costs are recorded and reported.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, regulatory obligations generate financial impacts across multiple GL accounts (e.g., FCC license fees flow through both regulatory expense and prepaid accounts; EAS equipment obligations touch capex, depreciation, and maintenance accounts). Conversely, each GL account receives postings from multiple regulatory obligations (e.g., the 'Regulatory Compliance Expense' account aggregates costs from content regulations, licensing, EAS, closed captioning, and public file obligations). The compliance and finance teams actively manage these mappings to ensure proper cost allocation, accrual accounting, and regulatory financial reporting.

True for obligations with annual fees that must be accrued monthly, regulatory penalties under dispute, or multi-year license fees. Corresponds to accrual_required_flag from detection data.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_rule
attributes.description: Business rule describing how costs for this obligation should be allocated to this GL account. May reference allocation keys, cost centers, profit centers, or percentage splits (e.g., 'Allocate 60% to linear TV cost center, 40% to OTT', 'Direct charge to broadcast operations functional area'). Corresponds to cost_allocation_rule from detection data.

Corresponds to effective_date from detection data.

attributes.description: Estimated annual financial impact of this obligation in this GL account, in the account's currency. Used for budgeting, forecasting, and materiality assessments. May be null for event-driven obligations with unpredictable costs.

attributes.name: mapping_status

attributes.name: mapping_type

Corresponds to obligation_gl_mapping_type from detection data.

attributes.name: notes
