attributes.description: The financial statement line item or regulatory report line where this obligation-account combination should be reported. Used for external regulatory financial reporting (e.g., FCC Form 323, Ofcom Annual Return) and internal management reporting. Corresponds to reporting_line_item from detection data.

products.name: cost_center_obligation_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of regulatory compliance responsibility and budget across cost centers for specific regulatory obligations. It captures the distributed accountability model where multiple cost centers share responsibility for meeting a single regulatory obligation (e.g., EEO compliance spans HR and station cost centers; closed captioning spans production and engineering). Each record links one cost_center to one regulatory_obligation with allocation percentage, responsible contact, compliance budget, and review dates that exist only in the context of this shared responsibility relationship.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, regulatory obligations such as EEO compliance, closed captioning requirements, and content licensing span multiple organizational cost centers. A single regulatory obligation (e.g., FCC closed captioning compliance) requires coordinated effort and budget from production studios, engineering operations, and quality assurance cost centers. Conversely, a single cost center (e.g., Digital Platform Operations) is responsible for portions of multiple regulatory obligations (content licensing, data privacy, accessibility standards). The business actively manages these allocations with specific budget amounts, responsible contacts, and review schedules for each cost center-obligation pairing.

products.name: cost_center_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization relationship between cost_center and employee. It captures the formal approval authority granted to employees for specific cost centers, including their role, authorization level, approval limits, and validity period. Each record links one cost_center to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting organizations, cost centers require multiple authorized approvers with different roles and approval limits for financial control and segregation of duties. A single cost center has multiple employees authorized to approve transactions (department heads, finance controllers, procurement managers, budget owners), each with specific authorization levels and monetary limits. Conversely, senior employees (VPs, finance directors) hold approval authority across multiple cost centers within their span of control. The current model's single responsible_manager_employee_id cannot represent this multi-approver authorization structure.

products.name: facility_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the cost allocation relationship between cost centers and broadcast facilities in Media Broadcasting operations. It captures how operational costs are distributed across shared physical infrastructure when multiple departments (news, sports, production, engineering) utilize the same studios, master control rooms, NOCs, and transmission sites. Each record links one cost center to one broadcast facility with allocation percentages, usage periods, and metrics that exist only in the context of this shared-resource relationship.. Existence Justification: In Media Broadcasting operations, broadcast facilities (studios, master control rooms, NOCs, transmission sites) are shared infrastructure used by multiple operational cost centers simultaneously. A single studio facility serves news, sports, and entertainment production departments, while a single cost center like 'Digital Platform Operations' utilizes multiple facilities (studio, NOC, data center) across different locations. The business actively manages these allocation relationships to distribute facility overhead costs for accurate departmental P&L and EBITDA reporting.

products.name: compliance_consent_record
products.description: Authoritative log of audience and subscriber consent events for data collection, processing, and marketing under GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, and emerging state privacy laws. Captures consent subject (subscriber, registered user, or anonymous viewer), consent type (data processing, marketing, profiling, cookies, targeted advertising, cross-device tracking), consent status (granted, withdrawn, expired, not-yet-given), consent mechanism (CMP banner, registration form, opt-in email, in-app toggle), jurisdiction, consent timestamp, expiry date, version of privacy policy accepted, and withdrawal mechanism used. Serves as the legal basis record for all personal data processing and the primary evidence artifact for regulatory audits.

products.name: sox_control
products.description: Master registry of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls applicable to the organization's financial reporting processes, with emphasis on media-specific revenue streams. Captures control ID, control name, control objective, process area (advertising revenue recognition, carriage fee billing, subscriber billing, content licensing revenue, rights royalty accruals, barter transactions), control type (preventive, detective, IT general, IT application), frequency (continuous, daily, monthly, quarterly, annual), control owner, last test date, test result (effective, ineffective with exception, ineffective), deficiency classification (control deficiency, significant deficiency, material weakness), remediation plan, and management assertion mapping. Supports SOX Section 302 and 404 compliance for publicly traded media companies.
products.reference: SOX Section 302 / SOX Section 404 / PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SOX control record. Primary key for the sox_control product.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: SOX control deficiencies are documented as audit findings. This FK links a SOX control to any audit finding that identified a deficiency in that control. Note: Using 'related_audit_finding_id' as the

attributes.name: compensating_control_id
attributes.description: Reference to another SOX control that serves as a compensating control if this control fails or is temporarily inactive. Compensating controls provide alternative assurance over the same financial reporting risk.

attributes.name: control_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SOX controls require named employee owners for accountability in financial reporting compliance. Control owner text should reference employee record for audit trail and performance tracking.

attributes.name: assertion_category
attributes.description: The financial statement assertion that this control addresses. Existence ensures recorded transactions occurred; completeness ensures all transactions are recorded; accuracy ensures amounts are correct; valuation ensures proper measurement; rights and obligations ensure the entity has legal claim; presentation and disclosure ensure proper classification and disclosure; cutoff ensures transactions are recorded in the correct period. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: existence|completeness|accuracy|valuation|rights and obligations|presentation and disclosure|cutoff — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auditor_notes
attributes.description: Comments and observations from internal or external auditors regarding control design, operating effectiveness, or areas for improvement. Supports audit trail and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: automated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is fully automated (True) or requires manual execution (False). Automated controls are typically embedded in financial systems and execute without human intervention.

attributes.name: control_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the control activity, including specific procedures, data sources, systems involved, thresholds, and documentation requirements. For media companies, may reference systems such as Wide Orbit (traffic and billing), Rightsline (rights management), or Zuora (subscription billing).

attributes.name: control_documentation_path
attributes.description: File path or document management system reference to the detailed control documentation, including procedures, flowcharts, and testing workpapers. Used for audit evidence and compliance verification.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is performed or operates. Continuous controls run automatically in real-time (e.g., system validations); periodic controls are executed at defined intervals; event-driven controls are triggered by specific business events (e.g., contract execution, content release). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|event-driven — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the control that summarizes its purpose (e.g., 'Advertising Revenue Recognition Review', 'Subscriber Billing Reconciliation').
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the control, typically formatted as a prefix code followed by a numeric sequence (e.g., FIN-001, REV-1234). Used for external reference and audit documentation.

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: Detailed statement of what the control is designed to achieve, including the specific financial reporting assertion it addresses (existence, completeness, accuracy, valuation, rights and obligations, presentation and disclosure).

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the control. Active controls are in effect; inactive controls are temporarily suspended; under remediation indicates deficiencies are being addressed; pending implementation means the control is designed but not yet operational; retired controls are no longer applicable.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its nature and timing. Preventive controls stop errors before they occur; detective controls identify errors after occurrence; IT general controls (ITGC) govern system access and change management; IT application controls are embedded in financial systems; entity-level controls address governance and culture; management review controls involve oversight and analysis.
attributes.value_regex: preventive|detective|it general control|it application control|entity level control|management review control

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for control lifecycle management.

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Severity classification of any identified control deficiency. No deficiency means the control is effective; control deficiency is a minor issue unlikely to result in misstatement; significant deficiency is important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance; material weakness is a deficiency or combination of deficiencies that creates a reasonable possibility of material misstatement not being prevented or detected.

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of any identified control deficiency, including the nature of the failure, root cause analysis, and potential impact on financial reporting. Null if no deficiency exists.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the control became operational and began addressing the identified financial reporting risk. Used to track control lifecycle and determine testing periods.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: financial_statement_line_item
attributes.description: The specific financial statement account or line item that this control impacts (e.g., 'Advertising Revenue', 'Subscription Revenue', 'Content Amortization Expense', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Deferred Revenue'). Maps control to financial reporting impact.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: key_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a key control (True) that directly addresses a significant risk to financial reporting, or a supporting control (False). Key controls receive more rigorous testing and documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this control record. Tracks changes to control design, ownership, status, or test results.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the control was formally tested for design and operating effectiveness by internal audit, external auditors, or control owners.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: management_assertion_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping of this control to management's assertions under SOX Section 302 (CEO/CFO certification) and Section 404 (internal control over financial reporting). Documents how this control supports management's ability to assert the effectiveness of internal controls.

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The business process or financial cycle to which this control applies. Media-specific areas include advertising revenue recognition (CPM, GRP-based billing), carriage fee billing (MVPD/vMVPD distribution payments), subscriber billing (SVOD, TVOD), content licensing revenue (syndication, windowing), rights royalty accruals (talent residuals, music licensing), and barter transactions (ad inventory exchanges). attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Action plan to address identified deficiencies, including specific corrective actions, responsible parties, and target completion dates. Null if no remediation is required.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation efforts for identified deficiencies. Not applicable if no deficiency exists; planned means remediation is designed but not started; in progress indicates active remediation; completed means actions are finished but not yet validated; validated means remediation has been tested and confirmed effective.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: remediation_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which remediation activities are expected to be completed and validated. Null if no remediation is required.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the control was retired or superseded by another control. Null for active controls. Used for historical tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the inherent risk level associated with the process area this control addresses. Critical and high ratings indicate areas with significant potential for material misstatement if controls fail.

attributes.name: system_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary financial or operational system in which the control is executed or from which control evidence is derived (e.g., 'SAP S/4HANA FI', 'Wide Orbit Traffic', 'Zuora Billing', 'Rightsline Rights Management').

attributes.name: test_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is formally tested for effectiveness. Quarterly testing is typical for key controls; annual testing may suffice for lower-risk controls; event-driven testing occurs when significant changes are made to the control or underlying process.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent control test. Effective means the control operated as designed with no exceptions; ineffective with exception indicates isolated failures that do not rise to a deficiency; ineffective means the control did not operate as designed; not tested means no evaluation has been performed.

products.name: audit_finding

Captures audit type, audit period, auditor (internal/external), finding category, severity (critical, high, medium, low), affected process or system, root cause, recommended remediation, remediation owner, target resolution date, and closure status. Drives the compliance remediation workflow.

products.name: facility_compliance_obligation
products.description: This association product represents the compliance tracking relationship between accessibility obligations and broadcast facilities. It captures facility-specific compliance status, review schedules, exemptions, and waivers for each accessibility requirement at each physical location. Each record links one accessibility obligation to one broadcast facility with compliance metrics and dates that exist only in the context of this specific facility-obligation pairing.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, each accessibility obligation (closed captioning, audio description, emergency alert accessibility, etc.) applies to multiple physical facilities (studios, NOCs, transmission sites), and each facility must comply with multiple accessibility obligations. Compliance is tracked and managed at the facility level because different facilities have different compliance statuses, review schedules, exemptions, and waiver expiration dates for the same obligation. The compliance team actively manages these facility-obligation pairings as part of regulatory reporting and audit preparation.

products.name: facility_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between regulatory obligations and broadcast facilities. It captures facility-specific compliance status, review schedules, exemptions, and responsible parties for each obligation at each facility. Each record links one regulatory obligation to one broadcast facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific facility-obligation compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, regulatory obligations apply to multiple facilities based on facility type and jurisdiction (e.g., EAS participation applies to all transmission sites, public inspection file requirements apply to all studios, tower lighting standards apply to all transmission towers), and each facility must comply with multiple obligations simultaneously (e.g., a studio must comply with EAS, public file, accessibility, content standards). Compliance officers actively manage facility-specific compliance status, review schedules, exemptions, and responsible parties for each obligation at each facility - this is an operational compliance tracking process, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.description: Earnings from regular hours worked at the base hourly or salary rate. Excludes overtime and other premium pay.

attributes.name: retirement_401k_deduction
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax or Roth contribution to 401(k) retirement savings plan.

attributes.name: social_security_tax
attributes.description: Employee portion of Social Security tax withheld under the Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA).

attributes.name: state_income_tax
attributes.description: Amount withheld for state income tax based on state tax regulations and employee elections.

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all tax withholdings and voluntary deductions subtracted from gross pay.

attributes.name: vision_insurance_deduction
attributes.description: Employee portion of vision insurance premium deducted from payroll.

attributes.name: adjusted_payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payroll_record (adjusted_payroll_record_id)

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of an employee's enrollment in a specific benefit plan — health insurance (medical/dental/vision), life insurance, disability insurance, 401k/pension, FSA/HSA, commuter benefits, or employee assistance programs. Captures plan name, plan type, coverage tier (employee only/employee+spouse/family), enrollment date, effective date, termination date, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, beneficiary designations, and enrollment source (open enrollment/qualifying life event/new hire).

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific benefit plan in which the employee is enrolling. Links to the benefit plan master record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is enrolling in the benefit plan. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: For FSA, HSA, or other contribution-based plans, the total annual amount the employee elected to contribute for the plan year. Expressed in USD. Nullable for non-contribution plans.
attributes.references: IRS Code Section 125 (FSA), IRS Code Section 223 (HSA)

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance carrier or benefits provider administering this plan (e.g., Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Fidelity, Vanguard). Used for vendor management and claims coordination.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 103, Internal Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: contingent_beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the contingent (secondary) beneficiary who receives benefits if the primary beneficiary is deceased or unable to receive benefits. Nullable if no contingent beneficiary designated.

attributes.name: contingent_beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the contingent beneficiary to the employee. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|domestic_partner|other_relative|friend|estate|trust|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: For life insurance and disability plans, the face value or benefit amount of the coverage (e.g., $100,000 life insurance, 60% salary replacement for disability). Expressed in USD or as a percentage. Nullable for non-insurance benefits.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The level of coverage selected by the employee, determining who is covered under the benefit plan (employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, full family, or employee plus domestic partner).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this enrollment record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA HR, Workday, ADP, Benefits Administration Portal). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage begins and becomes active. This may differ from enrollment_date due to waiting periods or plan year start dates.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount that the employee contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or plan cost. Expressed in USD. For retirement plans, this may represent the employee deferral percentage converted to dollar amount.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee contribution is deducted from payroll or paid by the employee.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount that the employer contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or plan cost. Expressed in USD. For retirement plans, this may include employer match or profit-sharing contributions.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employer contribution is made toward the benefit plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: A confirmation or transaction number provided by the benefits administration system or carrier when the enrollment is processed. Used for audit trail and employee inquiries.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee submitted or completed the benefit enrollment election. This is the transaction date when the enrollment decision was made.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104, Internal HR Audit Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the benefit enrollment, typically used in HR systems and employee communications. Format: BEN-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The triggering event or process that allowed this enrollment to occur. New hire indicates initial employment enrollment; open enrollment indicates annual election period; qualifying life event (QLE) indicates mid-year change due to marriage, birth, etc.; plan change indicates employee-initiated modification; rehire indicates return to employment.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311, HIPAA Special Enrollment Rights

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date; active indicates currently in force; terminated indicates coverage has ended; suspended indicates temporary hold; cancelled indicates enrollment was voided before becoming active; waived indicates employee declined coverage.
attributes.references: ERISA Reporting Requirements, Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee must provide medical evidence of insurability (health questionnaire, medical exam) to qualify for this coverage level. Typically required for supplemental life insurance above guaranteed issue amounts.
attributes.references: HIPAA Portability Provisions, Insurance Carrier Requirements

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: If evidence_of_insurability_required is true, this field tracks the status of the EOI submission and approval process. Not_required indicates no EOI needed; pending indicates awaiting carrier review; approved indicates coverage granted; denied indicates coverage declined; incomplete indicates additional information needed.
attributes.references: HIPAA Portability Provisions, Insurance Carrier Requirements

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: The marketing or display name of the benefit plan as presented to employees (e.g., 'Premium Health PPO', 'Basic Dental Plan', '401k Traditional').

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan. Includes health insurance (medical/dental/vision), life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plans (401k/pension), flexible spending accounts (FSA), health savings accounts (HSA), commuter benefits, employee assistance programs (EAP), and supplemental coverage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability_insurance|retirement_401k|retirement_pension|fsa|hsa|commuter_benefits|employee_assistance_program|supplemental_life|critical_illness|accident_insurance — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act), IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which this enrollment is effective. Used to track enrollments across annual benefit cycles and open enrollment periods. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The carriers policy or group number under which this enrollment is covered. Used for claims processing and carrier coordination. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the primary beneficiary designated to receive benefits in the event of the employees death. Applicable primarily to life insurance and retirement plans. Nullable if no beneficiary designated.

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of benefits allocated to the primary beneficiary. Typically 100 for single beneficiary or split among multiple. Value range 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the primary beneficiary to the employee. Used for compliance and verification purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|domestic_partner|other_relative|friend|estate|trust|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the qualifying life event occurred (e.g., marriage date, birth date, loss of coverage date). Nullable for non-QLE enrollments. Used to validate enrollment timing compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Provisions, ACA Section 1311(c)(6)

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: If enrollment_source is qualifying_life_event, this field specifies the type of life event that triggered the mid-year enrollment change. Nullable for non-QLE enrollments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death_of_dependent|loss_of_coverage|employment_status_change|dependent_age_limit|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Provisions, ACA Section 1311(c)(6)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage ends. Nullable for active enrollments. Populated when employee terminates employment, changes plans, or reaches plan end date.

attributes.name: tobacco_user_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee declared tobacco use during enrollment. Used for premium rating and wellness program eligibility. Protected health information under HIPAA.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: The total cost of the benefit plan per pay period, representing the sum of employee and employer contributions. Expressed in USD. Used for financial reporting and cost analysis.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: If enrollment_status is waived, this field captures the reason the employee declined coverage (e.g., covered under spouses plan, Medicare eligible, cost concerns). Free-text field for HR documentation. Nullable for non-waived enrollments.

attributes.name: wellness_program_participant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee is participating in employer-sponsored wellness programs that may affect premium rates or provide incentives.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2705, HIPAA Wellness Program Rules

attributes.name: superseded_benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on benefit_enrollment (superseded_benefit_enrollment_id)

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Transactional record of each employee leave request submitted at Media Broadcasting — vacation, sick leave, FMLA, parental leave, bereavement, jury duty, military leave, and unpaid leave. Captures request date, leave type, requested start date, requested end date, total days requested, approval status, approving manager, approval date, denial reason if applicable, FMLA certification status, intermittent leave flag, and actual leave taken dates. Feeds time and attendance systems and payroll deduction calculations.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request. Primary key for the leave request transaction.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the department where the employee works at the time of the leave request. Used for departmental leave analytics and staffing impact analysis.

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_substitute_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee designated to cover the absent employee's responsibilities during the leave period. Null if no formal substitute assigned.

attributes.name: actual_days_taken
attributes.description: Actual number of leave days taken, calculated from time and attendance records. Used for leave balance deduction and payroll processing.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual last date the employee was absent on approved leave. May differ from requested end date if employee returned early or extended leave.

attributes.name: actual_hours_taken
attributes.description: Actual number of leave hours taken, calculated from time and attendance records. Used for hourly leave balance deduction and payroll processing.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual first date the employee was absent on approved leave. May differ from requested start date if employee returned early or extended leave.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the approving manager made the approval or denial decision. Null if request is still pending.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the leave request: pending (awaiting manager review), approved (manager approved), denied (manager rejected), cancelled (approved but later cancelled by manager), withdrawn (employee withdrew before approval decision).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the approving manager made the approval or denial decision, including time zone. Used for audit trail and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes provided by the employee when submitting the leave request, such as reason for leave or special circumstances.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which the employee's time is charged. Used for financial reporting and labor cost allocation during leave periods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave request record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the manager when denying a leave request. Null if request was approved or is still pending.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized categorical reason for denial: staffing_shortage (inadequate coverage), blackout_period (restricted dates such as sweeps or upfront periods), insufficient_notice (did not meet advance notice policy), policy_violation (does not meet eligibility or usage rules), other (see denial_reason for details).

attributes.name: fmla_certification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Certification Date
attributes.description: Date when FMLA medical certification was received and approved by HR. Null for non-FMLA leave or if certification not yet approved.

attributes.name: fmla_certification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Certification Status
attributes.description: Status of required medical certification for FMLA leave: not_required (non-FMLA leave), pending (certification requested but not yet received), received (certification submitted by employee), approved (HR approved certification), insufficient (certification does not meet requirements).

attributes.name: fmla_protected_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Protected Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request is protected under the Family and Medical Leave Act. True if FMLA-eligible and certified.

attributes.name: intermittent_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an intermittent leave request (multiple non-consecutive absences for the same condition) rather than a continuous block of leave. Common for FMLA medical treatment schedules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave request record was last updated in the system. Tracks changes to approval status, actual dates, or other fields.

attributes.name: leave_balance_after
attributes.description: Employee's remaining leave balance in days or hours after this request was approved and taken. Used for leave accrual and entitlement tracking.

attributes.name: leave_balance_before
attributes.description: Employee's available leave balance in days or hours before this request was approved and taken. Snapshot for audit and balance tracking.

attributes.name: leave_subtype
attributes.description: Optional granular classification within the leave type, such as maternity vs paternity under parental leave, or continuous vs intermittent under FMLA.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Category of leave being requested: vacation (paid time off), sick (illness or medical appointments), FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act protected leave), parental (maternity/paternity/adoption), bereavement (death of family member), jury_duty (civic duty), military (military service), unpaid (leave without pay).
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825, Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes provided by the approving manager when reviewing the leave request, such as approval conditions or coverage arrangements.

attributes.name: paid_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave is paid (employee receives regular compensation) or unpaid (no compensation during absence). Drives payroll deduction calculations.

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: Payroll period (YYYY-MM format) in which this leave was processed for compensation adjustments. Used to reconcile leave with payroll cycles.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request has been processed by payroll for deductions or adjustments. True once payroll cycle has incorporated the leave.

attributes.name: reduced_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request involves a reduced work schedule (working fewer hours per day or days per week) rather than full-day absences. Common for FMLA return-to-work transitions.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the leave request. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the leave request, typically formatted as LR-YYYYNNNN for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the requested leave period. Employee intends to return to work the following business day.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the requested leave period. Employee intends to be absent starting this date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this leave request record originated, typically SAP S/4HANA HR or a time and attendance system.

attributes.name: total_days_requested
attributes.description: Total number of leave days requested, calculated as business days between start and end dates. May include fractional days for partial-day leave.

attributes.name: total_hours_requested
attributes.description: Total number of leave hours requested, used for hourly leave tracking and partial-day absences. Supports intermittent FMLA leave measured in hours.

attributes.name: original_leave_request_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on leave_request (original_leave_request_id)

products.name: leave_balance
products.description: Master record tracking the accrued and available leave balances for each employee across all leave types — vacation, sick, PTO, floating holiday, and comp time. Captures balance as of date, accrued hours/days in current period, used hours/days in current period, carried-over balance from prior year, forfeited balance, and adjusted balance. Updated each pay period by the payroll and time-tracking systems. Enables HR and managers to monitor leave liability and enforce accrual caps per Media Broadcasting policy.

attributes.name: leave_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave balance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee to whom this leave balance belongs. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Personnel Number

attributes.name: accrual_cap
attributes.description: Maximum leave balance that can be accrued for this leave type per Media Broadcasting policy. Once reached, no further accrual occurs until balance drops below cap.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Maximum

attributes.name: accrual_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current accrual period. Balances may reset, roll over, or be forfeited at this boundary per policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Period

attributes.name: accrual_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current accrual period (e.g., calendar year, fiscal year, or anniversary year depending on Media Broadcasting policy).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Period

attributes.name: accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which leave accrues per pay period or per hour worked, based on employee tenure and policy tier. Expressed in hours or days per unit time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Accrual Rate

attributes.name: accrued_current_period
attributes.description: Total leave hours or days accrued during the current period based on accrual rate and service time. Updated each pay period by payroll system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Accrual

attributes.name: adjusted_balance
attributes.description: Manual adjustments to the leave balance (positive or negative) made by HR for corrections, policy exceptions, or one-time grants. Includes adjustment reason in notes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Manual Time Quota Adjustment

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: Current available leave balance that the employee can request. Calculated as: opening_balance + accrued_current_period - used_current_period + adjusted_balance - pending_requests.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Available Time Quota

attributes.name: balance_as_of_date
attributes.description: The date as of which this leave balance snapshot is accurate. Typically updated at the end of each pay period or after a leave transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Evaluation Date

attributes.name: carried_over_balance
attributes.description: Leave balance carried forward from the prior accrual period. Subject to carryover caps per Media Broadcasting policy (e.g., maximum 40 hours vacation carryover).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Carryover

attributes.name: carryover_cap
attributes.description: Maximum leave balance that can be carried over to the next accrual period. Any balance above this cap is forfeited per policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Carryover Limit

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave balance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current eligibility status of the employee for this leave type. Ineligible may apply during probation, leave of absence, or termination notice period.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting HR Policy Manual - Leave Eligibility

attributes.name: forfeited_balance
attributes.description: Leave hours or days forfeited at the end of the prior period due to exceeding carryover caps or use-it-or-lose-it policy. Represents lost leave liability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Forfeiture

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave balance record is currently active. Inactive records represent historical snapshots or terminated leave types.

attributes.name: last_accrual_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent leave accrual transaction for this employee and leave type. Typically aligns with pay period end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Last Time Evaluation Date

attributes.name: last_usage_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent leave usage (deduction) for this employee and leave type. Helps identify stale balances and usage patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Last Absence Date

attributes.name: leave_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of leave (e.g., VAC for vacation, SICK for sick leave, PTO for paid time off, FLOAT for floating holiday, COMP for compensatory time). Standardized codes per Media Broadcasting HR policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Absence Type

attributes.name: leave_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the leave type (e.g., Vacation, Sick Leave, Personal Time Off, Floating Holiday, Compensatory Time).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Absence Type Text

attributes.name: liability_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the current available leave balance, calculated as available_balance multiplied by the employees hourly or daily rate. Represents financial liability for Media Broadcasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - Accrued Leave Liability

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding this leave balance record, including reasons for manual adjustments, policy exceptions, or special circumstances documented by HR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Notes

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: Leave balance at the start of the current accrual period, including any carryover from the prior period. Expressed in hours or days per unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Opening Balance

attributes.name: pending_requests
attributes.description: Total leave hours or days currently requested but not yet approved or denied. Represents potential future deductions from available balance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Pending Absence Requests

attributes.name: policy_tier
attributes.description: The accrual policy tier applicable to this employee for this leave type, typically based on tenure or job level (e.g., Tier 1: 0-2 years, Tier 2: 3-5 years, Tier 3: 6+ years).
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting HR Policy Manual - Leave Accrual Tiers

attributes.name: projected_year_end_balance
attributes.description: Forecasted leave balance at the end of the current accrual period, assuming no further usage. Used for liability planning and to alert employees of potential forfeitures.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting HR Analytics - Leave Liability Forecast

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which leave balance is tracked and reported: hours or days. Standardized per leave type and employee classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Unit

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this leave balance record. Supports audit and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave balance record was last modified. Updated each pay period or after leave transactions. Audit trail for record lifecycle.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: used_current_period
attributes.description: Total leave hours or days used (taken) by the employee during the current period. Sourced from approved leave requests and time-tracking system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module - Time Quota Deduction

attributes.name: prior_leave_balance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on leave_balance (prior_leave_balance_id)

products.name: timesheet
products.description: Transactional record of an employee's time worked for a specific pay period — capturing regular hours, overtime hours, double-time hours, on-call hours, and shift differential hours by day. Includes timesheet period start/end, submission date, approval status, approving manager, total hours submitted, total hours approved, project/cost center allocation codes, and any time-off hours included. Critical for broadcast operations staff working irregular shifts, live event crews, and production personnel subject to union overtime rules.

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.channel. Business justification: Timesheets in broadcast operations track which channel/property work was performed for. Essential for cost allocation, project tracking, and channel P&L reporting. Standard practice in multi-channel b

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary work location or facility where the employee performed work during this timesheet period. Links to location master record.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the department to which the employee belongs during this timesheet period. Links to department master record.

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_schedule. Business justification: Crew timesheets reference specific program schedules they worked on (e.g., production crew for specific broadcast). Production cost tracking and labor accounting requires linking timesheets to program

attributes.name: timesheet_approving_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved or is responsible for approving this timesheet. Links to employee master record.

attributes.name: timesheet_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who submitted this timesheet. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: timesheet_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this timesheet record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the timesheet was approved by the manager. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the timesheet in the workflow. Tracks progression from draft through submission, approval, or rejection.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the timesheet was approved, used for audit trail and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which the timesheet hours are allocated for financial reporting and departmental cost tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timesheet record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Total number of double-time hours worked, typically compensated at 2x regular rate. Common for holiday work, excessive overtime, or seventh consecutive day worked per union agreements.
attributes.references: Union Collective Bargaining Agreements, State Labor Laws

attributes.name: holiday_hours
attributes.description: Total number of paid holiday hours included in this timesheet period for recognized company holidays.
attributes.references: Company HR Policy, Union Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timesheet record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by the employee or manager regarding this timesheet, such as explanations for unusual hours or special circumstances.

attributes.name: on_call_hours
attributes.description: Total number of on-call hours during the pay period. Relevant for broadcast engineers and technical staff required to be available for emergency playout or transmission issues.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the pay period, typically compensated at 1.5x regular rate. Critical for broadcast operations staff working irregular shifts and live event crews subject to union overtime rules.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), Union Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Pay grade or salary band of the employee during this timesheet period. Used for compensation calculation and reporting. Business-confidential information.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the pay period covered by this timesheet. Defines the end of the time reporting window.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the pay period covered by this timesheet. Defines the beginning of the time reporting window.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet has been processed by the payroll system. True if processed, False if pending.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Project or production code to which the timesheet hours are allocated. Used for cost tracking and project accounting in content production and live event operations.

attributes.name: pto_hours
attributes.description: Total number of paid time off hours included in this timesheet period, including vacation, sick leave, and personal days.

attributes.name: regular_hours

attributes.name: innovation_rating

attributes.name: goal_id

attributes.description: Reference to the department or organizational unit to which this goal is aligned. Supports departmental goal rollup and reporting. Links to the department master record.

attributes.name: review_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the performance review cycle or period to which this goal belongs (e.g., 2024 Annual Review, Q2 2024 Quarterly Review). Links to the review cycle master record.

attributes.name: achievement_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage of goal completion based on current value relative to target value. Values over 100% indicate the goal was exceeded. Used for performance scoring and reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of goal approval. Draft: being created by employee; pending approval: submitted to manager; approved: accepted by manager; rejected: not accepted; revision requested: manager requested changes before approval.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the manager approved this goal. Null if the goal has not yet been approved.

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: Starting or current value of the metric at the time the goal was set. Provides context for measuring progress and improvement (e.g., current audience reach before the goal period).

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the goal was marked as completed or achieved. Null if the goal is still in progress or not yet achieved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this goal record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and goal lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_value
attributes.description: Most recent measured value of the target metric, reflecting progress toward the goal. Updated periodically as performance data becomes available.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date by which the goal should be achieved. Used to assess timeliness of goal attainment and plan performance reviews.

attributes.name: employee_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the employee documenting progress, challenges encountered, resources needed, or self-assessment. Supports employee self-reflection and two-way performance dialogue.

attributes.name: goal_category
attributes.description: Classification of the goal scope and level. attributes.name: goal_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the goal, including context, expected outcomes, and success criteria. Provides comprehensive understanding of what the employee is expected to achieve.

attributes.name: goal_type
attributes.description: Nature of the goal measurement. attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goal is mandatory (required for all employees in a role or department) or optional (individually selected). Mandatory goals often relate to compliance, training, or core job functions.

attributes.name: is_stretch_goal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a stretch goal (aspirational target beyond normal expectations). Stretch goals are typically weighted differently in performance evaluations and partial achievement is often considered successful.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent progress review or check-in for this goal. Used to track regular monitoring and feedback cadence.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this goal record was most recently modified. Tracks the currency of goal data and supports change auditing.

attributes.name: manager_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and feedback from the manager regarding goal progress, challenges, support provided, or observations. Used for coaching and performance documentation.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target value (e.g., 'percent', 'viewers', 'hours', 'episodes', 'dollars', 'rating points'). Clarifies how the numeric target should be interpreted.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next progress review or check-in. Supports proactive performance management and ensures regular goal monitoring.

attributes.name: okr_alignment
attributes.description: Reference to the company-level or department-level OKR (Objectives and Key Results) that this goal supports. Ensures goal alignment with organizational strategy. May reference specific objective identifiers or descriptive text.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this goal. Critical goals are essential to business success; high priority goals are important but not mission-critical; medium priority goals are standard objectives; low priority goals are developmental or stretch targets.

attributes.name: progress_status
attributes.description: Current state of goal progress. Not started: work has not begun; in progress: actively being worked on; on track: progressing as expected; at risk: may not meet target; behind: falling short of milestones; completed: target achieved; exceeded: surpassed target; cancelled: goal no longer applicable.
