attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity that developed or delivers the training course (e.g., Media Broadcasting Learning & Development, Dalet Academy, Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers).

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Source of the training course: internal (developed and delivered by Media Broadcasting HR/L&D), external (third-party training vendor), vendor (system vendor training such as Dalet or Ericsson), industry association (MPA, ATSC, SCTE), or regulatory body (FCC-mandated training).

attributes.name: recertification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months after which the certification or training must be renewed or retaken to maintain compliance or currency (e.g., 12 months for annual cybersecurity awareness, 36 months for FCC regulatory training). Null if no recertification is required.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the training course as displayed in the learning catalog and on certificates.

attributes.name: training_course_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the training course by subject area: broadcast operations (playout, scheduling, transmission), regulatory compliance (FCC, EEO, COPPA), technical skills (MAM, CDN, encoding), leadership development, cybersecurity awareness, or editorial standards.

attributes.name: training_course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course: active (available for enrollment), inactive (temporarily unavailable), under development (being created or updated), retired (permanently discontinued), or suspended (on hold pending review or update).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the training course content, incremented with each major or minor revision (e.g., 1.0, 1.1, 2.0). Tracks course evolution and ensures participants complete the current version.

attributes.name: prerequisite_training_course_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on training_course (prerequisite_training_course_id)

products.name: training_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of an employee's enrollment and completion status for a specific training course or learning program. Captures enrollment date, scheduled session date, completion date, completion status (enrolled/in-progress/completed/failed/withdrawn), assessment score, pass/fail result, certificate issued flag, certificate expiry date, and training hours credited. Enables compliance tracking for mandatory FCC regulatory training, EEO training, and broadcast technical certifications required for licensed operations.

attributes.name: training_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training enrollment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee enrolled in the training course. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: previous_enrollment_training_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous training enrollment record that this recertification enrollment supersedes. Used to track recertification history and lineage. Null for initial enrollments.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the training course or learning program for which the employee is enrolled. Links to the training course catalog.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the employee commenced the training course. May differ from scheduled start date due to delays or early starts.

attributes.name: assessment_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the training assessment indicating whether the employee passed, failed, has a pending assessment, did not require assessment for completion, or has an incomplete assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numerical score achieved by the employee on the training assessment, test, or examination. Typically expressed as a percentage (0-100) or raw score. Null if no assessment was administered or not yet taken.

attributes.name: attendance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of scheduled training sessions or modules that the employee attended or completed. Calculated as (hours completed / hours scheduled) * 100. Used for compliance verification and completion criteria.

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the training certificate expires and recertification or refresher training is required. Null for certifications that do not expire or if no certificate was issued. Critical for tracking compliance with FCC technical certification requirements.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the training completion certificate was issued to the employee. Null if no certificate was issued.

attributes.name: certificate_issued
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a training completion certificate was issued to the employee upon successful completion. True if certificate was issued, False otherwise.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate identification number issued upon successful training completion. Used for verification and audit purposes. Null if no certificate was issued.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee completed all requirements of the training course. Null if training is not yet completed.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this training enrollment including tuition, materials, instructor fees, and facility costs. Used for training budget tracking and cost allocation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which the training expenses are allocated. Used for financial reporting and departmental budget tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the training cost amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: enrolled_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who initiated the enrollment (e.g., HR administrator, manager, or self-enrollment by employee). Used for audit trail and enrollment source tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee was enrolled in the training course. Represents the business event timestamp for enrollment initiation.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique enrollment reference number assigned to this training enrollment for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training enrollment indicating progression through the learning journey. Tracks whether the employee is enrolled, actively participating, has completed, failed, withdrawn, or had the enrollment cancelled.

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the enrollment indicating whether the training is mandatory (required by policy or regulation), voluntary (employee-initiated), recommended (suggested by manager), or compliance-driven (regulatory requirement such as FCC or EEO training).

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the instructor, facilitator, or trainer who delivered the training session. Null for self-paced online courses without instructor involvement.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this training is mandatory for the employee based on role, regulatory requirements, or company policy. True for mandatory training, False for optional training.

attributes.name: is_recertification
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this enrollment represents a recertification or refresher training for a previously completed course. True for recertification enrollments, False for initial certifications.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this training is required to meet regulatory compliance obligations such as FCC broadcast licensing requirements, EEO training mandates, or technical certification standards. True for regulatory-required training.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who last modified this enrollment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this training enrollment. May include accommodations provided, special arrangements, or other relevant information.

attributes.name: number_of_attempts
attributes.description: Count of how many times the employee attempted the training assessment or examination. Used for tracking learning progress and identifying employees who may need additional support.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the training assessment and achieve completion status. Used to determine pass/fail result. Null if no assessment is required for completion.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory framework or governing body requirement that mandates this training (e.g., FCC Broadcast License Compliance, EEO Training, OSHA Safety, SOX Financial Controls). Null if not regulatory-driven.
attributes.references: Federal Communications Commission (FCC), Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA)

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the training session or learning program is scheduled to conclude for this enrollment.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the training session or learning program is scheduled to begin for this enrollment.

attributes.name: training_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training content is delivered to the employee. Includes in-person classroom sessions, virtual instructor-led training, self-paced online courses, blended learning combining multiple methods, or on-the-job practical training.

attributes.name: training_hours_completed
attributes.description: Actual number of training hours completed by the employee. Used for tracking progress, compliance reporting, and crediting continuing education units.

attributes.name: training_hours_scheduled
attributes.description: Total number of training hours scheduled for this enrollment based on the course curriculum. Used for planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: Learning Management System (LMS) Course Duration Standards

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training is conducted. For in-person training, includes facility name or address. For virtual training, may include platform name (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams). Null for self-paced online courses.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee withdrew from the training course before completion. Null if the enrollment was not withdrawn.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or categorized reason for why the employee withdrew from the training. Used for analyzing training dropout patterns and improving course design. Null if not withdrawn.

attributes.name: retake_training_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on training_enrollment (retake_training_enrollment_id)

products.name: certification
products.description: Master record of professional certifications, licenses, and credentials held by Media Broadcasting employees — FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License (GROL), SBE (Society of Broadcast Engineers) certifications, SMPTE technical certifications, IT/cloud certifications, and professional credentials. Captures certification name, issuing body, certification number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, verification status, and associated job profile requirements. Critical for ensuring licensed broadcast operations are staffed with appropriately credentialed engineers.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the professional certification record. Primary key for the certification entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who holds this certification. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: certificate_url
attributes.description: Web URL or digital link to the electronic certificate or credential badge. Used for digital verification and display of credentials.

attributes.name: certification_category
attributes.description: Functional domain or technical discipline that the certification covers. Used to align certifications with job roles and departmental needs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_engineering|it_infrastructure|cloud_computing|network_engineering|audio_engineering|video_engineering|rf_transmission|compliance_regulatory|project_management|cybersecurity — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certification_code
attributes.description: Short code or abbreviation for the certification type. Examples: GROL, CBNT, CBT, CPBE, AWS-SAA, SMPTE-CTS. Used for internal classification and reporting.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Proficiency or seniority level represented by the certification. Entry-level certifications demonstrate foundational knowledge; expert and master levels indicate advanced expertise and leadership capability.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the professional certification, license, or credential. Examples: FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License (GROL), SBE Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT), AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SMPTE Certified Technology Specialist.
attributes.references: FCC Licensing Standards; Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) Certification Program; SMPTE Professional Development

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or license number issued by the certifying body. This is the official credential identifier that can be used for verification purposes.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Licensing System (ULS); SBE Certification Registry

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Active certifications are valid and current; expired certifications have passed their expiry date; suspended certifications are temporarily invalid; revoked certifications have been permanently withdrawn; pending verification certifications are awaiting confirmation; in-progress certifications are being pursued but not yet awarded.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the certification based on its nature and purpose. Regulatory licenses are legally required for specific broadcast operations; professional certifications demonstrate industry expertise; technical certifications validate specialized technical skills; vendor certifications are product-specific credentials; industry credentials are association-based qualifications.

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours_completed
attributes.description: Number of continuing education hours the employee has completed toward the current renewal cycle. Used to track progress toward recertification requirements.

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of continuing education or professional development hours required to maintain or renew the certification. Null for certifications without continuing education requirements.
attributes.references: SBE Recertification Standards; Industry Certification Body Requirements

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to obtain or renew the certification, including exam fees, training costs, and application fees. Used for workforce development budget tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost. Examples: USD, GBP, EUR, CAD.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_storage_path
attributes.description: File path or document management system reference to the scanned or digital copy of the physical certificate. Used for record retention and audit purposes.

attributes.name: employer_sponsored
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certification was sponsored or paid for by the employer. True if the company funded the certification; false if the employee self-funded it.

attributes.name: exam_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the certification exam, if applicable. May be a percentage, numeric score, or standardized score depending on the certification body. Null for certifications that do not have scored exams.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Null for certifications that do not expire. Critical for compliance tracking and renewal planning.
attributes.references: FCC License Renewal Requirements; SBE Recertification Standards

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is required by law or regulation for the employee to perform specific duties. True for FCC licenses and other legally mandated credentials; false for voluntary professional certifications.
attributes.references: FCC Regulations 47 CFR Part 73; Industry Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: is_required_for_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is a mandatory requirement for the employees current job role. True for certifications that are job prerequisites (e.g., FCC GROL for broadcast engineers); false for optional or supplementary credentials.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was originally issued or awarded to the employee. Used to calculate tenure and experience with the credential.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or regulatory authority that issued the certification. Examples: Federal Communications Commission (FCC), Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE), Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers (SMPTE), Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft, Cisco.
attributes.references: FCC; SBE; SMPTE; Industry Certification Bodies

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or username of the person who last modified this certification record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the certification must be renewed to maintain active status. Used for proactive renewal reminders and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, or context about the certification. May include details about specializations, endorsements, or unique circumstances.

attributes.name: passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the certification exam. Used to contextualize the exam score and assess performance relative to the standard.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was last renewed or recertified. Tracks ongoing maintenance of the credential.

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or institution that provided the training or preparation for the certification exam. May be the same as the issuing body or a separate training vendor.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was verified with the issuing body. Used for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the authenticity of the certification. Online registry checks use public databases; issuer confirmation involves direct contact with the certifying body; document review examines physical certificates; third-party services use specialized verification providers; self-attestation relies on employee declaration.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification of the certification with the issuing body. Verified certifications have been confirmed as authentic; pending verifications are awaiting response; failed verifications could not be confirmed; not required applies to internal or non-critical certifications.

attributes.name: renewed_certification_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on certification (renewed_certification_id)

products.name: disciplinary_action
products.description: Transactional record of formal disciplinary actions taken against Media Broadcasting employees — verbal warnings, written warnings, performance improvement plans (PIPs), suspensions, and terminations for cause. Captures action date, action type, policy violation description, investigation summary, corrective action required, response deadline, employee acknowledgment status, HR business partner assigned, legal review flag, and outcome. Maintained under restricted access per employment law requirements and feeds termination workflow when applicable.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the disciplinary action record. Primary key for the disciplinary action entity.

attributes.name: primary_disciplinary_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Media Broadcasting employee who is the subject of this disciplinary action.

attributes.name: tertiary_disciplinary_issuing_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or supervisor who issued the disciplinary action to the employee.

attributes.name: action_date
attributes.description: Date the disciplinary action was formally issued to the employee. This is the official date of record for the action and starts any applicable timelines.

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the disciplinary action, formatted as DA-YYYYNNNN for external reference and case tracking.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the disciplinary action: draft (being prepared), pending review (awaiting HR/legal approval), active (in effect), completed (action fulfilled or time elapsed), overturned (reversed on appeal), or expired (no longer on employee record per retention policy).

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disciplinary action severity level: verbal warning (informal counseling), written warning (first formal step), final warning (last chance before termination), performance improvement plan (PIP - structured remediation), suspension (temporary removal from duties), or termination for cause (employment ended due to policy violation).

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date the employee filed a formal appeal or grievance. Null if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has filed a formal appeal or grievance challenging this disciplinary action. True if appeal filed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the appeal or grievance process: upheld (original action stands), overturned (action reversed), modified (action reduced or changed), or pending (under review). Null if no appeal filed.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Specific actions, behavioral changes, or performance improvements the employee must demonstrate to resolve the disciplinary action. May include training completion, metric achievement, or behavioral modification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disciplinary action record was first created in the HR system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date the employee signed or electronically acknowledged the disciplinary action documentation. Null if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has acknowledged receipt and review of the disciplinary action documentation. True if acknowledged, false if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: employee_response
attributes.description: Written response or statement provided by the employee regarding the disciplinary action. May include explanations, disagreements, or mitigating circumstances. Null if no response provided.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date when the policy violation or performance issue that triggered this disciplinary action occurred. May precede the action date due to investigation time.

attributes.name: investigation_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the investigation conducted prior to issuing the disciplinary action, including interviews, evidence reviewed, and findings. Documents due process and fair treatment.

attributes.name: legal_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required legal review has been completed and approved. Null if legal review is not required.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disciplinary action requires legal department review and approval before issuance. Typically true for terminations, suspensions, or actions involving potential litigation risk.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal department representative who reviewed and approved this disciplinary action. Null if legal review was not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the HR system user who last modified this disciplinary action record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disciplinary action record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional confidential notes, context, or follow-up information related to the disciplinary action. May include manager observations, HR guidance, or case management details.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the disciplinary action: successful (employee met corrective action requirements and improved), unsuccessful (employee failed to improve, may lead to further action), in progress (action period still active), or terminated (employment ended as result of this action).

attributes.name: pip_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance improvement plan period if action type is PIP. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days from start. Null for non-PIP actions.

attributes.name: pip_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance improvement plan period if action type is PIP. Null for non-PIP actions.

attributes.name: policy_violated
attributes.description: Reference to the specific company policy, code of conduct section, or employment agreement clause that was violated. Includes policy number and title for traceability.

attributes.name: record_retention_date
attributes.description: Date until which this disciplinary action record must be retained in the employee file per employment law and company policy. After this date, record may be purged or archived per retention schedule.
attributes.references: Employment Law Record Retention Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the employee must provide a written response, complete required corrective actions, or demonstrate improvement. Null if no response is required.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: End date of suspension period if action type is suspension. Null for non-suspension actions.

attributes.name: suspension_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension is paid (true) or unpaid (false). Null for non-suspension actions. Paid suspensions are typically used during investigations; unpaid for disciplinary purposes.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of suspension period if action type is suspension. Null for non-suspension actions.

attributes.name: termination_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disciplinary action resulted in or triggered employee termination. True if termination occurred, false otherwise. Feeds termination workflow when true.

attributes.name: union_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether union notification is required for this disciplinary action per collective bargaining agreement. True for union-represented employees in positions covered by CBA disciplinary procedures.

attributes.name: union_notified_date
attributes.description: Date the union representative was formally notified of the disciplinary action. Null if union notification is not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: union_representative_name
attributes.description: Name of the union representative notified and involved in the disciplinary action process. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the policy violation type: attendance (tardiness, absenteeism), performance (failure to meet job standards), conduct (behavioral issues), safety (workplace safety violations), compliance (regulatory or legal violations), confidentiality (data/information breach), or harassment (workplace harassment or discrimination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: attendance|performance|conduct|safety|compliance|confidentiality|harassment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HR Policy Classification Standards, EEOC Guidelines

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific policy violation or performance issue, including facts, circumstances, and impact. Maintained as confidential employment record.

attributes.name: escalated_disciplinary_action_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on disciplinary_action (escalated_disciplinary_action_id)

attributes.name: appeal_status

attributes.name: complaint_description

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_taken

attributes.name: external_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external agency to which the grievance was reported (e.g., EEOC, OSHA, state labor department).

attributes.name: external_case_number

attributes.name: filed_date
attributes.description: The date when the formal grievance was officially filed with Human Resources, marking the start of the investigation timeline.

attributes.name: grievance_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the grievance case, formatted as GRV-YYYYNNNN for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: grievance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grievance case in the investigation and resolution workflow.

attributes.name: grievance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grievance based on the nature of the complaint: workplace harassment, discrimination, wage dispute, unsafe working conditions, union grievance filing, or retaliation.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The date when the alleged incident or violation that prompted the grievance occurred.

attributes.name: incident_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the alleged incident occurred (e.g., studio, office, remote work, production site).

attributes.name: investigation_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation was completed and findings were documented.

attributes.name: investigation_findings
attributes.description: Summary of the investigation findings, evidence collected, witness statements, and conclusions reached by the investigator.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the formal investigation of the grievance commenced.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the grievance record was last updated, reflecting the most recent change to case status or details.

attributes.name: legal_counsel_involved_flag

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the HR system user who last modified the grievance record.

attributes.name: resolution_date

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the resolution actions taken, corrective measures implemented, and any remediation provided to the complainant.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome

attributes.name: respondent_type

attributes.name: severity_level

attributes.name: union_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a labor union was involved in the grievance filing or resolution process.

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Name of the labor union representing the complainant or involved in the grievance process, if applicable.

attributes.name: union_representative_name

attributes.name: headcount_plan_id

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: org_unit_id

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this headcount plan was formally approved by the authorized approver. Marks the transition from draft to approved status.

attributes.name: approved_fte_count
attributes.description: The approved target headcount expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units for this org unit, job family, and fiscal year. Represents the authorized staffing level approved by finance and executive leadership.

attributes.name: attrition_assumption_percentage
attributes.description: The assumed annual attrition rate (as a percentage) used in workforce planning for this org unit and job family. Informs net hiring targets and replacement planning.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The total budgeted compensation and benefits amount allocated for this headcount plan (org unit, job family, fiscal year). Expressed in the budget currency and used for financial planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency budgeting for global Media Broadcasting operations.

attributes.name: contractor_fte_count
attributes.description: The planned or approved headcount for contractors and contingent workers expressed in FTE units. Tracked separately from permanent employee FTE for total workforce visibility.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who created this headcount plan record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this headcount plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_role_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this headcount plan record covers critical or hard-to-fill roles that require special attention in workforce planning and talent acquisition. True if critical; False otherwise.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte
attributes.description: The current actual headcount in FTE units as of the plan snapshot date. Used to calculate variance against approved FTE and identify open capacity.

attributes.name: diversity_hiring_target_percentage
attributes.description: The target percentage of new hires from underrepresented groups for this org unit and job family. Supports diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) goals and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this headcount plan applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with Media Broadcasting's annual budget and planning cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: intern_fte_count
attributes.description: The planned or approved headcount for interns and temporary student workers expressed in FTE units. Supports talent pipeline and early career program planning.

attributes.name: job_family

Aligns with Media Broadcasting's job architecture and talent segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_operations|content_production|engineering|sales|finance|hr|legal|marketing|it|executive — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this headcount plan record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this headcount plan record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: net_hiring_target
attributes.description: The net number of new hires required to achieve the approved FTE count after accounting for attrition and current filled FTE. Calculated as (approved_fte_count - current_filled_fte + expected_attrition).

attributes.name: open_requisition_count
attributes.description: The number of open job requisitions currently in the recruitment pipeline for this org unit and job family. Tracks active hiring efforts against the approved plan.

attributes.name: plan_approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of this headcount plan record in the budget and planning workflow. Tracks progression from draft through executive approval.

attributes.name: plan_effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which this headcount plan remains effective. Typically aligns with the end of the fiscal year or planning period. Null indicates an open-ended plan.

attributes.name: plan_effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this headcount plan becomes effective. Typically aligns with the start of the fiscal year or the beginning of a planning period.

attributes.name: plan_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and commentary on this headcount plan record. Captures business context, assumptions, constraints, or special considerations for workforce planning.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type or category of headcount plan (e.g., Annual, Quarterly, Mid-Year Revision, Strategic). Distinguishes between regular annual planning cycles and ad-hoc revisions.

attributes.name: plan_version_code
attributes.description: Version identifier for the headcount plan (e.g., FY2024-V1, FY2024-V2-REVISED). Supports multiple iterations of the annual plan as revisions are made during budget cycles.

attributes.name: planning_scenario
attributes.description: The business scenario or strategic context for this headcount plan (e.g., Baseline, Growth, Cost Reduction, Restructuring, Merger Integration). Supports scenario-based workforce planning.

attributes.name: remote_work_fte_count
attributes.description: The number of FTEs in this plan designated for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Supports workforce flexibility planning and real estate optimization.

attributes.name: succession_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether roles in this headcount plan require formal succession planning due to business criticality or leadership pipeline needs. True if succession planning is required; False otherwise.

attributes.name: union_fte_count
attributes.description: The number of FTEs in this plan covered by collective bargaining agreements or union membership. Critical for labor relations planning and compliance in broadcast operations.

attributes.name: variance_fte
attributes.description: The variance between approved FTE count and current filled FTE. Calculated as (approved_fte_count - current_filled_fte). Positive values indicate unfilled capacity; negative values indicate overstaffing.

attributes.name: revised_headcount_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on headcount_plan (revised_headcount_plan_id)

products.name: union_membership
products.description: Master record tracking each Media Broadcasting employee's union membership and collective bargaining agreement (CBA) affiliation — NABET-CWA (broadcast engineers/technicians), SAG-AFTRA (on-air staff), WGA (writers), IATSE (production crew), and Teamsters (drivers/facilities). Captures union name, local number, membership status, initiation date, dues deduction authorization, CBA reference, job classification under CBA, and grievance eligibility. Distinct from talent guild affiliations in the talent domain — this covers internal staff union membership only.

attributes.name: union_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the union membership record. Primary key for tracking each employee's union affiliation within Media Broadcasting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Media Broadcasting employee who holds this union membership. Links to the workforce employee master record.

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary work location or facility where this union membership applies. Union contracts may vary by location, and some employees may be covered by different CBAs at different facilities.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific bargaining unit to which this employee belongs. A bargaining unit is a group of employees with a clear community of interest who are represented by a union for collective bargaining purposes. Large employers may have multiple bargaining units for different job families, locations, or divisions.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) Bargaining Unit Determination Standards

attributes.name: cba_effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) Effective Start Date
attributes.description: Date when the current collective bargaining agreement became effective and binding. CBAs are typically negotiated for multi-year terms and this date marks the beginning of the current contract period.

attributes.name: cba_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current collective bargaining agreement expires. Negotiations for a successor agreement typically begin 60-90 days before expiration. If no new agreement is reached, the existing CBA may be extended or employees may work under the expired contract terms while negotiations continue.

attributes.name: cba_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference code or identifier for the specific collective bargaining agreement that governs this employee's terms and conditions of employment. Multiple CBAs may exist for different unions, job classifications, or facilities within Media Broadcasting.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) CBA Filing Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this union membership record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dues_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Amount of union dues deducted from the employee's paycheck each pay period. May be a flat amount or a percentage of gross earnings as specified in the collective bargaining agreement. Null if dues deduction is not authorized.

attributes.name: dues_deduction_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has authorized automatic payroll deduction of union dues. True means the employee has signed a dues checkoff authorization form and Media Broadcasting deducts dues from each paycheck and remits to the union. False means the employee pays dues directly to the union.
attributes.references: Labor Management Relations Act Section 302(c); Right-to-Work Laws

attributes.name: dues_deduction_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which union dues are deducted from the employee's paycheck. Must align with the employee's pay frequency and union requirements.

attributes.name: fair_share_fee_payer
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee pays a fair share or agency fee rather than full union dues. In some jurisdictions and under some CBAs, non-members who are covered by the union contract must pay a fee to cover the cost of representation, but this fee is typically lower than full membership dues. This practice varies by state right-to-work laws and recent Supreme Court rulings.
attributes.references: Janus v. AFSCME (2018); Right-to-Work State Laws

attributes.name: grievance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible to file grievances under the collective bargaining agreement's grievance and arbitration procedures. True for members in good standing. False for employees in probationary periods, suspended members, or those who have opted out of union representation where permitted by law.

attributes.name: health_welfare_plan_participant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health and Welfare Plan Participant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee participates in a union-sponsored health and welfare benefit plan. Many unions maintain multi-employer health plans that provide medical, dental, vision, and other benefits funded by employer contributions.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA); Affordable Care Act

attributes.name: initiation_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time initiation fee paid by the employee when joining the union. This fee covers administrative costs of processing the membership application and is typically specified in the union constitution. May be paid in a lump sum or through payroll deduction installments.

attributes.name: initiation_fee_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee completed payment of the union initiation fee. Membership may not be fully active until this fee is paid in full.

attributes.name: job_classification_code
attributes.description: Union job classification code that determines the employee's pay scale, work rules, and benefits under the collective bargaining agreement. Job classifications define specific roles, skill levels, and wage rates negotiated between the union and employer.

attributes.name: job_classification_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the union job classification under which the employee is covered. Examples include Camera Operator, Audio Engineer, Production Assistant, Broadcast Technician, Grip, Electrician, Driver, etc. This may differ from the employee's official job title in HR systems.

attributes.name: last_dues_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent union dues payment received from or on behalf of this employee. Used to track dues currency and membership good standing status.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this union membership record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: membership_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's union membership ended, either through withdrawal, termination of employment, or conversion to retired status. Null for active memberships.

attributes.name: membership_initiation_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee was formally initiated into union membership and became a full member. This may differ from the hire date if there was a probationary period or if the employee joined the union after starting employment.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employee's union membership. Active indicates full membership in good standing with dues current. Inactive indicates membership has lapsed or employee is on leave. Suspended indicates temporary suspension due to disciplinary action or non-payment. Pending indicates application submitted but not yet approved. Withdrawn indicates voluntary resignation from union. Retired indicates membership converted to retired status.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this union membership record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this union membership. May include information about dues payment arrangements, membership transfers, special accommodations, or historical context.

attributes.name: pension_plan_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee participates in a union-sponsored pension or retirement plan. Many unions, particularly in broadcasting and entertainment, maintain multi-employer pension plans funded by employer contributions negotiated in the CBA.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA); Multi-Employer Pension Plan Amendments Act

attributes.name: probationary_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's probationary period under the collective bargaining agreement ends. During probation, employees may have limited rights and protections. After probation ends, employees typically gain full seniority rights, just cause protection, and full grievance rights.

attributes.name: right_to_work_state
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee works in a right-to-work state where union membership and dues payment cannot be required as a condition of employment. This affects whether union security clauses in the CBA apply to this employee.
attributes.references: Labor Management Relations Act Section 14(b); State Right-to-Work Laws

attributes.name: seniority_date
attributes.description: Date used to calculate the employee's seniority for purposes of layoffs, recalls, shift bidding, vacation scheduling, and other seniority-based rights under the collective bargaining agreement. May be the original hire date or adjusted for breaks in service.

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: The local chapter or lodge number of the union to which the employee belongs. Local unions represent members in specific geographic regions or facilities and handle local grievances and contract administration.

attributes.name: union_member_number
attributes.description: Unique member identification number assigned by the union to this employee. This ID is used for union records, benefit claims, and communications. Different from the employee_id which is Media Broadcasting's internal identifier.

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Name of the labor union or guild to which the employee belongs. Primary unions for Media Broadcasting staff include NABET-CWA (National Association of Broadcast Employees and Technicians - Communications Workers of America) for broadcast engineers and technicians, SAG-AFTRA (Screen Actors Guild - American Federation of Television and Radio Artists) for on-air talent, WGA (Writers Guild of America) for writers, IATSE (International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees) for production crew, Teamsters for drivers and facilities staff, and DGA (Directors Guild of America) for directors.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Labor Management Relations Act

attributes.name: union_steward_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee serves as a union steward or shop steward. Union stewards are elected or appointed members who represent fellow workers in grievances, workplace disputes, and contract enforcement. Stewards have special protections under labor law and may have release time for union duties.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act Section 7; CBA Union Rights Provisions

attributes.name: prior_union_membership_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on union_membership (prior_union_membership_id)

products.name: course_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the training curriculum requirement between training courses and job profiles. It captures which courses are mandatory or optional for each job role, completion deadlines, recertification periods, and sequencing requirements. Each record links one training course to one job profile with attributes that define the compliance and learning path requirements for that specific role-course combination. Managed by HR and Learning & Development teams to ensure workforce compliance and skills development.. Existence Justification: This is a genuine operational M:N relationship representing training curriculum requirements managed by HR and Learning & Development teams. A training course applies to multiple job profiles (e.g., 'FCC Compliance Training' required for broadcast engineer, studio director, content scheduler), and each job profile requires multiple training courses (e.g., broadcast engineer needs technical certifications, safety training, regulatory compliance courses). The business actively manages this relationship by defining mandatory vs. optional courses, setting completion deadlines, updating requirements as regulations change, and tracking compliance.

attributes.name: course_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this course requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the job profile that has this training course requirement.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the training course that is required or recommended for the job profile.

attributes.name: applicable_job_profiles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job roles, job families, or organizational units for which this training course is applicable or required (e.g., Broadcast Engineers, Content Producers, Ad Sales Representatives, All Employees). Used to auto-assign training to employees based on their job profile. [Moved from training_course: This denormalized STRING field in training_course contains a comma-separated list of job profiles for which the course is applicable. This is the exact relationship data that should be normalized into the course_requirement association, where each job profile becomes a separate record with its own requirement attributes (is_mandatory, completion_deadline_days, etc.). The denormalized field proves the business operates this way but lacks proper normalization.]

attributes.name: completion_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of days from hire date or role assignment by which the employee must complete this training course. Used for onboarding and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: completion_order_sequence
attributes.description: Recommended or required sequence order for completing this course relative to other courses for this job profile. Supports learning path design where prerequisite courses must be completed before advanced courses.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this course requirement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this training requirement was retired or replaced for this job profile. Null if currently active. Enables historical analysis of training program evolution.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this training requirement became effective for this job profile. Supports historical tracking of curriculum changes.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training course is mandatory (true) or optional/recommended (false) for this job profile. Drives compliance tracking and enforcement.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this course requirement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: recertification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months after which employees in this job profile must retake or renew this training course. Supports ongoing compliance for roles requiring periodic recertification (e.g., FCC regulations, safety training).

attributes.name: requirement_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for why this course is required for this job profile. Examples: regulatory compliance (FCC, EEO), operational safety, technical competency, leadership development.

attributes.name: waiver_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement can be waived for employees in this job profile based on prior experience or equivalent credentials.

attributes.name: compliance_certification

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: fcc_license_number

attributes.name: manufacturer

attributes.name: model_number

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special configurations, known issues, or operational considerations specific to this transmission equipment unit.

attributes.name: operating_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Specific center frequency in megahertz at which the transmission equipment is configured to operate. Must align with FCC license authorization.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the transmission equipment in the broadcast workflow. Determines whether the equipment is available for on-air use or requires intervention.

attributes.name: power_output_kw
attributes.description: Maximum rated transmission power output of the equipment measured in kilowatts. Critical for coverage area calculation and FCC licensing compliance.

attributes.name: redundancy_role
attributes.description: Role of this equipment in the redundancy and failover architecture. Defines automatic switchover behavior during primary equipment failure to ensure broadcast continuity.

attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: snmp_community_string

attributes.name: useful_life_years

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date

attributes.name: replaced_transmission_equipment_id

attributes.name: control_room_adjacent

attributes.name: daily_booking_rate_usd

attributes.name: decommissioning_date

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system

attributes.name: floor_area_sqft

attributes.name: green_screen_available

attributes.name: hvac_type

attributes.name: operational_status

attributes.name: studio_name

attributes.name: studio_type

attributes.name: technical_specification

products.name: noc_monitor
products.description: Master configuration record for each monitored signal path, service, or system endpoint registered in the Network Operations Center (NOC) monitoring platform. Captures monitor name, monitored entity type (channel feed, satellite link, IP stream, encoder, transmitter), monitoring protocol (SNMP, MPEG-TS probe, SCTE-35 listener), alert threshold configuration, escalation tier, assigned NOC team, polling interval, and active status. Defines WHAT the NOC watches — distinct from noc_alert which captures WHAT went wrong.

attributes.name: noc_monitor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NOC monitor configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_facility. Business justification: NOC monitors are physically deployed at broadcast facilities to monitor equipment and signal paths. This FK links each monitor configuration to its deployment facility. No columns removed - geographic

attributes.name: signal_path_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.signal_path. Business justification: NOC monitors are configured to watch specific signal paths. The 'monitored_entity_type' field can be 'signal_path'. Links the monitoring configuration to the signal path being monitored for health, la

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.transmission_equipment. Business justification: NOC monitors watch transmission equipment health (transmitters, encoders, multiplexers). The 'monitored_entity_type' field can be 'transmission_equipment'. Links the monitoring configuration to the sp

attributes.name: alert_notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether alert notifications are currently enabled for this monitor. When false, alerts are logged but not sent to NOC teams.

attributes.name: alert_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold that, when exceeded or not met, triggers an alert. Interpretation depends on threshold_metric (e.g., packet loss percentage, bitrate Mbps, uptime percentage).

attributes.name: assigned_noc_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the NOC team responsible for responding to alerts from this monitor. Used for routing notifications and incident assignment.

attributes.name: auto_remediation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated remediation actions (e.g., service restart, failover trigger) are enabled for this monitor. When true, the NOC system may take corrective action without human intervention.

attributes.name: business_service_name
attributes.description: Name of the business service or channel that depends on this monitored entity. Links technical monitoring to business impact analysis.

attributes.name: compliance_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory or compliance frameworks this monitor supports (e.g., FCC_BROADCAST_LICENSE, ATSC_STANDARDS, SOX_CONTROLS). Used for compliance reporting and audit preparation.
attributes.references: FCC (Federal Communications Commission), ATSC Standards, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the NOC operator or system administrator who created this monitor configuration. Audit field for accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this monitor configuration record was first created in the NOC system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this monitor configuration was deactivated or superseded. Null for currently active monitors. Used for lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this monitor configuration became active and began generating alerts. Used for historical analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: equipment_model
attributes.description: Model number or product name of the monitored device. Helps identify firmware versions and known issues during incident response.

attributes.name: escalation_tier
attributes.description: Priority level for alert escalation. Determines which NOC team or management level receives notifications when this monitor triggers an alert.

attributes.name: expected_uptime_percent
attributes.description: Target uptime percentage defined in the SLA for this monitored service or device. Used to calculate SLA compliance and trigger breach alerts.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Current firmware or software version running on the monitored device. Critical for vulnerability management and compatibility tracking.

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Physical location or data center where the monitored equipment or service endpoint resides. Used for regional outage correlation and dispatch.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this monitor tracks the primary (active) instance in a redundant configuration. False indicates a backup or standby instance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the NOC operator or system administrator who last modified this monitor configuration. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this monitor configuration. Used to track configuration drift and change frequency.

attributes.name: monitor_category
attributes.description: High-level functional category of the monitored entity within the broadcast infrastructure. Used for dashboard organization and reporting rollups.

attributes.name: monitor_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this monitor within the NOC system. Used for system integration and API references.

attributes.name: monitor_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of what this monitor tracks, its business purpose, and any special configuration notes. Provides context for NOC operators.

attributes.name: monitor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to this monitoring endpoint or service. Used for identification in NOC dashboards and alert notifications.
attributes.references: SCTE (Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers) Monitoring Standards

attributes.name: monitor_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the monitor configuration. Active monitors generate alerts; inactive or suspended monitors do not trigger notifications.

attributes.name: monitored_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Network address or URL of the monitored service or device. May be an IP address, streaming URL, or API endpoint. Confidential as it exposes internal infrastructure topology.

attributes.name: monitored_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the infrastructure component or signal path being monitored. Determines the applicable monitoring protocols and alert thresholds.
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee) Infrastructure Standards

attributes.name: monitored_ip_address
attributes.description: IPv4 address of the monitored device or service endpoint. Used for network-level monitoring and diagnostics. Confidential infrastructure data.

attributes.name: monitored_port
attributes.description: TCP or UDP port number on which the monitored service listens. Used in conjunction with IP address for endpoint identification.

attributes.name: monitoring_protocol
attributes.description: Technical protocol or method used to collect telemetry and status data from the monitored entity. Examples include SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) for device polling, MPEG-TS probe for transport stream analysis, SCTE-35 listener for ad insertion markers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional operational notes, troubleshooting tips, or configuration context not captured in structured fields. Used by NOC teams for knowledge sharing.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel or integration used to deliver alert notifications to the assigned NOC team. Multiple channels may be configured per monitor.

attributes.name: polling_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which the NOC system queries or samples the monitored entity. Lower intervals provide faster fault detection but increase system load.

attributes.name: redundancy_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the redundancy or failover group this monitor belongs to. Multiple monitors in the same group represent primary/backup configurations.

attributes.name: remediation_script_path
attributes.description: File system path or identifier of the automated remediation script executed when this monitor triggers an alert. Confidential as it exposes automation logic.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level agreement tier associated with this monitored entity. Determines response time commitments and escalation procedures.

attributes.name: threshold_metric
attributes.description: The specific performance or quality metric being measured against the alert threshold. Examples: packet_loss_percent, bitrate_mbps, uptime_percent, latency_ms, error_rate.

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: Comparison operator applied to the threshold metric. Defines whether an alert is triggered when the metric exceeds, falls below, or equals the threshold value.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the equipment manufacturer or service provider for the monitored entity. Used for vendor-specific troubleshooting and support escalation.

attributes.name: parent_noc_monitor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on noc_monitor (parent_noc_monitor_id)

attributes.name: affected_channel_id

attributes.name: distribution_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technical service or platform component impacted by the alert event (e.g., OTT stream, linear feed, VOD platform). May be null for channel-specific alerts.

attributes.name: impacted_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subscriber.subscriber. Business justification: Critical streaming service alerts require identifying specific affected subscribers for proactive customer care outreach, SLA credit processing, and personalized service recovery. Incident management

attributes.name: noc_monitor_id
