products.name: tech_incident
products.description: Transactional record of each formal technology incident raised through the ITIL incident management process — broadcast signal failures, IT system outages, cybersecurity events, and infrastructure faults that require structured investigation and resolution. Captures incident number, incident category (broadcast, IT, network, security), priority (P1–P4), affected service, reported timestamp, assigned resolver team, escalation history, resolution timestamp, resolution description, root cause classification, and post-incident review flag. Distinct from noc_alert (automated monitoring trigger) — this is the formal ITIL incident record.

attributes.name: tech_incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the technology incident record. Primary key for the tech_incident product.

attributes.name: affected_channel_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broadcast channel impacted by the incident, if applicable. Links to the channel master data.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broadcast facility where the incident occurred. Links to broadcast_facility master data.

attributes.name: compliance_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.incident. Business justification: Technical incidents escalating to compliance incidents when regulatory impact occurs (transmitter failure causing off-air time, encoder failure causing caption loss). Real incident management workflow

attributes.name: noc_alert_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Network Operations Center (NOC) Alert Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the NOC alert that triggered or is associated with this incident. Links to noc_alert transactional data.

attributes.name: primary_tech_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that reported the incident. Links to user/employee master data.

attributes.name: quaternary_tech_closed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who formally closed the incident record. Links to user/employee master data.

attributes.name: related_change_tech_change_request_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the related change request if this incident was caused by or resolved through a change in the ITIL change management process.

attributes.name: related_problem_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the related problem record if this incident is linked to a known problem in the ITIL problem management process.

attributes.name: signal_path_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.signal_path. Business justification: Incidents affect signal paths (path degradation, routing failures, quality issues). The 'affected_service' field can reference a signal path. Links the incident to the specific signal path experiencin

attributes.name: tertiary_tech_resolved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technician or engineer who resolved the incident. Links to user/employee master data.

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific transmission or studio equipment involved in the incident. Links to transmission_equipment or studio equipment master data.

attributes.name: affected_service
attributes.description: Name of the business service or technical service impacted by the incident (e.g., Live News Broadcast, VOD Streaming Platform, Ad Insertion Service, Network Operations Center Monitoring).

attributes.name: affected_viewer_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of viewers or subscribers impacted by the incident, used for prioritization and business impact assessment.

attributes.name: assigned_resolver_team
attributes.description: Name of the technical support team or resolver group currently assigned to investigate and resolve the incident (e.g., Broadcast Engineering, Network Operations, IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity).

attributes.name: assigned_to_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual technician or engineer currently assigned to the incident.

attributes.name: closure_notes
attributes.description: Final notes and comments recorded when closing the incident, including confirmation of resolution and any follow-up actions.

attributes.name: closure_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the incident was formally closed after confirmation that the resolution was successful and no further action is required.

attributes.name: contact_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the incident was reported: phone call, email, self-service portal, automated monitoring system, or escalated from NOC alert.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this incident record was first created in the incident management system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: escalation_history
attributes.description: Chronological log of escalation events, including timestamps, escalation reasons, and teams/individuals escalated to. Stored as structured text or JSON.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation tier of the incident. 0 = no escalation, 1 = first-level escalation, 2 = second-level escalation, 3+ = senior management escalation.

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Business impact analysis describing the scope and severity of the incident effect on broadcast operations, audience reach, revenue, and service availability.

attributes.name: incident_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the incident type: broadcast signal failures, IT system outages, network disruptions, cybersecurity events, infrastructure faults, or playout automation issues.

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the incident symptoms, impact, and circumstances as reported by the user or detected by monitoring systems.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique incident ticket number assigned by the ITIL incident management system. Format: INC followed by 8 digits.

attributes.name: incident_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the incident category (e.g., signal loss, server crash, DDoS attack, power failure, encoder malfunction).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this incident record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes that the service or broadcast was unavailable or degraded due to the incident.

attributes.name: post_incident_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or completed date of the post-incident review meeting.

attributes.name: post_incident_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal post-incident review (PIR) or post-mortem is required for this incident. True = PIR required (typically for P1/P2 incidents), False = no PIR needed.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the incident based on impact and urgency. P1 = Critical (immediate broadcast impact), P2 = High, P3 = Medium, P4 = Low.

attributes.name: reported_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person or system that reported the incident.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the incident was first reported to the service desk or detected by monitoring systems. This is the principal business event timestamp for the incident lifecycle.

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the actions taken to resolve the incident, including troubleshooting steps, fixes applied, and workarounds implemented.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the incident was resolved and the service restored to normal operation.

attributes.name: resolved_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the technician or engineer who resolved the incident.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying root cause of the incident (e.g., hardware failure, software bug, configuration error, human error, environmental factor, third-party service failure).

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause identified during post-incident analysis.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Technical severity assessment of the incident impact on broadcast operations and services.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident resolution exceeded the committed SLA response or resolution time target. True = SLA breached, False = SLA met.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: The committed SLA resolution time target in minutes for this incident priority level.

attributes.name: tech_incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the incident within the ITIL workflow: new (just reported), assigned (routed to resolver), in_progress (actively being worked), pending (awaiting external input), resolved (fix applied), closed (confirmed resolved), cancelled (invalid/duplicate). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|assigned|in_progress|pending|resolved|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: workaround_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temporary workaround was applied to restore service before a permanent fix. True = workaround used, False = permanent fix applied immediately.

attributes.name: workaround_description
attributes.description: Description of the temporary workaround applied to restore service while a permanent fix is developed.

attributes.name: parent_tech_incident_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tech_incident (parent_tech_incident_id)

products.name: encoder_config
products.description: Master configuration record for each video and audio encoder deployed across broadcast and streaming infrastructure — hardware encoders (Harmonic, Elemental), software encoders, and cloud encoding instances. Captures encoder name, encoder type (hardware/software/cloud), assigned facility or platform, input format, output codec (H.264, HEVC, AV1), output bitrate ladder, audio codec, latency mode (low-latency, standard), redundancy mode, assigned channel or stream, firmware version, and operational status. Enables encoder fleet management and configuration governance.

attributes.name: encoder_config_id

attributes.name: assigned_channel_id

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id

attributes.name: transmission_equipment_id

Normalizing by linking encoder config t

attributes.name: assigned_stream_name

attributes.name: audio_channels

attributes.name: audio_codec
attributes.description: Audio codec used for encoding audio streams (AAC, Dolby AC-3, Dolby E-AC-3/DD+, Opus, MP3).

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the encoder was commissioned and put into operational service.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: Named configuration profile or preset applied to the encoder defining encoding parameters, quality settings, and output specifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: drm_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Digital Rights Management encryption is enabled on the encoder output for content protection (True/False).

attributes.name: drm_system
attributes.description: Name of the DRM system integrated with the encoder (e.g., Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay, AES-128).

attributes.name: encoder_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or asset tag code for the encoder used in inventory and configuration management systems.

attributes.name: encoder_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the encoder for operational identification and reference.

attributes.name: encoder_type
attributes.description: Classification of the encoder deployment model: hardware-based encoder appliance, software encoder running on server, or cloud-based encoding instance.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Current firmware or software version installed on the encoder, used for compatibility tracking and update management.

attributes.name: input_format
attributes.description: Video and audio input format accepted by the encoder (e.g., SDI, HDMI, IP/RTP, RTMP, file-based).

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Network IP address assigned to the encoder for management, monitoring, and stream delivery.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance or service performed on the encoder.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this encoder configuration record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: latency_mode
attributes.description: Encoding latency profile configured for the encoder: low-latency for live sports and interactive content, ultra-low-latency for real-time applications, or standard for non-time-sensitive content.

attributes.name: management_url
attributes.description: Web-based management interface URL for accessing the encoder configuration and monitoring dashboard.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous output streams or renditions that the encoder can produce concurrently.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned maintenance or firmware update for the encoder.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special configuration details, known issues, or maintenance history related to the encoder.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the encoder: active (in production use), standby (ready for failover), maintenance (undergoing service), offline (not operational), or decommissioned (retired from service).

attributes.name: output_bitrate_ladder
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of output bitrates in kbps or Mbps defining the Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) ladder for multi-quality streaming (e.g., 500kbps, 1Mbps, 2.5Mbps, 5Mbps, 8Mbps).

attributes.name: output_codec
attributes.description: Primary video codec used for encoding output streams (H.264/AVC, HEVC/H.265, AV1, VP9, MPEG-2).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4, ISO/IEC 23008 HEVC, AV1 Specification

attributes.name: output_protocol
attributes.description: Streaming protocol used for encoder output delivery (e.g., HLS, MPEG-DASH, RTMP, SRT, Zixi).

attributes.name: platform_assignment
attributes.description: Name of the streaming platform, channel, or service to which this encoder is assigned (e.g., OTT platform, linear channel, FAST channel).

attributes.name: power_consumption_watts
attributes.description: Typical power consumption of the encoder hardware in watts, used for capacity planning and energy cost calculation.

attributes.name: rack_location
attributes.description: Physical rack and unit position where the hardware encoder is installed in the data center or broadcast facility (e.g., Rack-12-U24).

attributes.name: redundancy_mode
attributes.description: Redundancy configuration role of the encoder in the broadcast infrastructure: primary (main encoder), backup (failover encoder), active-active (load-balanced), or none (standalone).

attributes.name: support_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the active maintenance or technical support contract covering this encoder.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date

attributes.name: base_encoder_config_id

products.name: satellite_transponder
products.description: Master record for satellite transponder capacity leased or owned by Media Broadcasting for uplink/downlink broadcast distribution. Captures transponder ID, satellite name (e.g., SES-1, Intelsat 21), orbital slot, frequency band (C-band, Ku-band, Ka-band), transponder bandwidth (MHz), polarization, leased capacity (Mbps), lease start/end date, carrier/provider, uplink facility, downlink coverage footprint, and operational status. Manages satellite capacity inventory for linear broadcast distribution.

attributes.name: satellite_transponder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the satellite transponder capacity record. Primary key for the satellite transponder master resource entity.

attributes.name: broadcast_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast facility used for uplink transmission to this transponder. Links to the broadcast_facility master data for operational coordination.

attributes.name: broadcast_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.broadcast_standard. Business justification: satellite_transponder.encoding_standard (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to broadcast_standard master. Satellite transponders operate under specific broadcast standards that should link t

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.vendor_contract. Business justification: satellite_transponder.contract_number (STRING) should be normalized to FK to vendor_contract. Satellite transponder capacity is leased under vendor contracts with carriers. This links the transponder

attributes.name: bandwidth_mhz
attributes.description: Total bandwidth capacity of the transponder in megahertz. Determines the data throughput and number of channels that can be multiplexed on this transponder.

attributes.name: carrier_provider
attributes.description: Name of the satellite operator or service provider leasing the transponder capacity (e.g., SES, Intelsat, Eutelsat, Telesat). Primary vendor contact for technical support and service issues.

attributes.name: center_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Center operating frequency of the transponder in megahertz. Used for uplink/downlink tuning and interference coordination with adjacent transponders.

attributes.name: channel_capacity
attributes.description: Number of standard-definition or high-definition channels that can be multiplexed on this transponder given current encoding parameters. Used for channel lineup planning.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the transponder capacity was first activated and put into operational service for broadcast distribution. Marks the start of the assets operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transponder record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the lease cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency financial reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the transponder capacity was retired from active service. Nullable for active transponders. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and capacity planning.

attributes.name: downlink_coverage_footprint
attributes.description: Geographic coverage area of the transponders downlink beam (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, CONUS). Defines the audience reach and distribution territory.

attributes.name: eirp_dbw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Effective Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP) in dBW
attributes.description: Effective Isotropic Radiated Power of the transponder in decibels relative to one watt. Measures the signal strength at the coverage area, critical for reception quality planning.

attributes.name: frequency_band
attributes.description: Radio frequency band used by the transponder for transmission. C-band (4-8 GHz) offers rain fade resistance, Ku-band (12-18 GHz) provides higher bandwidth, Ka-band (26-40 GHz) enables high-throughput applications.
attributes.references: ITU Radio Regulations - Frequency Allocation Table

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance activity or service check performed on the transponder or associated ground equipment. Supports preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the transponder lease or capacity agreement expires. Nullable for owned capacity or indefinite agreements. Used for renewal planning and capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: lease_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the transponder lease or capacity agreement becomes effective. Critical for capacity planning and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: leased_capacity_mbps
attributes.description: Amount of transponder capacity leased by Media Broadcasting in megabits per second. Represents the contracted data rate available for broadcast distribution.

attributes.name: modulation_scheme
attributes.description: Digital modulation technique used (e.g., QPSK, 8PSK, 16APSK, 32APSK). Higher-order modulation increases throughput but requires better signal-to-noise ratio.

attributes.name: monthly_lease_cost
attributes.description: Monthly recurring cost for leasing the transponder capacity. Used for budget planning, cost allocation, and financial reporting. Excludes one-time setup fees.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned maintenance or service review. Used for proactive maintenance planning and service continuity assurance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional operational notes, special configurations, service restrictions, or historical context relevant to this transponder capacity.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the transponder capacity. Active indicates in-use for broadcast, Standby for backup/redundancy, Maintenance for service windows, Decommissioned for retired capacity, Reserved for future deployment.

attributes.name: orbital_slot
attributes.description: Geostationary orbital position of the satellite in degrees (e.g., 101.0W, 28.2E). Defines the satellites fixed position relative to Earth for broadcast coverage planning.
attributes.references: ITU Radio Regulations - Geostationary Satellite Orbit Allocation

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transponder capacity is owned outright, leased from a satellite operator, shared with other broadcasters, or reserved under a long-term agreement.

attributes.name: polarization
attributes.description: Signal polarization type: Horizontal, Vertical, Right-Hand Circular Polarization (RHCP), or Left-Hand Circular Polarization (LHCP). Enables frequency reuse by transmitting on orthogonal polarizations.
attributes.references: ITU-R Recommendation BO.1516 - Satellite Polarization Standards

attributes.name: primary_service
attributes.description: Primary broadcast service or channel distribution purpose for this transponder (e.g., Linear TV Distribution, VOD Delivery, Contribution Feed, Occasional Use). Supports capacity allocation and service planning.

attributes.name: redundancy_configuration
attributes.description: Redundancy role of this transponder in the broadcast distribution architecture. 1+1 provides full hot backup, N+1 shares backup across multiple primaries, None indicates no redundancy.

attributes.name: regulatory_license_number
attributes.description: FCC or equivalent regulatory authority license number authorizing the use of this transponder for broadcast transmission. Required for compliance reporting and spectrum management.

attributes.name: satellite_name
attributes.description: Name of the satellite hosting this transponder (e.g., SES-1, Intelsat 21, Eutelsat 7B). Critical for uplink/downlink coordination and transmission planning.

attributes.name: sla_uptime_percentage
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed uptime percentage for the transponder service (e.g., 99.9%, 99.95%). Used for vendor performance monitoring and service credit calculations.

attributes.name: transponder_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the transponder, typically assigned by the satellite operator or internal asset management system. Used for operational reference and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SCTE (Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers) - Satellite Standards

attributes.name: transponder_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation for the transponder, often including satellite name and transponder number for easy identification by broadcast operations teams.

attributes.name: transponder_type
attributes.description: Technology classification of the transponder: Analog (legacy FM), Digital (DVB-S/S2), or Hybrid (supporting both). Modern broadcast operations primarily use digital transponders.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transponder record was last modified. Enables change tracking and data quality monitoring for capacity management.

attributes.name: uplink_antenna_size_meters
attributes.description: Diameter of the uplink antenna dish in meters. Larger antennas provide higher gain and better signal quality for satellite transmission.

attributes.name: backup_satellite_transponder_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on satellite_transponder (backup_satellite_transponder_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `media_broadcasting_ecm`.`_metrics`.`advertising_ad_inventory`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Key advertising inventory metrics for planning and performance."
  source: "`media_broadcasting_ecm`.`advertising`.`ad_inventory`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "inventory_type"
      expr: inventory_type
      comment: "Type of advertising inventory (e.g., spot, sponsorship)."
    - name: "inventory_status"
      expr: inventory_status
      comment: "Current status of the inventory (e.g., booked, available)."
    - name: "channel_id"
      expr: channel_id
      comment: "Identifier of the broadcast channel."
    - name: "demographic_segment_id"
      expr: demographic_segment_id
      comment: "Target demographic segment identifier."
    - name: "inventory_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', inventory_date)
      comment: "Month of the inventory date for time‑based analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "inventory_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of inventory records."
    - name: "total_estimated_impressions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_impressions AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated impressions across inventory."
    - name: "total_estimated_reach"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_reach AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated unique reach."
    - name: "avg_estimated_grp"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_grp AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Gross Rating Point (GRP) estimate."
    - name: "avg_rate_card_cpm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(rate_card_cpm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average CPM from the associated rate card (as stored on inventory)."
    - name: "total_hut_index"
      expr: SUM(CAST(hut_index AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of HUT index values for inventory."
$$
metric_views.description: Key advertising inventory metrics for planning and performance.
